name: Woke up and tidied up
description: The New Year's Day alarm went off right on time. Because he was thinking about today's family outing, he didn't linger in bed. After getting up, he opened the curtains; outside the window was a clear, cloudless sky, and a ray of winter sunlight fell on the succulent on the desk. While washing up, he deliberately shaved, then changed into the thick dark gray hoodie and black down jacket to guard against the low outdoor temperature in the ancient town.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Enjoying New Year's Day breakfast
description: Sitting down at the dining table, my mother had already laid out steaming millet porridge, her signature pork-and-scallion buns (the aroma instantly felt familiar and comforting), and two small plates of pickled vegetables. My father, while watching the news on his phone, kept muttering that it would be crowded at the ancient town today and told me to drive slowly. I nodded in response, feeling that such an ordinary morning was peaceful and pleasant, and that the first day of the new year should begin just like this.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-departure preparation and route confirmation.
description: After breakfast, he helped his mother clear the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, then carefully checked his backpack: thermos, power bank, and DSLR camera (thinking he'd photograph some New Year prints and woodworking material) — none missing. He discussed with his parents that they would first stop by Caozhuang Flower Market to add some new members to the "succulent brothers" on the balcony, then go to Yangliuqing Ancient Town to look at New Year pictures. His parents readily agreed. The family of three put on their coats and went downstairs with laughter and chatter.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to Caozhuang Flower Market
description: Driving my father's old Passat, I slowly left the residential complex with my parents and headed west along Zhongbei Avenue. Along the way, my mother looked at the winter sunlit street scene outside the window and brought up funny memories of going to the market during Spring Festival when I was little. The atmosphere in the car was warm. My father quietly mentioned that he remembered a shop in Caozhuang Market that specialized in handcrafted wooden items by old craftsmen, and said we could stop by in a bit.
location: Drive: Huating International Community to Caozhuang Flower Market, via Zhongbei Avenue.

name: Visited Caozhuang Flower Market
description: Entering the market, the warm, humid floral fragrance rushed at me. Familiar with the place, I went straight to my usual store, "Xiaopang Succulents," and spent over twenty minutes carefully selecting a fine "Ebony Hybrid" and a few pink "Peach Egg" succulents for my "succulent army," and chatted with the owner about winter watering control. Meanwhile, my mother bought a pot of narcissus and a few bundles of lucky bamboo. Afterwards, remembering my father's words, I lingered for a long time at the "Old Li Woodware" stall in another corner of the market, carefully examining a hand-carved elm wood tea coaster and studying its mortise-and-tenon structure. Seeing how attentively I was looking, the old man even explained a few things to me in detail.
location: Caozhuang Flower Market, 260 meters northeast of the intersection of Feixia Road and Yuhe Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove on to Yangliuqing Ancient Town
description: Loaded with purchases from the flower market, they drove south along Liuxia Road. He had previously used his phone to navigate to the parking lot near Guangming Hall in Yangliuqing Ancient Town, and, considering the New Year's Day crowds, deliberately avoided the most congested entrance traffic. His mother fiddled with the newly bought daffodil bulbs in the car, while his father was still savoring the craftsmanship of the wooden pieces they had just seen, saying the dovetail slot on the tea tray was truly well made.
location: Driving: from Caozhuang Flower Market to Yangliuqing Ancient Town, via Liuxia Road

name: Visit the Yangliuqing New Year Painting Market
description: After parking the car, the family of three strolled leisurely into the ancient town. The buildings with grey tiles and black bricks, the bright red lanterns hanging high everywhere, the Spring Festival couplets with auspicious words, and the New Year pictures in various forms brought the festive atmosphere to its peak. He accompanied his mother as she stopped at various stalls, helping her pick out the most classic New Year picture of a doll holding a fish, meaning “surplus year after year”, and exquisite paper-cut window decorations, and bargained with the vendors together with her. From time to time, he raised his camera to capture the veteran craftsmen who were printing New Year pictures by hand with woodblocks, recording moments of this traditional craft.
location: Yangliuqing Ancient Town Scenic Area, at the intersection of Guyi Street and Heyan Avenue, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Market break and sharing memories of the older generation
description: Tired from walking, the family of three sat down to rest at a long-established tea soup stall by the street. Each ordered a bowl of steaming tea soup brewed from a dragon-mouth copper kettle. My father held the hot tea, looked at the lively scene, and, moved by the moment, began telling me about how he spent New Year's Day at Tianjin No. 1 Machine Tool Plant when he was young: the factory get-togethers, the commendations on the honor roll, and workers hanging colorful flags together at the factory gate... I listened intently, asking for more details now and then, and gained a deeper understanding of that era of rigor and collective honor of my parents' generation.
location: Wangji Tea Soup Shop, Yuhe Renjia Food Street, Yangliuqing Ancient Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch near the ancient town
description: After resting, the family of three found a local restaurant called "Old City Street Bistro" on the ancient town food street. Considering his parents' tastes, he ordered a steaming dish of pork and cabbage stewed with vermicelli, pan-fried pork tenderloin, and two bowls of zhajiang noodles. The portions were generous and the flavors were authentic. As they ate, they discussed how to arrange the newly bought New Year pictures when they got home in the afternoon, and the dinner table was filled with a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.
location: Laocheng Street Restaurant, Yuhe Renjia Food Street, Yangliuqing Ancient Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Drove back home
description: After lunch, he drove his parents back. On the way, his mother was a little tired and dozed against the seat. His father looked at the Xiqing street scenes outside the window and occasionally chatted with him about the heating temperature at home and new goods that had arrived at the group-buying pickup point near the community gate. He drove steadily, enjoying this quiet companionship.
location: Driving: from Yangliuqing Ancient Town to Huating International Residential Community, about 8 kilometers in total.

name: Returning home to organize New Year goods and family interaction
description: After getting home, the three of us spread out the New Year paintings, Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, and lucky characters we had bought on the living room floor, making the whole living room festive. I hurriedly took the newly bought succulents to the balcony, repotted each one into a new small clay pot, filled in soil, and spread top dressing stones. Then I returned to the living room and, together with my father, gestured and planned which couplet to put on the front door and which window to place the paper-cuts on for the best look on New Year's Eve. My mother, meanwhile, brewed a pot of tea and watched the two of us discuss, with a satisfied smile on her face.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal rest and relaxation
description: The afternoon was his time to rest and recharge. Back in the room, instead of sleeping, he first opened his phone and logged into the WeChat group of an ancient coin collecting forum. A local collector from Tianjin had posted a Beiyang 34th Year dragon dollar with a warm, mellow patina. With great interest, he left several comments discussing the depth of strike and the edge teeth. Then he opened Bilibili and watched the latest clips of a popular competitive variety show, a little mental relaxation before the upcoming workday.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: A cozy New Year's Day family dinner.
description: In the evening, the familiar aroma floated out of the kitchen. Mother, wearing an apron, was busy at the stove. On the table was a feast of New Year dishes: bright red braised pork, tender steamed sea bass, a plate of stir-fried broccoli, and a bowl of tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the dining table under the warm yellow light. Father made an exception and poured himself a small glass of baijiu, and I took a small sip to keep him company. As we enjoyed the meal, we shared what we had seen and felt at the flower market and the old town during the day, laughing constantly. The air was filled with peace and warmth.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Chatting and watching TV with parents in the living room.
description: After the meal, my mother cleared the dishes, and I took the initiative to do the washing up. Afterwards, the family sat on the sofa in the living room and watched the New Year's Eve gala on Tianjin TV for a while. My father commented on the crosstalk performers in the show, while my mother preferred watching the singing and dancing performances. I leaned back on the sofa, replying to New Year greetings from friends on WeChat with my phone, while enjoying the relaxing time with my family.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare annual performance review materials in the study.
description: After his parents returned to their room to rest, he came to the study on time. He opened his laptop and pulled up, one by one, the records of the three major projects he handled in 2024, technical achievements (including a structural optimization simulation report), and monthly personal work improvement logs. Based on the key points for tomorrow's meeting with Senior Engineer Gao, he carefully organized a PPT outline, especially highlighting the finite element analysis model he had created this year to solve the 'precision robotic arm bracket fatigue' problem, and anticipated some technical detail questions Senior Engineer Gao might ask.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, reviewing the day, and relaxing before bed
description: Finished preparing the materials, feeling much more grounded. Got up and took a hot shower in the bathroom, washing away the day's fatigue. Back in the bedroom, instead of turning off the light immediately, I leaned against the headboard and quickly reviewed the key data and conclusions prepared for tomorrow's interview in my mind, making sure nothing was missing. Then I scrolled through my phone for a while, saw Zheng Kai and Liu Yang calling for a gaming session on New Year's Day evening in the WeChat group, and replied that I'd arrange it tomorrow night.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime sleep
description: Turned off the desk lamp and closed my eyes. Although my mind was still a little active, my body was sleepy. After settling my breathing, I soon drifted into a peaceful sleep, storing up energy for the workdays of the new year ahead.
location: Room 1402, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: Woken up by the 7:10 alarm, despite the chill outside the covers, I knew in my heart this was a key workday. After a quick wash and grooming in front of the mirror, I reminded myself to stay focused and efficient today.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and final preparations.
description: Mom Wang Xiulan had already prepared a hot breakfast: millet porridge, jianbing, and pickled vegetables. While eating, I chatted briefly with Mom about today's work talk with my supervisor, to reassure her. After the meal, I packed the performance review materials (including the finite element analysis report) and the notebook prepared last night into the commuter bag, and put on the thickest hardshell jacket to cope with the outdoor cold and smog.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute by e-bike
description: Put on the helmet and gloves, and wheeled out the electric scooter. Traffic on the road was slightly sparser than before the holiday, but riding in the fog required extra caution. It took about 35 minutes to arrive at the company, and I charged the electric scooter at the charging pile downstairs.
location: Huating International Community to Haitai Development Office Building

name: Workstation preparation and warm-up
description: Punched in at the company and got a cup of hot water at the water dispenser. At my desk, I turned on the computer, reviewed the performance self-evaluation materials and key case analysis prepared last night, and wrote down on a sticky note three key points for today's conversation with the Senior Engineer: 1. Demonstrate core project capabilities; 2. Communicate honestly about project management shortcomings; 3. Clarify the direction of digital development.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Have a one-on-one performance review with my supervisor
description: At the agreed time, he walked into Gao Zhiyuan's office with the document folder. The conversation was professional and candid. Senior Engineer Gao first affirmed your achievement of having the independently designed core component pass acceptance, then, regarding the project delay, he pointed out your shortcomings in cross-departmental coordination based on his early career experiences. You carefully wrote down every suggestion in your notebook.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Jointly formulate annual core development goals.
description: The review ended and the conversation turned to future development. After several rounds of discussion with Engineer Gao, you finally finalized your three core goals for 2025: 1. Lead at least one key technical breakthrough; 2. Integrate Python script optimization into the design process; 3. Improve management capability by proactively taking on a project coordination role. Engineer Gao encouraged you to break these goals down into quarterly plans.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Conversation review and email drafting
description: Back at your desk, while your memory was still fresh, you quickly organized the key points of the morning conversation and the jointly developed goal list into a simple review memo, and began drafting a thank-you email to Engineer Gao, attaching the organized goal list, ready to send to him for confirmation in the afternoon.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: At noon, went with colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to the usual "Zhang Ji Malatang" downstairs. The three ate hot, self-serve malatang while chatting about their New Year's experiences. You also shared your feelings about the morning talk with Senior Engineer, and Zhou Tao and the others shared their expectations for the new year's work.
location: Zhang's Malatang, ground-floor commercial unit, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, returned to the company, put on an eye mask at the workstation, and took a 20-minute brief meditation break to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Refining the goal list and planning action paths
description: In the afternoon, feeling energetic. You broke down the 3 goals identified in the morning into quarterly and monthly action plans: within the Q1 quarterly plan, focus on completing an online course on Python applications in mechanical design, and start taking on cross-departmental coordination for a small project.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Explore directions for optimizing Python
description: To achieve the goal of being a "digital design pioneer," you started searching tech forums and GitHub for cases of "Python + SolidWorks automation," bookmarked 3 open-source libraries and 2 in-depth technical articles, and recorded your initial ideas in your study spreadsheet.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Organized work logs and sent emails.
description: Just before leaving work, he organized today's work process and newly collected Python materials into the work log. Then he formally sent the thank-you email prepared in the morning, along with the refined target checklist attachment, to Senior Engineer Gao, and CC'd himself.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Brief project communication meeting
description: While getting water in the break room, I ran into project manager Wang Peng. Wang Peng took the initiative to ask about your performance review and mentioned that the new project would start next week, possibly with a technical challenge phase. You followed the conversation and briefly asked about the technical difficulties of the new project, preparing in advance for a possible future challenge.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute after work and package pickup at the community
description: He cleaned up his desk and turned off the computer. He swiped his work badge to clock out, got on his electric bike, and headed home. On the way, he stopped by the Yiyi Community Group Buy Store on Yingyu Road to pick up several bags of Tianjin-produced Xiaozhan rice that his mother had ordered in the group chat yesterday, plus the seasonings she needed for cooking tonight.
location: Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Tianjin

name: Arrive home and have family dinner
description: After arriving home, you washed your hands and changed into loungewear. At the dinner table, you took the initiative to share the morning's performance review with your parents, especially the senior engineer's recognition of your independent design ability and your career plans for the new year. Mom was delighted and kept adding food to your bowl. Dad encouraged you in his brief way: 'Once you set a goal, don't be nervous—just work at it steadily.'
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Study room review and document organization
description: After dinner, he went into the study, integrated the handwritten conversation notes from the day with the electronic review memorandum, and produced a well-structured PDF titled '2025 Annual Performance Review and Personal Development Retrospective Report', which he saved to his personal work files.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Systematic learning of Python and SolidWorks applications
description: Start systematic learning. You open your laptop and, based on the open-source case you found in the afternoon, start debugging your first basic SolidWorks macro command script by yourself, aiming to achieve 'one-click modification of the drawing title block'. You encounter a parameter passing error. You repeatedly check the code and consult the API documentation, and finally run it successfully around 21:30.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal leisure: ancient coin forum and videos
description: Finished efficient studying, you switched to leisure mode. Lying in bed, opened the "Ancient Coin Garden" forum, browsed the latest discussion thread about "Xianfeng Heavy Treasure of the Qing Dynasty", and casually replied to a beginner's question. Then scrolled through Bilibili for a while, watched a clip from the new variety show "New Competitive Forces", and relaxed your mind.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After washing up, he set the alarm for 7:10 tomorrow morning. Lying in bed, he thought back on the fulfilling day: he had successfully completed the performance review, finalized the annual direction, and made a breakthrough in learning programming. He felt full of anticipation for tomorrow's challenges.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Sleep
description: I close my eyes, calmly anticipating tomorrow, and fall asleep peacefully.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wash-up and breakfast
description: At 7:10 in the morning, the alarm went off and I got up, feeling refreshed. I washed up quickly. As I passed through the living room, my mother Wang Xiulan was already preparing breakfast; she said she had made jianbing guozi and soy milk today. At 7:40 I sat down at the dining table and had breakfast with my father Ye Jianguo, and casually mentioned to my mother that last night's cold chicken breast salad had been delicious. She responded happily that she would make it often, gently setting the stage for the formal dietary communication at dinner.
location: Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting and package pickup
description: After breakfast, I put on a thick coat, gloves, and helmet, and left on an e-bike at 8:00 sharp. On the way, I stopped by the Yiyi Community Group-buying Store near the neighborhood, gave the pickup code, collected the package for the book 'Project Management in Practice' that had arrived the previous day, and put it in the e-bike's rear trunk. Then I continued riding to the company, arrived at the Haitai Development Office Building at 8:25, parked the bike in the designated shed, swiped the card to enter the building, took the elevator to the office on the 8th floor, brewed a cup of tea, and turned on the computer to prepare for the day's work.
location: Yiyi Community Group-buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, then to the 8th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Refine the first-quarter action plan.
description: At 8:50 I started handling several routine project emails and replied to project manager Wang Peng to confirm the meeting time for next week. At 9:15 I focused, took out my personal development plan and performance review records, and broke down the annual goals into specific actions for the first quarter: first, sign up for a structured Python advanced online course, aiming to complete the basic modules before the end of February; second, proactively apply to Gao Zhiyuan to join the company's newly formed technology pre-research group, targeting early March; third, start reading the book Project Management in Practice that I had just picked up. To this end, I made a three-month study schedule, printed it out with Excel, and posted it at my workstation. During this time I also checked the internal technical forum and course platform, and my thinking was very clear.
location: Workstation, 8th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal organizing and project meeting prep
description: After stretching and loosening his neck, his colleague Li Xiang came over to discuss a parameter optimization issue for a transmission structure. The two discussed the drawings on the screen for over ten minutes, and Ye Mingxuan offered his own suggestions. Then he started organizing the materials for the afternoon project communication meeting, copied the Python script that had been debugged the day before to a USB drive, and made sure the afternoon presentation would go smoothly.
location: Workstation, 8th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: At noon, he invited his deskmate colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to eat at the malatang restaurant downstairs from the company in Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, a place they often frequented. They ordered a mildly spicy broth base and added beef and a variety of vegetables. During the meal, Zhou Tao talked about wanting to go skiing in Ji County on the weekend, while he shared his plan to possibly visit the antique market in Zhongbei Town on the weekend. The atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and scheduling a physical examination
description: After returning to the office, he rested at his workstation for 15 minutes. By 1 p.m. his energy had recovered, and he remembered the physical exam appointment. He took out his phone, opened WeChat, and found the chat window with his family doctor, Liu Wentao. He sent a message to book the routine annual physical exam for tomorrow morning (January 4). A few minutes later, Dr. Liu replied to confirm that he should come to the clinic at 8:30 tomorrow morning and that he needed to fast. After receiving the confirmation, he immediately set an alarm for 7:15 tomorrow morning and added a note in the phone's memo app: “fasting, no food or water.”
location: Workstation, 8th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon project communication meeting and work.
description: At 1:30 p.m., attended the “Motor Base Lightweighting” proposal meeting organized by project manager Wang Peng, demonstrated how the Python script that was successfully debugged yesterday can automatically calculate some parameters, and received recognition from Gao Zhiyuan. The meeting lasted until 3 p.m. Afterward, I returned to my workstation, continued to refine the design sketch based on meeting feedback, and called colleagues from the purchasing department to communicate about the supply lead times of two new aluminum alloy materials. After 5 p.m., I finished the last email, spent 15 minutes reviewing and updating the work log and confirming tomorrow's plan, turned off the computer, and clocked out on time at 5:30 p.m.
location: Conference room and workstation, 8th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute home from work
description: At 17:30, he left the company on his electric bike on time and rode along the familiar route toward home. Traffic was not heavy at this time, and he rode smoothly all the way to the entrance of Huating International Community.
location: From No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Discussed the diet plan during dinner and enjoyed family time.
description: When he got home, his mother was busy in the kitchen, and he helped bring the dishes to the table. Tonight's meal was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed fish, and a broccoli and chicken breast salad dressed with olive oil—noticeably lighter than usual. He took a bite and found it refreshing, and took the opportunity to tell his mother that he wanted to control his weight, hoping that meals at home would be less oily, less salty, and more steamed or boiled. His mother was taken aback for a moment, his father Ye Jianguo also nodded in support, and then his mother readily agreed to work on healthier dishes in the future. After dinner, he proactively helped clear the table and took the kitchen trash downstairs. Back in the living room, he watched the news with his parents for a while and chatted briefly about the medical check-up arrangements for the next day. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Living room and dining room, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal interests and leisure time.
description: This period of time was entirely his own. He first went back to the study, opened the package picked up that morning—the book "Project Management in Practice"—flipped through the title page and table of contents, and roughly planned the order of reading. Then he went to the balcony to check the succulents and watered a somewhat shriveled "Orange Monroe". Next, he sat at the desk, took out the "Catalog of Chinese Machine-Made Silver Dollars", turned to the page about the "Sun Yat-sen Three Sails coin, 18th year of the Republic" that Lao Zhao had discussed on the forum, carefully studied and compared, and made several notes in his notebook. In the middle, he opened his phone and sent a voice message to his friend Xu Ming about writing a file-processing script in Python. Xu Ming replied with a joke; he finished reading it with a smile, enjoying a relaxed and pleasant evening.
location: Tianjin City, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, Building 2, study and balcony.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: Near 22:00, remembering that tomorrow's medical checkup requires fasting and no water, went to the kitchen for a last sip of water, then set the phone alarm to 7:15 tomorrow morning. Then went to the bathroom, took a thorough shower, brushed teeth and rinsed mouth, making sure all cleaning was completed before 22:00. After that, changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reviewing the day: the detailed plan was completed, the checkup was booked, and the diet plan was initially achieved, feeling very satisfied and fulfilled. Then scrolled through Bilibili for a while and watched highlights from "Street Dance of China", relaxing his mind and preparing for sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime sleep
description: At exactly 23:00, he turned off the bedside lamp and lay down. Looking back on this Friday, everything had been advancing step by step in an orderly way. He felt grounded and at ease, and soon fell asleep, storing up energy for the next day's physical exam and the new week's work.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: On an early weekend morning, fine snow was falling outside the window and the sky was gloomy. Ye Mingxuan woke up in his bedroom and felt that he had rested well. After washing up on an empty stomach, he changed into comfortable loungewear. His mother, Wang Xiulan, had prepared warm millet porridge and a plate of boiled greens. He took a few bites and drank some water. His mother reminded him to bring his medical record booklet. He nodded in agreement, put on his thick black down jacket, picked up his folding umbrella, and got ready to go out.
location: Building 13, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Went to the community health service center for the annual physical exam and then returned home
description: Ye Mingxuan left Huating International Community and walked about 10 minutes along Zhongbei Avenue to reach the Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center (No. 76 Xingguang Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin). After self-check-in at the registration hall on the first floor, he received the physical examination form. He went to the physical examination department on the second floor and, under the guidance of Dr. Liu Wentao, began the annual physical exam. He completed blood routine, urine routine, electrocardiogram, blood pressure measurement, and height and weight checks in sequence. During the blood draw, he cooperated with the nurse by naturally rolling up his left sleeve. After receiving the summary report, Dr. Liu interpreted the results: height 1.73 meters, weight 75.2 kg, BMI 25.1, which was at the overweight threshold. Fortunately, core indicators such as blood pressure and blood sugar were normal, but he needed to increase aerobic exercise and strictly control his diet. Ye Mingxuan listened carefully and immediately used his phone to book a Saturday follow-up appointment in early March. After leaving the health service center, on his way home he passed the Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store at Room 104, Building 12, Mengheyuan, Yingyu Road, picked up a parcel that had arrived the day before, and then returned to his home in Huating International Community.
location: Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center, No. 76 Xingguang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returned home to rest and leafed through a new book.
description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan first drank a glass of warm water to relieve the fatigue of being on an empty stomach. name: Relaxed by listening to an ancient coin collecting program.

location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Turned off the last light, put my phone on the nightstand, and closed my eyes peacefully to fall asleep, ready for the weekend.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and home tidying
description: Woke up naturally in the warm winter sun, feeling in good spirits. Weighed himself; the 75.0 kg reading brought back memories of last night's indulgence, so he quickly drank a large glass of warm water. Then he tidied up the PMP books and succulents spread out on the desk, and moved several pots of Haworthia and Echeveria to the south-facing windowsill to let them enjoy the rare winter sunlight.

name: Breakfast and plan check

The staff confirmed that there were still openings for the wheel-throwing experience class from 13:00 to 16:00 this afternoon, and he immediately signed up via WeChat Pay.

participant.name: Staff member at the pottery studio.

name: Studying and reviewing at home.

Afterward, he briefly thought about the weekend diet control plan and reminded himself to exercise restraint at tonight's barbecue with Zhang Wei.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycle to Yangliuqing Ancient Town.
description: At 11:30, left on time, put on a fleece-lined jacket, helmet, and gloves, and got on his electric bike. The winter sun shone on him; although the wind was a bit cold, he felt full of anticipation for this novel craft trip. The total distance was about 5 km, a 15-minute ride.

name: Lunch and a stroll in the ancient town.

He ordered a bowl of hot beef hand-pulled noodles and added a braised egg. After eating, he strolled along the stone-paved streets of the ancient town for about ten minutes, enjoying the leisurely weekend atmosphere so different from the usual factory days.
location: Old Ma's Beef Noodles, Qingyuan Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

After a brief explanation of the theory and a demonstration of the teacher's techniques, Mingxuan started working with his hands. On the spinning potter's wheel, the clay initially would not cooperate, but slowly, under his palms, it found its center, gradually rose, and took the shape of a cylinder. He was completely focused, forgetting the complex data and drawings at work. After repeated attempts, with the teacher's help, he finally pulled a small, crooked but fully formed cup. He added a "handle" to it and planned to use it as a drinking cup after firing.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Yangliuqing Town, No. 17 Qingyuan Road, Nitu Laboratory Pottery Studio.

name: Studio wrap-up and artwork storage
description: After the experience, he carefully carved the mark Y.MX 2025.01.11 on the bottom of the clay body. The staff told him that bisque firing and glazing would take two weeks and that they would notify him when the finished piece was ready. He filled out the form, chose a deep blue kiln-transmutation glaze, and hoped the finished piece would be a pleasant surprise.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Yangliuqing Town, No. 17 Qingyuan Road, Nitu Laboratory Pottery Studio.

name: Ancient town stroll and phone replies.
description: He walked out of the studio and planned to take a casual stroll around the ancient town. His phone buzzed—it was a WeChat message from his childhood friend Zhang Wei, saying he had already arrived at the usual place and asking whether to order two extra grilled kidneys. Mingxuan smiled and replied, "We'll talk when I get there—you decide!" and shared some photos of his pottery-making from the afternoon.
location: Streets of Yangliuqing Ancient Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycle to the barbecue restaurant.

name: Arrive early to meet Zhang Wei

The two greeted each other with a smile, and Zhang Wei handed him a bottle of Dayao Jiabin as they started chatting. Mingxuan looked at the menu and deliberately ordered two skewers of grilled vegetables to prepare for tonight's dietary control.
location: Old Flavor Grilled Skewers, Guangming Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: The old eatery was buzzing with voices and full of lively energy. Zhang Wei ordered beef tendon slices, grilled chives, and grilled sliced mantou buns, and also specially asked for a bottle of Dayao Jiabin. The two chatted while they ate; Zhang Wei shared the details of his wedding preparations (best man suit sizes, bridal party game arrangements), while Mingxuan told him about the fun of playing with clay in the afternoon. He remembered the rule he had set for himself and deliberately controlled his drinking, having only one bottle of beer.
location: Old Flavor Grilled Skewers, Guangming Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After dinner, take a walk to help digestion.
description: After walking out of the skewer restaurant, the two strolled along the sidewalk for a few minutes, chatting about work and buying a house. When Zhang Wei heard that he was planning to buy a house, he said he could ask a friend who works in real estate. After parting, Mingxuan rode his electric bike home against the night breeze.
location: Sidewalk near Guangming Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return home, wash up, and weigh yourself.
description: Returning home, he greeted his parents, who were still watching TV, and went back to his room. After taking a shower, he stepped onto the scale with some trepidation — 75.2 kg, indeed a slight rebound. He let out a long breath. None of this was unexpected, but it strengthened his determination to strictly carry out the plan tomorrow.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Making a precise plan for tomorrow
description: Opened the memo app on his phone and solemnly wrote down tomorrow's to-do list: 7:30 get up and weigh himself; 8:00 breakfast (oatmeal with milk); 9:00-10:30, Limei Fitness (40 minutes on the treadmill + core training); 12:00 lunch (homemade chicken breast and vegetable salad); afternoon free arrangement (organize house-viewing materials / ancient coin forum). After writing it, he felt much more at ease.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and ancient coin appreciation.

Meanwhile, he browsed a few new posts on the "Guquan Yuandi" forum and replied to fellow collector Zhao Jianguo's question about a Chongning Tongbao coin.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading PMP.
description: He carefully put away the ancient coins, leaned against the headboard, and opened Chapter 2 of Project Management in Practice. Although it was the weekend, he had not forgotten his exam-prep plan. After reading for 15 minutes, he felt drowsy, so he closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment mixed with slight guilt.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning weigh-in and disciplined breakfast.
description: After waking up naturally in the soft light of a cloudy day, the first thing Ye Mingxuan did was weigh himself. Seeing 74.6kg, 0.6kg lighter than last night's 75.2kg, the number after water metabolism made him feel relieved. Keeping yesterday's promise, he politely declined the bread his mother had prepared. In the kitchen, he made himself a bowl of instant oatmeal with skim milk and boiled an egg. His mother, Wang Xiulan, muttered, "How can you handle just this?" He smiled while eating and explained, "Today I need to scrape off the oil from yesterday's barbecue."
location: Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning study time: ancient coin discussion and tackling design calculations.
description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan first sat down at his desk and opened his laptop. Instead of diving straight into design calculations, he first dealt with the unfinished "homework" from the previous night—the issue of the patina on that "Hubei Guangxu Yuanbao" coin. He logged into the collecting forum, compared the high-definition photos Teacher Zhao had sent last night with the ones he had taken, looked up information to confirm two possible causes and cleaning methods, and organized his analysis into a WeChat message of about 200 characters to send to Teacher Zhao for advice. After finishing that small task, he took a deep breath, opened the design manual, and began calculating the torque at key stress points on the core transmission module of the project. He listed all the variables in an Excel spreadsheet and, applying mechanics of materials formulas, derived and double-checked the calculations step by step. In the middle, he took a short break and went to the balcony to add some water to the Chihuahua succulent.
location: Master bedroom/study, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch: homemade chicken breast salad.
description: The morning calculations went smoothly, and Ye Mingxuan was in a good mood. As a 'remedy' for yesterday's barbecue, he made a hearty salad himself with lettuce, red cabbage, cherry tomatoes, and ready-to-eat chicken breast, drizzled with homemade vinaigrette. He deliberately avoided the pork rib soup his mother had simmered and drank a glass of warm water with the salad. At the dining table, while eating, he browsed an ancient coin trading group on his phone for a while. When he saw a 'Sichuan copper coin' in good condition, he saved a few photos for later research.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

After the alarm went off, he felt much more refreshed, returned to the bedroom, changed into running shoes and quick-dry sportswear, grabbed a towel and water bottle, and got ready to head to the gym.
location: Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

location: Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin (walking from Huating International Community to Tower B, New City Center Office Building)

He selected the preset “interval run” program and ran at a steady pace of 7 minutes per kilometer for 40 minutes, covering a total of about 5.7 kilometers. Sweat soaked his back, but he felt the greasy feeling left in his body from yesterday being expelled. After finishing the cardio, he did not leave immediately. Instead, he went to the yoga mat area and did three additional sets of planks and two sets of crunches, taking about 15 minutes in total, to make up for the “debt” from not going to the gym yesterday. Coach Wang Jian saw him, came over to say hello, and praised him: “You're so disciplined even when you're by yourself.”
location: Limei Fitness Center, 4th floor, Building B, New City Center Office Building, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: After the workout, Ye Mingxuan did a full stretch in the rest area to prevent soreness the next day. Then he took a shower, changed into clean clothes, sat on a bench at the gym entrance for 5 minutes, and drank half a bottle of water. After that, he walked 28 minutes back home along the same route.
location: Returned from Limei Fitness Center, Block B, New City Center Office Building, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, via Zhongbei Avenue.

name: Afternoon work: CAD drafting and finishing design calculations
description: Arriving home, Ye Mingxuan was full of energy. He sat straight down at his desk and transferred the calculation results derived in the morning into the CAD software on his computer. This was his favorite moment, watching the mechanical structure composed of lines appear on the screen from nothing. He carefully drew the gear mesh diagram of the transmission module and marked the key dimensions and tolerances. When the last line was completed, he saved the drawing with satisfaction and marked the item 'Core Transmission Module Design Calculation' as 'Completed' in the project schedule.
location: Master bedroom/study, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Family assistance and pre-evening relaxation
description: Ye Mingxuan closed his notebook and walked out of the study. He saw his father Ye Jianguo sitting on the living room sofa watching the evening news, so he walked over, said hello, and asked how his father's chess games at the park had gone that day. Then he took the initiative to go into the kitchen and asked his mother, “Mom, what's for dinner? I'll help.” He helped trim a bunch of chives, wiped the dining table clean, and set out the bowls and chopsticks.
location: Living room and kitchen, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and warm conversation
description: Dinner was home-style dishes made by his mother: garlic broccoli, steamed sea bass, and tomato egg drop soup. The family of three ate and chatted. Ye Mingxuan shared the results of his afternoon workout and drawing. His father nodded approvingly and said, 'Drawings are the language of engineers—you need to practice them solidly.' His mother mainly listened, occasionally putting food into his bowl.
location: Dining room, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Residential Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Anticipating and defusing: a conversation about matchmaking
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan and his father continued sitting in the living room watching the news, while his mother cleared the table. After washing the dishes, his mother came over with her phone and pulled up a photo: “Xiaoming, look, this is the daughter of your Aunt Li's colleague. She's a teacher in Hexi District, one year younger than you, and has real poise. Do you want to add her on WeChat and chat?” Ye Mingxuan was prepared. He took the phone, glanced at it, and said to his mother with a smile: “Mom, she looks pretty gentle. But I think this isn't the best time. You see, my work is just picking up, and I've saved a bit of my bonus. I want to use that money to secure a house first. Once I have my own place, isn't it more reassuring to talk about relationships?” His father Ye Jianguo chimed in: “That's right. Mingxuan makes sense. He has his own plans for his life; don't worry about it.” His mother sighed, but didn't press further. She just muttered, “Then weigh it yourself, and don't delay.” The conversation went even more smoothly and calmly than expected.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, Building 2, Unit 1, Room 803, living room

name: Late-night planning and personal improvement
description: Back in the study, Ye Mingxuan felt very calm and clear about his goals. He pulled out the dark-green-covered notebook and solemnly wrote down three words on the blank first page: "Buying a house — promotion — dating." After thinking for a while, he added a line of small text after them: "Seek the way of development on a stable foundation." Then he opened an Excel file on his laptop, which contained the information on the five second-hand houses in Xiqing District he had shortlisted earlier. Taking into account the latest listing news for a certain community mentioned by Zhang Wei on WeChat last night, he re-compared and ranked the listings based on total price, area, down payment requirement, monthly mortgage payment, and other information, according to his own affordability and commuting convenience. After finishing this "homework," he felt extremely grounded. Next, fulfilling his promise from yesterday, he took out the exam-prep book "Project Management Practice" and began reading Chapter 3, "Identifying Project Stakeholders," carefully underlining the key points.
location: Master bedroom/study, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime routine: organize bag and relax.
description: Before going to bed, Ye Mingxuan set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning. Then he took out his commuter bag and checked it: work ID, keys, power bank, earphones. He went back to the study and put the book Project Management in Practice into the bag, planning to read a few pages during lunch break the next day. Finally, he took a hot shower, dried his hair with a bath towel, and changed into pajamas.
location: Bedroom and hallway, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Sleep preparation and mental reset
description: Ye Mingxuan turned off the bedside lamp, leaving only a small night light. Lying in bed, he briefly reviewed the day: healthy eating, efficient exercise, tackling work, a peaceful family, and clear planning. He felt that everything had been truly carried out—a typical ISTJ-style perfect Sunday. His heart was filled with a sense of control and accomplishment. He put on his earphones, listened to white noise, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 803, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and commute preparation
description: The phone alarm rang on time at 7:00. Ye Mingxuan got up and first went to the bathroom to weigh himself; the electronic scale showed 74.4 kg, 0.2 kg lighter than yesterday, which made him happy. After washing up, his mother Wang Xiulan had already set breakfast on the table: hot millet porridge, a boiled egg, and a small plate of pickled vegetables. Ye Mingxuan sat down and ate breakfast quietly, and reminded his mother that it was snowing lightly outside today and she should dress warmly when going out.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, Building 6, Unit 2, Room 302

name: Commuting to work
description: Wearing a thick black outdoor jacket, helmet, and gloves, Ye Mingxuan set off from Huating International Community on his electric bike. The road was somewhat slippery due to light snow, so he rode steadily and did not dare to go too fast. On the way, he listened to an industry podcast via Bluetooth earphones, which was about the application of new materials in precision transmission systems. After riding for about 35 minutes, he parked the electric bike in the non-motor vehicle garage on the basement level of the office building, then walked 2 minutes to the lobby of Building B, Haitai Development Office Building.
location: Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Work Preparation and Structural Design (Part 1)
description: After clocking in at the company, Ye Mingxuan first brewed a cup of hot green tea, turned on the computer, and checked the emails received over the weekend. He then opened CAD software and began concentrating on designing the structure of the control module on the overall framework already set up. He first laid out the positions of several key micro motors and sensors, and switched to 3D view to check for interference with surrounding structures.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: After resting for a few minutes and stretching his wrists, Ye Mingxuan continued working and completed the sketch design of the auxiliary support component. During this time, his colleague Li Xiang came over to discuss a detail about the layout of the heat dissipation fins. The two sketched on the screen for a bit, and Ye Mingxuan, based on his calculations, proposed a solution that balanced both strength and heat dissipation. Near 12 o'clock, he saved two versions of the drawings and quickly noted a few key parameters in the project log.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues

Ye Mingxuan, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang went downstairs and walked about 10 minutes to the malatang restaurant in Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park that they often went to near the company. Ye Mingxuan chose a clear broth base, adding more lettuce, baby bok choy, and tofu, with only a few beef meatballs. Sitting in the warm restaurant, he ate while listening to Zhou Tao complain about the bizarre encounter at his weekend blind date, while Li Xiang talked about last night's ball game. Ye Mingxuan chimed in, sharing his experience yesterday of making a small wooden item (a small wooden spoon). Li Xiang was very interested in woodworking and asked many details. The walk was 10 minutes each way, and eating and chatting took about 40 minutes.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation, put on an eye mask, leaned back in his ergonomic chair, and took a 20-minute nap to store up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Initial inspection of core transmission module optimization.
description: After splashing water on his face to refresh himself, Ye Mingxuan opened the drawings of the core transmission module finished yesterday and, together with the control module structure newly designed that morning, began re-examining several key connection points and support points.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Self-care for shoulder and neck discomfort.
description: After half an hour of working at his desk, Ye Mingxuan felt the muscles in the back of his neck and shoulders starting to tense up. He immediately stood up, went to the pantry on his floor to pour himself a cup of hot water, set a phone alarm to go off every 45 minutes, and then did a simple set of neck and shoulder stretches in the corridor for 5 minutes. After returning to his desk, he took out two heat patches from the drawer, peeled them open, and applied them to the back of his neck and trapezius.
location: Tea room and workstation, 4th floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Fine optimization and detail adjustments of the core transmission module
description: After applying a heating pad, the soreness eased somewhat, and Ye Mingxuan went back to work. He carefully performed virtual assembly of the auxiliary support components completed in the morning with the core transmission module, repeatedly checked the dimension chain, and fine-tuned the fit tolerances at the connections to ensure the solution achieved optimal stability and manufacturability. The alarm went off every 45 minutes, and each time he stood up, walked a few steps, and rubbed his neck.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Work wrap-up and preparation for tomorrow.
description: Half an hour before leaving work, Ye Mingxuan saved the final version of the design drawings and updated today's progress log in the project management system, describing the specific optimization details and parameters. Afterwards, he organized the materials needed for the next morning's regular meeting, put them in his commuter bag, and said goodbye to Zhou Tao, who was still working overtime.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute to the gym after work.

He followed the planned route and rode to Limei Fitness Center, taking about 25 minutes in total. After arriving, he parked the electric bike in the designated area at the gym entrance and spent 5 minutes changing into his workout gear.
location: Limei Fitness Center, No. 88 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

location: Yiyi Community Group-buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: His parents had already eaten dinner, and his mother had left food for Ye Mingxuan. Ye Mingxuan heated up the meal in the microwave and ate a bowl of rice with stir-fried dishes, accompanied by two pieces of fermented bean curd. After dinner, he sat on the living room sofa and watched the national evening news with his parents. He mentioned to his father the second-hand home he had previously looked at in Xixiu Garden, Zhongbei Town. His father thought the community was a bit far from the metro station, but its nearby Zhongbei Primary School was good, and the two chatted briefly about it. Meanwhile, his mother was opening a package beside them — it was the PMP mock exams Ye Mingxuan had bought.

As he read, he organized the knowledge framework in his notebook and hand-drew a mind map linking process groups such as identifying risks, qualitative/quantitative analysis, and planning responses. When he read the parts related to actual work, such as schedule risk caused by changes to technical solutions, he found it very inspiring.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening leisure: polishing antique coins and browsing forums.
description: After studying, Ye Mingxuan got up to wash up. While washing his face, he used a spray bottle to water a few pots of succulents next to his computer desk.
