location: Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute: drive to the company.
description: Ye Mingxuan picked up his commuter bag and car keys, went downstairs, and started the car. Out of habit, he turned on the radio, tuned to FM100.5 Tianjin Music Radio, and listened to the morning news and traffic reports. The Friday morning rush hour was not heavy, and the drive was smooth, arriving at the company in about 15 minutes.
location: Along the route from Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Morning work: refine the 3D model.
description: After arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan first went to the break room to get a cup of hot water, then turned on his computer. The core task of the morning was to refine the 3D model of the transmission bracket. Based on the simulation feedback he discussed with Li Xiang yesterday, he began to make careful adjustments: first he selected several key mounting surfaces of the bracket and used the "Draft" feature to add a 2-degree draft angle, then used the "Move Face" command to fine-tune a few clearance spaces. Next, he renamed the placeholder-style feature names in the feature tree to the logically clear "Bracket_Base" and "Rib_Support_Left". While modifying, he mentally walked through the simulation analysis process Li Xiang would perform next week. Around 10:30, he stopped to drink some unsweetened oolong tea he had brought and rolled his shoulders.
location: Workstation, 16th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and casual chat
description: When the lunch break bell rang, Zhou Tao came over on time and patted Ye Mingxuan on the shoulder: "Hey, Xuan-ge, let's go. What should we eat for lunch?" Ye Mingxuan also wanted to talk about the side job from yesterday, so he closed his laptop and said, "Let's go, malatang. About what you said yesterday—is it reliable or not?" The two talked as they walked to the malatang shop they often went to downstairs from the company. While waiting for the food, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to ask Zhou Tao about the specific details of the side job. Zhou Tao explained that a friend of his ran a small non-standard automation factory and wanted to find someone to work part-time helping revise some part drawings, paid by the piece, with flexible hours. Ye Mingxuan listened carefully, but considering that he would soon need to learn Python, do woodworking, and review for exams, he clearly said he didn't have the energy for now and politely declined, but thanked Zhou Tao for thinking of him. Zhou Tao said he understood and would recommend him if something suitable came up later.
location: Zhang's Malatang, 1st Floor, Tiankai Huayuan Science Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: After eating malatang and returning to the company, it was still early. Ye Mingxuan didn't go straight back to his desk, but went to the break room to heat up a cup of black coffee he had brought from home that morning in the microwave, then leaned by the window and scrolled on his phone for a few minutes, looking at new posts in the ancient coin collecting forum. The several pots of succulents he had brought back from Caozhuang Flower Market last week were soaking up the sun on the windowsill; he sprayed them with a little water and felt much more relaxed.
location: Pantry and workstation on the 16th floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work: model finalization and review.
description: As soon as the afternoon work started, Ye Mingxuan checked the 3D model he had modified that morning as a whole again, confirming that the changes had not caused interference or errors. Then he opened the self-check list and went through each item: material, wall thickness, and mold opening direction. Everything looked good, so he saved the final model file and change log, ready to submit to Li Xiang on Monday.
location: Workstation, 16th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Follow up on the delivery schedule of outsourced parts
description: After completing the model review, Ye Mingxuan picked up his phone and called Manager Liu, the sales manager of "Hengda Precision Die-Casting Co., Ltd." in Beichen District, Tianjin. His tone was calm but direct: "Hello, Manager Liu, this is Ye Mingxuan from Haitai Precision. I'd like to confirm the machining progress of the bracket housing part... I heard that many factories are limiting production capacity before the holiday. How is your production scheduling? Can you deliver as originally planned two weeks before the Spring Festival?" Manager Liu said that because orders were piling up before the new year and the production line was tight, delivery would likely be delayed by about 5 days. Ye Mingxuan's heart skipped a beat, but he didn't panic. He calmly asked for the latest possible delivery date after the delay and wrote it down. After hanging up, he immediately wrote a concise status report email, clearly informing project manager Wang Peng of the delay and the adjusted delivery date, and copied Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan, reminding them to prepare contingency plans in advance. After sending the email, he felt relieved.

participant.name: Manager Liu
participant.relation: Sales manager of the outsourcing factory.

location: Workstation, 16th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Write weekly report
description: After following up on the delivery schedule, Ye Mingxuan started on the last important task of the day—the weekly report. He opened a blank Word document and first spent 15 minutes carefully reviewing the entire week's work: Monday, sorting out the plan; Tuesday, revising feedback; Wednesday, integrating and submitting; Thursday, configuring the environment and attending the department weekly meeting. He listed all the key milestones in a draft, then began writing the weekly report: first, he summarized the week's completed revision of the transmission module plan, external coordination, and Python environment configuration; second, he highlighted next week's '3D model simulation test plan' in bold and red font, specifying the five key working conditions to be tested and the expected goals, so that Engineer Gao could grasp the key points on Monday. He scrutinized every word, and after finishing the main text, he logged into the OA system and submitted the weekly report as an attachment to Gao Zhiyuan.
location: Workstation, 16th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Work wrap-up and pre-shift preparation
description: After submitting the weekly report, there was still an hour before getting off work. Ye Mingxuan didn't sit idle. He sorted out the scattered sketch files from the day's work and deleted useless temporary files. He also checked whether the simulation file paths that needed to be sent to Li Xiang on Monday were correct. He cleaned the desk, disinfected the mouse and keyboard, then picked up the water cup and washed it. With everything tidy, he looked at the clean desk and felt very pleased.
location: Workstation, 16th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Evening commute: drove home
description: At exactly 17:30, Ye Mingxuan turned off his computer, picked up his coat, went downstairs, and drove home. On the way, he turned on the car radio and tuned to the program "Auto World," which happened to be comparing the technology of mainstream hybrid SUVs. He listened intently, planning to show off a thing or two when chatting with Zhang Wei later.
location: Along the route from No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue.

name: Brief return home and departure
description: Ye Mingxuan pushed the door open and called out toward the kitchen: "Mom, I'm home! Zhang Wei will be here soon. I'll go out and wait for him; I won't be back for dinner." Wang Xiulan poked her head out at the sound: "Okay, come back early and don't be too late. It's cold tonight—button up your coat." Ye Mingxuan smiled and acknowledged, put down his commuter bag, changed into sneakers, and sent Zhang Wei a WeChat message to confirm the departure time.
location: Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Met up with his childhood friend
description: Just as Ye Mingxuan reached the entrance of the community, Zhang Wei's car arrived. He opened the door and got in. Zhang Wei said with a helpless look, “Bro, it's Friday night—what about the mutton hotpot we agreed on?” Ye Mingxuan smiled and directed the way: “Cut the jokes. The new light meal place is right next to the office. Healthy and delicious. Let's go.”
location: Entrance of Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Casual light meal with childhood friend Zhang Wei
description: The two soon arrived at the light meal shop. The shop was small with fresh decor; they found a seat in a corner by the window. Ye Mingxuan recommended, "Have the same as me—the signature chicken salad, plus two glasses of freshly squeezed orange juice." Zhang Wei gave a wry smile: "That's it?" Ye Mingxuan replied, "Don't underestimate it. It's much better than instant-boiled mutton. With your heavy year-end targets at the 4S store, you need to eat less greasy food and watch out for the three highs." As they ate and chatted, Zhang Wei indeed began complaining about this year's sluggish car market, then asked Ye Mingxuan how the price of the house he had been eyeing was now. Ye Mingxuan, while twirling salad leaves with his fork, shared the hybrid SUV market news he had just heard and advised him, "Save money first, don't rush. Don't aim for top configurations for either house or car now. Wait until the market stabilizes before making a move." Zhang Wei thought it made sense and felt much better.
location: Lüye Xianzong Light Food Salad Restaurant at the intersection of Haitai Development 6th Road and Haitai North-South Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walk home after the meal
description: After finishing the salad, the two walked out of the restaurant. The air outside was cold but comfortable. Zhang Wei said he needed to go back to the shop to work overtime and go through client accounts. Ye Mingxuan understood: 'Alright, you get busy. I'll walk back to help digest.' Zhang Wei drove away, and Ye Mingxuan walked alone along Haitai North-South Avenue back to the residential area. On the way, he wore earphones and listened to a Python basics tutorial audio for a while, recalling the string functions he learned yesterday. The cold wind on his face felt very refreshing.
location: Haitai South-North Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin (direction from Green Wizard Light Food Restaurant to Huating International Residential Area)

name: Family time chatting with mother
description: He got home at about 20:30, and his mother was leaning on the sofa watching a new palace intrigue drama. Ye Mingxuan didn't disturb her. He went to the bathroom first to wash his face, then took a glass of water and sat down next to his mother. He made small talk: "Mom, how was the food today?" Wang Xiulan kept her eyes on the TV but didn't stop talking: "Not bad. After you left, I just made myself some egg fried rice. Oh, let me tell you something — Aunt Li's son, from the family upstairs, is getting married next month. I heard they booked the banquet at Jinwan Plaza. When are you going to bring a girl home for me to see?" Ye Mingxuan was prepared and smiled as he changed the subject: "Mom, your son is busy building his career! Once I've saved up enough for a down payment and my job is more stable, you don't need to worry about it." His mother was persuaded by his reasonable argument. Although she muttered "settle down before building a career," she didn't pursue it further.
location: Living room, Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening study: remote Python review with Xu Ming.
description: After sitting with his mother until 9:30, Ye Mingxuan got up and returned to his small study. He put on his headphones, turned on the computer, and sent a message to Xu Ming on WeChat: 'Buddy, are you ready? Today we're not following the Tuesday-Thursday routine, but I want to go through the practice problems from last night's class. Do you have time?' The other side quickly replied: 'What a coincidence, I'm stuck on something too, let's do it!' The two opened Tencent Meeting and shared their screens. They spent an hour going over the programming problems assigned in yesterday's live class, focusing on the multiple ways to write nested for loops and common pitfalls with input() and int(). While listening to Xu Ming explain, Ye Mingxuan typed code on his own computer to verify, and felt his thinking was much clearer.
location: Study, Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Ancient coin research and relaxing before bed.
description: After studying, Ye Mingxuan didn't go to bed right away. He picked up the book 'Catalog of Chinese Machine-Struck Silver Dollars' that had arrived last night and turned to the chapter on the 'Year 23 of the Republic of China Sun Yat-sen Sailing Ship Silver Coin.' Against the high-definition color plates, he carefully studied the coin's edge reeding pattern and the details of the grain motif, and noted in his notebook the subtle differences in the characters 'Sun' and 'Nian' between the 'Central Mint version' and the 'Yunnan version.' After admiring several fellow collectors' HD images, he closed the book with satisfaction, went to the bathroom to wash up, and got ready for bed.
location: Study and bedroom, Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Turned off the lights and rested.
description: Ye Mingxuan turned off the bedroom light, leaving only a dim yellow bedside night light. He got into bed and briefly ran through the day's events in his mind like a movie: the model was fixed, the phone call was done, the weekly report was submitted, he ate a healthy meal with a friend, studied with Xu Ming, and finally looked at his beloved ancient coins. He felt that although the day was ordinary, it was fulfilling, and the soreness in his neck and shoulders had improved a lot thanks to a full day of attentive self-care. He reached out and turned off the lamp; the room fell into darkness, and he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 1103, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and neck and shoulder stretches.
description: My biological clock woke me right on time on Saturday. Instead of staying in bed, I first loosened my stiff neck and shoulders while still lying down. At 8:10, I got up, put on my exercise clothes, went to the living room, and spent 10 minutes doing a standard neck-and-shoulder stretching routine—the required lesson for an engineering guy's occupational hazard.
location: From the bedroom to the living room at home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning jog (3 km)
description: Today in Xiqing District it was overcast, with temperatures of -4 to 0°C, and it felt quite cold. I changed into windproof running shoes and a fleece jacket, set off from the south gate of Huating International Community (128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town), and jogged along the planned greenway inside the community. I kept the pace around 6 minutes per kilometer, ran for about 18 minutes, and completed 3 kilometers. After the run, I stretched for 5 minutes downstairs to avoid muscle soreness.
location: Greenway at the south gate of Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Breakfast and rest
description: The first thing I did when I got home was take a shower and change into dry loungewear. Mother had already prepared breakfast: steaming hot millet porridge, two boiled eggs, and a jianbing guozi. We chatted while eating. Mother said that although it was overcast today, there wasn't much wind either, so it was a good day to go out. We also talked about how our childhood friend Zhang Wei treated us to a light meal yesterday.
location: Bathroom and dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Tend to the succulent plants.
description: After breakfast, I went to my favorite south-facing balcony. I first helped my mother trim the dead leaves from several pots of Aeonium and Moonstone succulents, then used a narrow-spout watering can to give my several pots of living stones a very small amount of water along the pot walls. I carefully checked their roots, and they were all in good shape. This half hour of focus was very relaxing.
location: South-facing balcony at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Organize woodworking tools and prepare materials.
description: He moved to the woodworking bench in the other corner of the balcony. First, he took out the tool box and put the chisels, carving knives, and hand planes back in order, then picked out two pieces of beech offcuts with straight grain and even thickness from the wood pile. He sketched the mortise-and-tenon structure of a traditional small lantern on paper with a pencil, marking the dimensions of the locking slots. His father made a cup of tea, walked over, looked at the drawing, and said to leave 1 mm allowance on the dovetail slot so assembly would not be difficult. Thinking his father was right, he immediately revised the drawing.
location: Woodworking bench on the balcony of home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Cleaned the ancient coins and photographed them for records.
description: I opened my collection album and gently wiped several Republic of China Double Flag coins and Hunan Province copper coins with a soft cloth. To archive them for my collector friend Zhao Jianguo, I used a macro lens to take four close-up shots of the edge teeth of a fine-condition Double Flag coin. After taking the photos, I slightly adjusted the contrast and uploaded them to a folder on my computer.
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother called us to lunch. Today there was braised hairtail (Mother knows I crave it), stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg drop soup. The three of us ate and chatted. Father brought up a documentary about CNC machine tools he had watched yesterday, and I followed the topic to discuss the automation design of the company's new project with him. The atmosphere was very harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Midday rest and pre-game confirmation.
description: After the meal, I took the initiative to help my mother clear the dishes. Then I went back to the bedroom, set an alarm for 1:50 pm, and lay down for a 40-minute nap to save energy for the afternoon ranked matches. When the alarm went off, I got up, washed my face, turned on the computer and headphones, and logged into the League of Legends client early.
location: Home bedroom and study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Confirmed the gaming session plan and the ancient coin sharing
description: With one hour still to go before the agreed time, I opened WeChat and sent a message to the three-person group: "We'll start at 2 PM sharp. I'm locking in Darius top lane." Zhou Tao replied immediately, "I'll play Kai'Sa bottom," and Li Xiang also replied, "I'll take jungle." The lineup was set. Then I sent the ancient coin photos I had taken that morning to fellow collector Zhao Jianguo via WeChat, with a voice message: "Mr. Zhao, take a look at the edge teeth on this Double Flag coin—doesn't it have a bit of original luster?"
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Played games with colleagues and achieved a complete victory.
description: At 2:00 sharp, the three of us met in the voice channel on time. In the first game, my Darius developed steadily in lane. At 8 minutes, I used a teleport to support bottom, coordinated perfectly with Zhou Tao to take first blood, and then took the dragon as well. In three games, I was MVP twice and SVP once. The voice channel was full of cheers: 'Perfect objective control that game!' 'My bad, my bad, I got a bit carried away on that fight!' We worked well together and felt great.
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Post-match banter and rest.
description: After three games, they didn't immediately leave the voice chat. Zhou Tao complained that his jungle route in the third game had been counter-jungled by the opponent several times, while Li Xiang teased him for "farming the jungle without using his brain." I finally said, "Let's play again next week, aiming for Gold! Free tonight? We'll set up another session?" The three agreed to decide later in the evening, and logged off amid laughter of "we've got this." I stood up and did a few chest stretches.
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Free time and miscellaneous errands.
description: After gaming, my mind was still a bit excited. I went to the balcony to get some air and also checked the succulents I had watered in the morning. Returning to my room, I turned on my computer, briefly adjusted the contrast and sharpness of the ancient coin photos taken in the afternoon, organized them into a folder, and prepared to send them to Zhao Jianguo later.
location: Living room balcony and study at home, Huating International Residential Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Confirmed online lecture with Zhao Jianguo
description: I sat down in the study and opened WeChat. Zhao Jianguo had replied and sent a high-definition photo of a “Sun Yat-sen Small Head” original luster coin from a recent auction. We had a voice conversation for a few minutes. Drawing on my own collecting experience, I shared my views on the authenticity of the coin's patina and silver luster. Finally, I wrote a message: “Teacher Zhao, how about setting the spring online appraisal lecture for Sunday, February 16, at 8 p.m.?” Zhao Jianguo quickly replied: “No problem, it's settled!”
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Arranged a dinner gathering with classmate Zhao Xiaofeng
description: After the lecture was confirmed, I immediately contacted my college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng. I directly asked him: "Buddy, are you free at noon tomorrow (the 19th)? Let's get together at the usual place?" Zhao Xiaofeng replied: "Sure! Let's go to that Old Beijing instant-boiled mutton restaurant on Nanshi Food Street!" We then confirmed the time by voice message: 11:30 am. He specially recommended the hand-sliced fresh lamb.
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Helped prepare dinner and chatted
description: Everything was settled, and I was in a good mood. I wandered into the kitchen and saw my mother making dumplings with fennel and pork filling. I washed my hands and offered to help. Mother brought up the topic again: "Last time, when your childhood friend Zhang Wei brought his girlfriend, she looked pretty good." I smiled and interrupted: "They're getting married soon. Don't play matchmaker. I know what I want!" My father in the living room heard and laughed.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat around eating dinner. Today's fennel dumplings tasted amazing. At the table, I shared my undefeated record from the afternoon games and said that tomorrow noon I would go to a mutton hot pot restaurant with classmates. My parents had no objections; my mother just reminded me not to drink too much. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening study and entertainment
description: After dinner, I returned to the study. I opened my laptop and browsed the Guquan Yuandi forum to see if there were any new posts about late Qing and Republican-era machine-struck coins, while flipping through the newly arrived Illustrated Catalog of Ancient Coins, focusing on the section about minting techniques for machine-struck coins. I also opened the Python course handouts and reviewed the list and tuple operations from the past few days, preparing for the online exchange with Xu Ming next Tuesday.
location: Home study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening notes and preparation
description: I closed the book and recorded my weight: 74.0 kg (up 0.2 kg from yesterday — dumplings are irresistible). I went to the bathroom, brushed my teeth, washed my face, and did my bedtime routine. Before bed, I set an alarm on my phone for 10 a.m. tomorrow (to remind myself to leave at 11), and sent a message in the small three-person group chat: 'Tomorrow noon I have hot pot with classmates; I'll get online again in the evening if nothing comes up.'
location: Home study and bathroom, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Back in the bedroom, I leaned against the headboard, picked up Ancient Coin Catalog, and flipped through the chapter on the Republic of China Guizhou automobile coin, finding it truly fascinating. At 22:30, I turned off the light and lay down, feeling deeply satisfied with today's full and pleasant life. Tomorrow there was still the long-awaited instant-boiled mutton. With a smile, I gradually drifted into sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Wake-up and morning care routine
description: Sunlight streamed through the gap in the curtains, and I woke up in a warm room kept cozy by the heating. In bed, I did a 5-minute neck exercise tracing the shape of the character 'mi' to stretch out my stiff shoulder and neck muscles. After getting up, I drank a cup of warm water and applied a hot towel to the back of my neck for 2 minutes.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mother prepared jianbing guozi and hot soy milk for breakfast. While eating and chatting, father talked about the new policies on intelligent manufacturing from the radio in the morning. Ye Mingxuan took up the topic and mentioned that he had arranged to discuss related trends with a former classmate in automotive design at noon. Mother reminded him that it was cold outside and to dress warmly.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Update shopping list and plan transportation
description: After the meal, he used the Notes app on his phone to add sugar-roasted chestnuts to the shopping list, and opened the map app to check the route from home to Rong'an Street, Heping District. He decided to take Metro Line 3, transfer to Line 1, get off at Yingkoudao Station, and walk there.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Final confirmation before simulation testing.
description: He called his colleague Li Xiang on WeChat right on time and confirmed that the optimized design model had been saved as a STEP file and uploaded to the shared server. Li Xiang reported that the ANSYS floating license was normal and the job had been pre-submitted, so the computing resources would be available on Monday. Ye Mingxuan noted the key points and thanked Li Xiang.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Organize collectibles and prepare to head out.
description: After hanging up, he imported the macro photos of the Republic-era double-flag coin he had taken last Saturday into his computer and renamed the folders by year and condition. Then he changed into a thick down jacket, put on a hat and gloves, checked his wallet, phone, earphones, and notebook, and left after confirming everything was in order.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Commuting to the dinner venue.
description: Walked to Zhongbei Town Metro Station and took Line 3. On the train, he used his phone to browse posts about the Ten Treasures of Copper Coins on the Guquan Yuandi forum. After about 23 minutes, he transferred to Line 1 at Wujiayao Station and rode to Yingkoudao Station, then walked to Sanxing Instant-Boiled Mutton.
location: Inside the carriages of Tianjin Metro Line 3 and Line 1

name: Had a mutton hot pot dinner with Zhao Xiaofeng
description: Met up with college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng at the restaurant entrance. The two ordered hand-cut fresh mutton, tripe, frozen tofu, and a vegetable platter, with a clear broth pot and sesame paste dipping sauce. While eating, they talked about recent situations: Ye Mingxuan shared his house-buying plan and Python learning progress; Zhao Xiaofeng gave a detailed introduction to precision transmission online monitoring technology in the automotive production line digitalization project. Ye Mingxuan used his phone to note down key technical terms.
location: No. 173 Rongye Street, Heping District, Tianjin, China - Sanxing Instant-Boiled Mutton (Rong'an Street Branch)

name: After-dinner walk and buying sugar-roasted chestnuts
description: After the dinner gathering, he said goodbye to Zhao Xiaofeng at the shop entrance and walked alone along Rongye Street toward Nanshi to help digestion. Then he took Bus 606 at Rongfangli Bus Stop to Qianjindao Stop, walked 2 minutes to the sugar-roasted chestnut shop, queued for 3 minutes to buy a serving of freshly cooked hot chestnuts (35 yuan), and put the bag into his backpack after confirming it was tightly sealed.
location: Sugar-Roasted Chestnuts (Qianjin Road Store), Qianjin Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, China

name: Return commute
description: I took Line 5 from Xinanlou Metro Station, transferred to Line 3 at Zhangxingzhuang Station, and headed home. Standing in the carriage, I watched beginner tutorial videos on Python web scraping on Bilibili to consolidate my knowledge.
location: Inside the cars of Tianjin Metro Line 5 and Line 3

name: Arriving home and interacting with mother
description: Upon arriving home, he pushed open the living room door and placed the still-warm sugar-roasted chestnuts in front of his mother. After tasting them, she smiled and praised them. Ye Mingxuan felt warm inside and sat down to chat with his mother about the fun moments from the gathering.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Discussed industry trends with father.
description: Walked to the balcony to watch father tending the clivia, moved a stool over and sat down to share the topic of precision transmission online monitoring that Zhao Xiaofeng had mentioned. Father took off his reading glasses and remarked that in the early years the machine tool plant relied on hand cranking and the naked eye, while now everyone uses sensors. He urged that technology should be studied in depth without fearing monotony. Ye Mingxuan nodded seriously.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: Ye Mingxuan put down his phone, went to the bathroom to wash up, then fetched a basin of hot water to soak his feet and relieve the day's fatigue. After soaking his feet, he leaned against the headboard, picked up his e-reader and browsed the e-book 'Ming-style Furniture Research', focusing on the mortise-and-tenon structure chapter to find inspiration for the plant stand. At exactly 22:00, he turned off the light and lay down, thinking back on the fullness of the day and the warmth of home, and soon fell asleep.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and washing up
description: On the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, 'Po Wu', Ye Mingxuan got up at 8:30, opened the curtains and found the sky gloomy, turning from cloudy to overcast. He weighed himself at 74.2 kg, felt he had indulged a bit during the Spring Festival, and reminded himself to watch his diet after the holiday. While washing up, he cleaned his razor.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Breakfast and confirming the gathering details
description: Mother had made millet porridge and steamed vegetarian buns. While drinking the porridge, Ye Mingxuan opened the three-person WeChat group 'Jinshen Yixiantian' on his phone, @-mentioned Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng to confirm gathering at the 'Chuanxiangli' BBQ restaurant near Tianjin Station at 6:30 p.m. Liu Yang instantly replied that he would arrive at Tianjin Station at 3 p.m. Zhao Xiaofeng responded that it would take him about 40 minutes to get there from Dongli. Ye Mingxuan sent the restaurant's location to the group and urged everyone not to be late.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Tended to succulents on the balcony.
description: After dinner, went to the balcony and found the succulent plants were dormant and the pot soil was very dry. Carefully picked out the withered leaves with small tweezers, and moved the wrinkled-leaf 'Taodan' to the sheltered spot inside the windowsill. Looked up out the window; the forecast said there might be scattered light snow in the afternoon, so casually closed the north-facing window tightly.
location: Balcony at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Making dumplings at home to welcome the God of Wealth
description: On Po Wu, the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, making dumplings was the highlight. His mother took charge of the arrangements; Ye Mingxuan volunteered to knead the dough and prepare the pork and cabbage filling, adding more water and less Sichuan peppercorn oil to keep it tender. His father, Ye Jianguo, using his retired fitter's skills, rolled out the wrappers into even thin rounds. The family of three gathered around the cutting board, wrapping and chatting. His mother mentioned that Aunt Liu upstairs had taken up ballroom dancing; his father scrolled through the photos of new housing projects saved on his phone yesterday, estimating prices for three new developments and one old-community renovation project near Zhongbei Town, while Ye Mingxuan was quietly calculating the down payment ratio.
location: Home kitchen, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dumplings for lunch
description: Steaming hot dumplings came out of the pot. His mother had specially cooked a plate with one dumpling filled with a coin, symbolizing “wealth rolling in.” Ye Mingxuan split open the third dumpling but didn’t get the coin; his father got it in one bite and, grinning, placed the coin beside his plate. The family of three ate dumplings with Laba vinegar and garlic paste, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: Feeling sleepy after lunch, he returned to the bedroom and lay on the bed. He first opened the memo app on his phone to refine the pre-Spring Festival shopping list: buy two Haworthia succulents at Caozhuang Flower Market on Saturday, and replace the battery in the e-bike key. Then he put down his phone, closed his eyes, and rested for about 50 minutes.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Reviewed career planning notes and studied Python problem-solving approaches.
description: After waking up, he washed his face and walked into the study. The notebook from yesterday's discussion with his cousin about career planning was still open on the desk, with flow diagrams on it. He opened his laptop and created a new document to organize his thoughts on "combining Python with mechanical design applications", including batch processing test data, using pandas for table cleaning, interfacing with the company's DWG output tools, and more. Thinking about talking with Liu Yang about hands-on Python practice in the evening, he felt full of anticipation.
location: Study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pack and prepare in advance for going out
description: Changed out of loungewear and put on a thick down jacket, fleece-lined jeans, and slip-resistant high-top boots. Checked the backpack to make sure the phone, power bank, keys, card holder, and tissues were all there, and also tucked a folding umbrella into the side pocket in case it snowed at night. Mother reminded from the living room to drink less and come back early.
location: Entrance hall and bedroom at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute to Tianjin Station
description: Walk 7 minutes from Huating International Community to Zhongbei Town Metro Station, take Metro Line 6 toward Nansunzhuang, transfer to Line 3 at Hongqi South Road Station toward Xiaodian, and ride four stops to Tianjin Station. The whole trip takes about 40 minutes. There were not many passengers in the car. Ye Mingxuan wore earphones and listened to instrumental music to relax.
location: Departed from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin; took Line 6 from Zhongbei Town Metro Station and transferred to Line 3 to Tianjin Station.

name: Meet up with Zhao Xiaofeng first
description: After exiting Tianjin Station from Exit B2 and walking about 5 minutes, he arrived at the "Chuanxiangli" barbecue restaurant, where red lanterns hung at the entrance and the smell of charcoal wafted out. Zhao Xiaofeng, already waiting at the door in an army-green work jacket, greeted him with a fist bump and small talk. Xiaofeng said his factory started work on the sixth day of the Lunar New Year, and he had finally managed to turn down a dinner invitation to come out today.
location: At the entrance of the "Chuanxiangli" barbecue restaurant at the intersection of Xinkai Road and Huaxing Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Wait for Liu Yang and order food first.
description: Entering the shop, they found a booth near the back with an outlet and sat down. Zhao Xiaofeng scanned the QR code and ordered a plate of lamb skewers, beef skewers, chicken wings, and grilled eggplant. Ye Mingxuan ordered a few bottles of Dayao soda and told the server that the friends hadn't arrived yet, so the second batch of skewers should be served later. At 17:52, Liu Yang walked in with a backpack on his back in large strides. The three stood up, shook hands, and hugged, creating a lively scene.
location: At the "Chuanxiangli" barbecue restaurant, Xinkai Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Barbecue gathering for in-depth discussion of Python applications
description: When the charcoal fire was brought over, the three chatted while grilling. Liu Yang shared his experience with an embedded systems team in Shenzhen, highlighting how they introduced Python for automated test scripts, allowing one person to complete in one day the manual workload of three people, involving batch data processing, table cleaning, and MES interface integration. Ye Mingxuan asked detailed questions about specific scenarios, and Zhao Xiaofeng also said his factory was promoting automation but making slow progress. They ate skewers and edamame, drank beverages, and talked about technology and work until after eight in the evening.
location: At the "Chuanxiangli" barbecue restaurant, Xinkai Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Group photo to remember the occasion.
description: Before the gathering ended, he asked a staff member to take a group photo. The three of them stood in a row with their arms over each other's shoulders under the storefront bearing the red-paper sign reading "Break the Fifth and Welcome the God of Wealth," and two photos were taken. Liu Yang looked at them, thought they were good, and said he would send them to the group chat later.
location: At the entrance of Chuanxiangli BBQ Restaurant, Xinkai Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Saw off Liu Yang and each returned
description: Liu Yang checked the time and said he had to catch the 22:10 high-speed train to Shenzhen. The three of them hurried to the North Entrance of Tianjin Station. Zhao Xiaofeng said, “Don't rush back like this next time.” Liu Yang waved and promised to bring Shenzhen's specialty lychee wine. After watching Liu Yang enter the ticket gate, Zhao Xiaofeng rode a shared bike back to Dongli, while Ye Mingxuan went down to the subway station alone and returned the same way.
location: Near the north entrance of Tianjin Railway Station, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Arrived home
description: He took the subway back along the same route, walked home, took out his keys and opened the door. The living room light was still on; his father Ye Jianguo was sitting on the sofa with several property brochures and a Tianjin map spread out beside him, clearly waiting for him.
location: At the entrance of Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Plan tomorrow's house-viewing route with his father.
description: Ye Mingxuan sat next to his father to plan the next day's house-viewing route. His father said he had confirmed with the agent that the two new developments east of Zhongbei Town, 'Xishuiyuan' and 'Jinyuefu', and the western renovation project 'Jinhuali' would all be open during the Spring Festival. Ye Mingxuan used Amap to compare distances and found that the three developments were within 6 kilometers of one another, so they could be linked by walking and cycling. He suggested going to the Xishuiyuan sales office in the morning and viewing the Jinhuali show flat in the afternoon on shared bikes. His father agreed and called the Xishuiyuan agent to confirm the duty schedule. The mother and son discussed until after 11 o'clock, and after the mother urged them to sleep early, they each returned to their rooms.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Before bed, wash up, review Python, and go to sleep.
description: Returning to the bedroom, he washed up, changed into pajamas, and sat back against the headboard. He took out his phone and recorded in detail in the memo the Python application points Liu Yang mentioned tonight: automated test scripts (CI/CD), batch data processing and spreadsheet cleaning (pandas + openpyxl), and API automation for integration with MES. He also sketched a flow diagram in his notebook, felt that his thinking was clear, and was full of anticipation for applying Python after the holiday. Snow was falling sparsely outside the window; the room was warm and quiet. He turned off the light and went to sleep, and the fulfilling day made him sleep especially soundly.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Early rising, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: The alarm went off at 7:10 in the morning. After getting up, I weighed myself: 74.0 kg. Wearing home clothes, I went to the living room. Father was already sorting through property listing materials. Mother had prepared millet porridge, steamed buns, and pickled vegetables for breakfast. During the meal, Father and I finalized today’s house-viewing route. After breakfast, I changed into a black down jacket and cargo pants, checked my messenger bag containing a notebook, pen, tape measure, and power bank. Father got himself ready. We said goodbye to Mother and left the house at 8:15 sharp.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Took the bus to Xishui Garden.
description: Starting from the west gate of Huating International Community, my father and I walked to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, then took Bus 645 for about six stops and got off at Ximingyuan Stop. Along the way, my father looked out the window while I checked the house-viewing plan memo on my phone again.
location: Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin: from the west gate of Huating International Residential Community to Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, then take bus No. 645 to Ximingyuan Station

name: View the Xishui Garden project.
description: Arrived at the Xishui Garden sales office and met with the appointed agent, Wang. He led us on a tour of two model apartments: 98 sqm and 112 sqm. I used a tape measure to take the actual bedroom dimensions, photographed the floor plans and price list, and wrote detailed notes in my notebook on area, orientation, unit price, and estimated down payment. My father paid more attention to the community greenery and building spacing.
location: Xishuiyuan Sales Office, No. 29 Ximingyuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Survey residential developments converted from old factory buildings and listen to father's memories.
description: Walked about 15 minutes from Xishui Garden to the former site of the original Jinfah Machine Tool Plant to visit a development converted from old factory buildings. The red brick walls, preserved steel frames, and old slogans made my father fall silent. He stood in front of a wall and recounted his thirty years in the Tianjin No. 1 Machine Tool Plant from apprentice to senior technician in his youth. I listened carefully and made a note in my notebook about the need to evaluate sound insulation and thermal performance.
location: Former site of the Jinfa Machine Tool Factory, at the intersection of Zhongfa Road and Kaiyuan Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch time
description: After leaving the old factory building project, I walked to the area near Jinyuefu and had lunch at Laoshuntian Beef Noodle Restaurant on the roadside. I ordered a large bowl of braised beef noodles, and my father ordered three-delicacy noodles. While waiting, my father was still reminiscing about the old factory building, and I was browsing photos of Xishuiyuan on my phone.
location: Laoshuntian Beef Noodle Restaurant, 50 meters east of the Jinyue Mansion Sales Center, No. 8 Jinguang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Viewing the Jinyue Mansion project.
description: After eating noodles, I walked into the Jinyue Mansion sales center across the street. The saleswoman, Miss Li, mainly introduced the 114-square-meter and 128-square-meter four-bedroom units, saying the total price was relatively high. I asked in detail about the space efficiency ratio, property management fees, and parking ratio, and compared them with Xishuiyuan in my notebook, noting that the surrounding amenities were more mature but the price was higher. My father was concerned about the thickness of the insulation layer.
location: Jinyue Mansion Sales Center, No. 8 Jinguang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Took a taxi to Jinhuali to view the apartment and happened to meet a warm-hearted community member.
description: Took a taxi from Jinyuefu to Jinhuali Community. When we arrived at the community gate, we met Aunt Liu, a warm-hearted community volunteer in a red vest. She enthusiastically introduced the pros and cons of the neighborhood. After learning that I was a mechanical engineer, she said the community was short of people to teach children handicrafts, and I said I would consider it after finishing my current work. Then community staff showed us two second-hand apartments: one was a three-bedroom unit on the fifth floor with no elevator, good lighting, but old decoration; the other was a first-floor unit with a small yard, but priced higher. We made brief notes and concluded.
location: Jinhuali Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Took the bus back home
description: Took Bus No. 616 from the entrance of Jinhuali Community back to Huating International Community. On the bus, my father dozed off by the window, and I opened my phone notes to organize the pros and cons of today's three residential projects into a simple table in preparation for the family discussion.
location: Bus No. 616 from Jinhuali Community to Huating International Residence, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returning home to rest and organizing house-viewing materials
description: After returning home and greeting my mother, I went to the study, imported the laptop data and phone photos into the computer, and created a folder named "Home Purchase Alternatives_20250203", categorizing by property development and marking estimated down payments.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and enjoying family dinner
description: I went to the kitchen to help my mother peel garlic and trim vegetables, while in the living room my father sipped tea and told my mother about his experience viewing houses today, especially his impressions of the old factory building. At dinner, the three of us sat around the table; my mother had made stir-fried shrimp, garlic stir-fried crown daisy stems, and tomato and egg soup. I objectively analyzed the pros and cons of the three developments, and my father added his views on the environment and transportation; the atmosphere was lively.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Residential Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Tending to succulent plants to relax.
description: After clearing the table, I went to the balcony, turned on the grow light, checked the condition of each succulent pot, removed dried leaves, and lightly sprayed water on the Peach Egg and Queen Flower Hat succulents to relax my mind.
location: Balcony, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening online apartment screening and Python learning.
description: Returning to the study, he opened his laptop, logged into the Lianjia and Beike apps, filtered for nearly new homes of 90-110 square meters in Zhongbei Town, saved 12 listings that matched expectations, and organized them into the notes app on his phone. Afterwards, he spent about forty minutes following along with a video on a Python tutorial website to practice coding, laying a foundation for resuming study after the holiday.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wash up, soak feet, do bedtime journaling, and rest
description: Late at night, after washing up, he fetched hot water to soak his feet, relieving the fatigue of 12,000 steps during the day. He used his phone to record his thoughts from the house viewing and the key points to discuss with family the next day, and set an alarm. Then he turned off the lights and rested, falling asleep after reviewing the fulfilling day.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, I got up and habitually weighed myself first; it showed 73.9 kg. Then I washed up briefly and spent a few minutes doing shoulder and neck stretches to loosen my calves, which were a bit sore from walking while viewing apartments yesterday. Then I went to the dining room, where my mother had already prepared breakfast: hot steamed buns simmered with braised pork, a bowl of millet porridge, and a boiled egg. While eating, I briefly chatted with my mother about going out with my father to view apartments in the afternoon.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Configure the Python work environment
description: Made technical preparations for tomorrow's return to work. In the study, I opened my laptop and first synced several key test data files from the company cloud drive to the local machine. Then I opened the PyCharm editor, used pip commands to install data processing libraries such as openpyxl and pandas, and wrote a few short lines of code to read and iterate through the data for verification, confirming the environment configuration was correct.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Took a morning walk and visited neighboring communities.
description: After a stretch of work came to an end, he got up and moved around. He put on his coat and walked about 22 minutes to the neighboring Jinsha Shuiyu Huacheng Community to observe its environment and living facilities. He walked a lap around the community, observing the greenery, parking, unit access control, and hallway cleanliness. He saw a community bulletin board downstairs with notices and community activity information, and gained a preliminary impression of the overall external environment of this community converted from old factory buildings.
location: Jinxia Shuiyu Huacheng Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and eat lunch
description: After the walk, he walked home, changed into loungewear, and went to the kitchen to help his mother. She planned to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried greens. He helped peel a few cloves of garlic and cleaned the vegetables bought yesterday. Meanwhile, he told his mother that he and his father would go out to view houses at 2 p.m. When lunch was served, the family of three ate and chatted. His father gave a brief analysis of the new developments and resale homes to be viewed that afternoon, and he himself proposed dimensions for comparison.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, he returned to his room to take a nap for about an hour, recharging his energy for the afternoon's walk to view apartments. He put his phone on silent and drew the curtains.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon: apartment viewing preparation and departure
description: Got up and washed my face. I packed the notebook, measuring tape, portable power bank, thermos cup and other items into my backpack, and checked my phone battery level again. After reviewing the specific addresses of the two residential developments to visit in the afternoon and the apartment viewing route with my father, who was also ready, we went downstairs together and walked to the bus stop outside the community.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Inspect the near-new residential community next to Zhongbei Middle School
description: Father and son took the bus at the entrance of Huating International Residential Community, got off at Zhongbei Middle School Station after about 15 minutes, and walked about 10 minutes to reach the target community. It is a quasi-new residential community built in 2018, surrounded by schools and a vegetable market, with a mature environment. They focused on the apartment layout, natural lighting, condition of the hallway common areas, and community environment. Using a handheld laser rangefinder, he measured the living room and master bedroom of one two-bedroom unit of about 97 square meters, and took photos and videos as records. Father was very satisfied with the neighborhood's living atmosphere and supporting facilities.
location: A nearly-new resale community next to Zhongbei Middle School, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Inspecting new housing developments in western Zhongbei Town and discussing on the return trip
description: After leaving the nearly-new resale community, the father and son walked to a new development west of Zhongbei Town that was cheaper but in a remote location. Surrounding infrastructure was still underdeveloped, and they assessed its future growth potential as they walked. After viewing the new development, they walked back along the same route to the Zhongbei Middle School bus stop to wait for the bus. At the stop, he took out his phone, compared the pros, cons, and prices of the previously recorded candidate properties, briefly reviewed with his father, and initially included the old renovation project seen earlier and today’s nearly-new resale home on the core candidate list.
location: New residential developments in western Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Zhongbei Middle School bus stop

name: Return home to enter data.
description: Took the bus home, about 15 minutes. After arriving home, changed out of my coat, immediately went to the study, turned on the computer, compiled the data and recordings from this afternoon's apartment viewing into text, added them to the property comparison framework Excel spreadsheet built in the morning, and updated the candidate list.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and conversation
description: Went to the kitchen to help Mother get bowls and chopsticks. In the living room, Father gave Mother a rough summary of today's house viewing. Dinner was clear-simmered pork ribs and cucumber salad, home-style flavors. At the table, Mother asked a few questions about housing prices and transportation, and Father patiently answered them all. The atmosphere was fairly relaxed.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family discussion about buying a home.
description: After dinner, he rested for a while, watered the succulents on the balcony, and adjusted the positions of the flower pots. Then he returned to the living room, connected his phone to the TV, and prepared to cast the data comparison table to the screen. When the discussion began, he connected his laptop to the TV and presented the information on the 12 shortlisted properties. When his mother heard that most of their savings might need to be used and that they would have to bear a monthly mortgage payment, she became emotional and strongly opposed a commercial loan; his father took out a calculator and rationally calculated the housing provident fund loan and repayment combinations. After patient explanation, he proposed choosing a nearly new second-hand home with a total price of 1.5 million to 1.8 million yuan, using a "housing provident fund + small commercial loan" approach to keep the monthly payment within 5,000 yuan. After more than an hour of discussion, his mother's attitude softened somewhat, and the family initially reached a consensus: "buying a home takes priority, with a preference for nearly new second-hand homes."
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After the meeting, reassured mother.
description: After the discussion ended, mother still seemed a bit worried and went back to her room. He followed her, sat down by her bedside, gently reassured her, and once again used data to explain that he had done a proper risk assessment, so she could set her mind at ease.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Creating and refining a financial model for property comparison.
description: Returning to the study, he opened Excel and began building a more detailed financial calculation model, listing the unit price, total price, and area of the six shortlisted candidate properties, and simulating monthly payments under different down payment ratios. During a short break, he sent a WeChat message to his friend Xu Ming about the house-viewing experience, lamenting how difficult it is to buy a house. After that, he continued refining the spreadsheet, marking risk points such as interest rate hikes and income fluctuations in red font at the bottom. After completing a final data validation, he backed up the file to both his computer and mobile cloud drive.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening wrap-up and relaxation
description: His father pushed the door open, patted him on the shoulder, and reminded him not to stay up too late. After finishing the work, he turned off the computer and tidied his desk. He went to the bathroom to wash up, then soaked his feet in hot water to relieve fatigue. Meanwhile, he used his phone's memo app to note down today's insights from the house viewing and discussions, and sorted out the to-do items for work tomorrow. After soaking his feet, he turned off the light and got into bed to rest.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wake up and have a quick breakfast.
description: The alarm went off on time. I had stayed up until 12:30 last night working on the Excel model for buying a house, and my eyes felt a little dry, so I splashed my face with cold water. My mother had already prepared breakfast: two slices of whole-wheat bread, a glass of hot milk, and a boiled egg. I ate quickly, thinking about today's tasks: I needed to process the backlog of data with a Python script. Today the north wind was force 3-4, it felt very cold, so I put on a thick down jacket and a scarf, gave up riding my e-bike, and decided to take the bus.
location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 10, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Walk to the bus stop.
description: Left at 7:15, walked 8 minutes to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop at the community gate. The cold wind stung my face, so I pulled my scarf up a bit. On the way, I saw street cleaners already sweeping the road.
location: The road section from the gate of Huating International Community on Zhongbei Avenue to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Commuting by public transit and route planning
description: Took Bus No. 3; the bus had heating and was fairly comfortable. According to the Amap reference, the commute takes about 62.8 minutes, and I expect to arrive around 8:10. On the bus, I opened my phone and carefully reviewed the House Purchase Property Comparison V1.1.xlsx model I made last night, focusing on the monthly payment data for the three candidate properties. At the same time, I also mentally went through the logic of the Python script I need to write today to prepare for the morning's work.
location: En route from Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China to Haitai Development Office Building (Bus No. 3)

name: Arrived at the company and clocked in
description: Arrived at the company building at 8:10 on time, walked quickly into the building, and clocked in. The timing was just right; he wasn't late.
location: Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Department kickoff meeting.
description: The department held a brief post-holiday kickoff meeting, chaired by project manager Wang Peng. Wang Peng reiterated several key project milestones in February, especially the design task for the photovoltaic cleaning device, and required an initial plan within two weeks. My direct supervisor, Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan, emphasized that the three customer test data reports backlogged before the New Year must be processed today. I felt confident and planned to use the Python script I had configured yesterday. After the meeting, Zhou Tao patted me on the shoulder and said, 'The senior engineer is in a decent mood today; your Python can definitely handle the data.'
location: Large Conference Room, 3rd Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Workstation preparation
description: Back at my desk, I first made a cup of instant black coffee to refresh myself, then logged into WeChat Work and my email. I synced the home-buying Excel model I organized last night to my office computer. Next, I opened PyCharm, created a script file named "test_data_processor.py", and opened the three Excel files to be processed, confirming the data formats and fields. Everything was ready, I took a sip of coffee and began to focus on writing the code.

name: Writing and debugging a Python data processing script
