location: Medium meeting room, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Project mid-term progress report
description: The report started on time. Ye Mingxuan presented the module design prototype and test plan at the planned pace, and used striking charts to compare efficiency before and after introducing the Python script, emphasizing the leap from half a day to 45 seconds. Wang Peng nodded in approval. However, when showing the simulated stress data, Wang Peng pointed out that a certain stress distribution deviated from expectations and asked to list it as the highest-priority issue for the next phase. Ye Mingxuan calmly recorded the feedback and promised to investigate with Li Xiang immediately after the meeting.
location: Medium meeting room, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After the meeting, had an urgent discussion with Li Xiang about the simulation deviation.
description: At 14:50 the meeting ended. Ye Mingxuan immediately went to Li Xiang's workstation with his notebook and recounted the deviation points Wang Peng had pointed out. Together they pulled up the model and checked the boundary conditions and material properties one by one, preliminarily concluding that the deviation might be caused by the preload setting of a certain bolt. They then agreed on an optimized division of work: Li Xiang would adjust the simulation parameters, Ye Mingxuan would modify the corresponding parts of the model, and they arranged to each work half a day on Sunday to complete the first round of iterations.
location: Li Xiang's workstation, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Consolidate the breakthrough plan and submit it.
description: At 15:20 he returned to his workstation and organized the meeting conclusions and the results of his discussion with Li Xiang into the “Action Plan for Tackling the Simulation Stress Deviation,” including clear milestones (complete the iteration before next Wednesday), specific adjustment measures, and required resources. At 15:50 he sent the email to the senior engineer for review. Five minutes later, he received a brief reply from the senior engineer: “Received. We’ll discuss in detail on Monday.” Ye Mingxuan noted a 9 a.m. Monday discussion with the senior engineer about the plan in his to-do list.
location: Workstation, 3rd Floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handle work chores and prepare to leave work
description: The rest of the afternoon was spent dealing with other minor issues noted during the meeting, such as document formatting, drawing number naming conventions, and other trivial matters. Then I checked the sports equipment in my backpack, confirmed that basketball shoes, jersey, towel, etc. were all there, and got ready for the evening basketball training.
location: Workstation, 3rd Floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work dinner
description: At 17:30, he left work on time. Knowing that the basketball training at 6:30 in the evening would be intense, Ye Mingxuan first ordered a small bowl of tomato and egg noodles at the Jinlaishun Knife-Cut Noodle Shop on Haitai Development Sixth Road near the company, and ate them quickly to fill his stomach.
location: Jinlaishun Knife-Cut Noodle Restaurant, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute to Tiangong University Gymnasium
description: At 17:50, he rode his e-bike from the noodle shop to the Tiangong University Gymnasium. The distance was about 15 kilometers. There was some congestion on the way, and after about 40 minutes of riding, he arrived outside the gymnasium at 18:30.
location: Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Department basketball team training
description: At 18:30, after changing into gear at the gym, training started on time. That evening, the coach focused on defensive tactics. Ye Mingxuan was especially committed on defense, staying close to his assigned player throughout and actively helping on defense. His defensive coordination with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang was more in sync than last time, and he even made a steal in a fast break and assisted Zhou Tao on a layup. Training lasted until 20:00. Although he was drenched in sweat, his work stress was greatly relieved.
location: Indoor basketball court at the gymnasium of Tiangong University, 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return journey after training and scouting the subway station.
description: After training, he stretched and relaxed by the court. While drinking water, he heard Zhou Tao complaining about having to work overtime on the weekend, and Ye Mingxuan responded with a wry smile. At 20:10, he said goodbye to his teammates and rode his electric bike back. On the way, he deliberately detoured to Exit A of Caozhuang Metro Station, confirmed the exact location of the exit, and noticed a Jinmen Roast Duck Restaurant next to it. He planned to have dinner there on the weekend with his childhood friend Zhang Wei. At 20:40, he returned to Huating International Community.
location: Caozhuang Metro Station Exit A and surrounding area, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Going home and showering
description: Arrived home at 20:40; his parents had already eaten dinner. His mother asked how his meal went, and Ye Mingxuan said he had already eaten out. He then took a quick hot shower to wash off the sweat from training and changed into dry loungewear.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Book crosstalk tickets and contact a childhood friend.
description: After resting for a while in the bedroom, Ye Mingxuan successfully booked two crosstalk tickets for the 2:30 p.m. session on February 15 via the official WeChat account of Mingliu Teahouse, and received SMS confirmation. Then he sent a voice message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei: 'Wei Ge, tickets are booked. Tomorrow at 1:40 p.m., meet at Exit A of Caozhuang Metro Station, okay?' Zhang Wei quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji and confirmed by voice. The two agreed to meet.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize tomorrow's schedule and the ancient coin collection
description: Took a screenshot of the crosstalk ticket QR code and saved it to his phone, and made a list of items to bring tomorrow (ID card, phone, power bank). Then he logged into the ancient coin collecting forum and saw a post titled Discussion on Guangxu Yuanbao Varieties by Xi'an collector Zhao Jianguo. He found it insightful and saved it to read closely on the road tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: At 22:15, Ye Mingxuan, having finished the day's work, felt exhausted. Instead of studying further, he lay down and listened to soothing instrumental music to let his mind fully relax. At 22:55 he turned off the lights and, in the darkness, reviewed the weekend plans: sleep in tomorrow, go to a crosstalk show and eat roast duck with his childhood friends in the afternoon, and organize his ancient coin notes in the evening. Feeling calm, he fell asleep around 23:15.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, healthy breakfast, and getting ready to go out.
description: On Saturday morning, the alarm went off at 8. Mingxuan turned it off, stretched in bed, felt the winter sunlight, lingered in bed for five minutes, then got up, washed up, and drank warm water to wake himself up. Then he went into the kitchen, filled a bowl with the multigrain porridge scheduled the night before, paired it with two boiled eggs and a small dish of homemade pickled cucumbers, opened the Boohee Health app to record breakfast calories (about 400 kcal), and scrolled through ancient coin forum posts on his phone while eating. After the meal, he quickly cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, changed into work pants, a plaid shirt, and a light jacket, took his canvas bag (containing a power bank, bottled water, and tissues), checked his car keys, wallet, and phone, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop and prepared to start work.
description: Mingxuan drove his silver-gray Lavida west along Zhongbei Avenue, then via Liukou Road to Yangliuqing Ancient Town. The roads were clear on Saturday morning. He played his folk music playlist and arrived at the town's public parking lot about 18 minutes later, then walked to the "Adze, Chisel, Axe, Saw" woodworking workshop. Pushing the door open, the air was filled with the scent of sawdust and pine resin. After greeting Master Qian Jianguo, who had already arrived, he put on a work apron and took the square chisel and wooden mallet he needed for the day from the tool wall.
location: No. 9, Yuhe Renjia Commercial Street, Liuxin Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, 'Adze, Chisel, Axe and Saw' Woodworking Workshop

name: Immersive mortise-and-tenon stool making and learning plan discussion
description: Master Qian handed over the hand-drawn mortise-and-tenon stool drawings and explained the key structural points in detail. Mingxuan chose North American black walnut, carefully chiseled the mortises with a pencil and a square chisel, and repeatedly measured and adjusted with a caliper. After two and a half hours, the parts were complete, and when assembled, the tenons fit perfectly. A warm, smooth little stool was born, giving him a strong sense of accomplishment. Afterwards, while cleaning up the tools, Mingxuan expressed to Master Qian his desire to systematically learn traditional woodworking and consulted about the beginner training course next month. Master Qian praised his aptitude and explained the schedule, content, and fees in detail. Mingxuan said he would reply after discussing it at home.
location: No. 9, Yuhe Renjia Commercial Street, Liuxin Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, 'Adze, Chisel, Axe and Saw' Woodworking Workshop

name: Return trip to pick up mother, community shopping, and quick lunch
description: Mingxuan said goodbye to Master Qian and drove back to Huating International Community. On the way, he received a call from his mother, Wang Xiulan, who wanted to buy sea bass at the community vegetable store. Mingxuan picked her up on the way and accompanied her at the 'Green Source Fresh' community vegetable store at the south gate of the community as she picked out live sea bass, tender spinach, and cilantro. His mother chatted with the shopkeeper about prices. Mingxuan helped carry the groceries home, then sorted the ingredients into the fridge, threw away expired sauces, and tidied up. Then he quickly fixed lunch for himself: he reheated last night's tomato scrambled eggs and heated frozen beef pies in the air fryer. After eating in a hurry, he prepared for his afternoon appointment with Zhang Wei.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the 'Lvyuan Xiansheng' community vegetable store at the south gate.

name: Walked to the subway station and met up with a childhood friend to go to Mingliu Teahouse.
description: Mingxuan put on his canvas bag and walked about 35 minutes to Exit A of Caozhuang Station on Metro Line 2, where he met his childhood friend Zhang Wei, who was already waiting there. The two swiped their cards through the gates, took the train toward Binhai International Airport, transferred to Line 1 at Xinanjiao Station, got off at Yingkou Road Station, and walked a few minutes from Exit E to reach Mingliu Teahouse. Along the way, they chatted about the convenience of the inventory management software upgrade at Zhang Wei's shop and the pressure from the simulation optimization plan Mingxuan needed to rush to complete next week.
location: Mingliu Teahouse, 1st Floor, Heping Cultural Palace, 177 Xinhua Road, Heping District, Tianjin (accessible via Caozhuang Station on Metro Line 2 and Yingkoudao Station on Line 1)

name: Enjoy Tianjin-style crosstalk at Mingliu Teahouse.
description: The tea and melon seed aromas filled the teahouse. After Mingxuan and Zhang Wei sat down, they ordered a pot of jasmine tea and a plate of spiced melon seeds. As the performance began, the performers delivered traditional routines such as "Learning Sign Language" and "Tongue Twisters", as well as newly written pieces on current events. Laughter and applause kept rising from the audience, and the two were doubled over with laughter, all the stress of work melting away.
location: Mingliu Teahouse, First Floor, Heping Cultural Palace, No. 177 Xinhua Road, Heping District, Tianjin

name: Strolling along Binjiang Road Commercial Street with Zhang Wei
description: After the show ended, the two strolled along Binjiang Road. The weather was warming up and a gentle breeze brushed their faces. Passing by the 'Shitou Menkan' vegetarian bun shop, Zhang Wei bought some vegetarian buns; then at Xiaobao Chestnuts they bought steaming hot sugar-roasted chestnuts, and Mingxuan also bought a small bag. The two walked while shelling chestnuts and chatting about old Tianjin stories until it grew dark, then parted at Yingkou Road Metro Station.
location: Binjiang Road Commercial Street, Heping District, Tianjin

name: Took the subway back home
description: Mingxuan took Line 1 at Yingkoudao Station, transferred to Line 2 at Xinanjiao Station, and got off at Caozhuang Station. The metro was not crowded on the way back. He looked through the close-ups of the woodworking workshop and candid shots of the crosstalk stage on his phone, and sent a stage photo to his father Ye Jianguo. His father replied that it reminded him of the days when he used to listen to crosstalk in his youth.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (return by metro)

name: Rest at home, warm dinner, and social sharing.
description: Mingxuan hung up his coat when he got home. His mother was busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of steamed sea bass wafted out. He chatted with his father about today's woodworking and crosstalk experience, and his father was full of praise for the little stool. Then he went to his room to charge the power bank. During dinner, the family sat together enjoying steamed sea bass, garlic spinach, cucumber salad, and winter melon meatball soup, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the table and put away the dishes, then sat on the living room sofa and picked four photos (close-up of the stool, tool wall, stage candid shot, and group photo with Zhang Wei) to post on WeChat Moments, with the caption 'Carpenter in the morning, crosstalk fan in the afternoon, this Saturday was full of Tianjin flavor.' Soon he got likes and comments from Zhao Xiaofeng, Li Xiang, and others.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Deep dive into ancient coin error varieties.
description: Mingxuan remembered the error coin post on the forum from last night, went into the study and carefully examined the "Sun Yat-sen Founding Commemorative Coin", used a phone flashlight to observe the irregular defect at the bottom of the "Yuan" character, compared it with the forum's featured posts and searched keywords. The more he looked, the more he felt it might be a rare error coin, so he decided to buy a high-power magnifying glass and an electronic scale next week for further study.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Healthy eating review and bedtime
description: Mingxuan came out of the study. His mother was binge-watching a drama on the sofa. He went to the kitchen to pour a glass of water, opened the Mint Health app, and logged the day's diet: breakfast 400 kcal, lunch 550 kcal, dinner 750 kcal, chestnuts 150 kcal, totaling about 1850 kcal and within the target range. His mother laughed at him for calculating again, and he praised her for cooking healthy meals. Then he washed up briefly, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed reviewing the fulfilling day: making a stool by hand, enjoying a crosstalk show, and discovering a new direction for ancient coins, while work pressure faded. He set the alarm for 8:30 tomorrow and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Get up, wash up, and record work inspiration
description: After waking up naturally in the morning, I went to the bathroom to wash up. Returning to the bedroom, I quickly jotted down on the notepad on the nightstand the key points of the idea about “engine mount stress concentration optimization” that had come to mind before bed last night, and took a photo and saved it to my phone's memo app so I wouldn't forget.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Have breakfast and discuss the day's arrangements with his mother
description: Mother Wang Xiulan prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, and two vegetable buns. While eating, I told her today's plan: in the morning I would accompany Zhang Wei to look at cars, in the afternoon go to Yangliuqing Antique Market, and in the evening go shopping with her at AEON supermarket. Mother nodded in agreement and reminded me to be careful during the test drive.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Contact a fellow collector to schedule a video appraisal time.
description: He took out his phone and sent a WeChat message to his collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an: "Brother Zhao, are you free for a video call on Wednesday or Thursday evening? I got a batch of nickel coins, and I'm not sure about a few varieties. I'd like your expert opinion." A few minutes later, Lao Zhao replied: "How about after 8 p.m. on Wednesday? I'm free." He replied, "Great," and set a reminder in his phone calendar for Wednesday evening.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waiting for my childhood friend and getting ready to go out.
description: Put on a coat, checked my phone, wallet, and notebook, and saw from the window that Zhang Wei's car had already turned into the community gate, so I went downstairs to greet him.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Accompanied a childhood friend on an SUV test drive and made a rational decision on the car purchase plan.
description: At 9:30, his childhood friend Zhang Wei picked him up by car. Driving along Zhongbei Avenue, Outer Ring West Road and other main roads for about 34 minutes, they arrived at the FAW-Volkswagen 4S store in the Automobile City of Dasi Town, Xiqing District at around 10:05. In the store, Zhang Wei enthusiastically introduced the highlights of the new family SUV, and he carefully felt the driver's seat space, seat comfort, and center console layout. After the test drive, sitting in the passenger seat, he used the calculator on his phone to work out the monthly mortgage payment, property management fee, and car maintenance costs after buying the house, and concluded that “buying a car now would seriously affect the savings plan.” On the way back, he wrote down the decision in his pocket notebook: “Buying a house takes priority; buying a car is postponed to 2026,” took a photo, and sent it to Zhang Wei. Although Zhang Wei was disappointed, he understood his friend's considerations.
location: FAW-Volkswagen Tianjin Huataitong 4S Store at No. 15-1 Chuyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the surrounding test drive route

name: Returned home from the automobile city
description: Zhang Wei drove him back to the entrance of the community. They chatted in the car for a while. Zhang Wei said he would keep watching and would find him the best price when he was ready to buy a car. Ye Mingxuan thanked him, got out of the car, and went home.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Had lunch and discussed next week's meal plan with Mom.
description: After arriving home, my mother had already prepared lunch: a plate of muxu pork and a plate of stir-fried lettuce. While eating, I opened the Boohee Health app on my phone to show her this week's calorie records, pointing out that protein intake was a bit low and the variety of vegetables was rather limited. The two of us discussed next week's menu at the table, and my mother agreed to try making more steamed fish, blanched shrimp, and combinations of chicken breast with broccoli.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon nap and some phone relaxation
description: After dinner, I leaned back on the sofa and rested for over ten minutes, and while doing so, I scrolled through Hupu for a bit, reading NBA news and posts to relax.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycle to Yangliuqing Antique Market
description: After enough rest, I went out. It was less than 3 km from Huating International Community to the Yangliuqing Antique Market, so I decided to ride a shared bike there, about 15 minutes, to stretch my limbs.
location: Yangliuqing Antique Market, at the intersection of Liukou Road and Qingyuan Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Browsed the antique market to hunt for appraisal tools.
description: He headed straight to a familiar coin and miscellany shop and greeted the owner. On the owner's recommendation, he carefully picked out a 10x folding magnifier and a high-precision electronic scale, spending less than 150 yuan in total and feeling it was good value. Afterward, he browsed two used-book stalls; although he didn't find any coin-related books, he still enjoyed himself.
location: Yangliuqing Antique Market, at the intersection of Liukou Road and Qingyuan Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Stop by Liukou Road for a haircut on the way
description: After coming out of the antique market, he saw a hair salon called "Fayi Styling" by the roadside. There weren't many people inside, so he went in and got a haircut. He told the barber, "Just trim the sides shorter and thin out the top a bit." It was done in a few minutes.
location: Hair Styling Salon on Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Ride a shared bike home.
description: After getting a haircut, he unlocked a shared bike and rode home. On the way, he stopped at the fruit shop at the entrance of the residential community and bought a few apples.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize ancient coins and prepare for next week's online exchange.
description: After returning home, he took out the coin collection box, a new magnifying glass, the China Machine-Made Silver Dollar Catalog, and cotton gloves from the study drawer. Wearing the gloves, he carefully inspected the batch of cheap ancient coins purchased at the flea market earlier this year with the new magnifying glass, roughly classifying them into silver coins, copper coins, and nickel coins. He focused on the character "yuan" on the "Sun Yat-sen Founding Commemorative Coin" and, under strong light, indeed spotted a very subtle mark that might be a missing stroke, which excited him greatly. He recorded in detail the features of several nickel coins in fair condition in his notebook, planning to discuss them with Zhao Jianguo on Wednesday evening.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walked with my mother to Aeon Supermarket for a big shopping trip.
description: In the evening, I walked with my mother to the Aeon supermarket in Zhongbei Town, about 30 minutes. I took out the list I had prepared earlier in my phone memo, and my mother and I split up. I was responsible for buying shrimp, steak, chicken breast, broccoli, mixed vegetable salad pack, and zero-fat salad dressing; my mother went to pick up soy sauce and cooking wine from a time-honored brand, planning to make a healthy version of braised pork. We met at the checkout, discussing how to cook according to the new menu tomorrow.
location: AEON Mall (Tianjin Zhongbei Store), No. 1 Fusheng Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Go home to prepare dinner and have dinner with the family
description: Back home, he proactively went into the kitchen to help his mother and washed the broccoli she had bought. Dinner was abundant: his mother made steamed sea bass, a healthier version of braised pork (using lean meat, less oil and less sugar), and garlic broccoli. The family of three chatted while eating. His father asked about the car viewing situation that morning, so he told him about his decision to postpone buying a car and explained the reasons, which won his father's approval.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Make a detailed meal plan for next week.
description: After dinner, he returned to his study and opened the Excel template on his computer. Based on the total calorie and macronutrient ratios agreed with the coach, and taking into account the afternoon's shopping list and the refrigerator inventory, he worked out a detailed three-meal-and-snack plan from Monday to Sunday, down to specifics like "150g steak / 200g broccoli / 50g brown rice." After finishing, he sent a screenshot of the plan to the family group and synced next week's "Healthy Eating" calendar reminders to his phone.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Learn programming and data processing on Bilibili
description: During free time, instead of playing games, he opened Bilibili and found a practical tutorial in his favorites about using the pandas library for data cleaning. He followed the video and typed code for more than half an hour, practicing how to use DataFrame to handle tabular data, and felt it would be very helpful for processing experimental data at work.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and reviewing the day before bed
description: I went to the bathroom and took a shower. After the shower, I stood on the scale, weighed myself, and recorded it in the app. Then I washed up and, by the bedside, reviewed today's decisions about "postponing the car purchase," "organizing ancient coins," and "making a diet plan," feeling very grounded.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Read a book on coins before going to bed.
description: I picked up the Catalogue of Chinese Machine-Made Silver Dollars from the bedside and spent a while reading about the varieties of Jiangnan Province dragon dollars, thinking it would be useful for the exchange with Old Zhao on Wednesday. I felt a sense of control over the upcoming Monday workday.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Turned off the lights and got ready to sleep.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast preparation
description: Mingxuan was woken by the alarm at 6:30 in the morning. He opened the curtains and saw gloomy weather outside, with temperatures ranging from -1°C to 5°C. He went to the bathroom and weighed himself, which showed 73.7 kg, 0.3 kg higher than yesterday, so he decided to strictly control his diet this week. Then Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiulan worked together in the kitchen to prepare lunch boxes, including pan-seared chicken breast 150g, garlic broccoli 100g, and multigrain rice, weighed and recorded precisely with an electronic scale. For breakfast, he had a cup of 250ml milk, two boiled whole eggs, and one whole wheat steamed bun.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Leave home and commute
description: Mingxuan checked his commuter bag to confirm he had his laptop, insulated lunch box, work badge, and folding umbrella, put on his windbreaker, and wore his helmet and gloves. Then he rode his electric bike from Huating International Community, heading east along Zhongbei Avenue, passing Zhongbei Bridge, waiting at a red light at Xingguang Road, and arrived at the foot of Tower B, Haitai Development Building after 40 minutes. He parked in the charging area and locked the bike.
location: From Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Sixth Road

name: Morning work preparation and initial model tuning.
description: After arriving at his workstation, Mingxuan turned on the computer and poured hot water, spent 15 minutes sorting out the key points from the discussion with Li Xiang, and prepared screenshots of the Pro/E model and calculation data. Then he opened the Pro/E model, modified key parameters such as rib thickness and fillet radius based on last Friday's meeting minutes and new ideas, and ran basic calculation analysis to be fully prepared for the 10 o'clock meeting.
location: 12th Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Technical discussion meeting
description: Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang discussed simulation model optimization in the small meeting room. Mingxuan proposed adjusting the lower base plate boundary condition to elastic support and presented the pre-adjusted model. Li Xiang suggested using a finer hexahedral mesh. The two agreed: Mingxuan would correct the model parameters by the end of today, and Li Xiang would complete the optimized results with the new mesh by Wednesday. The meeting reached a consensus efficiently.
location: Small meeting room, 12th Floor, Block B, Haitai Development Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday relaxation and lunch
description: After the meeting, Mingxuan felt stiffness in his neck and shoulders. He walked to the window, looked out over Huayuan Science Park, and did chest-opening and shoulder-circle movements to relax. Later, he returned to his desk to refine the parameters. At noon, he went to the break room to heat up his homemade bento. His colleague Zhou Tao also came to heat his meal, and the two shared and tasted each other's food. Mingxuan ate chicken breast, broccoli, and mixed-grain rice, and chatted with Zhou Tao about their weekend test-driving experiences with new-energy electric cars.
location: 12th Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and online learning
description: After resting with his eyes closed at his desk for 20 minutes, Mingxuan put on earphones and watched a 15-minute Python pandas data cleaning hands-on video on Bilibili to prepare for his personal programming project.
location: 12th Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work and end-of-day preparations
description: Mingxuan focused on adjusting the model parameters, especially the local fillets and boundary condition definitions, then submitted the task to the high-performance computing server in the company's server room for simulation. While waiting, he organized his work log and next day's plan. At 5:15, he confirmed the simulation task had been successfully submitted, tidied his workstation, packed his insulated lunch box, and grabbed his gym bag to get ready to leave.
location: Tower B, Haitai Development Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Fitness training and nutritional supplementation

description: Woken by the phone alarm at exactly 7 a.m., I first did 5 minutes of neck stretches and shoulder circles in bed to relieve the stiffness from sitting for a long time last night. After getting out of bed, I washed my face with cold water to refresh myself, put on a light jacket, and went downstairs for a 20-minute brisk walk around Huating International Community. The temperature in the early morning of late February was only 2 degrees, and the air was crisp. While walking, I mentally sorted out today's work priorities: I needed to handle the last design change order, confirm the simulation report with Li Xiang, and contact Master Zhang in the workshop.

name: Breakfast and diet record
description: After he got home, his mother had already prepared breakfast: warm milk oatmeal porridge, a boiled egg, and two vegetable buns. Lin Yan opened the Boohee Health app on his phone and logged the breakfast items one by one, noting that the carbohydrates today were moderate and suitable for a workout day. While watching him eat, his mother reminded him not to catch a cold when playing ball in the evening. Lin Yan acknowledged, finished eating quickly, and got ready to commute.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting by bus.
description: At 8:00 sharp, he put on his earphones, slung on his commuter bag, and left. After walking 5 minutes to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, he caught the No. 616 bus bound for Haitai on time. There were few passengers on the bus. Lin Yan sat by the window, opened his phone, and browsed a technical article excerpt about the Flask framework that Xu Ming, a friend in Shenzhen, had shared in the group chat the night before, preparing for future web development learning. About 45 minutes later, he arrived at the stop near the Haitai Development Office Building.
location: From Huating International Residential Complex, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, took Bus 616 to Haitai Fazhan Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District.

name: Morning work and project communication
description: At 8:45, he arrived at his workstation on the 4th floor of the Haitai Development Office Building. After a quick wipe of the desk, he started the computer, logged into his email and the project management system. In the inbox were a client's confirmation letter about the design change order and a reminder about the project team's regular meeting. From 9:00, he focused on processing the last design change order, which involved replacing a rolling bearing model. He opened the drawing in CAD, modified the local dimensions of the assembly drawing, recalculated the shaft-hole fit tolerance, and after confirming that it met the standards in the Mechanical Design Manual, submitted it for review through the electronic workflow. At 10:30, a search in the system revealed that his colleague Li Xiang had completed and archived the simulation report before leaving work the previous day. Lin Yan quickly browsed it to confirm the data was complete, sent Li Xiang an instant message to confirm, and downloaded the report for archiving. At 11:00, he briefly discussed next week's test plan for the photovoltaic cleaning device prototype with Li Xiang in front of the whiteboard in the small meeting room, clarifying the division of responsibilities and delivery time points. After returning to his workstation, he jotted down the key feedback points on a sticky note. In the last half hour, he sorted the scattered technical sketches, calculation drafts, and heat treatment reference materials into the file rack, labeled the used notebook “2025.02” and put it back on the bookshelf. The desk was restored to neatness.
location: 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch gathering with colleagues
description: At noon, Zhou Tao suggested that the three of them — Lin Yan, Li Xiang, and Zhou Tao — go try the newly opened Japanese-style casual restaurant “Shiguangli” near the office building. They walked there together. Lin Yan ordered the teriyaki chicken thigh set meal and specially changed the staple food to steamed sweet potato. When logging the meal in his phone app, he added the note “carb supplement on training day.” During the meal, the three talked about weekend plans. Zhou Tao said he wanted to see a newly released movie. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Shiguangli Japanese Casual Dining Restaurant, near Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and technical exchange
description: After returning to the company, Lin Yan put on an eye mask and napped at his desk for 20 minutes to recover his energy. After waking up, he habitually sent a WeChat message to his friend Xu Ming in Shenzhen, chatting about the follow-up optimization directions for the "automatic report generator" project discussed in the group chat last night, and asking about the pros and cons of Django vs Flask as backend frameworks. Xu Ming enthusiastically sent voice messages sharing his views, and Lin Yan jotted down key points while listening.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon: routine work and workshop follow-up.
description: At 1:30 p.m., I first handled the client confirmation reply and updated the project schedule, then opened the department's shared 'February Work Summary Sheet' and briefly filled in the main work completed this month and key technical improvements, preparing for the report to Manager Wang next Monday. At 3:00, I called Zhang Jianguo, the workshop master in charge of prototype trial production, to follow up on the structurally optimized parts submitted last week. Zhang reported that the parts were already in production, but there was a burr issue during drilling. Lin Yan suggested over the phone trying to adjust the feed rate, and after hanging up, immediately set an 8:00 reminder in his phone memo: check Zhang's handling feedback. At 4:00, I started wrapping up, filing and organizing today's revised drawings and emails, confirming all items were marked complete; on a sticky note I listed the top task for Monday (confirm the prototype burr feedback), then closed all work software and packed my commute bag.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Then he walked about 12 minutes to Limei Fitness Center, taking in the cool evening air to relax a bit along the way. After arriving, he went into the locker room to change into his workout gear, then went early to the open area outside the body assessment zone for 5 minutes of jogging and joint mobility exercises, getting his body slightly warm.
location: Yiyi Community Group Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin; then went to Limei Fitness Center, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District.

description: Coach Wang Jian arrived at the body measurement area on time and used a body fat scale to perform a standard measurement for Lin Yan. The results showed a weight of 73.2 kg and a body fat percentage of 22.0%, a significant decrease from 23.1% at the beginning of the month. Lin Yan opened the food diary on his phone and reviewed the past week's dietary adjustments with the coach, specifically mentioning that he proactively added quality carbs like sweet potatoes on training days. The coach affirmed the results, and they agreed to add a 45-minute aerobic interval training session per week next month on top of strength training. Also, targeting Lin Yan's shoulder and neck fatigue, the coach taught him a new set of activation warm-up exercises on the spot. The whole exchange lasted nearly an hour.
location: Physical fitness assessment area, Limei Fitness Center, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Basketball practice and returning home
description: After the physical fitness test, Lin Yan rehydrated and ate two protein bars he had brought, changed into basketball shoes, locked his gym bag in the locker room, and walked 3 minutes to the adjacent community multi-purpose court. Between 18:30 and 19:00, he rested by the court and observed the venue. As his teammates gradually arrived, captain Zhao Gang organized the last training session of February: first 15 minutes of basic dribbling and shooting warm-up, then a scrimmage in groups. Lin Yan was energetic today and very active on defense, repeatedly disrupting opponents' shots and grabbing key defensive rebounds. Training lasted until 20:15, when everyone sat around the bench to summarize the month's gains. Lin Yan admitted that his stamina and tactical off-ball movement awareness had improved significantly. The team agreed to keep training twice a week in March and strive for good results in the quarterly friendly match. At 20:30 he said goodbye to his teammates and walked 15 minutes back to Huating International Community in the evening breeze, feeling physically refreshed.
location: Community multi-purpose court in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, then walked back to Huating International Community.

name: Relaxing shower
description: After entering the house, I first drank a large glass of warm water, then took a comfortable hot shower in the bathroom, washing away the sweat and fatigue after exercise. After showering, I changed into loose loungewear and completely relaxed.
location: Bathroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing Python learning outcomes
description: Opened the laptop in his study and logged in to GitHub, organized the notes and practice code from the entire Python course into three modules — 'Basic Syntax,' 'Pandas Data Analysis,' and 'Project Practice: Report Generator' — and uploaded them to a newly created private repository. He also wrote a concise README file. Then he wrote a thank-you email to the course instructor, expressing his plan to continue learning web frameworks such as Django/Flask, and sent it to the instructor.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

He suggested that if he got back early enough from tomorrow's woodworking class, he would accompany her to Caozhuang Flower Market for a stroll, and his mother happily agreed. Then Lin Yan went to the balcony, used a spray bottle to water his beloved succulents, and rotated one of the pots so it would receive more even light.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime routine and reading.
description: Back in the bedroom, Lin Yan did 10 minutes of bedtime stretching on the yoga mat beside the bed, focusing on relaxing the shoulders, neck, and lower back that were tense from sitting for long periods and exercising. After that, she poured half a glass of warm water and placed it on the nightstand, set an alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, and opened the chapter on mortise and tenon structure in Ming-style Furniture Research. Leaning against the headboard, she read quietly for about 15 minutes. During this time, her mother brought a warm cup of honey milk and urged her to rest early. After drinking the milk, Lin Yan turned off the light and lay down, reviewing the fulfilling day, feeling content with the successful conclusion of February, and gradually falling asleep with slight anticipation for tomorrow's woodworking training.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Natural wake-up and morning preparation.

Last night before bed I had looked at some dovetail joint drawings, and today's first lesson would officially begin systematic study; I felt a faint sense of excitement.
location: Home bedroom, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and mindset adjustment
description: While washing up, I stretched my neck and shoulders in the mirror. Seeing 73.3 kg on the scale and remembering Coach Wang's reminder from yesterday, I decided to be more careful with my diet today. After washing my face, I felt refreshed and energetic.
location: Home bathroom, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: Walking out of the bedroom, my mother was opening the wardrobe on the balcony, muttering that the weather had warmed up quickly these days and that the thick down jackets needed to be put away. I went over to help. Together we folded the thick winter coats and sweaters into storage bins, and hung a few light jackets and shirts within easy reach.
location: Master bedroom and balcony at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast with parents.

I took a sip of the porridge and told them that this morning I had the first lesson of the woodworking training class, and in the afternoon I would go to Master Qian's place. Father nodded and said, 'Learn the basic skills well.'
location: Dining room at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: After breakfast, I checked my canvas bag to make sure the notebook, pen, and the marking gauge I sanded yesterday were all inside, then changed into a leather jacket and went out. Walking from the residential community to the Xiqing Adult Technical School beside Zhongbei Avenue takes about 8 minutes. The morning breeze was slightly cool, and my steps were brisk.
location: Xiqing District Adult Technical School, west side of the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-class preparation and attendance check-in.
description: When I arrived at the classroom, several trainees were already there. I found my workstation and laid out my notebook and pen. On the podium, the teacher was adjusting the projector. I glanced at the schedule; today's lessons were 'History of Chinese Furniture and Basics of Mortise-and-Tenon Joints' and 'Demonstration of Making Flat Mortise and Tenon Joints'.

name: First lesson of the spring training course on traditional woodworking skills.
description: The class started on time. The instructor first talked about the cultural origins of traditional woodworking, then focused on demonstrating the marking, sawing, and chiseling techniques for flat mortise-and-tenon joints. I listened very attentively, took careful notes, and during the hands-on practice I repeatedly checked my layout lines with a try square. During the break, I chatted briefly with a classmate surnamed Liu, a man in his forties, who said he works in interior design and wanted to make a small desk for his daughter. At the end of the class, the instructor distributed a list of 16 basic tools, including chisels and planes, and reminded everyone to bring them next time.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, west side of the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanhui Road, Xiqing District Adult Technical School, Woodworking Training Classroom

name: Walk home
description: After class, I walked home along the same route I had taken. I was still savoring the teacher's words, 'Marking lines is the soul of woodworking,' and planned to review my notes again when I got home.
location: Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch.
description: When I got home, my mother had already prepared lunch. Knowing I went to learn a craft today, she specially made my favorite muxu pork and stir-fried eggplant. During the meal, I briefly shared what I saw in class that morning. My father listened carefully and even asked what tools the teacher had introduced.
location: Dining room at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and tool preparation
description: After lunch, I didn't rest right away. Returning to the study, I first took a photo of the tool list I received today, then took out my portable try square and old chisel, and sanded the edges with sandpaper to prepare for visiting Master Qian in the afternoon. Then I leaned back in the chair and rested with my eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Home study, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycling to the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop
description: At 1:20 pm, I got on a shared bike and set off. From Zhongbei Town to Yangliuqing Town is about 3 kilometers; cycling west along Zhongbei Avenue and through a few intersections gets you there. The breeze felt very pleasant.

name: Woodworking workshop learning: wood characteristics and baseline drawing.
description: Arrived at the workshop on time. Master Qian had prepared pine, beech, and Manchurian ash lumber and let me touch each one to feel the texture and density, and explained in detail how they differed in strength and moisture content. Then he personally taught me how to use a marking gauge with a try square to accurately draw a reference line on the beech square stock. I practiced repeatedly for nearly an hour until the lines I drew were straight and uniform in depth; only then did he nod with approval and say, "Now that's starting to look like something."
location: Master Qian's Woodworking Workshop, south side of the intersection of Liukou Road and Zunmei Street, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Rode back home.
description: With the satisfaction of the whole afternoon, I rode my bike home. The sun was low in the west, and the cool breeze felt pleasant on my face. I felt that the hands-on skills I learned today were far more practical than reading for a month.
location: Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Systematically organize study notes and plan practice.
description: After returning home, I sat down at my desk and integrated the content from today's training class and Master Qian's teachings into a complete knowledge system. In my notebook, I drew a quick-reference chart of wood characteristics, and recorded the key points and common mistakes of marking reference lines using text plus simple diagrams. Finally, I wrote on the notebook's flyleaf: “Saturday: systematic learning, honing my craft.”
location: Home study, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Chatting with my mother and tending to the plants.
description: My mother was watching TV in the living room. I walked over and chatted with her for a while about my thoughts today. Then I went to the balcony, watered the pots of succulents, and checked whether the newly bought Haworthia had settled in.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner

I noticed Dad was in a good mood today and talked more than usual, so I asked him about the problem with the old desk lamp in the study. Dad said the switch had not been making good contact for a long time.
location: Dining room at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

I took the initiative to bring out the toolbox and tested the circuit with my father using a multimeter, eventually determining that the switch had aged. While replacing it, my father casually demonstrated how he used to crimp wire ends to replace plugs at the fitter's bench in the machine tool factory back in the day. I listened with great interest and also tried my hand at soldering a wire with the soldering iron.
location: Study and tool room at home, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

In the WeChat group, my mechanical engineer colleague Li Xiang posted a link to a new paper on three-axis motion control. I clicked in, skimmed through it, marked a few key points, and plan to read it more carefully tomorrow.
location: Home study, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

What flashed through my mind was the straight reference line I had marked in the woodworking shop that afternoon. With a fulfilling sense of satisfaction, I soon fell asleep.

name: Online ancient coin appraisal lecture and personal collection appraisal
description: The lecture started on time, titled 'Scientific Methodology for the Authentication of Machine-Struck Coins.' The instructor explained the key points of authentication through material density, traces of minting techniques, and patina oxidation patterns. Ye Mingxuan listened while examining his own collection. When the instructor discussed the edge reeding density features of the Yuan Datou from the third year of the Republic of China, Ye measured his coin with a vernier caliper and found a 0.02 mm deviation from the standard value. After repeated comparisons and combining it with the characteristics of the 'Chongqing version,' he judged it to be a counterfeit. He did further research and speculated that the field texture of this counterfeit was consistent with the temporary supplemental minting process at the Chongqing Mint during the War of Resistance, possibly hiding a piece of wartime monetary history. He wrote down all the identification steps and inferences in detail in his notebook.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin
