location: Dining room, Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting by bus.
description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan checked his commuter bag: a lunchbox, a folding umbrella, a notebook, and a car magazine, then put on his coat and left. He walked about 5 minutes from Huating International Community to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop and took Route 616 bus to the company. During the morning rush hour, the bus was quite crowded; he found a corner spot and stood, put on his earphones, and listened to an industry podcast episode about "trends in integrated die-casting technology for new energy vehicles." Thinking of his childhood friend Zhang Wei, who wanted to work in car sales, he jotted down a few keywords about Tesla's integrated die-casting in his phone memo for future conversations.
location: From Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, taking Bus 616 via Zhongbei Avenue Bus Stop.

name: Morning core work and drawing refinement.
description: After arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan clocked in with a fingerprint scan, went to his workstation, turned on his computer, checked his schedule and email, dragged the drawing files to be handled today from the project shared drive to the desktop, and opened CAD and professional calculation tools. Then he focused on the simulation optimization plan finalized yesterday, precisely adjusting the stiffening rib sizes and chamfers at key positions on the CAD drawings. Around 10:00, his colleague Li Xiang came over with the printed simulation analysis report; the two had a brief five-minute discussion and confirmed that the latest stress distribution data met the design requirements. After that, Ye Mingxuan updated the project progress memo, changing the status of 'Complete first-round optimization of drawings' to 'In Progress,' and estimated the completion time.
location: Workstation and small meeting room, Room 702, 7th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and a stroll around the park
description: At lunchtime, colleague Zhou Tao came over to call Ye Mingxuan to go to the cafeteria together. He pointed at the homemade lunch box he had brought and said with a smile, “Bringing my own food today.” After heating the lunch box in the office pantry microwave, he returned to his desk and ate while browsing industry news on a mechanical automation forum on his phone. After finishing lunch and cleaning up the dishes, he took advantage of the good weather to take a walk in the small garden behind the office building. He strolled along the green path for about 15 minutes, stretching his shoulders and neck that had become stiff from sitting too long, breathing fresh air, and felt much more refreshed.
location: Workstation at Room 702, 7th Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the green path behind the office building

name: Noon break
description: After taking a walk, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation, put on a U-shaped neck pillow, dimmed the monitor, and rested with his eyes closed, head on the desk, for about 30 minutes. He had stayed up a bit late playing games with Zheng Kai last night, and today's midday nap restored his energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Workstation, Room 702, Floor 7, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon: drawing optimization and presentation preparation.
description: The afternoon work was divided into two parts. In the first half, Ye Mingxuan made a small adjustment to a detail of the transmission structure based on a new idea from his noon walk. At 3 p.m., colleague Zhou Tao came over to discuss the dynamic sealing structure issue of another parallel project, and he gave two suggestions based on his past experience. In the second half, he began preparing the project report materials for next week, organizing this week’s work results and next week’s plan. At 4 p.m., he confirmed the final adjusted simulation results with colleague Li Xiang again; after confirming they were correct, he saved the final optimized drawings and uploaded them to the project shared drive. Near the end of the workday, he checked off the last two items on today’s to-do list in his memo, closed the CAD software, tidied his desk, put his water bottle and notebook into his commuter bag, and got ready to leave. During that time, he checked his phone and saw that his mother had posted a community group-buying notice in the family group, reminding him to pick up the vegetables on the way.
location: Workstation, Room 702, Floor 7, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute from work and pick up group-buy groceries
description: Ye Mingxuan clocked out on time and took bus No. 616 back toward Zhongbei Avenue. After getting off, he walked about 8 minutes to the 'Yiyi Community Group Buying' pickup point at the ground-floor shops of Xiqingyuan in Zhongbei Town. After checking the order number with the shopkeeper, he took a plastic bag full of vegetables and fruit, thanked her, and carried the bag home, arriving smoothly.
location: Yiyi Community Group-Buying Pickup Point, ground-floor shop, Xiqingyuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going home to rest and recharge.
description: After arriving home, Ye Mingxuan handed the vegetables he had picked up to his mother, who was preparing dinner. He then packed his gym clothes, towel, and water bottle into his sports backpack. Since he still had about an hour before going to the gym, he ate half a banana and a slice of whole-wheat bread in advance as a quick carbohydrate supplement before training.
location: Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Following Ye Mingxuan's health plan, his mother made steamed sole and garlic stir-fried lettuce for dinner. The family of three chatted while eating. Ye Mingxuan told his parents that he had a personal training session tonight and might come back a little later. His mother reminded him to buy a carton of milk after training to replenish his strength, and he made a mental note of it.
location: Dining room, Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walking to the gym
description: Ye Mingxuan rested at home for a while and helped his mother clear the dishes. Then he picked up his pre-packed gym bag, put on his sports shoes, left home, and walked about 20 minutes to Limei Fitness Center. Limei Fitness Center is about 1.5 kilometers from the residential community.
location: Walk from Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Limei Fitness Center, 2nd floor, Yunjin Shuiyuan commercial podium, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District.

name: Personal training session and relaxation shopping
description: After arriving at the gym, Ye Mingxuan swiped his membership card at the front desk, went into the locker room to change into his training clothes, filled his water bottle, and walked to the strength training area. His personal trainer Wang Jian was already waiting, and after a brief greeting they started the session. This workout included four sets each of squats, bench press, and barbell rows for muscle gain, followed by 15 minutes of core training: four sets of planks (1 minute each) and three sets of weighted Russian twists (20 reps each). He gritted his teeth and completed all the sets, his clothes soaked with sweat. After the core training, Coach Wang arranged for him to do 30 minutes of steady-state cardio on the elliptical machine, keeping his heart rate around 140. Overall, his stamina felt subtly better than the first time. After the workout, he did a thorough stretching routine on a yoga mat to relax, then took a shower and changed back into his casual clothes. After leaving the gym, he walked downstairs to the China Resources Vanguard supermarket (Yunjin Shuiyuan Branch), picked out a carton of low-fat high-calcium milk in front of the milk shelves, paid, and left.
location: Limei Fitness Center, 2nd floor of the commercial podium, Yunjin Shuiyuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin; and Vanguard Supermarket (Yunjin Shuiyuan Store), 1st floor

name: Walking home from the gym.
description: Ye Mingxuan walked back to Huating International Community from the gym carrying a milk crate. His body was a bit tired from the physical exertion, but mentally he felt fulfilled because he had completed today's fitness goal.
location: Walked from the street-level shops of Yunjin Shuiyuan in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, to Huating International Community.

name: Go home to bathe and tidy up.
description: After returning home, his parents had already gone to their room to rest. Ye Mingxuan tiptoed back to his own room and put the milk in the refrigerator. Then he took a nice hot shower, changed into comfortable loungewear, and relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Python learning and automation script concept
description: Ye Mingxuan brewed a cup of hot tea, put on his earphones, and opened his laptop. He logged into the Python online course platform and studied the last two subsections of the "Modules and Functions" chapter. He watched the instructional videos and practiced the example code for `import` statements and function definitions in the local Jupyter Notebook. While doing the after-class exercises, he thought of his daily work, where he often had to repeatedly create similar 3D models of standard parts. So he paused the course, created a blank text file, and scribbled out a functional module sketch for the "Mechanical Standard Parts Parametric Invocation Script", including a standard parts database module, a parameter input interface module, and a model generation module. Although the framework was rough, he felt he had found a good way to combine learning with work.
location: Study room, Room 401, Entrance 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Health data recording and watering succulents
description: After finishing that round of study, Ye Mingxuan opened his health management Excel sheet, entered tonight's dinner content and training subjects, and estimated protein and carbohydrate intake. Then he went to the balcony, touched the soil of several pots of succulents, and feeling it was a bit dry, used a small spray bottle to mist them evenly.
location: Study and balcony, Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Residential Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: Ye Mingxuan did a simple stretching routine on the bed, focusing on relaxing his abdomen and shoulders from today's workout. Then he leaned against the headboard, picked up "A Study of Ming-style Furniture," turned to the chapter "The Design Philosophy of Ming-style Furniture," and read a few pages to calm his mind from programming calculations. Afterward, he glanced at his phone; it was already past 11:00, so he set the phone to silent, turned off the main bedroom light, and left only a dim bedside lamp. After confirming the 6:30 a.m. alarm for the next morning, he turned off the light and lay down. Filled with a sense of fulfillment from the day's physical and mental exertion, he soon fell fast asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 401, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning preparation
description: The sky outside the window was already light; I woke up naturally before the alarm went off. I got up quietly, and while washing up in the bathroom, habitually checked a new pimple that had appeared on my chin in the mirror. When I came to the living room, my mother had already set breakfast on the table — two steaming pork buns, a bowl of millet porridge, and a small dish of pickled vegetables. She asked with concern how I had slept last night. I told her I slept well, and she nodded with satisfaction, then turned and went back to the kitchen to tidy up.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pack the lunch box and confirm before leaving home
description: After breakfast, I opened the refrigerator, took out the homemade lunch bento box that had been packed in separate containers last night (stir-fried chicken breast with broccoli and multigrain rice), and put it into the canvas bag printed with the “Jinmen Guli” pattern. I checked my work badge, keys, and phone, and confirmed that both the lunch bag and sports backpack were ready — there was training this evening, so I had to bring my sportswear and knee pads. While changing shoes at the door, I opened my phone again to confirm the address and meeting time for the suit fitting tomorrow, making sure everything was correct.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute: confirming details with Zhang Wei
description: Left at 7:40 sharp, walked 5 minutes to Zhongbei Town bus stop. While waiting for the bus, I took out my phone and sent a WeChat message to my childhood friend Zhang Wei: “Are you up yet? Let’s meet at Zhongbei Town subway station at nine tomorrow. Don’t forget.” The bus arrived; there weren’t many people on it, so I found a seat and sat down. Soon after, Zhang Wei replied by voice: “Just woke up! No problem, see you tomorrow!” He then typed an additional message: “Send me the exact address of the formalwear shop again, just to be safe.” A few minutes later, he sent a location pin. After confirming, I put away my phone and looked out at the familiar street scene.
location: Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road (Bus No. 754)

name: Arrive at the company, brew tea, and start work
description: After getting off the bus, he walked two minutes to the company building. When swiping his card to enter, he ran into Sister Zhang from the finance department, who was also arriving just in time, and they nodded to each other. At his workstation, he put down his two bags, first went to the pantry to get a pot of hot water, put a pinch of Lu'an Guapian tea leaves into his enamel cup, and watched the leaves slowly unfurl in the hot water. He turned on the computer; the screen lit up, and on the desktop were the SolidWorks interface that had been left open yesterday, as well as a folder of revision comments sent by Engineer Gao.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning design work: tackling the core calculations.
description: All morning, he was completely immersed in technical details. He opened the design drawings and calculation tables and began working on the initial draft of the core load-bearing part of the 'Transmission Module Lightweight Optimization Plan' assigned by Engineer Gao Zhiyuan last week. To complete this part, he had to switch back and forth repeatedly between the finite element analysis software and the calculation documents, and his notebook was filled with sketches. Meanwhile, Zhou Tao passed by his workstation, leaned over to look at the screen, and said quietly, "Mingxuan, if this plan comes together, it should make a good impression at the department meeting." He smiled without looking up and continued to focus on the data flow at hand.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Project communication meeting
description: Project manager Wang Peng called a brief impromptu meeting to discuss the key points of technical coordination with the client next week. Engineer Gao Zhiyuan took the lead in analyzing several key design points. I reported the core calculation approach I had just finished that morning and offered a preliminary conclusion. Wang Peng signaled for me to continue and reminded me that I might need to give a technical presentation at next Tuesday's client meeting. Zhou Tao and Li Xiang added some optimization suggestions. The whole meeting was efficient and goal-oriented.
location: Meeting room, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch: Homemade bento and sorting out Python notes
description: After the meeting, I returned to my workstation, took out the bento box I had brought in the morning, and heated it in the microwave in the break area. While eating broccoli stir-fried chicken breast with multigrain rice, I opened my laptop. Taking advantage of the undisturbed lunch break, I opened the cloud note app and began to systematically organize last night's course notes on 'modules and functions' as well as the framework I had conceived for the 'mechanical standard parts parameterized calling script'. In the document, I added detailed descriptions and implementation priorities for each functional module, synced it with my personal cloud notes, and after confirming the sync succeeded, closed the document.
location: Rest area, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon rest and basketball gathering
description: After organizing his cloud notes, he leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for about ten minutes. His phone vibrated with a message from the department basketball team group chat. He replied, "I'll be there on time," then privately messaged Zhou Tao and Li Xiang: "Guys, training is at 6:30 today, the usual place, don't be late. As usual, Li Xiang, you're responsible for bringing two extra bottles of water." The two quickly replied "OK" and "Got it." He calmed his mind and prepared to start the afternoon's work.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon Design Work: Plan Refinement and Finalization
description: The afternoon's pace was equally intense. He integrated and fine-tuned the morning's core calculation draft with the rest of the project to ensure logical consistency. He reviewed several relevant industry standard documents and added the necessary parameter descriptions and citation notes to the design report. Around 17:15, he saved the preliminary calculation document and model files, sent a backup to Engineer Gao Zhiyuan, and briefly described the day's progress and unresolved issues in the email. Then he turned off the computer, packed up, and prepared to leave.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Left work and set off for the training gym.
description: Changed into a sports T-shirt, shorts, and basketball shoes, folded the work clothes and stuffed them into the bag. Carrying the sports backpack, walked quickly out of the office building. The weather was nice today, and the warm afterglow of the setting sun spread over the road. Following the navigation, walked to the bus stop, took the bus, and arrived at Tiangong University about 15 minutes later.
location: From No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension (by bus)

name: Department basketball team training
description: He arrived on time at the familiar indoor basketball court. Zhou Tao and Li Xiang were already there warming up. After simple stretching and jogging, the training officially began. First came round after round of shuttle runs and defensive slide drills; sweat quickly soaked his jersey. Next were two-man and three-man passing and cutting drills. His pick-and-rolls and off-ball movement with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang were already very smooth, and he was able to complete a beautiful backdoor cut and layup. The final half hour was a full-court scrimmage. He actively boxed out to grab rebounds and assisted Li Xiang on a fast break to score. At the end of training, they gathered around for a drink of water. He briefly discussed the tactical priorities for the next friendly match with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, and they agreed to work out the details in the group chat on the weekend.
location: Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Finished training and cycled home.
description: After training, I felt great all over. I wiped off sweat with a towel and high-fived my teammates goodbye. At the bus stop, I enjoyed the evening breeze and felt the work stress of the whole day melt away. After getting off the bus, I passed the fruit shop at the entrance of the neighborhood and bought a few apples on the way.
location: From No. 399, Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 128, Zhongbei Avenue (by bus).

name: Going home to relax and having dinner
description: After returning home, I put my sports bag by the door, took a refreshing hot shower, and changed into loungewear. With my hair still wet, I walked into the living room, where my parents were watching the news. Seeing me back, my mother got up and went to the kitchen to bring out the meal she had saved for me: a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables and a braised sea bass. While eating, I briefly chatted with my father about today's work and training. He nodded without saying much, but his eyes showed approval.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening hobby: ancient coin research.
description: After dinner, I helped my mother clear the tableware. I went back to my room, opened the desk drawer, and took out the fifty-wen nickel coin from the 25th year of the Republic of China (1936) that I had recently found, along with a printed copy of coin research materials. I turned on a strong flashlight and carefully examined the reeded edge and inscription details of the nickel coin with a magnifying glass, comparing them with the die variety characteristics in the materials to try to determine its specific variety. At the same time, I browsed the latest market posts and appraisal notes on an ancient coin collecting forum, and recorded the images and features of the nickel coin in my collection document on the computer.
location: Study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Before-bed time: browsing Moments
description: 22:30, I put down the magnifying glass, washed up, and lay in bed. Picked up my phone and scrolled through Moments for a while. I saw that Zhang Wei had updated his status at 8 p.m. It was a behind-the-scenes video from a wedding photo shoot, captioned “One month countdown — a bit nervous but really looking forward to it!” I opened the video, saw a few cheerful candid shots, smiled knowingly, liked it, and left a comment: “See you Saturday, the best man is ready!” Seeing this post, I felt genuinely happy for him, my friend of twenty years.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing for sleep
description: He turned off the phone screen and stopped looking at any messages. He checked the alarm clock and confirmed that the 9 a.m. appointment with Zhang Wei tomorrow was correct. Lying flat, he closed his eyes and went over the fulfilling day in his mind: work had seen progress, his body had been exercised, and in the evening he had researched something he enjoyed. He felt grounded and satisfied. Tomorrow would be a day to prepare for a major life event with a good friend. Accompanied by the occasional chirping of insects outside the window, he slowly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning family breakfast and departure preparations
description: Woke up at seven in the morning sharp. The weather outside was clear and sunny, and sunlight streamed into the bedroom. After washing up, I went to the living room. My father had already brewed tea and was watching the morning news, and my mother brought out hot soy milk and jianbing guozi. The family chatted while eating about the article analyzing the edge-tooth varieties of the Republic of China nickel coin discovered last night. My father recalled the molds he had seen at the factory when he was young and was in high spirits. After breakfast, I went back to my room, changed into durable work pants and an old jacket, carefully checked the chisels, marking gauge, try square and other tools in the woodworking tool bag, charged the electric bicycle key, and put on a helmet and gloves. Before leaving, I glanced at the weather on my phone: 16°C, south wind force 3, comfortable.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycling to the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop
description: Riding an electric bike west along Zhongbei Avenue, crossing Jinjing Highway, with gentle sunshine all the way. Passing by Yangliuqing Square, he saw many elderly people doing morning exercises and children flying kites, and felt very pleased. About 18 minutes later, he arrived at Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop, located next to the old town parking lot, and parked the bike in an empty spot at the entrance.
location: The section from Zhongbei Avenue to Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Traditional woodworking skills training and practice
description: After arriving at the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop and greeting Master Qian, he first demonstrated the marking method for a standard right-angle straight tenon and the chiseling technique for mortises, emphasizing, "three parts marking, seven parts skill." Then I practiced on a piece of beech wood, starting with the verticality of the mortise and depth control. The first two times, the tenon was too loose after insertion. Master Qian pointed out that the mortise wall was slightly tilted, and I adjusted my grip angle in time. The third time, I calmed down and worked slowly and carefully; after assembly, the tenon fit firmly and perfectly, earning Master Qian's approval. After class, I specifically asked about the workbench dimensions for building a home woodworking shop. Master Qian drew a sketch on paper and suggested looking for a hardwood worktop at the flea market. After the training ended, I packed up my tool bag, filled my thermos with hot water at the door, and said goodbye to Master Qian.
location: Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop, west side of the intersection of Liukou Road and Qingzhi Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycling to Caozhuang Flower Market
description: Ride the electric bike, go south along Liukou Road for about 1.5 km, then turn onto Feixia Road. After about 15 minutes, arrive at Caozhuang Flower Market in Zhongbei Town and park the bike in the bicycle parking area at the market entrance.
location: The road section from Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town to Feixia Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Visit Caozhuang Flower Market to buy succulents.
description: The flower market on a spring day was full of life. He went straight to the succulent section and picked out two plump 'Peach Egg' plants and a distinctive 'Living Stones' plant, and also bought a bag of nutrient soil and a few small unglazed terracotta pots. When checking out, the shopkeeper recognized him as a regular customer and threw in a small handful of moss as a bonus, which brightened his mood.
location: Caozhuang Flower Market, 260 meters northeast of the intersection of Feixia Road and Yuhe Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycled back to Huating International Community.
description: Carrying the succulents and nutrient soil, I rode north along Feixia Road back to Zhongbei Avenue, arriving at the entrance of Huating International Community in about 10 minutes. I parked the e-bike in the shed, locked it, and carried the things upstairs.
location: The section of road from Feixia Road to Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch and midday rest.
description: After arriving home, his father was already in the kitchen preparing steamed sea bass and garlic spinach. He placed the succulents on the balcony and briefly rinsed their roots. During lunch, they talked about the progress of the carpentry class. His father was very interested in the right-angle straight tenon and said it was even more standard than what he had learned when he was young. When he mentioned that he would accompany Zhang Wei to try on formal wear in the afternoon, his mother immediately perked up and asked him to see what the bride-to-be looked like. After the meal, he tidied up briefly, returned to the bedroom, changed into a clean white T-shirt and jeans, checked his phone, power bank, and key pouch, and deliberately put the best-man bow tie Zhang Wei had previously sent into his bag. Using the last 15 minutes, he sat at his desk and mentally went over the new energy vehicle technical questions he wanted to discuss with Zhang Wei in the afternoon.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycled to Caozhuang Metro Station
description: He put on a helmet, rode the electric bike east along Zhongbei Avenue for about 1.5 kilometers, and arrived at Caozhuang Metro Station after 8 minutes. He parked and locked the electric bike in the bike shed next to the station, then walked in.
location: Section from Zhongbei Avenue to Wanhui Road in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Meet Zhang Wei and walk to the formal wear shop
description: Met Zhang Wei on time at Exit B of Caozhuang Metro Station. He was wearing a dark blue hoodie and looked delighted. They patted each other on the shoulder and exchanged a few words about recent events, then walked north along Wanhui Road for about 400 meters. Eight minutes later, they arrived at Block B of the New City Center Office Building and found "The King" custom suit shop on the first floor.
location: The road section from Exit B of Caozhuang Metro Station, northeast of the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to No. 8 Wanhui Road.

name: Accompanying to try on the groom's suit and discussing career plans at length
description: After entering the store, the staff received them warmly. Zhang Wei chose two three-piece suits, one navy blue and one silver gray, to try on. Ye Mingxuan helped him hold the suit jacket and gave careful advice on details such as the fit of the back collar, shoulder width, and waistline position. In the end, Zhang Wei chose the slim-fit single-breasted navy blue style, which suited his skin tone better, and the tailor noted the measurements that needed adjustment. During the 20-plus minutes of waiting for the alterations, the two sat on a leather sofa and talked in depth. Zhang Wei recounted in detail his experience of switching from a Cadillac 4S store to a Tesla experience center, including salary, the training system, and his views on the new energy vehicle track. He believed that 'you can't put all your eggs in one basket; you have to follow the momentum.' Ye Mingxuan frankly talked about the bottlenecks he might face in his company and expressed his idea of learning Python to expand his skills and seek a breakthrough. Zhang Wei expressed support and suggested he test-drive a Model Y sometime to feel the chassis quality of the new platform. After the alterations were done, Zhang Wei tried it on again. It looked great, and he paid the balance with satisfaction.
location: The King Custom Suit Shop, 1st Floor, Tower B, New City Center Office Building, No. 8 Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return commute and career reflection on the subway
description: After the formal wear fitting, I walked back to Caozhuang Metro Station with Zhang Wei along Wanhui Road. Outside the fare gates at the station entrance, we chatted briefly about wedding preparations and agreed that the groomsmen would definitely be on time. After parting, I swiped my card through the gates and boarded the metro alone. There were not many people in the carriage. I was wearing earphones but not playing music; Zhang Wei's words kept echoing in my mind, and I began to reflect on my career: "Am I content with the status quo? Is there enough room for advancement at the company? If three years from now I am still drawing and revising drawings, will I regret it?" I opened the memo app on my phone and quickly typed the keywords "career planning," "job-hopping risk," "Python empowerment," and "new energy track." When the metro reached Caozhuang Station, I got off and exited, then walked about 7 minutes along Zhongbei Avenue back to Huating International Community.
location: Inside the carriage of Tianjin Metro Line 2, and along the route from Wanhui Road to Zhongbei Avenue in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District.

name: Afternoon activities at home and family dinner

He found that the middle tooth of this nickel coin was slightly shallower than the two ends, possibly indicating a specific variety. He immediately took a high-definition macro photo and saved it, and left a message asking the moderator Qian Huang for advice.

Ye Mingxuan listened attentively throughout, occasionally pausing the screen and using a magnifying glass to examine the local patina on the counterfeit nickel coin, while quickly writing down key points in his notebook. After the lecture, he spent 20 minutes organizing his notes, comparing the natural patina of genuine items with the chemically aged patina of counterfeits using simple sketches, and saved the diagrams for reference. Then he opened WeChat, sent the key points and photos of his notes to his collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an, and asked him by voice message what he thought of the new technique of acid-etching to create an aged effect followed by high-temperature color fixing.

name: Evening review and preparing for sleep
description: After brushing teeth and washing face, he still felt bloated, so he did a few abdominal and leg stretches on the yoga mat beside the bed to help pass gas. After lying down, he opened the notes app on his phone and briefly recorded today's body measurement data and key work milestones. He set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow and put the phone aside to charge. Reflecting on the day, the finalization of the plan and the decrease in body fat were both gratifying, but the slight stomach discomfort also reminded him that health management could not be slackened. Then he turned off the light, relaxed his body, and adjusted his breathing. Though he was still bloated, his body was tired and he gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, having breakfast, and preparing a lunchbox
description: In the morning, he woke up before the alarm thanks to his precise biological clock. Hearing the sound of his mother preparing breakfast in the kitchen, he got up, drank a glass of warm water, and prepared today's lunchbox with her: reheating the multigrain rice refrigerated overnight, stir-frying broccoli with minced garlic, and pairing it with the leftover steamed sea bass chunks from yesterday. Breakfast was millet porridge and boiled eggs. After eating, he put the lunchbox into his backpack.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Building 1, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute to company
description: He rode his e-bike from home along the usual route: starting from Zhongbei Avenue, heading east on Zhongbei Road, crossing the West Outer Ring Road, and arriving at the company along Haitai South-North Avenue. The weather was cloudy and the temperature was comfortable. Passing the Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken Zhongbei Town flagship store at Ground-Floor Shop No. 18, Xiqingyuan, Zhongbei Town, he remembered the meal with Zhang Wei last Friday. The whole trip took about 25 minutes.
location: On the way in Xiqing District, Tianjin, from Huating International Residential Community via Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Road, West Outer Ring Road, and Haitai North-South Avenue to Haitai Development Office Building

name: Arriving at the office and morning preparation.
description: Arrived at Haitai Development Office Building, swiped card to enter workstation Room 901. First went to the pantry to brew a cup of chrysanthemum tea. Returned to the workstation and spent 10 minutes quickly reviewing yesterday's unread emails and work group messages. Took the initiative to walk to Li Xiang's workstation with a notebook to quickly go over a few details of the simulation boundary conditions in the hybrid plan finalized yesterday, to ensure consistent understanding.
location: Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize the TL-37 lightweight comparison data.
description: Morning core work. I closed all irrelevant chat software and browser pages, keeping only Excel and the CAD model. I opened the original model that passed verification yesterday and started making a plan comparison table. The table includes detailed comparison data between the raw material plan and the optimized plan on three core dimensions: weight, maximum stress, and minimum safety factor. I extracted precise data from the CAD model, checked and filled it into Excel item by item, preparing data support for tomorrow's weekly meeting. I was fully focused throughout, only getting up once to get water.
location: Workstation, Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Brief rest and stretching
description: After working for three hours straight, his eyes were sore and his shoulders were tight. He stood up, walked to the window, looked into the distance, did a few simple shoulder and neck stretches and chest-opening exercises to relax, and prepared for lunch and the afternoon work.
location: By the window, Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: In the pantry on the 9th floor, he heated up his packed lunch in the microwave. Li Xiang had also brought food, and the two ate and chatted. The topic naturally shifted from the morning's simulation boundary details to the reporting strategy for tomorrow's department weekly meeting. Li Xiang suggested using charts to present the core data first and then explaining the process in words. Ye Mingxuan thought this was a good idea.
location: Break room, 9th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday Stroll Around the Park
description: After the meal, I took a walk alone along the paths in the company campus to let my mind go completely blank. I walked two laps around the campus, about 15 minutes, then sat down on a bench and rested with my eyes closed for ten minutes.
location: Park path below the Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Schedule refinement and quality self-check.
description: After the walk, I returned to my workstation feeling much more refreshed. I opened the project files and, based on the data sorted out in the morning, further refined the follow-up work schedule for the TL-37 lightweighting plan, clearly writing down the person responsible, estimated time, and deliverables for each step to ensure the final plan could be submitted before Friday. After that, recalling Senior Engineer Gao's suggestions yesterday about the cooling loop design in the original plan, I began a preventive quality self-check of the original plan's design documents.
location: Workstation, Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Urgent correction of dimension annotation deviation.
description: In the afternoon, Li Xiang reminded me through internal messaging software that while checking the archived materials, he found a possible tiny 0.05 mm deviation in the diameter dimension of a certain connection hole. Mingxuan immediately opened the original model and documents to verify, and confirmed that it was a typo - an extra digit entered during data input. He quickly determined the scope of impact and found that four tables were associated. He immediately corrected them, re-confirming the data source for each change, and after the corrections, reran the simulation verification for that part until he confirmed it exactly matched the corrected data. He sent the updated files and explanation to Li Xiang for confirmation. This incident gave him a cold sweat and once again reminded him of the importance of paying attention to details.
location: Workstation, Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Archiving and weekly meeting preparation.
description: Organize all of today's corrections and findings into a work log. Archive the comparison table compiled in the morning and the corrected files together into the project folder. Finally, write a text outline for tomorrow's weekly meeting oral report, highlighting: confirmation of the hybrid plan, data support, and a potential annotation issue found and corrected during the archive self-check.
location: Workstation, Room 901, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work commute and canceling personal training class
description: He left work on time and rode his electric bike back home along the same route. While waiting at a red light, he sent a WeChat message to Coach Wang at Limei Fitness Center, saying that because he had stayed late to deal with technical issues and his body had not fully recovered, he hoped to move today's personal training session to the same time tomorrow. The coach quickly replied and agreed, reminding him to rest.
location: En route from Haitai Development Office Building back to Huating International Community, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Chatting with my parents.
description: After arriving home, he changed into slippers. Mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen, and father was watching the news on the sofa. Mingxuan briefly mentioned that he had fixed a small mistake that afternoon, “I almost made a big mess, but luckily I caught it in time.” Father said, “Technical work requires carefulness.” Then Mingxuan went into the kitchen to help his mother pick vegetables.
location: Living room and kitchen, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Mother made stir-fried shrimp, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and winter melon meatball soup. Mingxuan practiced healthy eating by taking a small half bowl of rice and eating more vegetables and shrimp. At the table, his mother chatted about neighborhood trivia, his father occasionally interjected with comments on international news, and Mingxuan listened quietly, responding now and then.
location: Home dining room, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Home recovery: stretching and foot soaking
description: After resting for half an hour after a meal, he spread out the yoga mat on the living room floor and followed a stretching tutorial on his phone to do 15 minutes of static stretches targeting the shoulders, neck, and legs, relieving the fatigue of sitting all day. Then he soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes, which felt very refreshing.
location: Tianjin Xiqing District, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Building 1, Huating International Community, living room

name: Personal programming study
description: After relaxing his body, he went to the study, turned on the computer, and continued studying the Python parametric script for standard parts as planned. He focused on writing a piece of code logic about parameter input and coordinate mapping. Although he got stuck twice, he successfully solved the bug by consulting notes and API documentation, and felt a sense of accomplishment.
location: Study room, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Organized ancient coin materials and exchanged with collector friends.
description: Switched to ancient coin collecting time. I opened my phone and saw that Professor Zhao, a fellow collector from Xi'an, had left a long comment under the previously posted photos of the Sichuan-edition copper coins. After reading it carefully, I opened the album on my computer, reorganized and cropped several high-definition detail shots, and replied with a few personal observations about the causes of patina formation on the coin surfaces.
location: Study room, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Health records and diary self-reflection.
description: Opened Keep and the diet tracking app to browse the past week's data. Calorie intake was basically on target, with only Monday's group meal exceeding it. Weight was not much different from the same time last week, but I do feel more energetic. In the Notes app on my phone, I wrote down the progress of this week's healthy eating/fitness plan: no more afternoon drowsiness, noticeably better energy. Decided to go to bed earlier tonight and continue tomorrow.
location: Study room, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up and preparing items for the next day
description: Took a shower, washed up, and changed into pajamas. Packed the laptop backpack for tomorrow: checked the laptop power adapter and mouse, put the USB drive for tomorrow's weekly meeting materials and the paper and pen for speaking notes into the bag, and confirmed the phone charger. Everything was ready.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime reading
description: He got into bed, leaned against the headboard, picked up Project Management Practice, and flipped through a few pages. Feeling his eyelids grow heavy, he put the book aside.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Getting sleepy and falling asleep
description: Turned off the desk lamp, reviewed today's work in the dark, and confirmed that the dimension marking issue was perfectly wrapped up. Took deep breaths, relaxed all muscles, and fell asleep on time at 22:30, about 40 minutes earlier than usual.
location: Bedroom, Building 1, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off on time. Ye Mingxuan turned it off and did not stay in bed; he did two minutes of stretching in bed. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, specifically using oil-control shampoo, and styled his hair in front of the mirror. There was an important presentation this afternoon, so a good appearance was important. He changed into a dark blue jacket and casual pants, feeling formal yet not too stiff, ready to start a new day.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Have breakfast with parents and prepare bento boxes.
description: Ye Mingxuan walked out of his room to find that his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared breakfast: millet porridge, jianbing, and homemade pickled vegetables. While ladling the porridge, she kept nagging about the house she had looked at in Zhongbei Town last night and told him not to be so stubborn. He nodded, took the stainless steel lunch box, and skillfully packed the braised chicken pieces and stir-fried seasonal vegetables he had made the night before. His father Ye Jianguo sat across from him, slowly encouraging him not to be nervous about the presentation, saying that his work was his and no one could take it away. Ye Mingxuan murmured in acknowledgment, feeling much more at ease.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuted to the company by bike.
description: Ye Mingxuan put on his jacket, picked up the lunch box and laptop bag, put on his helmet and gloves, and walked downstairs to where his e-bike was parked. He inserted the key and rode west along Zhongbei Avenue. The morning breeze was cool, and sunlight was already shining through the buildings. Out of habit, he slowed down at the entrance of the community he liked in Zhongbei Town and glanced at it, then sped up toward the company.
location: Along the route from 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road

name: Arriving at the office and preparing for work.
description: Arrived at the company office building and swiped in. Walked to the workstation, put down the backpack, first placed the lunch box in the refrigerator in the pantry, then returned to the workstation and brewed a cup of chrysanthemum goji tea in the thermos cup. Turned on the computer and checked the report PPT saved on the USB drive the night before, confirming there were no issues with files failing to open or formatting errors.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Final verification and preparation for the weekly meeting.
description: Ye Mingxuan walked over to colleague Li Xiang's workstation with a teacup in hand, and the two leaned over the computer and went through the presentation slides from beginning to end. Li Xiang pointed out several text layout oversights, and Ye Mingxuan also added a note about the manufacturing process. Anticipating that supervisor Gao Zhiyuan might ask about the material fatigue life curve, they pulled up last week's simulation report and carefully checked the data sources and calculation logic to make sure everything was flawless.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handle private messages about ancient coin exchange
description: After returning to his seat, Ye Mingxuan took out his phone and checked the WeChat message from Professor Zhao in Xi'an, who asked for details about a Sichuan-issue copper coin mentioned earlier. He remembered that a high-definition photo of the coin was tucked in yesterday's notebook, so he found it and used his phone's macro lens to take clear photos of the front, back, and reeded edge against the light. He sent them over along with his preliminary thoughts on the coin variety.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and a casual get-together with colleagues
description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang went downstairs on time and walked five minutes to the malatang shop near the company. Each picked a bowl and chatted while eating. Zhou Tao said mysteriously that the neighboring project team might be taking on a new project, and some of them might be seconded to help. Li Xiang frowned, and Ye Mingxuan took the opportunity to finalize with Li Xiang the division of roles for the afternoon presentation; the two had already rehearsed seamlessly.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and after-lunch walk
description: After eating lunch and returning to the company, Ye Mingxuan didn't lie down immediately. Instead, he went downstairs and walked around the office building for a while. After about ten minutes, he felt the food had settled somewhat. Back at his desk, he put on an eye mask and earplugs, leaned back in his chair, and slept for about forty minutes. After waking up, he felt much more refreshed.
location: Near Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Final preparation before the meeting
description: Ye Mingxuan picked up his laptop and notebook and met Li Xiang at the door of the meeting room. Zhou Tao patted him on the shoulder and told him to go for it. Ye Mingxuan took a deep breath, pushed the door open, and walked into the meeting room. He saw his supervisor Gao Zhiyuan and several other colleagues already seated.
location: At the door of the large conference room, 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Department weekly meeting plan report.
description: The meeting was chaired by Manager Wang Peng. When it was Ye Mingxuan's turn, he and Li Xiang worked in close coordination to present the TL-37 lightweighting solution. When discussing the key simulation verification results, he deliberately slowed his speaking pace and used a laser pointer to point to the weakest area on the stress contour plot. The senior engineer nodded frequently and interjected with two tricky technical questions, but Ye Mingxuan answered them fluently because he was well prepared. After the presentation, the senior engineer was the first to applaud and publicly praised their efficiency and the robustness of the data. Ye Mingxuan's heart was racing, but he kept his composure, quickly drew a checkmark in his notebook, and wrote down the optimization suggestions the senior engineer had mentioned.
location: Large meeting room, 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize meeting minutes and wait for test data.
description: After the meeting ended and he returned to his workstation, Ye Mingxuan immediately turned the feedback from the senior engineer and colleagues into standardized meeting minutes. He then opened the project management system to check the progress of the testing team's tasks and found that the final data had not yet been submitted. He sent an instant message to ask, and the reply said about another hour was needed, so he used the time to start writing the information summary section of the archival report.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Work overtime to finish the archiving and wrap-up
description: At around 5:30, Ye Mingxuan finally received the final data from the testing team, immediately filled it into the appendix of the archive report, then read through the entire report from beginning to end to confirm there were no formatting or content errors. Finally, he uploaded the report to the project management system and notified all relevant parties by email, copying Manager Wang Peng and Supervisor Gao Zhiyuan. After completing all this, the clock had already pointed to 7 p.m.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Heading to the gym after work on the way home.
description: Ye Mingxuan packed up his things, turned off the computer, and before cycling, stopped by the convenience store downstairs from the company to buy a bottle of Gatorade and a bag of whole-wheat bread for some energy, then followed the navigation and rode to Limei Fitness Center.
location: Convenience store downstairs at Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: The fourth personal training session
description: Ye Mingxuan arrived at the gym on time. Seeing that he was a little tired, Coach Wang Jian changed the planned heavy barbell squats to lighter dumbbell split squats and machine chest presses, but kept the number of sets and reps the same. During the workout, the coach kept encouraging him that as long as his form was right, quality was more important than weight. After the strength training, he also did 30 minutes on the elliptical machine as required, and the sweat gradually washed away the anxiety of overtime work.
location: Limei Fitness Center, No. 70 Xiqing Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Finished working out and cycled home.
description: After training, Ye Mingxuan took a shower and felt a bit more relaxed. He rode his electric bike slowly back along Zhongbei Avenue. The evening breeze brushed his slightly damp hair. He opened a podcast on his phone and listened to an episode about the renovation of Tianjin's old city, and his mood calmed down considerably.
location: Along Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: He returned home and received a call from the real estate agent.
description: Ye Mingxuan parked the car and returned home; his mother was watching TV in the living room. He briefly said he was back and was about to head to the bedroom to change when his phone rang — it was the real estate agent. With an apologetic tone, the agent told him that the two-bedroom apartment in Zhongbei Town had been bought in full by a client that afternoon, at a price 200,000 yuan above his budget. Ye Mingxuan froze for a few seconds, said "I see," and hung up.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Disappointment and re-planning with my father
description: Ye Mingxuan sat on the living room sofa and remained silent for a long time. His mother noticed something was wrong and came over to ask quietly. He waved his hand and said he was fine, so she went back to her room to rest. About ten minutes later, his father came out of the bedroom with reading glasses and a notebook, sat down beside him, poured himself a cup of tea, and calmly asked him to talk about what was going on. Ye Mingxuan told him everything about his thoughts over the past few days and his fixation on the house. After listening, his father was silent for a moment, then opened the notebook, which had a rough map of Xiqing District, Tianjin, that he had drawn himself, with several residential communities marked. His father said he would ask old neighbors the next day to see if there were any homes available in communities such as Pingzhouyuan, Xixiuyuan, and Dadi Shiercheng, and also ask about the latest prices. Ye Mingxuan's feelings of unwillingness and disappointment gradually subsided. They carefully looked through the candidate communities on the phone map, marked three key options with a red pen, and agreed to go see the houses on Sunday. Late at night, he returned to his room to rest. Although he still felt some resentment, he had found direction again.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Back in the bedroom, he lay down on the bed. Although it was already late, his mind was still clear. Ye Mingxuan opened the memo app on his phone and noted down the names of several residential communities to visit on Sunday and important reminders. Then he turned off his phone, closed his eyes, took deep breaths, and gradually calmed himself down. With new plans for the future and gratitude for his father's support, he slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: Ye Mingxuan took a while to wake up after the alarm went off, then got up and washed up. His mother, Wang Xiulan, had already prepared breakfast. He made a point of taking his father's thermos, and took the lunchbox packed the night before (braised pork and stir-fried cauliflower) out of the refrigerator and stuffed it into his backpack. The family sat around the dining table for breakfast (steamed buns, millet porridge, and spiced eggs). Seeing that he was low on energy, his mother gave him an extra boiled egg, grumbling that he had stayed up late; his father, Ye Jianguo, reminded him not to forget the thermos and said he himself was going to South Canal Park to play chess. Ye Mingxuan felt that the cozy atmosphere of home was the best pick-me-up.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting by electric bike
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike along Zhongbei Avenue to the Haitai Development office building at No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road. On the way, he put on earphones and listened to a podcast about mechanical design, chewing the rest of his breakfast while riding. The warm spring breeze blew away the grogginess of waking up early. After arriving at the company, he clocked in, took the elevator to the 7th floor, first put his lunchbox in the pantry refrigerator, then made a cup of strong tea to refresh himself.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Archived the results of the TL-37 lightweight design project.
description: Ye Mingxuan opened the company's project management system and uploaded the final CAD drawings of the lightweight design, the simulation verification report (FEA), and all change record documents one by one, strictly setting file numbers, version numbers, and access permissions according to the archiving specification. After finishing, he sent a message to his colleague Li Xiang via the internal messaging software to confirm the archiving status, and they agreed to meet next Monday afternoon to coordinate with the testing team and discuss the physical sample verification process.
location: Workstation, 7th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Desk lunch and miscellaneous tasks
description: Ye Mingxuan took the lunchbox out of the refrigerator, heated it in the company microwave, and ate braised pork and cauliflower while browsing several technical articles on mechanical engineering on his phone. He also listed today's to-do items on a sticky note and checked off the 'archiving completed' item, feeling reassured.
location: Workstation, 7th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break walk and rest with eyes closed
description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan did not take a nap right away. Instead, he put on earphones, went downstairs, and walked around the green spaces and sidewalks near the office building, enjoying the spring sunshine, loosening up his shoulders, neck, and wrists, and breathing in the fresh air. After returning to his workstation, he rested face-down on the desk with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes.
location: The area around the first floor of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handle work emails and next week's schedule
description: Back at work in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan handled and replied to several emails from suppliers and collaborating departments. He then opened the project management software to sort out the work schedule for the following week, focusing on coordination with Li Xiang and the sample verification matters for the testing team. After confirming there were no urgent to-dos, he felt the relief of having completed his tasks, but the fatigue from lack of sleep remained.
location: Workstation, 7th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Report early departure and pack up
description: Ye Mingxuan, holding a teacup, went to the office door of his supervisor Gao Zhiyuan, knocked, and explained that the day's work was basically finished but he felt a bit tired and hoped to leave an hour early. Gao Zhiyuan agreed and patted him on the shoulder. Ye Mingxuan then returned to his workstation, tidied the documents on his desk, turned off the computer, rinsed his cup, put on his commuter bag, took his lunchbox out of the refrigerator, took the elevator downstairs, and rode away on his electric bike.
location: 7th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Buy electrolyte drinks on the way home
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike home along Zhongbei Avenue. On the way, he stopped briefly at the Vanguard convenience store (Zhongbei Town branch) by the roadside and bought a bottle of iced electrolyte drink to replenish his energy for the upcoming training.
location: Vanguard Convenience Store (Zhongbei Town Branch), Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Catching up on sleep to restore energy
description: After arriving home, Ye Mingxuan greeted his mother, who was watching TV in the living room, then went to his room, flopped onto the bed, set a 17:55 alarm on his phone, and fell sound asleep. When the alarm woke him, his head didn't feel as heavy, and his energy had recovered quite a bit.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Change clothes and head to the gym for training
description: After getting up, Ye Mingxuan quickly changed into basketball clothes, shoes, and protective gear. In the living room, he drank most of a bottle of electrolyte drink and ate a banana for energy. After telling his parents he was going to play basketball, he left with his gym bag, rode an electric bike along Zhongbei Avenue and West Outer Ring Road to Tiangong University Gymnasium, arriving in about 10 minutes.
location: Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Basketball team tactical practice and stretching
description: The training started on time, focusing on defensive drills and half-court tactical coordination. Ye Mingxuan was active on defense, grabbing multiple rebounds, and worked well with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang during fast-break practice, completing several beautiful attacks. The one-and-a-half-hour high-intensity training left him drenched in sweat and temporarily took his mind off his worries. Afterward, everyone formed a circle to stretch and relax. Zhou Tao invited him for a late-night snack, but he politely declined. Ye Mingxuan discussed tactics for next Wednesday's match with several people and agreed to talk further in the group chat.
location: Basketball court, Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Stroll the antique market and buy groceries on the way back
description: After leaving the gym, Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike west along Zhongbei Avenue to the antique market near Fengqiaoyuan. The market was about to close. At a secondhand book stall, he found a thread-bound book titled A Brief Introduction to Mechanical Principles, published during the Republic of China period, and bought it for 80 yuan, planning to make it part of his father's birthday gift. He then rode home in a good mood. On the way, he bought apples and a jin of tomatoes at the Dongxingli vegetable market in Wangzhuangzi, thinking that tomorrow he could make tomato and egg noodles.
location: From the used-book stall near Shisanqi Buddhist Ritual and Antiques on Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Wangzhuangzi Dongxingli Vegetable Market.

name: Returned home to rest and spend time with family
description: When Ye Mingxuan got home, he put the fruits and vegetables in the kitchen and greeted his parents. His father had already come back from playing chess and was watching the news. In the living room, he chatted briefly with his parents about training and the fun of finding old books. His father was very interested when he heard he had bought an old mechanics book.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take a shower and eat fruit
description: Ye Mingxuan went back to his room to get a change of clothes, took a hot shower, and washed off the sweat. After coming out, he cut an apple and replied to a few WeChat messages while eating.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing thread-bound books and communicating with collector friends

After contacting property management through the elevator intercom, I guided everyone to stand close to the inner wall, speak less, and stay calm. description: Mingxuan drove from Huating International Community, via Zhongbei Avenue and West Outer Ring Road, toward Haitai Development Sixth Road. To cope with the dusty weather, he set the car to recirculation mode. On the way, he turned on the car stereo and played an audio explanation of connector design from the Mechanical Design Manual to warm up his brain for the intensive work ahead. About 30 minutes later, he arrived at the underground parking lot of Haitai Development Office Building.
location: In Xiqing District, Tianjin, on the drive from Huating International Community in Zhongbei Town along Zhongbei Avenue and West Outer Ring Road to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road

name: Morning work: model building and hand calculation checks
description: After arriving at his desk, Mingxuan first checked new emails, confirmed there was no project change from Engineer Gao, and taped the action list from yesterday's project meeting to the edge of his monitor. Then he found his colleague Li Xiang, confirmed that Li Xiang had time after 3 p.m. for the simulation joint debugging, and agreed to send the model then. After brewing a strong cup of tea, Mingxuan dove into AutoCAD modeling. Starting from the main exterior shape of the part, he positioned the mounting interfaces according to interface dimensions, initially assigned wall thicknesses, and laid out reinforcing ribs, constantly switching between three-view and isometric views to check for interference. Once the model was roughly shaped, he took out his calculation notebook and manually checked the bending and shear strength of the two most critical cross-sections of the connector, marking three stress concentration points.
location: Room 712, 7th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch
description: Mingxuan went to A9 Malatang in the food court on the basement level of Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, ordered a bowl of mala mix (not spicy) and a bottle of mineral water. To avoid eating at the same shop two days in a row, he deliberately chose this restaurant with a more diverse menu. During the meal, he did not discuss work, but instead browsed cutting-edge technology posts in the mechanical industry, giving his brain a brief break.
location: A9 Malatang, basement food court, Tiankai Huayuan Science Park, No. 20 Kaihua Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and organizing materials.
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation and dozed on the desk for 20 minutes. After waking up, he did not immediately go online to search; instead, he first sorted through in his mind the list of materials for the upcoming quote request, and wrote from memory onto scratch paper parameters such as the density and approximate tensile strength of aluminum alloy 6061-T6 and titanium alloy TC4, in preparation for the subsequent cost comparison.
location: Room 712, 7th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work: detailed design and cost comparison
description: In the afternoon, Mingxuan focused his energy. Based on the morning verification results, he added fillets to the CAD model to reduce stress concentration and finely adjusted the thickness of the stiffening ribs. Then he looked up market reference prices on B2B platforms for round bars and plates of three materials: carbon steel Q235, aluminum alloy 6061-T6, and titanium alloy TC4, and roughly recorded them. He saved the final model, created a new Excel file to enter parameters such as material prices and density, and combined with manually calculated volumes to estimate approximate material costs, completing a cost comparison table. At 16:30, he packaged the model and cost comparison table and sent them to Li Xiang via internal communications software, leaving a message asking him to arrange the simulation joint debugging as appropriate. After that, Mingxuan cleaned his desk, put his calculation pad and notebook back into his backpack, checked tomorrow's weather, turned off the computer, and prepared to leave work.
location: Room 712, 7th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving home from work.
description: Mingxuan drove out of the company's underground parking garage. It was the beginning of the evening rush hour, and traffic was heavy but still within an acceptable range. He headed back the same way, via Haitai Development 6th Road and Outer Ring West Road toward Zhongbei Avenue, playing relaxing post-rock music along the way to soothe his tense nerves.
location: In Xiqing District, Tianjin, on the drive from Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, back to Huating International Community via Outer Ring West Road and Zhongbei Avenue.

His mother, as usual, asked whether work went smoothly, and Mingxuan nodded that the model was finished. His father asked whether the neck cushion he used was comfortable, and Mingxuan felt warmth in his heart.
location: Room 602, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

They worked well together in two ranked games, winning one and losing one. The fast-paced game let Mingxuan temporarily forget the rigors of work and relax.

After sitting down, she brought up the daughter of Aunt Zhang from across the street, probing whether Mingxuan would be willing to meet during the May Day holiday. Mingxuan was prepared. In a gentle but firm tone, he explained that the current project milestones were tight and his mind was full of drawings and stress, and that he would definitely consider it seriously once this busy period was over. He then smoothly changed the subject and asked whether she needed help buying groceries the next day. Seeing his sincere attitude, his mother gave a few more reminders, put down the fruit, and left.

After the workout, the soreness in his lower back was somewhat relieved.

Standing under the old pine tree, his father calmly recounted the difficult history of how their ancestors migrated here from Hebei, and handed Ye Mingxuan a handful of fresh soil. Ye Mingxuan knelt in front of the grave and carefully sprinkled the soil. After the rain, faint sunlight filtered through the gaps in the clouds, and the atmosphere was solemn yet warm.

He bargained with the stall owner unhurriedly and finally closed the deal at 80 yuan. The stall owner smiled and said the coin was fated to be Ye Mingxuan's. Ye Mingxuan carefully put the coin into his inner pocket.

After it ran successfully, I checked the stress contour plot and deformation; the error compared with the hand calculation was less than 5%, which gave me more confidence in the connector simulation next week. During the learning process, I organized the key steps and settings with a mind map.

After modifying the model, I took out a calculator and, against the hand-calculated draft, rechecked the bending stress, shear stress, and bearing stress at critical cross-sections one by one. Confirming that the safety factors at all key locations were above 1.5, I saved the final 3D model shape with satisfaction.

name: Development and testing of the ancient coin crawler project
description: At 19:45 he sat down at the computer in the study and officially launched the ancient coin scraper project. He opened the browser, logged into the Ancient Coin Garden trading website, used developer tools to analyze the URL patterns and HTML structure of the listing pages, and sketched the scraper workflow framework on paper. At 20:15 he installed the requests, BeautifulSoup4, and csv libraries. At 20:25 he wrote his first test script, successfully sent a GET request, and parsed out the website's homepage title. He then tried to scrape the static content of a listing page (coin names and some prices), and recorded the fields that were not retrieved due to dynamic loading. At 21:00 he saved the code as coin_scraper_v0.1.py. Then, based on the test results, he wrote down in his notes the key points to tackle next: how to handle dynamically loaded page content (Ajax requests), and how to make a full-crawl plan, including handling pagination and simulating scroll-to-load. At 21:30 he closed his laptop.
