He did 5 minutes of gentle lower back stretching in bed, including cat pose and child's pose. After washing up, he had breakfast with his parents; his mother made tomato and egg noodles. Li Ming told his parents about his morning appointment at the community health center. He then got his medical insurance card and phone, put on comfortable casual clothes and walking shoes, and walked about 18 minutes from home to the Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center as a morning relaxation.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Zhongbei Avenue

name: Visit to the community health service center
description: Li Ming arrived on time at Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center. After registering, Dr. Liu Wentao performed a detailed physical examination (tenderness points, straight-leg raise test, etc.). Considering his long history of sedentary office work and recent fitness activities, he diagnosed mild lumbar muscle strain and ruled out disc problems. Dr. Liu prescribed three sessions of low-frequency pulsed electrical stimulation physiotherapy, once a week. Li Ming received the first treatment on the spot. The electrode pads were attached to his lower back, and the current felt tingling and warm. After 20 minutes, the muscle tension was significantly relieved. He recorded the doctor's key advice in his phone memo and booked the remaining two physiotherapy sessions through the hospital system.
location: Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center, Xiqing District, Tianjin (north side of the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanyuan Road)

name: Make a rehabilitation plan and shop on the way home
description: After leaving the consultation room, Li Ming sat down on a bench in the hallway and used the memo app on his phone to record Dr. Liu's rehabilitation guidelines in detail: he must get up and stretch every 45 minutes of sitting, do core exercises such as dead bugs and glute bridges every morning and evening, and communicate with fitness trainer Wang Jian to adjust his training plan. Then he walked home, buying a bottle of 1.5 L purified water and a pack of sugar-free mint candies at the convenience store by the community entrance on the way, to refresh himself during afternoon work or reading.
location: On the way from Zhongbei Town Community Health Service Center in Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community (passing the Zhongbei Avenue convenience store)

name: Communicated the diagnosis with parents, had lunch, and took an afternoon nap
description: After arriving home, his mother was preparing lunch. Li Ming clearly told his parents about the diagnosis of mild lumbar muscle strain. His father reminded him to get up and move if he sat for too long at work and offered to help adjust the office chair back in the study in the afternoon. Lunch included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised crucian carp, and rice. Li Ming had a good appetite and cleared the table after the meal. Then he went back to the bedroom, drew the curtains, put on a steam eye mask, and took a 45-minute midday nap. When he woke up, he felt refreshed and his lower back was comfortable.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Visit Caozhuang Flower Market to buy succulents.
description: It took about 12 minutes on foot from home to reach Caozhuang Flower Market. Li Ming walked straight to the succulent stall he usually visited, carefully examining each pot and lightly touching the leaves to check their health. In the end, he chose three pots: a plump Bear's Paw, a crystal-clear Jade Dew, and a Plush Plant with reddening leaves that was just coming into its best state. He also picked a simple, elegant shallow clay pot with a matching tray. The total came to 65 yuan.
location: Caozhuang Flower Market, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (260 meters northeast of the intersection of Feixia Road and Yuhe Road).

name: Repot succulents and note down care tips
description: After returning home, Li Ming spread old newspapers on the small table of the balcony plant stand, put on gardening gloves, and carefully removed three succulents from their pots, shook off the old soil, and trimmed the withered roots. He placed clay pebbles at the bottom of new terracotta pots, filled in granular soil, planted the Bear's Paw and the others one by one, straightened them, filled in soil, and topped with white Kanuma soil. When finished, he numbered them in his care notebook using '2025-D-081' as the prefix, recording their names, purchase dates, watering and sunlight habits, and planned the next time to record their status.
location: Balcony, Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organized the ancient coin crawler code and did some reading.
description: Li Ming made a cup of green tea in his study, turned on the computer, and started refactoring the code of the ancient coin crawler project that he had previously discussed with Professor Zhao Jianguo and fellow student Xu Ming. He focused on optimizing the proxy pool, encapsulating the reading, validation, and rotation logic of proxy IPs into a standalone function, and added exception handling. After testing, the code ran smoothly. About 50 minutes later, he turned off the computer, took “Research on Ming-style Furniture” from the bookshelf, and read the chapter on the “waist” structure, associating it with the waistline of the new ceramic pot he had bought today, appreciating the combination of mechanics and aesthetics.
location: Study room, Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Went out for dinner with parents and took a walk after the meal
description: Li Ming suggested taking his parents out for a better meal, and the family of three walked about 13 minutes to the main store of Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken in Zhongbei Town. They ordered a small pot of mildly spicy hot pot chicken and added wide noodles, potatoes, tofu, and greens. During the meal, Li Ming showed his parents photos of the succulents he had just bought and answered his mother's questions about her lumbar spine. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After dinner, they strolled home slowly along Zhongbei Avenue. The evening breeze was cool, and Li Ming chatted with his father about his father's youthful skill of repairing large machine tools by 'locating faults by ear,' which helped their digestion.
location: Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken Zhongbei Town main store at No. 18, ground-floor commercial unit of Xiqingyuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Zhongbei Avenue

name: Communicate with the fitness coach about adjusting the training plan.

The two talked and decided to suspend all heavy strength training for the next week and change the personal training sessions on Monday and Wednesday of next week to rehabilitative training, focusing mainly on core stability, upper-body push and pull, and low-intensity cardio. Coach Wang also sent several recommended videos of rehab exercises to do at home.
location: Living room, Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening rehabilitation exercises, bath, and leisure time.
description: Li Ming spread out his yoga mat in the bedroom and did rehabilitation exercises as guided by Dr. Liu and Coach Wang: cat stretch, bird-dog, and glute bridge. After finishing, his lower back felt much more relaxed, and he recorded the movements and how he felt in his phone's memo app. Then he took a hot shower, especially running hot water over his lower back. After changing into loose loungewear, he watched "National Treasure" with his parents and explained to them the gear transmission principle of the wooden ox and flowing horse. After the show ended, he returned to his study, jotted down the day's reflections in his notebook, took a final photo of the newly planted succulents, and continued reading the section in "Studies on Ming Furniture" about how the backrest design of the official's hat chair provides lumbar support, utterly absorbed.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

The heat penetrated into the deep muscles and felt very comfortable. He set the alarm for 7:00 the next workday and noted down the second physical therapy appointment next Tuesday. He lay down, adjusted the pillow height, and recalled the fulfilling day. Feeling at ease, he turned off the light and prepared to sleep, falling asleep at around 22:50.

His father focused on plumbing and electrical systems, turning on all faucets to check water pressure, testing drain speed in the floor drains, and carefully inspecting the distribution box. They photographed and recorded everything one by one. After an hour, they confirmed no major issues with the key items, and both parties signed for the handover. Standing in the middle of the living room, his father looked around and praised the layout as square and well oriented with good north-south ventilation, urging him to renovate carefully.

From his phone he picked a photo taken through the living room window that showed the community's central garden and the afterglow of the setting sun, and captioned it: "Coordinates: Xiqing. Coordinates: the starting point. The wish I had when I joined the company in 2018 finally landed in 2025." After posting it on Moments, he received quite a few responses. He then had dinner with his parents in the dining room, where the table held his mother's braised pork, steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, cucumber salad, and the fresh pork buns they had bought. His father opened a bottle of Fenjiu and poured himself a small half glass. The mood was pleasant at first, but after his mother mentioned the pressure of the monthly mortgage payment, she put down her chopsticks, sighed, and urged them to tighten their belts from now on. His father raised his glass and clinked it in encouragement: "Life is lived one day at a time." He also perked up and joined his father for a small drink.

In the second half, the opposing guards sped up and launched fast breaks, and defensive rotations left gaps. During one transition defense, Ye Mingxuan felt his lower back tighten and signaled to be substituted off to rest. In the last three minutes of the fourth quarter, the deficit grew to 8 points. Li Xiang scored on a putback, and the game ended in a narrow 62:66 loss. As the final buzzer sounded, Zhou Tao put his arm around Ye Mingxuan's shoulder and said, 'Come back next year,' but quietly added, 'After this season, I might not be here next year.'

description: Arrived at Old Ma's food stall, where Zhou Tao and Li Xiang had already saved seats under the tarp. The three sat around a plastic table and ordered skewers, edamame, peanuts, spicy stir-fried clams, and beer. Raindrops pattered on the tarp, bringing a touch of coolness. For the first half hour, they carefully reviewed the details of the morning's game. After a few rounds of drinks, Zhou Tao came straight out with his idea of quitting his job to start a business. Ye Mingxuan helped him analyze the risks item by item—social insurance continuation, startup capital, customer sources—with nothing but worry and concern in his eyes. Li Xiang also chimed in, saying he could help with equipment technical parameter analysis if needed.
location: Lao Ma's food stall near the intersection of Haitai Development Sixth Road and Haitai North-South Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Saying goodbye at the end
description: The rain had stopped and the ground was wet. The three of them stood by the roadside waiting for the designated driver. Zhou Tao hugged Ye Mingxuan tightly and said, "Brother, you're the only one who can speak to me this bluntly." Li Xiang also called a designated driver. Ye Mingxuan watched them get into the car and drive away, feeling conflicted.
location: At the entrance of Lao Ma Food Stall, near the intersection of Haitai Development Sixth Road and Haitai North-South Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cycling home
description: Rode the electric scooter and hurried home in the slightly cool night breeze. The air was especially fresh. After getting home, plugged the electric scooter into the charging station downstairs.
location: Return from Lao Ma's Food Stall to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up and bedtime lower back stretching
description: After getting home, I washed up briefly. I did pre-sleep lower back stretches on the yoga mat in the bedroom, with slow, controlled movements. On the bedside table, I wrote today's summary in my notebook: 'The 3D printer has been ordered, 3500 yuan. Zhou Tao is very determined about starting his business, and I have helped him analyze the main risks. My mother was right about tightening our belts; for the next three months, I need to keep a close eye on cash flow.'
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Set an alarm and went to bed.
description: Set the phone alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning and checked that the sports watch was fully charged. Lying in bed, he recalled the details of today's game and Zhou Tao's heartfelt words, sighed, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up and pre-run preparation.
description: The alarm 'Light Cavalry Overture' rang on his phone on time. Ye Mingxuan pressed it off and did cat stretches in bed, feeling a faint soreness lingering in his lower back. After washing up quietly, he changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts, went to the kitchen and ate two slices of whole wheat bread and half a banana to refuel. Then he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did the pre-run dynamic stretches prescribed by Dr. Liu, including knee-hug calf raises and lunge twists, paying special attention to cat pose and child's pose to activate the lower back core.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Walk to Zhongbei Town Community Square and check in for warm-up
description: Ye Mingxuan put on his running shoes and sports watch, then went out. The spring morning air was slightly cool. Walking east along Zhongbei Avenue, he saw crabapple flowers in full bloom on the roadside. He slowed down, took a deep breath, and relaxed. After arriving at Zhongbei Town Community Square, he found the number area, picked up his race bib and timing chip, and pinned them on his chest. He did group warm-up exercises with the crowd, loosened his joints, and waited for the starting gun.
location: Community Square, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Join a 5K Fun Run and Make New Friends
description: After the starting gun fired, Ye Mingxuan moved forward steadily at a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. When he reached the second kilometer, a young runner in a dark blue running shirt with a similar pace caught his attention. At the water station in the new city center at the third kilometer, the other runner initiated a conversation, and the two chatted warmly, discovering that the man was named Chen Xiao, a new resident of Zhongbei Town and a software engineer specializing in machine vision. When Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he used Python to process data, Chen Xiao also shared his experience in image processing. Over the remaining two kilometers, they chatted about technical topics while running, and finally Ye Mingxuan finished the race in 33 minutes 42 seconds. After the race, the two walked to a bench to pick up their finisher bags, sat down to exchange marathon experiences, and Chen Xiao encouraged Ye Mingxuan to try a half marathon. They added each other on WeChat, agreed to go for weekend morning runs in the future, and said goodbye at 8 o'clock.
location: Along Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (Start/finish: Zhongbei Town Community Square; turnaround point: New City Center)

name: Post-run recovery and handling personal matters.
description: After jogging home, Ye Mingxuan immediately did a systematic post-run stretch on the yoga mat in the living room, stretching the front and back of his thighs, calves, and hip flexors for over 30 seconds each, and touching his toes to relax his lower back. During stretching, he created a new line in his phone's notes: 'Half-marathon preparation plan - to be started; target: Tianjin Marathon in spring 2026,' with a note that the year-end bonus needed to be in place and the monthly mortgage payment stable. Then he took a hot shower, changed into loungewear, and went to the kitchen to fry two eggs, mix a cup of protein powder, and have it with whole wheat bread as brunch. While eating, he shared his running experience in the family group chat, browsed an ancient coin collecting forum, and saved a post by Mr. Zhao Jianguo about varieties of Republic of China nickel coins.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Plan the studio in the new house and tidy up the desk.
description: After eating brunch, Ye Mingxuan went into the study. Facing the old desk that had been cleared for the 3D printer, he took out a tape measure and measured the desktop's length, width, and load capacity. Referring to the renovation notes and floor plan of the new house, he planned the arrangement of the printer, consumables rack, whetstone, computer, and tool cabinet, sketched a simple layout, and marked dimensions and power outlet locations, making a preliminary plan for the future 3D printing work area.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Leisure time with parents and lunch
description: Ye Mingxuan went to the living room and saw his father Ye Jianguo wearing reading glasses and reading the biography of a crosstalk performer. He sat down, asked about the book, and shared that he had met his programmer neighbor during today's run. His father nodded and encouraged him to make more friends. Then his mother Wang Xiulan called everyone to dinner. The dishes were simple but made with care: stir-fried choy sum, tomato scrambled eggs, and reheated braised pork. Ye Mingxuan served rice and chatted while eating about the morning's plans for the new house. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, his stomach felt full and bloated. Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 14:30, drew the curtains, and closed his eyes to rest. Although he didn't fall fully asleep, the half-hour relaxation was enough to restore his energy.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing renovation notes and reviewing technical materials
description: After the alarm went off, Ye Mingxuan did not get up right away. Instead, he picked up the new-home renovation notebook from the bedside and used pens of different colors to copy and supplement the morning's planning sketches into the notebook, labeling functional areas. Then he opened the tablet and browsed technical forums on 3D printer reviews and DIY modifications, building up knowledge for tomorrow's installation and debugging after the device arrives.
location: Bedroom/study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Went to Zhongbei Hospital for lumbar physiotherapy and returned home.
description: Ye Mingxuan changed clothes, put his medical insurance card and phone into his crossbody bag, got on his electric bike, and rode along Zhongbei Avenue to Xingguang Road, arriving at Tianjin Zhongbei Hospital within 10 minutes. On the second floor, in the rehabilitation department, Dr. Liu Wentao asked about his reaction to the last physical therapy and how his lower back felt during yesterday's basketball game. Ye Mingxuan honestly reported slight discomfort. Dr. Liu attached electrode pads to the erector spinae and quadratus lumborum muscles on both sides of his lumbar spine, started the low-frequency pulse therapy device in soothing mode for 20 minutes, and then performed 10 minutes of acupoint pressure and manual relaxation. He advised him to continue stretches such as supine knee-to-chest holds and confirmed the third physical therapy session for next Sunday. After treatment, Ye Mingxuan rode back, stopping at the Cainiao station at the community entrance on the way to pick up a desktop storage box package.
location: Tianjin Xiqing District, No. 76 Xingguang Road, Tianjin Zhongbei Hospital, second-floor rehabilitation physiotherapy room, and the round trip

name: Assemble the storage box and share it with Mom.
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiulan was trimming vegetables in the kitchen. Ye Mingxuan shook the express delivery box and told her it was for storing odds and ends. He chatted that today's physical therapy felt good and the doctor praised his recovery. Then he went to the study, opened the package with a utility knife, and assembled the multi-compartment storage box according to the instructions, planning to use it for screwdrivers, pens, and a small tape measure.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Planning and learning for installing a 3D printer.
description: After assembling the storage box, Ye Mingxuan opened his laptop at the desk, searched for a Creality Ender-3 V2 unboxing and installation video tutorial, went through the process in his head, and confirmed that he had a hex wrench at home. Then he spent some time studying the basic settings of the slicing software Cura, such as layer height and infill density, to build up knowledge for tomorrow's printing.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Mother called everyone to dinner. The meal was more lavish than usual, with steamed sea bass and winter melon meatball soup, both of which Ye Mingxuan loved. At the table, Mother again brought up whether to hire acquaintances for the new house renovation. Ye Mingxuan smiled and took over the conversation, saying he would plan it in his notebook first and then ask for quotes later. Father Ye Jianguo nodded quietly beside them.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Watched TV with parents and browsed information
description: After the meal, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to wash the dishes. When everything was tidied up, the family of three sat on the living room sofa watching a documentary on ancient architecture broadcast on CCTV-1. During the show, he took out his phone to check his Moments and liked a running post by Chen Xiao.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Exchanged startup plans online with Zhou Tao
description: After getting tired of watching TV, Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and sent Zhou Tao a WeChat message sharing how he felt about today's run and physical therapy, and asked how he was resting. Zhou Tao replied that he had organized a draft of the business plan and sent it over. Ye Mingxuan leaned against the headboard and carefully read the PDF. He found that the market and customer analysis in the plan was good, but the cost budget and staffing sections were still somewhat vague, so he used his phone's memo app to note a few questions and revision suggestions, planning to discuss them in more detail with Zhou Tao the next day.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bed stretching, washing up, and getting ready
description: After putting down his phone, Ye Mingxuan walked to the yoga mat and did the bedtime lower-back rehabilitation stretches taught by Dr. Liu, including supine knee hugs and glute bridges, holding each movement for 15–20 seconds. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking in the mirror, he felt the day had been full and steady. After changing into pajamas, he took out the T-shirt and trousers for the next day, placed them on the nightstand, and checked the e-bike keys.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Reading before bed and reviewing the day before sleep
description: At exactly 22:00, Ye Mingxuan turned off the main light, leaving only the small bedside lamp. He picked up the Mechanical Engineering Handbook (Volume 3) and read the chapter on tolerances and fits for about 20 minutes, then closed the book when his eyes felt sore. His mind naturally replayed the day's experiences, and he felt that Sunday had been busy and fulfilling. He then turned off the lamp, adjusted into a comfortable position to keep his lower back relaxed, and soon fell into a sound sleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang on time, and Ye Mingxuan did not linger in bed because the 3D printer was scheduled to arrive today; he felt excited. He first did 10 minutes of lower back rehabilitation stretches and core activation to relieve the stress from sitting for long periods. Then he washed up, weighed 73.7 kg, and changed into dark gray work pants and a blue polo shirt. His mother had prepared breakfast: homemade jianbing guozi and freshly ground soy milk. Ye Mingxuan chatted with his parents while eating, telling them a delivery would arrive today and he would be busy on the balcony in the evening. His father reminded him to use electricity safely, and his mother told him to watch his lower back.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bike commute and listen to tech podcasts
description: Ye Mingxuan put on his noise-cancelling headphones, rode his gray Niu electric scooter, and set off for work. He played the Python data processing podcast recommended by Chen Xiao, a software engineer he had met while running on Sunday, and used his commute to learn hands-on Pandas data cleaning, feeling the morning breeze while completing fragmented learning.
location: Along the route from Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Morning focused on work: drawing tolerance revisions and task preparation.
description: After arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan clocked in, brewed green tea, and immediately got to work. He first completed the drawing tolerance revision that the senior engineer had assigned last week, tightening the key fit tolerance of the connector from 0.05 mm to 0.03 mm, checking the related dimension chain, and submitting it for review through the internal system after updating the drawing number and version. He then organized the suggested key points for Zhou Tao's startup business plan, outlining discussion topics from the perspectives of technical barriers and initial customer acquisition costs.
location: 8th Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare for the May Day class reunion during the lunch break
description: Seeing Sun Jing's May Day gathering message in the college class group, Ye Mingxuan replied in a private chat that he would attend but the budget needed to be controlled within 100 yuan per person. During the lunch break, he did not dine with colleagues; he bought a sandwich and yogurt from a convenience store and drove to Shuixi Park. After parking, he walked along the trail and talked with Sun Jing for nearly half an hour, candidly sharing his mortgage payment pressure, and Sun Jing agreed to lower the meal standard. Ye Mingxuan searched on his phone and booked the Tianjin restaurant 'That Courtyard' near the Italian Style Area, confirmed the private room and preliminary menu at 11:30 on May Day, and then shared the reservation information to the class group. On the way back to the parking lot, he planned the Five Great Avenues walking route from memory, and confirmed with Sun Jing via WeChat the plan starting from Minyuan Stadium, along Chongqing Road and Dali Road, and finally resting at a café on Machang Road. After synthesizing opinions, Sun Jing posted the final activity arrangement in the group.
location: South Gate of Shuixi Park, Bixin Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work discussion and production follow-up
description: After returning to the company, Ye Mingxuan printed out the key suggestions he had organized in the morning. Around 14:00, he met with Zhou Tao for 20 minutes in the small meeting room, giving sincere advice from three aspects: technical implementation cost, initial market customer acquisition channels, and team building risks. Zhou Tao said he was very inspired. Afterwards, he continued to complete the robotic arm simulation data summary report, and checked the courier information showing the printer had arrived at the sorting center. Later in the afternoon, he went downstairs to the production workshop and checked the key assembly dimensions of the previous batch of samples with Li Xiang, who was monitoring the test prototype, confirming they met the design requirements. After returning to the office, he handled emails, archived work results, and recorded tomorrow's to-do items in his work log. At 17:25, he packed up and left work on time.
location: 8th floor and workshop, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work commute and signing for a 3D printer
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his e-bike home, feeling cheerful on the way as he thought about the 3D printer that was about to arrive. When he reached the doorstep, he saw, as expected, a half-meter-square cardboard box leaning against the wall. He carefully carried it into the living room, skillfully cut open the tape with a utility knife, and took out one by one the foam-wrapped printer body, accessory box, white PLA filament, and quick-start guide, preparing for assembly.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Assembling the main body of the 3D printer
description: Ye Mingxuan carried the printer and accessories to the balcony workshop and placed them on the workbench that had long been cleared. He removed the protective film from the print bed, fixed the gantry base according to the manual, installed the Z-axis lead screw, carefully secured the print bed onto the linear rails, and finally connected the stepper motor wires and limit switch cables. The whole process took only about 30 minutes, completing the main frame assembly and all cable connections.
location: Balcony workshop, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: His mother had already made dinner, including scrambled eggs with tomatoes and shredded pork with green peppers, which Ye Mingxuan loved. The family sat together, and Ye Mingxuan shared the day's amusing stories: his planned May Day class reunion proposal had been approved by his mother, and the 3D printer had been set up and was ready for debugging. His father again reminded him to pay attention to electrical safety. The family atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: 3D printer calibration, first print, and learning 3D modeling
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan immediately returned to the balcony and manually leveled the heated bed by following a video on his phone. He repeatedly adjusted the knobs at the four corners of the bed using an A4 sheet until the nozzle resistance was even. Then he loaded white PLA filament, selected the 'small gear' model on the SD card, and began printing. Watching the nozzle heat to 200 degrees and extrude material layer by layer to build the gear outline, he felt a sense of satisfaction. While the printer worked quietly, he returned to the computer in his bedroom, spent 10 minutes downloading and installing the personal edition of Fusion 360, and followed the built-in tutorials to learn basic functions such as view manipulation, sketch creation, and smart dimensioning. More than an hour later, the print finished. He carefully removed the white gear and found that it was overall successful except that one corner of the bottom was slightly warped. He immediately took a photo and recorded the problem and improvement ideas in his phone's memo.
location: Balcony workshop and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and stretching before bed
description: Tired but excited, Ye Mingxuan quickly took a hot shower to relax his tense muscles. Back in the bedroom, he did 10 minutes of targeted stretching for his lower back. After lying down on the bed, he took out his phone and briefly noted the day's key events in the notepad: the 3D printer's first test print was successful and issues were recorded, the May Day route plan was completed, and communication with Sun Jing went smoothly. Finally, he glanced contentedly toward the balcony workshop.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Read professional books before going to sleep.
description: After turning off the main light, Ye Mingxuan turned on the bedside lamp and read the Mechanical Design Handbook (Mechanism Design Section) for about 20 minutes. Growing sleepy, he turned off the light and reviewed tomorrow's plan: complete the project drawings in the morning, respond to the Senior Engineer's review comments in the afternoon, and then fall asleep right at 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 13, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine, breakfast, and getting ready to head out
description: At 06:50 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. Ye Mingxuan turned off the alarm, got out of bed, and stepped onto the scale, which showed 73.6 kg. He then did lumbar rehabilitation stretches, completing cat-cow stretch and child's pose relaxation. After washing up, he went downstairs to the dining room, where his mother had prepared breakfast: corn grits porridge, dressed potato shreds, and braised pork belly. While eating, Ye Mingxuan praised his mother's cooking, mentioned he would be learning software in the evening, and his mother told him not to overwork himself. After the meal, he returned to the bedroom to get the folding umbrella, went to the balcony to check the raincoat in the e-bike's trunk, confirmed it was intact, put on his helmet, and placed the raincoat and umbrella in the vehicle.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin: at home — bedroom, bathroom, dining room, and the parking shed downstairs.

name: Commuting to work and arriving at the company
description: Ye Mingxuan rode the electric bike along Zhongbei Avenue to the company. On the way, he wore earphones and listened to a Python podcast, learning tips for processing CSV data with pandas. After arriving at the Haitai Development office building, he parked in the designated area, swiped his card to go upstairs, and met his colleague Li Xiang in the elevator, briefly asking about the progress of the simulation report. At his workstation, he turned on his computer, got some water, and listed the day's priority tasks in his notebook.
location: From Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning core work.
description: Ye Mingxuan processed the drawing review comments raised by the senior engineer, revised the CAD drawings item by item in accordance with the comments, and marked the revision logic and basis with a red pen. Afterward, he reported progress to the senior engineer via instant message and asked about follow-up adjustments. In between, he took the time to reply to colleague Zhou Tao's feedback on his business plan, offering conservative data-based suggestions on the market analysis section.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: To save money, Ye Mingxuan went to the company cafeteria and ordered scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic broccoli, and spicy diced chicken with rice, costing 12 yuan. Compared with takeout, the cafeteria is more cost-effective, which fits his money-saving plan.
location: Company cafeteria, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Sorted and printed notes during the lunch break.
description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation and did not rest immediately. Instead, he used the memo app on his phone to organize the problem of warping at the bottom of the 3D printer from last night. He listed possible causes in a mind map format (insufficient heated bed temperature, first-layer printing speed too fast, damp filament) and the corresponding troubleshooting steps (re-measuring the heated bed level, adjusting first-layer printing parameters).
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Midday indoor activity
description: As the rain outside the window grew heavier, Ye Mingxuan gave up going out for a walk and instead paced back and forth in the corridor on the 17th floor of the company building to stretch his lower back after sitting for long. Walking to the window at the end of the corridor, he gazed at the misty rain in the distance and remarked that the weather forecast had been accurate.
location: 17th-floor corridor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work period
description: Ye Mingxuan finalized the robotic arm simulation report: imported the final parameters provided by Li Xiang into the simulation software, reran the motion trajectory simulation under load conditions, and after confirming the data was correct, pasted the charts and conclusions into the report document. He then took the printed drawings to the workshop and checked the key dimensions and tolerance requirements of the transmission shaft assembly with Li Xiang in person. After returning to the office, he archived and processed this week's technical consultation emails, categorizing and replying to them and marking them accordingly.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin — company workstation and workshop.

name: After work, pick up fruit on the way home.
description: After work, Ye Mingxuan put on his raincoat and, on the way home on his electric bike, stopped by the community group-buying store. Using his pickup code, he collected a box of red-fleshed dragon fruit and two jin of imported bananas he had reserved. As a regular customer, he got a few extra small kumquats from the owner.
location: Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Going home, family communication, and dinner.
description: Ye Mingxuan arrived home with fruit, put the fruit in the kitchen, and changed out of his slightly damp coat. His mother was cooking vegetables and his father was watching the news. He briefly told them that work was going well and mentioned the 3D printer issue, and then the family had dinner together. Dinner was the chive and pork dumplings his mother had made. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan shared amusing stories from the company, such as the senior engineer's advice and Li Xiang's debugging story. His father also recalled technical problems he had encountered at the factory in his youth. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Rest after the meal and study preparation.
description: After helping clear the dishes, Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom, brewed a cup of instant coffee, took out the woodworking toolbox design sketch, spread open his notebook, turned on the computer, and adjusted his chair and headphones, preparing for the upcoming Fusion 360 study session.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Fusion 360 learning and modeling practice
description: Outside, the rain was falling heavily. Ye Mingxuan followed a Bilibili tutorial to learn parametric sketch creation in Fusion 360, using tools such as lines, circles, and rectangles, and mastered symmetric constraints and equal-length constraints. Next, he tried extruding a 2D rectangle into a rectangular solid, and used the Revolve command to create a sphere from a semicircular profile. After encountering an error that the revolve profile was not closed, he patiently corrected it and successfully generated the solid. He then independently completed a small quiz: creating a cylinder, a cube, and a rectangular block with a hole, using equal constraints to ensure the cube's side lengths were equal, and finally drilling a hole on the top face of the rectangular block. After finishing, he rotated the view to check the model, confirmed that the hole was centered and the dimensions were correct, and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Review the woodworking toolbox design
description: After the modeling practice, Ye Mingxuan took out the hand-drawn woodworking toolbox design sketch from a few months ago and thought about reconstructing it with 3D modeling software. In his notebook, he drew a module breakdown diagram, marking the estimated dimensions of the four main modules—the toolbox body, partitions, handle, and hinge mounting positions—recording the blueprint for the subsequent formal design.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Indoor core muscle training
description: Because of the continuous rain, Ye Mingxuan switched to indoor core training. On the yoga mat, he completed, in order, planks (3 sets of 1 minute), side bridges (3 sets of 45 seconds on each side), and bird-dog exercises (3 sets of 12 reps). Although he felt like giving up between sets, he gritted his teeth and persisted. When he finished, his abdominal and lower back muscles were trembling, and he spent a few more minutes doing the pre-bedtime lumbar rehabilitation stretches.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After training, wiped off sweat and went into the bathroom. While brushing teeth, he was still reviewing the modeling steps from earlier in his mind. After showering, his body and mind gradually relaxed, preparing for sleep.
location: Home bathroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening review, browsing forums, and going to sleep
description: Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, opened his notebook, and used keywords to record his work gains (the drawing issues pointed out by the senior engineer, key parameters from the robotic arm report) and learning insights (understanding Fusion 360's extrude and revolve commands, ideas for solving errors). He then leaned against the headboard and used his tablet to browse a mechanical design forum, bookmarking a post about special glue for FDM print edge warping, and also looked at interior structure designs on a woodworking forum to get inspiration for the toolbox project. Finally, after confirming that the alarm for the next day was set, he turned off the desk lamp and fell asleep to the sound of pattering rain.
location: At home, in front of the bedroom desk and on the bed, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Research auction item details and set a budget ceiling.
description: After tidying up, I went to the balcony workshop that doubles as a study and closed the door. I opened the Weipaitang app and found the Hubei Double Dragon one-tael silver coin I had been longing for. Using the high-magnification magnifier function, I repeatedly checked the sharpness of the edge serrations, the continuity of the dragon scales, and the patina distribution on the base — not letting a single detail pass. Then I opened my homemade Excel monthly budget sheet and listed the current balance, the 4,200 yuan monthly payment to be deducted on April 28, and the estimated living expenses for May one by one. After precise calculation, I took a deep breath and entered the psychological price limit I had set into the bid remarks field — a price just beyond the safety line for the monthly payment and living expenses, not one yuan more.
location: Balcony workshop, Room 501, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Participated in real-time bidding and rationally gave up.
description: The auction officially started at 20:00, but I observed the live room's atmosphere beforehand. The starting bid was 8,000 yuan, and the first few minutes were cautious. As the auctioneer's pace quickened, the price climbed rapidly. I didn't bid immediately, but instead observed the bidding styles of the main bidders. When the price broke past my psychological ceiling by 200 yuan, I finally placed a bid—but it was instantly outbid. I added another tentative bid of 50 yuan, and the price kept climbing. At that moment, staring at the constantly jumping numbers on the screen, my finger hovered over the 'Confirm Bid' button. In the end, I decisively closed the bidding page, picked up my cup, and took a sip of water. The instant I gave up, I felt a bit disappointed, but more than that, a sense of relief—knowing I had held on to a more important financial bottom line.
location: Balcony workshop, Room 501, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

The accompanying images were the high-definition photos of the silver coin he had saved earlier and a small mortise-and-tenon wooden piece he had just printed in the balcony workshop. After posting, he soon received three thumbs-up from Zhao Xiaofeng, a teasing "Stay healthy, bro" from Zhou Tao, a face-palm laugh from fitness coach Wang Jian, and a comforting private message from Sun Jing. Looking at these interactions, he couldn't help but smile, and felt more relaxed and at ease than before.
location: Balcony workshop, Room 501, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Exchange collecting insights with fellow collector Zhao Jianguo.
description: After posting on Moments, he proactively sent a WeChat voice call to Mr. Zhao Jianguo, a fellow ancient coin collector far away in Xi'an. He shared the bidding process that night and his mental journey of ultimately choosing to give up, admitting that being constrained by his budget was indeed unpleasant. Mr. Zhao Jianguo answered quickly and, in his signature Shaanxi dialect, recounted the "feat" of eating instant noodles for a whole month in his youth just to buy a few old coins. Then he earnestly advised him: "Collecting is a long-term pursuit; if the opportunity hasn't come, it cannot be forced. Living within your means is the right way. Xiao Ye, you did the right thing." The two talked for a long time about the collecting philosophy of "living within one's means." Mr. Zhao also shared an interesting story about recently winning a "Jiangnan Yisi Province 7 Mace 2 Candareens" coin at an overseas auction, and encouraged him to pay more attention to low-priced coins with historical research value. After the call ended, he felt a strong resonance and understanding; this online kindred spirit understood him better than many of his real-life friends.
location: Balcony workshop, Room 501, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (WeChat voice call)

name: Fusion 360 3D modeling
description: After brewing tea, I officially started the most important technical task of the day: designing a 3D model of a phone stand. I opened Fusion 360 and first quickly sketched the side view and top view on draft paper, confirming the structure of an oval base, a post with reinforcing ribs, and an inclined bracket on top. Then I formally started modeling: used “Extrude” to create the 8mm thick oval base; created a new sketch on the base, drew the rectangular cross-section of the post, and extruded it to 80mm; merged the base and post using “Boolean”; for the bracket part, used the “Revolve” command to create a curved support surface with a 15-degree inclination; finally used “Chamfer” to soften the edges, and “Shell” to hollow out the inside of the post to reduce weight and material. During the design, I encountered a sketch constraint conflict and solved it after patiently troubleshooting. When it was done, I reviewed it from all angles; the structure was reasonable and the result satisfying, so I saved it as an STL file.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 10, Huating International, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Based on the senior engineer's requirements emphasized last Friday—that the fan mounting seat needs reinforced support and the air duct angle needs fine adjustment—I carefully adjusted layer height, infill density, and support type, compared slice previews with several different parameters, found the solution with the most stable support and best surface quality, and recorded the key parameters. The model is planned to be trial-printed on the company's printer tomorrow.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 10, Huating International, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Ye Mingxuan shared his own stress-coping method: break big goals into smaller tasks and find a hobby after work that you can fully immerse yourself in.
