name: Run a Python script to analyze personal finances
description: Opened the laptop and connected to the small printer in the study. First opened the China Merchants Bank app, confirmed the final balance of 58,110.00 yuan once more, and saved a screenshot. Then ran my own Python financial analysis script. The program read the latest monthly budget table manually entered into a CSV file, which now included a new item: the actual mortgage payment of 1,600 yuan. The program quickly output this month's cash flow forecast bar chart and a detailed income and expense list, clearly showing that after maintaining the basic cost of living (support for parents, communication, commuting, and fitness), the remaining monthly disposable funds had plummeted from about 7,000 yuan before buying the house to less than 1,500 yuan. Staring at the chart on the screen, I fell silent and felt my chest tighten. I picked up a pen and firmly wrote "Fixed cost: mortgage 1,600 yuan/month" in my notebook, and drew a heavy circle next to it.
location: Home study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Make a financial austerity decision
description: After looking at the data, he did not complain. He took a deep breath, opened the notes app on his phone, and wrote down one by one a plan of "load checking" and "structural optimization" for his life, then took a screenshot and saved it as a private favorite on WeChat: 1. Game recharges: cancel entirely; 2. Large purchases of ancient coins: suspend, allowing occasional bargain hunting of no more than 100 yuan per month; 3. Eating out: reduce to at most once a month, with per-person spending no more than 80 yuan; 4. Car purchase savings plan: officially shelve, and convert the original 2,000 yuan monthly transfer to the car fund into emergency reserves; 5. Lifestyle: starting tomorrow, begin making homemade lunch bento boxes. After writing it, he estimated in his notebook how much money each measure could save.
location: Home study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Collect bento recipes and make a shopping list
description: After making up his mind, he took action immediately. He opened the Xiachufang app and the websites of several fitness bloggers, and began screening recipes based on Li Xiang's suggestion at noon and the cookware available at home. He focused on three keywords: time-saving, high-protein, and still tasty after microwaving. In the end, he settled on five meal combinations, including pan-seared chicken breast with multigrain rice and cold spinach salad, and scrambled eggs with shrimp and quinoa rice with stir-fried broccoli. Then he compiled all the ingredients into a detailed shopping list (skinless chicken breast, frozen shrimp, broccoli, spinach, eggs, brown rice, quinoa, olive oil, coarse sea salt, and sealed bento boxes), sent it to himself via WeChat, and planned to get everything in one trip to the Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store or a warehouse supermarket after work tomorrow evening.
location: Home study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Checked the ingredients at home and washed the lunchbox.
description: To make sure there would be no duplicate items on tomorrow evening's shopping run, he went to the kitchen, looked through the fridge and the storage cabinets, and took stock of the seasonings on hand (light soy sauce, cooking wine, black pepper) and the lunch boxes he already had. In a corner of the cabinet he found a double-layer glass lunch box that had not been used for a long time, carefully washed it with dish soap, and turned it upside down on the drying rack to air dry. This small act made the idea of bringing a lunch box starting tomorrow feel more real.
location: Home kitchen, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening reading and a walk in the courtyard
description: Returned to the room and didn't look at the computer or phone again. To relax his brain, which was a bit tense from thinking about finances, he picked up an old book about the history of automobile engine development and read for 20 minutes. After that, he put on a jacket and went downstairs for a slow 15-minute walk around the neighborhood. The night air was slightly cool, allowing him to calm down again.
location: Courtyard, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and prepare for sleep
description: Back home, he washed up briefly and soaked his feet in hot water. Although there was still something on his mind, all the plans had been implemented, and he regained a long-missing sense of control and security.
location: Home bathroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Got into bed and turned off the light, forcing himself not to think about the account balance. Briefly reviewed the day's schedule in his mind and confirmed nothing was missed, especially the key items on tomorrow's shopping list. The economic tightening was a fact, but planning and responding rationally was the most familiar and most effective approach. With this mindset, he gradually fell asleep. Although he fell asleep a bit later than usual, his mood was calm.
location: Home bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 15, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up, washing up, breakfast, and preparing to leave home.
description: The alarm went off at 7:00. After washing up, he went to the kitchen, where his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared warm two-grain porridge and boiled eggs. He finished breakfast quickly and drank a glass of warm water. Then he changed into work clothes, put his phone, work badge, and car keys into his commuter bag, and did a final check of the afternoon shopping list in his phone notes (chicken breast, shrimp, broccoli, spinach, carrots, brown rice, quinoa, glass lunch box). After confirming everything was correct, he put on his sports shoes and got ready to leave.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Listened to a podcast while driving to work.
description: Driving a silver sedan along Zhongbei Avenue, on the way I started a podcast about “minimalist living” to get a feel for the new pace of life in advance and prepare for the upcoming frugal lifestyle.
location: On the commute from Zhongbei Avenue to Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Work in the morning and get in touch with friends.
description: After arriving at the office, he immediately turned on the computer and handled three emails: a confirmation of the internal review meeting time (2:30 pm) from the project assistant, and updated parameters from two suppliers. After replying quickly, he focused on the transmission optimization drawing left unfinished yesterday, marking the stress concentration areas at the connections that needed refinement with a red pen. Around 10 o'clock, he took a short break at his desk and sent a casual WeChat message to his friend Sun Jing to cancel the self-driving trip to Jixian; Sun Jing quickly replied saying she understood and confirmed the May Day dinner, which easily resolved the budget issue. He then went back to work, opened SolidWorks to export the models that needed simulation analysis, organized a trend chart of recent test data in Excel, and prepared key points for the afternoon review meeting. During this time, his colleague Li Xiang passed by his workstation, and the two briefly discussed questions that might be asked at the afternoon meeting.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Malatang lunch, controlling expenses.
description: Went with colleagues to a malatang shop near the company. To control spending, he deliberately only took vegetables, soy products, and a small amount of meat, with a balanced mix but limited total quantity. The final bill was 27 yuan, nearly half of usual. After the meal, he walked about 10 minutes in the downstairs garden to relax his spine.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Final preparations before the afternoon review meeting
description: Back at his workstation, he went through the prepared PPT again, focusing on supplementing a comparative analysis of material costs. When the senior engineer passed by, he took the initiative to ask a detailed question about material fatigue life in the optimization plan, and received guidance from the senior engineer.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Small internal project review meeting.
description: The meeting started on time. Ye Mingxuan presented the optimization of the transmission module he was in charge of, using data charts to clearly show the advantages of the improvement plan in reducing energy consumption and improving precision. When answering questions about vibration control under extreme working conditions, he drew on the ideas he had thought about the night before and gave a preliminary proposal, earning a nod of approval from project manager Wang Peng. The meeting ended a bit later than expected.
location: Meeting room, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organized meeting minutes and wrapped up the day's work
description: After returning to his workstation, he made a minor adjustment to the drawings based on the meeting discussion, entered the recorded to-do items into the project management system, and updated the Gantt chart according to the task assignments. After confirming that the day's work was basically complete, he closed the computer and tidied his desk.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: After work, go to Sam's Club to shop.
description: Left work on time, started the car, and navigated directly to Sam's Club. In a good mood on the way, I opened a podcast about bento recipes on the car's media player. After arriving, I pushed a shopping cart and moved through the supermarket strictly following the checklist on my phone's memo. After rationally comparing the prices of several frozen chicken breasts, I chose the one with the best value for money. When choosing a lunch box, I looked up heat resistance online and chose the more hygienic and durable glass version. The total came to 286 yuan, within budget. After checkout, I put two large bags of groceries in the trunk, drove back to the entrance of my building, carried all the groceries into the kitchen in two trips, and spread them out on the counter.
location: Sam's Club at 221 Huichuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the commuting route

name: Family dinner and organizing ingredients.
description: Dinner was sautéed seasonal vegetables and braised fish made by his mother. While eating, Ye Mingxuan talked with his parents about the day's work and the results of the evening grocery run, explaining the intention behind the "frugal lifestyle" and "homemade bento." His father Ye Jianguo approved, and his mother reminded him to portion out the ingredients. After the meal, he sat for a moment and then started processing the ingredients: dividing chicken breast into 150 g portions in freezer bags and freezing them; breaking broccoli into florets, shredding carrots, and washing spinach, then patting them dry with paper towels and storing them in containers in the fridge; mixing brown rice and quinoa in a 2:1 ratio and portioning out some for tomorrow morning's rice cooking. His mother came by and set down a box of eggs, reminding him to keep a balanced diet.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Replied to Chen Xiao on WeChat and arranged a morning run.
description: Sitting on the living room sofa to rest, I saw a message from my friend Chen Xiao asking about my recovery after the weekend run. I briefly replied with how I felt after core training and proactively suggested: "After the holiday, the first Saturday morning, the usual place? I've been meaning to boost my endurance too." Chen Xiao readily agreed, and the two left the specific time to be decided.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Core training and stretching before bed.
description: Put on exercise shorts, spread the yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and did about 10 minutes of core strength exercises (plank, side plank, glute bridge, etc.), followed by cat stretch and child’s pose to relax the lower back. After exercising, my body felt comfortable, and the sweat carried away the day’s fatigue.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening study, forum browsing, and bedtime preparations.
description: After taking a shower, he turned on his laptop and first spent 20 minutes watching the parts of the Python data processing course video about file reading/writing and exception handling, and wrote two lines of test code. Then he opened the ancient coin forum in his bookmarks and browsed several appreciation posts about the Sun Yat-sen nickel coin of the 25th year of the Republic of China, quietly studying. Afterward he went to the bathroom to wash up, and before bed went to the kitchen to arrange in the refrigerator the ingredients needed for tomorrow morning (portioned chicken breast, cut vegetables, mixed brown rice and quinoa), ensuring a smooth morning routine.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Turning off his phone, he lay down on the bed. Reviewing the day, the plan to proactively cancel the self-driving trip had been carried out smoothly, the shopping was completed seriously, and exercise and study also proceeded as planned. The neatly arranged ingredients in the refrigerator gave him, on the first day of his frugal life, a long-missed sense of stability from actively taking control of his own life. As he planned the contents of tomorrow's first homemade bento, he gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Night rest
description: In the early morning of the last day of April, Ye Mingxuan was sleeping soundly in his bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, enjoying a quiet night's rest and storing up energy for the fulfilling day ahead.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Made a healthy lunch bento in the early morning.
description: After the alarm went off on time, Ye Mingxuan quickly washed up and walked into his kitchen. The rice cooker had already cooked a pot of brown rice and quinoa as scheduled, giving off the aroma of grains. He took the chicken breast and vegetables that had thawed overnight from the fridge, and skillfully diced, marinated, and pan-fried them, and scrambled a free-range egg his mother had prepared into soft egg curds. He layered the multigrain rice, pan-fried chicken, scrambled egg, blanched broccoli, and shredded carrots into a newly bought glass lunchbox, with a perfect color combination. His mother, Wang Xiulan, got up when she heard the commotion, saw her son making a lunchbox, smiled approvingly, and then began preparing breakfast for the two of them.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and getting ready before going out
description: Ye Mingxuan and his mother sat in the home dining room, eating two slices of whole wheat bread with hot milk for breakfast. While eating, he checked the weather app on his phone and confirmed today's forecast: 'sunny turning to cloudy, 18-26.' After eating, he carefully placed his lunch box into an insulated bag, checked his work badge, keys, and phone at the entrance, straightened his collar in front of the mirror, and prepared to leave for work with a confident smile.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to the office.
description: Ye Mingxuan drove his own car from Huating International Community, went along Zhongbei Avenue, turned onto West Outer Ring Road, and then entered Haitai Development 6th Road, heading to the Haitai Development Office Building. On the way, he played a minimalist-living podcast about “how to build sustainable daily habits,” which matched the homemade lunches and frugal routine he had started following, and he listened intently.
location: En route by car from Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 6 Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road

name: Morning work: drawing optimization and review meeting minutes.
description: After arriving at Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., Ye Mingxuan first handled emails to confirm project progress, then opened CAD software and made fine parameter adjustments to a key part drawing of the transmission module based on the suggestions made by his colleague Gao Zhiyuan at last Friday's review meeting. At around 10 a.m., he organized and refined the meeting minutes, listing one by one the points praised by Senior Engineer Gao and the follow-up modification items, and CC'd the project manager Wang Peng. Meanwhile, he saw his colleague Zhou Tao carefully wiping down his workstation, with signs of a document handover becoming increasingly evident. Their eyes met, and they nodded knowingly at each other.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch, stair-climbing workout, and midday rest
description: After the lunch break bell rang, Ye Mingxuan took out the healthy homemade bento from his insulated bag and heated it in the microwave in the break room. His colleague Li Xiang passed by, saw it, and curiously came over to compliment him. The two chatted while eating, and Ye Mingxuan shared his feelings about bringing lunch for the first time. After the meal, he used the time from 12:20 to 12:40 to walk up from the 1st floor to the 11th floor twice, completing the day's strength training plan. At 12:40, he returned to his workstation, put on an eye mask, leaned back in his chair, and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon work: track the fixture trial assembly progress and write the weekly report
description: Right after starting work in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan went to the production department workshop to follow up on the trial assembly progress of the new fixture samples. He carefully discussed potential tolerance issues in assembly with the technician in charge and observed the trial fitting of the first batch of parts on site. After confirming that all indicators met requirements, he returned to the office with relief. He then began writing this week’s weekly report, summarizing key work such as transmission drawing optimization and fixture progress tracking, and planned tasks after the holiday, including starting to review the documentation related to the intelligent warehouse subsystem that Zhou Tao was about to hand over.
location: Haitai Development Office Building and Production Department Workshop, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving home from work.
description: Ye Mingxuan left work on time at 5 p.m. and drove back along the same route to Huating International Community. He deliberately slowed down to enjoy the relatively smooth traffic before rush hour as a simple way to relax.
location: While driving from No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town.

name: Clean and arrange the living room at home.
description: After arriving home, Ye Mingxuan changed into loungewear and began his cleaning and arrangement plan. He spent half an hour deep-cleaning the living room: he carefully wiped the coffee table, TV cabinet, and window sill with a damp cloth, put the magazines and remote controls scattered on the sofa back in place; then he vacuumed and mopped the floor. Finally, he moved several potted succulents from the balcony flower stand to the coffee table and TV cabinet as decoration, adding a touch of vitality to the home.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Head to Wumart Supermarket to buy supplies for the gathering.
description: After finishing the cleaning, Ye Mingxuan drove a few minutes to the Wumart supermarket in Zhongbei Town. Pushing a shopping cart, he shopped precisely according to the checklist on his phone memo: first he grabbed two large bottles of juice, a pack of cola, and a few cans of Tsingtao Beer; then he went to the snack section and picked two packs of nuts and a bag of potato chips. When he passed the specialty frozen-food section, he found his target — 2 boxes of Tianjin Goubuli steamed buns (frozen), planning to steam them tomorrow morning and bring them to his classmates. Finally, he went to the checkout counter and paid. The total came to 138 yuan, within the 150-yuan budget. After shopping, he drove back to Huating International Community.
location: On the way to Wumart Supermarket (Zhongbei Branch) on Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and on the way back to Huating International Residential Community

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared dinner, including Ye Mingxuan's favorite scrambled eggs with tomatoes and a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The family of three sat around the dining table. While eating, Ye Mingxuan shared his experience of bringing a home-packed lunch for the first time today. His parents expressed their support, and his mother specifically reminded him not to forget to thaw the food first when steaming buns tomorrow.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Have an in-depth talk with his father and get urged by his mother to marry
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan went over and sat on the living room sofa, made his father a cup of tea, and candidly talked about his colleague Zhou Tao's resignation and the possibility that he might take over new business responsibilities, also mentioning the financial pressure of the monthly mortgage payment. His father, Ye Jianguo, put down his teacup and encouraged him in a calm voice to take one step at a time and hone his skills. During a pause in their conversation, his mother, Wang Xiulan, walked over with a cup of freshly brewed hot tea. Hearing the words 'loan repayment pressure', she couldn't help interjecting and urging him to find a partner and get married soon, so the home would feel more like a home. As her words fell, the living room air grew slightly tense. Ye Mingxuan lowered his head and sipped his tea without responding, while his father silently turned up the TV volume.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening social confirmations and bedtime preparations
description: After talking with his parents, Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom. He first confirmed the final details of the May Day gathering with Sun Jing: they would meet at 11 a.m. tomorrow at the entrance of the Italian Style District; all attendees were confirmed, and Ye Mingxuan confirmed that he would bring Goubuli steamed buns. Then he sent a WeChat message to his friend Chen Xiao, arranging a morning run at 6:30 a.m. on May 4 along the riverside greenway in Zhongbei Town, and Chen Xiao readily agreed. After completing these social confirmations, he spread a yoga mat on the bedroom carpet and did 10 minutes of core training and lower back stretches. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, returned to the bedroom to pack the bag for tomorrow's gathering, and placed a power bank, tissues, and a portable umbrella in it in advance.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime sleep and late-night rest.
description: After turning off the lights, Ye Mingxuan lay in bed, wrapped in darkness. The important events of the last day of April—work, family, socializing, finances—intertwined in his mind. His father's words made him feel grounded, while his mother's words were like a stone dropped into a calm lake. He felt tired but clear-headed. Thoughts about the future, the weight of adulthood, and the austerity mode he had chosen swirled around him. Amid the tangled thoughts, he slowly drifted into sleep. Outside the window, the night deepened, and he spent the last moments of the day in quietness.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning washing and rehabilitation exercises
description: At 7:30 in the morning, the alarm clock went off on time. Ye Mingxuan sat up in bed, first stretched to feel the condition of his lower back, then brushed his teeth and washed his face. He unrolled his yoga mat and did fifteen minutes of morning core training and lower back stretching, including planks, glute bridges, and cat-cow stretches, to maintain the recovery effect from his lumbar muscle strain.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: After washing up, Ye Mingxuan went to the dining room to have breakfast with his parents. He steamed a basket of frozen Goubuli buns and fried a few eggs. While eating, he told his parents about today's plan: he would go to Tianjin Station to pick up his college classmates, take them around the Five Great Avenues, and listen to crosstalk in the evening; he would not be home for lunch or dinner. His father reminded him to drive safely, and his mother told him not to spend too much and to just have a good time with his classmates.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pack things for going out and check the vehicle
description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan returned to the study to pack his backpack. He put in a power bank, a mirrorless camera (with an extra spare memory card), some tissues, and keys, and checked the camera battery, since he had promised to send Sun Jing some photos. He then went downstairs to the basement garage of the residential complex, walked around the car to check the tires and general condition, and after confirming everything was fine, started the engine to warm it up.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the basement garage

name: Drive to Tianjin Railway Station.
description: Ye Mingxuan set off from the residential community, set the navigation, and drove along Zhongbei Avenue, then onto the Outer Ring Road and then Jinbin Avenue toward the North Square of Tianjin Station. Along the way he listened to the traffic reports for the May Day holiday on the radio. Even though it was a holiday, the morning rush hour traffic was still heavy; he arrived about thirty minutes later.
location: North Square of Tianjin Railway Station, Jianguo Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Meet university classmates at Tianjin Railway Station.
description: After parking the car, Ye Mingxuan came to the exit of the North Square, holding up his phone to confirm the train number. After waiting about twenty minutes, he saw Sun Jing, Liu Yang, Zhao Xiaofeng, Wang Fang, Li Ming, and Zhou Jie, a group of six, walking out of the station with suitcases. He immediately waved and shouted. They were especially warm meeting each other, patting shoulders and hugging. Sun Jing joked that he had grown thinner, and Ye Mingxuan teased that with mortgage pressure, he had recently been cooking for himself to lose weight.
location: North Square exit, Tianjin Railway Station, Jianguo Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Take the subway to Five Avenues
description: After exchanging pleasantries, Ye Mingxuan suggested taking the subway to Five Great Avenues, which was faster than taking a taxi and avoided worrying about traffic jams. The group of seven entered Tianjin Station, took Subway Line 2 to Xinanjiao Station, transferred to Line 1, and got off at Xiaobailou Station. In the carriage, everyone caught up on recent news: Liu Yang complained about too much overtime in Shenzhen, Zhao Xiaofeng asked about details of the mortgage, and Sun Jing said her new job finally no longer required the 996 schedule.
location: Tianjin Metro Line 2, from Tianjin Station to Xiaobailou Station.

name: Strolled along the Five Great Avenues, taking photos to commemorate the occasion.
description: After exiting the subway station, everyone strolled along Machang Road and Dali Road. It was a spring day, roses were in bloom, and the former residences of celebrities along the street, such as Prince Qing's Mansion and Zhang Boling's old home, drew people to stop and take photos. Ye Mingxuan took group and individual photos of his classmates with his mirrorless camera, while Wang Fang and Li Ming studied travel guides nearby. When they reached Minyuan Square, they happened upon a folk artist performing, and everyone watched for a while in a lively atmosphere.
location: Five Avenues Historical and Cultural District, Heping District, Tianjin (Minyuan Square, Machang Road, Dali Road)

name: Lunch at Lao Yongsheng Bistro
description: After walking around for a while, everyone got hungry. Ye Mingxuan led them to a local restaurant on Changsha Road, “Old Yongsheng Bistro.” The environment was nice and the prices were fair. The seven of them ordered the signature potstickers, old-style sautéed trio, eight-treasure tofu, and stewed gluten, eating and chatting as they went. Sun Jing wanted to treat everyone, but Ye Mingxuan stopped her, saying that today he was the host and he knew the per-person bill would not exceed 100 yuan. Everyone laughed and clinked glasses in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Lao Yongsheng Restaurant, Changsha Road, Heping District, Tianjin

name: In-depth talk and exchange at Xiannong Courtyard.
description: After lunch, the group continued deeper into Five Avenues. Ye Mingxuan took them to Xiannong Courtyard, which he had scouted before; there were fewer people there, suitable for chatting. Everyone sat on a bench under a large locust tree and chatted for over two hours. Sun Jing talked in detail about the amusing experience of changing jobs from Beijing. Liu Yang shared the tech atmosphere in Shenzhen and recommended two simulation-learning WeChat official accounts. Zhao Xiaofeng seriously asked Ye Mingxuan how he was coping with mortgage pressure. Ye Mingxuan candidly shared the whole process from buying the house to making the first month's repayment. Li Ming and Zhou Jie talked about their romantic lives, and Wang Fang recorded a Vlog on her phone, planning to edit it later.
location: Xiannong Courtyard, 288 Hebei Road, Heping District, Tianjin

name: Take a taxi to the Italian Style District.
description: They hadn't talked enough, but it was getting late, so Ye Mingxuan urged everyone to head to the Italian Style Area. They took a taxi from Xiannong Courtyard, and on the way they talked about embarrassing college stories: Zhao Xiaofeng got drunk and sang downstairs from the dormitory and was caught by the counselor; Liu Yang was reported by his roommate for playing video games. Laughter continued all the way, and everyone said it was like being back in their student days.
location: Italian Style District, Ziyou Road, Hebei District, Tianjin.

name: Visit to the Italian Style District and dinner at Chenggui Western Restaurant.
description: After arriving at the Italian Style Area, everyone first took a group photo at Marco Polo Square, then strolled along Dante Road. Ye Mingxuan had booked courtyard seats at 'Chenggui Western Restaurant' in advance. After everyone sat down, he recommended signature dishes such as pot-braised beef, cream of mushroom soup, and pasta. Sun Jing took the initiative to order two bottles of red wine and soft drinks. During the meal, everyone raised their glasses, drank joyfully, and chatted about the changes since graduation a few years ago. Zhao Xiaofeng patted Ye Mingxuan on the shoulder and said, 'Buddy, you're taking life one step at a time, and you've put down roots in Tianjin, we all envy you,' bringing the atmosphere to a high point. Ye Mingxuan quietly looked at the bill: the per-person average was just over 100 yuan, and Sun Jing had covered the drinks, which warmed his heart.
location: Chenggui Western Food Courtyard Restaurant, Ziyou Road, Hebei District, Tianjin

name: Walk to Mingliu Teahouse
description: After eating and drinking their fill, Ye Mingxuan led everyone on foot to the Mingliu Teahouse. The teahouse was near the Ancient Culture Street; they walked through a few old alleys, taking in Tianjin under the night sky. Li Ming also bought some steamed pear cake from a street stall to try.
location: Mingliu Teahouse, Ancient Culture Street, Nankai District, Tianjin

name: Listening to crosstalk at Mingliu Teahouse
description: Entering the teahouse, the performers were telling the piece "Yellow Crane Tower." They ordered a pot of tea, sunflower seeds, and peanuts, and sat down in a booth. The traditional crosstalk was blended with many contemporary jokes, and everyone was doubled over with laughter. Zhou Jie laughed until tears came, saying it had more flavor than Beijing's Deyun Society. Near the end of the show, the performers interacted with the audience. Ye Mingxuan was called on to answer a brain teaser, and the whole room applauded; the atmosphere was wonderful.

As they said goodbye, Sun Jing patted his arm and said, "Ye'er, I'm so happy today! Thank you. At least you have roots in Tianjin now - I'm really envious of you." Ye Mingxuan felt a warm surge in his chest and nodded vigorously: "When you come next time, we'll get together again!" After watching them enter the station, he let out a long breath.

name: Analyze the cause of the 3D printing failure, optimize the model, and start printing.
description: After the rest, refreshed, he returned to the study, opened the storage box model file that had failed to print the day before, and used calipers to measure the warping height and wall thickness, concluding that uneven local wall thickness had caused inconsistent cooling shrinkage. He then added fillets with a 1 mm radius at the four inner corners of the model, added two reinforcing ribs to the weak areas on the bottom, and raised the heated bed temperature in the slicer software from 60 to 65, enabling a 10-loop brim to enhance adhesion. After generating the new .gcode file, he uploaded it to the FDM 3D printer, checked that the PLA filament was not tangled, and started printing. He focused intently on monitoring the first-layer adhesion, and only after confirming the material was even, flat, and free of warping did he let it run automatically with peace of mind.

They agreed that the sellers would come next week to re-measure before placing the order. The two also opened a can of paint they had brought and touched up a chipped spot on the secondary bedroom windowsill. After walking for about 15 minutes, Zhang Wei suddenly remembered the anime and game expo on July 18 and said, "I've already grabbed two early-bird tickets on Bilibili's member store; I'll send you the code later." Ye Mingxuan patted him on the shoulder and said he could count on him. The two parted at the entrance of the barbecue restaurant. name: Morning work: tackling model reconstruction topology issues and testing/verification
description: Focusing on solving the model broken-surface problem after parameter updates, he introduced the core module of the NURBS surface reconstruction algorithm and wrote the core interface functions. Li Xiang asked about progress via internal messaging software, and he replied that he estimated the first round of tests could run through by 11 o'clock. After finishing the core functions, he created a test script to randomly generate 20 sets of geometric parameters for validation. In the first round, 3 sets had broken surfaces; he located the issue as overly loose continuity constraints on adjacent surfaces. After fine-tuning the tolerance parameters, all 20 sets passed the second round, perfectly reconstructed with no broken surfaces. Satisfied, he sent a screenshot to Li Xiang: 'The topology problem is solved. You can take over for integrated debugging this afternoon.' Before noon, Zhou Tao passed by his workstation and chatted about lunch. Ye Mingxuan suggested trying the new tomato soup base at the malatang restaurant.

description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan packed the items he needed for work into his backpack: work shoes, a spare T-shirt, a first-aid kit, Bluetooth earphones, and a power bank. He checked the bandages and CPR rescue mask in the first-aid kit, and after confirming they were in order, put on sun-protection cooling arm sleeves, got on his e-bike, and set off. He rode along Zhongbei Avenue toward the Haitai Development Office Building. The weather forecast showed a high of 36 degrees Celsius that day, and the morning breeze already carried warmth. On the way, he passed the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Haitai North-South Street, saw that the breakfast stalls had already opened, but he did not stop and headed straight to the company.
location: From Huating International Community on Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, via Zhongbei Avenue and Haitai North-South Avenue.

name: Reporting for duty and pre-drill preparation
description: After arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan first went to the restroom to change into his work shoes, then went to the safety supervisor's office to review the evacuation map on the east side of the second floor again, confirming the location of the emergency sirens and how the manual alarm buttons were triggered. Returning to his workstation, he printed out the project integration test checklist and circled the two parameter passing errors exposed yesterday with a red pen. Then he left a message to Li Xiang on DingTalk: "Li Xiang, I've arrived. Before the joint debugging this afternoon, I'll first go through the interface logs of the payment module." Next, he turned on the computer, pulled the test environment code to his local machine, and checked line by line the logic of the parameter passing error fixed yesterday to ensure the changes did not introduce new issues. He also confirmed online with Li Xiang that they would start joint debugging with the logistics module at 1:30 PM.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Fire drill during Safety Production Month
description: At 8:50, Ye Mingxuan went downstairs early to assemble. At 9:00 sharp, the safety supervisor laid out the drill procedures in the square, and Ye Mingxuan was assigned as the evacuation guide for the east side of the second floor. When the alarm sounded, he quickly took his position and loudly directed colleagues to cover their mouths and noses, stay low, and follow the evacuation. After everyone safely evacuated to the square, he was the first to pick up a dry powder fire extinguisher and accurately put out the oil pan fire. Then he volunteered to demonstrate CPR. With his Red Cross first aid certificate, he performed 30 chest compressions and 2 rescue breaths on the manikin to standard, while explaining the key points. The safety supervisor praised him on the spot: "Engineer Ye from the Mechanical Department has solid technical skills and strong emergency response capability. Everyone should learn from him!"
location: Haitai Development Office Building Plaza, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin; the stairway entrance on the east side of the second floor; and the plaza drill area.

name: Drill review and email handling
description: After the drill ended, Ye Mingxuan and the safety supervisor briefly reviewed the exercise. He pointed out that the corner of the eastern staircase was poorly lit and suggested adding emergency lighting stickers. Back at his workstation, he drank a large glass of water and began handling the work emails that had accumulated in the morning. He replied to several routine inquiries, then organized last week's design drawing review comments and sent them to Senior Engineer Gao.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch at the company cafeteria and sending ancient coin materials.
description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan went to the company cafeteria for lunch. That day, braised beef noodle soup and zhajiang noodles were available, and he chose the braised beef noodles and added a fried egg. He sat at the same table with his colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, and they talked about the fun moments from the morning drill and the preparation status of the logistics module that Zhou Tao was responsible for. After the meal, he took out his phone and sent the compressed folder of ancient coin images he had organized the night before to Teacher Zhao via WeChat, with the message: 'Teacher Zhao, the images of yesterday's notes are organized, please take a look. What specific time this weekend would be convenient to talk on the phone about that nickel coin article?'
location: In-house canteen of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and sorting out the plan
description: Back at his desk, Ye Mingxuan did not take a midday nap on his desk; instead, he leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for about fifteen minutes. He then put on his earphones and listened to “Counting Stars” to refresh himself. After that, he ran through the final plan for the afternoon's integration test in his head, identified several interface points where problems might arise, and fully prepared mentally for the upcoming joint debugging.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Project integration testing and joint debugging
description: At 1:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang started the integration test on time. They first ran the logistics module and smoothly switched to the payment module. During debugging, the order status callback stuttered. The two calmed down and went through the API documentation line by line, finally discovering that a callback address on Li Xiang's side had one letter wrong. After fixing it, the full pipeline ran through successfully at 3:50. At 4:15, with still 15 minutes before the review meeting, Ye Mingxuan went downstairs to the office park for some fresh air. Seeing the sunset glow already spreading across the western sky, he took a photo and posted it on Moments: Friday's sunset glow signals a smooth finish today.
location: Workstation on the 4th floor of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the campus below the building.

name: Iteration retrospective meeting.
description: Ye Mingxuan joined the online meeting. Manager Wang Peng specifically praised his team: "In the face of a key member leaving and staffing changes, Mingxuan proactively took on more code review and coordination work, ensuring the stable delivery of this iteration. This is worth learning for everyone." When it was Ye Mingxuan's turn to speak, he clearly shared the team's experience of keeping information synchronized through refined task division and a daily 15-minute stand-up meeting, and highlighted the value of two-way code review with Li Xiang in catching problems early. His attitude was pragmatic, neither overbearing nor self-effacing.
location: Conference Room, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin (online)

name: Project wrap-up and delivery
description: After the review meeting ended, Ye Mingxuan immediately returned to his workstation and merged the locally tested code branch into the main development branch, triggering the CI/CD pipeline. When he saw the green prompt on the screen, "Build successful, deployment complete," he let out a long sigh of relief. He then wrote a concise and clear delivery email with the full test report attached, sent it to Manager Wang and CC'd the project team, with the subject '[Delivery] Logistics and Payment Module V2.1.0 Integration Test Report and Deployment'.
location: Workstation, 4th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work relaxation: billiards and picking up takeout
description: After sending the email, the tension finally eased. Ye Mingxuan, Li Xiang, and Zhou Tao walked to Ruili Billiards Hall near Haitai Development Second Road, chatting on the way about the embarrassing mistake of writing the wrong callback address during the afternoon integration test. At the billiards hall they opened a snooker table. Although they were rusty, the atmosphere was relaxed. After three games with two wins, Zhou Tao narrowly won. After playing, the three parted briefly. Ye Mingxuan walked back to the company to pick up his electric scooter, then rode it to the Mala Xiangguo restaurant in the ground-floor shops of Huijie Jiayuan to pick up the pre-ordered 'less oil, medium spice' Mala Xiangguo (with sliced fatty beef, beef tripe, and wide noodles). The boss smiled and greeted him: 'Young man, working overtime again today?' He replied: 'The project is finally wrapped up!'
location: Ruili Billiards Hall at No. 2 Haitai Development Second Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the Mala Xiangguo Restaurant at No. 7, Zone A, ground-floor shops of Huijie Jiayuan, Zhongbei Town.

name: Return home for dinner and changing clothes.
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his electric scooter home in five minutes. His mother took the mala xiangguo and heated it up for him. He finished dinner quickly, knowing there was basketball practice tonight, so he didn't dawdle. He changed into his training clothes and sneakers, packed his knee pads and sports towel, and drank half a glass of water before heading out.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Basketball training.
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike along Zhongbei Avenue, turned onto Outer Ring West Road, and arrived at Tianjin University of Technology Gymnasium in about ten minutes. After arriving, he changed into his jersey and did dynamic stretching and dribbling warm-ups. That evening he played full-court pickup basketball. He was on the same team as Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, responsible for organizing offense and directing defense. He grabbed several key rebounds and assisted teammates in making buzzer-beating shots. During the 40-minute full-court game, his heart rate stayed around 160. After that, he played half-court for another half hour and finished right at 22:00, feeling thoroughly satisfied.
location: Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Late-night dinner gathering and proposal for a technology sharing session
description: After training, the three of them, hungry and satisfied, strolled to the Mala Xiangguo restaurant at the entrance of Huijie Jiayuan and sat at an outdoor table. They ordered a medium-spicy Mala Xiangguo and, as usual, added beef, beef tripe, and wide noodles. While eating and chatting, Zhou Tao formally proposed forming an internal technical sharing group, with members taking turns sharing technical insights for half an hour every Friday afternoon. Ye Mingxuan thought it was a great idea, asked in detail about the implementation plan, and said he could share the concurrency issue he had just fixed.
location: Malaxiangguo Restaurant, No. 7, Zone A, ground-floor commercial units, Huijie Jiayuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going home, washing up, and doing chores
description: After finishing the late-night snack, Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike home. On the way, he stopped at the Guoranduo Fruit Shop at the entrance of the community and bought half a Qilin watermelon. When he got home, he took a hot shower, soaked his sweat-soaked training clothes and work clothes in a basin with laundry detergent, and brought the cut watermelon to the living room for his parents, who had not yet gone to bed.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime journal and rest
description: Ye Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, opened Notion, and updated today's log, focusing on the parameter error fixed during project delivery and its root cause analysis, as well as his personal heart rate data from basketball training. Then he crossed off items on his to-do list such as “fire drill,” “project delivery,” and “weekend nickel coin article discussion,” and added “print the dimension drawing for the custom curtains on Monday.” He glanced at the health reminder card on the table and decided to have a good talk with his father about high blood pressure at lunch the next day. After lying down, he closed his eyes and quickly reviewed: the drill went perfectly, the project was delivered smoothly, the basketball was satisfying, and the late-night snack was comforting. Thinking that he could sleep in tomorrow, he felt relaxed and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning Run and Targeted Stretching
description: After the 5:50 alarm went off, Ye Ning set out from the west gate of Huating International Residential Community and jogged south along the South Canal greenway for 4 kilometers, keeping a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. Despite the morning breeze, the weather was muggy. After the run, he did 20 minutes of systematic stretching in the bench area by the river and used a massage gun to relax his posterior calf muscles, ensuring proper recovery after exercise.
location: South Canal Greenway, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (starting from the west gate of Huating International Community, heading south along the river to Fujin Road, then turning back)

name: Breakfast and shower
description: After exercising and returning home, his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, fermented bean curd, and the pancakes from last night. Ye Ning told his parents about today's plan while eating; his mother fussed about fixing the air conditioner. After the meal, he took a quick shower, changed into dry loungewear, and prepared for the day's activities.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Purchased shade netting and cable ties.
description: After breakfast, Ye Ning rode an electric bike to Wankelai Hardware, Local Products and Daily Necessities Store. After chatting with the owner he knew, he bought a 2m x 3m black shade net and 20 plastic cable ties to build a sun protection system for the succulents. Then he rode back to the residential community.
location: Wankelai Hardware, Local Products and Daily Necessities Store, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Air conditioner repair request and basic inspection
description: After getting home, Ye Ning called Haier's official after-sales service to report a repair, describing the issue that the air conditioner was not cooling and the outdoor unit stopped a few seconds after starting, suspecting a faulty start capacitor. The customer service representative recorded the report and said they would arrange a technician as soon as possible. After hanging up, he moved a ladder himself, opened the outdoor unit cover, inspected it with a flashlight, confirmed that the top of the capacitor was slightly bulging, and preliminarily identified the fault.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Building a sun protection system for succulents.
description: Ye Ning used the 3D-printed brackets and buckles printed yesterday to drill holes at predetermined positions on the shade net, then fixed five brackets on the south balcony railing, adjusted them to about a 30-degree incline, and used zip ties to tension and firmly secure the shade net. Father Ye Jianguo passed by the balcony and teased, "Succulents are more precious than people." Ye Ning replied with a smile, "Health management starts with plants."
location: South balcony, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Air conditioner repair and testing
description: At 9:45, Haier's after-sales Technician Li arrived on time. After testing, he confirmed that the start capacitor had aged, replaced it with a new capacitor, and charged 85 yuan. In the power-on test, the vent temperature dropped to 9, and cooling returned to normal. Ye Ning thanked the technician and mentioned that the outdoor unit bracket had a little rust and could be checked during the next maintenance. After seeing him off, he took a photo of the repair receipt with his phone and uploaded it to the family WeChat group.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wrote and tested the automatic watering reminder script.
description: Ye Ning opened his laptop in the study. Using the QWeather API and simulated soil moisture data, he wrote a Python script that automatically checks temperature and humidity every hour, setting it so that when the temperature is >32 and the simulated humidity is <40%, it sends him a watering reminder via a WeChat Work bot. He finished testing at 11:30 and deployed it as a resident background process.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Writing the first draft of ancient coin notes
description: Switching to ancient coin research mode, Ye Ning opened the document chapter on “Hubu Guangxu Yuanbao” and, using the macro photos sent by fellow collector Zhao Jianguo, began writing descriptions of anti-counterfeiting features. He focused on two key identification points: the “dot-shaped hidden mark in the dragon’s eye” and the “edge tooth slant.” He wrote about 600 characters and left them for a detailed phone discussion with Teacher Zhao in the evening.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and afternoon plan confirmation
description: At 12:30, Ye Ning prepared lunch with his mother: tomato scrambled eggs, cucumber salad, and reheated the leftover braised pork from yesterday. After the meal, he helped his mother clear the dishes. At 12:50, he sent a WeChat message to Boss Li at the curtain shop to confirm the installation of the curtains and bed on Monday (June 16) afternoon, and arranged to meet at the new house after 2 p.m. tomorrow. The other party replied that they had received the message and would arrive on time.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: Pulling the bedroom curtains closed and setting a 30-minute alarm, Ye Ning lay down for a nap on the bamboo mat to conserve energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare health intervention materials.
description: After taking out iced mung bean soup from the fridge to cool off, Ye Ning turned on the TV screen-casting function and projected the pre-made data visualization charts (his own weight dropping from 75.8kg to 73.5kg, body fat from 23% to 19%; his father's blood pressure rising from 135/85 to 145/95 by month; comparison of exercise/sedentary time) onto the TV. He rehearsed the presentation logic to ensure smooth chart transitions, preparing to persuade his father in the evening.
location: Living room and study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Indoor core fitness training
description: On the summer mat in the living room, Ye Ning did three sets of home exercises: 45-second planks x3, bird dogs 15 reps each side x3, and glute bridges 20 reps x3, drinking water between sets to keep the workout smooth.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Independent research and family interaction
description: Ye Ning opened the ancient coin forum, browsed the draft of Zhao Jianguo’s article on nickel coins, and marked two questionable points for discussion in the evening. Then he went to the balcony to check the stability of the succulent plant stand and, on the side, watered a few pots of crown of thorns and aloe. Seeing his father watching an anti-Japanese war drama in the living room, he took the opportunity to sit with him for 10 minutes and casually brought up his father’s marathon days from his youth. His father didn’t respond but listened very attentively.
location: Study and balcony at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walking in the green park and communicating with elders
description: Ye Ning invited her mother Wang Xiulan to take a walk in Lvshuiyuan Park. They walked about 3 laps along the trail for around 40 minutes. She proactively chatted about her mother's fun square-dancing stories and used her phone to check her father's step count for the day, which showed only 2,725 steps, so she had a sense of the situation.
location: Lüshuiyuan Park, 180 meters west of the intersection of Ziyang Road and Luoping Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Returned home and had dinner with my parents: steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the dinner table, Ye Ning brought up the installation of the new house's curtains and bed on Monday afternoon. Father asked if he needed to go supervise, and Ye Ning replied that they could handle it and would send videos.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Persuade father by projecting data on the screen.
description: After the meal, Ye Ning cleared the tea table, cast his phone screen to the TV, and first showed his own weight and body fat change curves, emphasizing that health management is proactive adaptation. He then displayed the trend line of his father's blood pressure, which had been rising year by year over the past six months, and supplemented it with an activity heat map indicating that over the past week he had averaged only 2,500 steps per day. After a brief silence in the living room, his father stared at the data for a long time and finally said he would try jogging a kilometer with him tomorrow morning. Ye Ning immediately responded, agreeing to call him at 6. His mother clapped and laughed off to the side.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Video call with Zhao Xiaofeng about career planning
description: Ye Ning returned to his study and connected a video call with college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng. After catching up on recent life, Xiaofeng suggested that he organize the parametric tool he had previously written into an internal technical paper, pointing out that it would be very beneficial as a bonus point for a mechanical engineer's promotion and senior engineer evaluation. Ye Ning agreed, and they planned to write a technical summary outline first next week.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reply to the technical group and the ancient coin questions
description: Ye Ning opened the ancient coin notes file, organized the two questionable points marked in the afternoon into text, and sent them to Zhao Jianguo, noting that they would discuss by phone tomorrow during the day. Later, in the company technical team group, he replied to Zhou Tao, saying he could use his case of fixing concurrency issues to give a sharing session from bug to abstraction, and decided to prepare the PPT next Friday.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Review and tomorrow's plan
description: Ye Ning updated his Notion log, recording the day's completed items: a 4 km morning run, setting up a sun-shading system for the succulents, fixing the air conditioner, the first successful step of the health intervention, and a video call with Xiaofeng. He set an alarm for 6:00 the next morning to accompany his father on a run, and in his phone memo wrote that after the run he would take his father to have tofu pudding and shaobing.
location: Home study and bathroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wash up and get ready for bed.
description: Ye Ning cleaned his teeth with a water flosser, washed up briefly, and lay down on the bed. Before turning off the light, he pulled open the curtain, glanced at the outline of the sunshade net on the south balcony, felt reassured, and turned off the light at 22:30 to go to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-race preparation, heading to the start, and warm-up
description: When the morning alarm rang, Ye Mingxuan quickly got up, washed up, and refueled as planned by eating two bananas and drinking a glass of lightly salted water. He carefully checked his gear bag: race bib, energy gels, salt tablets, and running watch. After confirming that the booked express car had accepted the order, he quietly went downstairs. He took a ride-hailing car to the race start at the square on the south side of Haimen Bridge, Tanggu, Binhai New Area, Tianjin. On the way, he confirmed the route with the driver, then closed his eyes to rest, and received a WeChat location from his friend Zhou Tao. After arriving at the start, he met up with Zhou Tao. The two did dynamic stretching, a 400-meter warm-up jog, and other pre-race warm-ups, then entered the starting area, Zone B, and waited for the race to begin.
location: Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to the square on the south side of Tanggu Haimen Bridge, Binhai New Area, Tianjin

name: Tianjin Binhai Half Marathon
description: At the starting gun, Ye Mingxuan ran steadily at the preset pace of 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. He ran side by side with Zhou Tao for the first 5 km. At 10 km, Zhou Tao speeded up, but Ye Mingxuan kept his own rhythm. His pace dropped slightly in the second half, but thanks to his willpower and the salt tablets he took, he didn't get cramps. He finally crossed the finish line with a net time of 2 hours 12 minutes 35 seconds, successfully completing the race.
location: The square on the south side of the Haimen Bridge in Tanggu, Binhai New Area, Tianjin (the course is an out-and-back route along the Hai River)

name: Cool-down and social sharing at the end.
description: After finishing the race, Ye Mingxuan picked up the finisher medal, water, and banana, and took a photo with Zhou Tao in front of the finish backdrop. Then he selected 9 race photos, including 2 group photos, and posted to Moments with the caption 'PB achieved! 2 hours 12 minutes 35 seconds, safely finished the Binhai Half Marathon, back to the grind the day after tomorrow!' along with the pace chart showing an average pace of 6 minutes 16 seconds per kilometer.
location: Square on the south side of Tanggu Haimen Bridge, Binhai New Area, Tianjin

name: Return trip and recovery along the way
description: After saying goodbye to Zhou Tao, Ye Mingxuan took a ride-hailing car back home. Once in the car, he immediately drank a bottle of electrolyte drink and used the ice pack he carried with him to apply cold compresses to his knees and ankles. Leaning back in the seat, he reviewed the key moments of the match and felt the soreness in his body, gathering material for organizing his training notes in the evening.
location: In a ride-hailing car, returning from the square on the south side of Tanggu Haimen Bridge, Binhai New Area, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Post-race recovery and family health discussion.
description: After arriving home, Ye Mingxuan briefly shared the race results with his parents, then did 15 minutes of leg stretching and foam roller relaxation, showered, and changed into dry loungewear. While both parents were in the living room, he formally launched the family health action discussion, showing a chart comparing his weight and body fat decline curves with his father's rising blood pressure line. Combined with his feelings from completing the race, he emphasized the importance of scientific exercise and dietary control. His father expressed willingness to start jogging twice a week from next week, and his mother agreed to control salt intake.
location: Home, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Online purchase of health supplies and lunch recipe discussion
description: Because of his condition after the half marathon, Ye Mingxuan switched to buying health products online. He placed an order on the Hema app: an upper-arm electronic blood pressure monitor, low-sodium salt, an electronic food scale, and a salt-control spoon; with his mother's confirmation, he also added lightly dried kelp and a mushroom soup pack. For lunch, his mother made a low-salt braised pork, stir-fried lettuce, and mixed-grain rice. Ye Mingxuan photographed the dishes, discussed with his mother and refined a one-week low-salt menu, such as winter melon and kelp soup on Monday, mushroom steamed chicken breast on Tuesday, and so on, then put the note on the refrigerator door.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Mandatory midday rest
description: After lunch, feeling noticeably tired, Ye Mingxuan drew the bedroom curtains, set a 30-minute alarm, and lay down to rest. Although he didn't fall fully asleep, the guided relaxation brought his body into a deep rest state. After the alarm went off, he kept his eyes closed for another 10 minutes, then slowly got up and felt much recovered.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Parametric tool bug fix
description: In the study, Ye Mingxuan first made a cup of instant coffee to refresh himself, then began tackling the bug in the parametric tool. In two steps: first, add a parameter range validator to solve the crash on out-of-range values; then, optimize the tolerance algorithm for Boolean operations to fix the small feature loss issue. After completing the code changes, he ran 10 sets of random parameter self-tests, all passed, and the version number was updated to 0.4.
location: Home study room, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Receive community group-buying items and air conditioner repair.
description: After receiving the parcel locker notification, Ye Mingxuan went downstairs to pick up his Hema order and placed the electronic blood pressure monitor and other items on the living room coffee table. Then the air conditioner repair technician arrived and confirmed it was a start capacitor problem. After replacing the capacitor, cooling returned to normal, and he also cleaned the outdoor unit's heat exchanger fins. Ye Mingxuan paid the 300 yuan repair fee via WeChat Pay, noted the repair time and cost in the family repair log, and took a photo of the new capacitor model for reference.
location: Home, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: 3D printing design showcase and adjustment coaching plan
description: Ye Mingxuan invited his father to the study and showed him the fishing tackle accessory bracket he designed in Fusion 360, from sketching and dimensional constraints to 3D modeling, and demonstrated the slicing preview with Cura. His father showed strong interest. Afterwards, based on today's half-marathon experience, the two revised the accompanying running plan: starting from next Saturday, Ye Mingxuan will combine the first 10 km of his long-distance aerobic run with the subsequent 3-5 km slow jog to accompany his father. The location will be the Nanyun River Greenway, and his father agreed to adapt first with brisk walking next week.
location: Home study room, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: For dinner, my mother followed the new recipe and made steamed chicken breast with mushrooms and multigrain rice. The whole family tasted it, and my father praised it as light but delicious. At the table, Ye Mingxuan shared fun stories from the marathon and the scenery along the course, and the three chatted while eating in a harmonious atmosphere.
location: Dining room at home, Building 2, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Online discussion of ancient coins.
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan had a WeChat video call with Teacher Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an. Focusing on several images of Hubu Guangxu Yuanbao coins, they checked reference books and discussed two points of doubt in depth: 'Manchu script calligraphy differences' and 'dragon-eye die features.' They agreed that next time Teacher Zhao would put together comparison images and they would discuss it further.
location: Home study room, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cared for plants and tested scripts.
description: Ye Mingxuan went to the south balcony and checked the succulent sunshade net and automatic watering system. He manually triggered the control script on his phone to test the software logic, confirming that the relay switched on normally and the sprinkler system worked properly. Then he checked each pot of succulents and moved one that was slightly leggy to a spot with weaker light.
location: South balcony at home, Building 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Digital organization and review

While washing up, I heard my mother rummaging around in the kitchen. I went to the living room and saw her checking the zongzi ingredients in front of the storage cabinet. Mom said she needed to make sure there were enough ingredients for tomorrow's Dragon Boat Festival. Ye Mingxuan reminded her not to buy too much glutinous rice and suggested making savory zongzi with lean meat. He decided to bring the electric bike sun-protection gloves and put a light jacket at his workstation to cope with the heat and air conditioning. He changed into a light blue work shirt and dark casual pants, checked that the sun-protection gloves were in his commuter bag, and added a bottle of boiled water. At 7:20 he locked the door, walked to the e-bike shed downstairs, put on his helmet and gloves, started the e-bike, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 7, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the area downstairs

name: During commute
description: Riding an electric bike, I headed east along Zhongbei Avenue, then via Haitian South-North Street to Haitai Development Sixth Road. Traffic increased along the way, and the 34-degree weather was already showing its power. In the heat of the sun, I was glad I had worn sunscreen gloves. While waiting at a red light, I saw colleague Li Xiang send a message in the project group suggesting a short afternoon meeting to discuss the boundary conditions of the simulation report. Ye Mingxuan quickly replied “1” to acknowledge.
location: From Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai North-South Avenue, to Haitai Development 6th Road.

name: Worked in the morning.
description: At 8:15, he arrived at the office on the 5th floor of Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, locked his e-bike, and swiped in. At his workstation, he turned on his computer, set yesterday's half marathon medal photo as the wallpaper, got some water, then opened SolidWorks, brought up the key component design sketch, and planned the 3D modeling steps. Colleague Zhou Tao arrived; they nodded to each other and worked separately. At 9:00, he formally started modeling. The component was an adjustable locking mechanism. Starting from the reference plane, he performed operations such as extrude, cut, revolve, and chamfer, checking dimensions and fits carefully at every step. Senior engineer Gao Zhiyuan passed by, stopped to watch, and praised his “good approach”, which greatly encouraged Ye Mingxuan. At 11:30, the first draft of the model was completed and saved as version V0.1. He also briefly recorded the working approach and problems encountered in the internal project document. Then he stretched his neck and waited for lunch break.
location: Office on the 5th Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and socializing
description: At noon, together with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, went to Xianggubao Braised Chicken Rice (Xiqing Branch) near the company for lunch. On the way, Li Xiang confirmed that the meeting was at 2 p.m., and Ye Mingxuan shared his approach to solving the morning's modeling difficulties. The three chatted over braised chicken, and the topic shifted from work to the next day's Dragon Boat Festival plans: Zhou Tao planned to visit Ji County, while Li Xiang intended to rest at home. After returning to the office at 12:35, he made a cup of green tea, opened the mechanical design technology forum, and searched for "flexible fixtures 2025 new research." He found a cutting-edge article from early June, browsed the abstract and core principles, then saved the link and key points to the group reference folder. At 13:00, he put down his phone, put on an eye mask, and took a half-hour nap at his desk to recharge.
location: Xianggubao Braised Chicken Rice (Xiqing Branch) in Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, Huayuan Industrial Zone, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the office on the 5th floor of Block A, Haitai Development Office Building.

name: Afternoon work
description: At 13:30 I woke up, washed my face, and threw myself into work with renewed energy. I focused on proofreading the part drawings completed last Friday. Wearing my glasses, I carefully checked the dimensional tolerances and geometric tolerances on the printed drawings, and marked two positioning dimensions that needed slight adjustments with a red pen. At 14:00 I had a short meeting with Li Xiang in the rest area next to the workstation. Li Xiang showed the simulation preliminary results; the temperature field distribution from the thermal stress analysis deviated from the expected working environment of the component designed by Ye Mingxuan. After analyzing it, Ye Mingxuan found that the mesh generation strategy had caused localized heat accumulation, and suggested refining the mesh in key heat-dissipation areas and adjusting the empirical values of the convective heat transfer coefficient. Li Xiang suddenly saw the light and immediately went back to rerun the simulation. After the meeting, Ye Mingxuan modified the dimensions in CAD according to the proofreading marks, exported and checked the file, then uploaded the final version to the PDM system, handled a few project emails, and prepared a handover memo for the Dragon Boat Festival holiday. At 16:30 he finished work, tidied his desk, wiped the keyboard and mouse with alcohol wipes, then sent a WeChat message to his collecting friend Teacher Zhao Jianguo saying that the final part of his notes would be posted tonight. Teacher Zhao replied that he would await the good news.
location: Office on the 5th floor and rest area on the 2nd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

After opening the door, quickly opened the windows in all rooms to ventilate; there was still a faint smell of wood panels inside. Took out the portable formaldehyde detector and measured in the living room and master bedroom: the master bedroom reading dropped from 0.10 mg/m the previous week to 0.09 mg/m, and the living room was 0.11 mg/m. Satisfied, he took photos with his phone and recorded the data in his notebook. Then he checked the pothos on the windowsill, found the potting soil a bit dry, and used a filled spray bottle to water it evenly. At about 17:50, he closed all the windows, locked the door, and left.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 8, Xizhuyuan Community, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
