Dinner included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato scrambled eggs, and braised pork ribs. My mother Wang Xiulan mentioned that she had gone to the supermarket in the afternoon to restock glutinous rice, candied dates, and red bean paste filling, planning to make zongzi together early the next morning. My father was responsible for cutting cotton string. Ye Mingxuan again suggested making savory zongzi with lean meat, and his mother agreed to make two kinds of filling. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table, then accompanied his parents in the living room to watch the local news and talked about the arrangements for visiting grandma's house for Dragon Boat Festival the next day.

The program ran automatically, performing RGB color distribution statistics on designated areas of each photo, and generating corrosion distribution heatmaps and color proportion pie charts. Ye Mingxuan captured these, saved them, and inserted them into the corresponding positions of the Word document 'Tianjin Modern Machine-Made Coin Anti-Counterfeiting and Variety Notes' as auxiliary identification evidence. After reading through the full text, he corrected two typos and adjusted the layout, then exported it as PDF. At 19:50 he sent it via WeChat to Mr. Zhao Jianguo with a message asking him to do the final review of the text and data.
location: Study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Programming and debugging
description: After sending the note, he stood up, stretched, and loosened his shoulders and wrists. He then opened the development environment and entered the parametric tool project. Following the reproduction steps in his memory, he quickly located the 'Entity Generation' module and checked the code line by line. He found that a variable name spelling error in the input parameter passing chain of a custom function prevented the data from being mapped correctly. After fixing it, he optimized the redundant judgment logic. He recompiled and ran the unit tests; all parameters were passed correctly, and the tool successfully generated the preset part model. He also randomly changed several sets of parameters and ran two more rounds, all of which were normal. He marked the fixed version as 0.4.1 and recorded the bug symptoms, cause, and solution in detail in the technical log.
location: Study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

After scanning internal emails and confirming nothing urgent, he made a cup of hot tea and got ready to work.

description: He focused on completing the day's core tasks. He opened SolidWorks and, following the design standards and manual provided by Senior Engineer Gao, meticulously built 3D models of the fixture body and two key clamping components. He carefully checked the constraint relationships of each sketch to ensure they conformed to the design intent. During the initial assembly check, he found a minor interference and marked it with the measurement tool, planning to revise it in the afternoon. When Gao Zhiyuan passed by, Ye Mingxuan proactively reported the phased progress and received recognition.

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: Hearing the voices of colleagues in the hallway, he saved his work files, locked the screen, and went downstairs. He met up with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, and the three walked to the newly opened "Haoweiduo" Chinese fast-food restaurant in the business park. After sitting down with their trays, Zhou Tao excitedly said that for the weekend team-building bonfire party he had practiced a song called "Chengdu" and was only missing a good guitar; Li Xiang said he could now finish a speedcubing solve in under 20 seconds and was ready to show off. Ye Mingxuan said he could bring a complex mortise-and-tenon Luban lock he had made to share, and everyone became even more interested.

It showed that the package had arrived at the city's sorting center and was expected to be delivered tomorrow, which put his mind at ease.

name: Afternoon work and communication

I first spent half an hour dealing with the model interference issue I had flagged in the morning, modifying the size of one of the clamping parts and reassembling to check that everything was correct. Around 3 p.m., I proactively walked over to Li Xiang's workstation. The two of us quickly went over the simulation parameter details for next Monday's handover using a whiteboard, clarifying the loading points and constraint conditions. The communication was very efficient.

name: Wrapping up and preparing to leave work
description: Back at his seat, he began organizing the day's work results. He named and archived the model files from the morning and the revised versions from the afternoon according to requirements, wrote the day's work log, and listed next week's to-do items. Half an hour before leaving work, he checked his personal email and sent a brief daily work report to Gao Zhiyuan.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

description: Left work on time and rode my electric bike home; the sunset along the way was beautiful. After getting home, I quickly changed into running shorts, a quick-dry T-shirt, and running shoes, and put on my sports watch and earphones. I told my mother I was going for a run and headed out.

Her overall pace was steady at around 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, with her heart rate controlled between 130 and 135. She stopped near the park after running exactly 3 kilometers. On the sidewalk, she carefully completed a full set of stretching exercises, including lunge stretches and calf stretches, and felt relaxed both physically and mentally.
location: Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin (section from Huating International Community to Lüshuiyuan Park) and Lüshuiyuan Park (180 m west of the intersection of Ziyang Road and Luoping Road)

At dinner, the family sat around the table, and Ye Mingxuan asked his parents what they wanted to eat on the weekend. His mother said she wanted a light winter melon meatball soup, and his father wanted to see him make sweet and sour pork ribs again. He readily agreed, then took out the small whiteboard in the living room and wrote down the recipes, the shopping list (winter melon, ground pork, pork ribs, rock sugar, ginger, etc.), and the weekend activity plan (taking his mother to the nearby small park for fresh air on Saturday morning and watching a competitive variety show with his father in the afternoon).

By writing code, he generated a clear bar chart of categorized expenses and found that the "dining" and "health care" spending were noticeably high, so he noted down beside it the plan to "reduce takeout in the second half of the year and add a family healthy food budget."

He took out the sunset photo of Zhongbei Avenue taken during the run and posted it on WeChat Moments: 'On an evening recovery run, watching the sunset scatter across the road I usually take to and from work, it feels great.' Then he opened the 'Coin Paradise' forum, browsed new posts on modern and ancient coinage, and left a comment under an identification post about the 'Da Qing copper coin'.

He flipped through it for ten minutes or so; the content was a little dry but helped him sleep. When he felt drowsy, he turned off the light, adjusted his sleeping position, and soon fell into a sound sleep. Today's weight remained at 72.1 kg.

After the run, he recorded the workout data on the bank of the river using Keep and stretched. Then they walked home, took a warm shower, and changed into clean loungewear.

description: After the lunch break, he opened his laptop and used Excel to carefully reconcile the total household expenses for June, focusing on dining and medical rehabilitation costs. Stop staying cooped up!' I immediately replied with an animated sticker saying 'Go then, who's scared!' Sitting on the edge of the bed, he said, "Mom, let's talk about that antique coin another time. With some spare cash at home for emergencies, I won't feel uneasy. Your health is more important than anything; we can always save more money." His mother's eyes grew moist, and she held his hand and said, "Silly child, I understand. Don't let me hold you back." Back in the study, he transferred the 2,000 yuan originally planned for collecting into the time deposit account of the family emergency fund, simultaneously updated the Python finance script, and the total emergency fund increased to 32,000 yuan.

After washing up, he used his notebook to record today's new house data, financial decisions, and key matters for next week. Before bed, he set the 6:30 alarm for tomorrow morning, reflected on the day's experiences, and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.

Then, in his own bedroom, he checked the contents of his backpack: sunscreen, a mirrorless camera, a power bank, a small mortise-and-tenon wood sample in a flannel bag, and three silver dollars (including one dragon dollar from the General Mint, one Xuantong Year 3 coin, and one Sun Yat-sen founding commemorative coin with a small head). location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

While eating, Ye Mingxuan chatted with his parents Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiufang about the day's team-building plans, telling them he would go hiking and have a bonfire in the Jizhou mountain area and expected to be back around 8 or 9 p.m. His father told him to be safe and not show off, while his mother reminded him to drink less alcohol and more water. After finishing, Ye Mingxuan cleared the dishes on his own initiative and once again reminded his mother to rest more and walk less during the day.

name: Gather at the company and board the bus for departure

He saw colleague Li Xiang sitting by the window on the coach waving, and Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan and project manager Wang Peng talking at the front. Once everyone was present, the coach departed on time at 8:30 for Jizhou.

description: After the bus got onto the Tianjin-Jizhou Expressway, the atmosphere became lively. Ye Mingxuan sat with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang. They first talked about the Python data visualization script Li Xiang shared yesterday, and Ye Mingxuan promised to discuss the implementation logic next week. Then Zhou Tao talked about his experience at the Jizhou karst cave, and Ye Mingxuan shared his preliminary plan for a self-driving trip around Qinghai Lake (route, vehicle model, budget). Li Xiang said he was interested in joining. Along the way, project manager Wang Peng handed out water to everyone, and Ye Mingxuan planned to proactively talk to him during the hike.

name: Hiking in the mountains and having an icebreaker chat with the project manager.
description: After the hike began, Ye Mingxuan deliberately slowed down to wait for Wang Peng to catch up, and the two walked side by side in the middle of the group. At first there was some awkwardness due to previous project disagreements. Wang Peng took the initiative to speak, offered him water, and talked about the driving feel of his new SUV. Ye Mingxuan then steered the conversation from vehicle performance to self-driving gear, bringing up the plan to circle Qinghai Lake. Wang Peng shared his experience of cycling the Sichuan-Tibet line in his youth, expressed appreciation for Ye Mingxuan's steady and methodical planning, and revealed that the senior engineer had privately praised his significant progress. The old friction dissolved as they walked and talked.

name: Farmhouse team lunch
description: After hiking, took the scenic area shuttle to the farmhouse restaurant “Fengying Farmyard.” Under the awning in the yard at a large round table, Ye Mingxuan sat with colleagues including Wang Peng, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang, enjoying authentic farm dishes such as stewed free-range chicken, braised reservoir fish, stir-fried eggs with wild vegetables, and steamed pumpkin. During the meal, Zhou Tao recounted embarrassing stories from the department team-building events, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Baichang Road, Jizhou District, Tianjin, China (Xuegang Mountain Lodge Farmhouse)

He took out a mortise-and-tenon wood sample to demonstrate assembly and disassembly, explaining the interlocking principle of tenons and mortises. Wang Peng was also attracted and praised it. Then he showed three silver dollars, teaching everyone to identify authenticity by checking the edge serrations and listening to the striking sound, and explained the varieties and prices, attracting quite a few colleagues to watch.

name: Move to the bonfire party venue and capture the sunset glow.

Ye Mingxuan was a bit reserved during the games, and his clumsy movements drew good-natured laughter. But during the free exchange session, he took out mortise-and-tenon wood samples and silver coins and became the center of attention; even the HR director came over to look. Once he found his comfort zone, his smile was confident.

Ye Mingxuan, Wang Peng, and Li Xiang continued discussing the difficulties of complex surface machining in the project. Wang Peng gave process suggestions, Li Xiang added the possibility of finite element simulation, and they agreed to hold a short technical meeting during Monday's lunch break.

name: Ride an electric bike home

His mother felt sorry he came home so late, and Ye Mingxuan comforted her with a smile.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

He watched instructional videos and TED talks, gaining a preliminary understanding of the 'accept and continue' principle and taking notes. Then he created a new document to record the key technical points on surface machining and the new ideas from today's exchanges with Wang Peng and Li Xiang as notes for next week.

I reviewed the day's experiences, especially breaking the ice with Wang Peng and the awkwardness at the bonfire party, and imagined what the improv theater session next Saturday would be like, feeling both nervous and excited. Once in bed, I turned off the light and tried to calm myself down and fall asleep.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Falling asleep
description: Carrying fond memories of today and looking forward to next week, Ye Mingxuan gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Getting up, morning care, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 6:10 sharp. He turned over and got out of bed. First he went to his mother's room and helped her apply a gel ice pack to her ankle. It hurt a little less now, and she said she had slept well last night. Only after applying ointment and wrapping her ankle with an elastic bandage did he feel relieved enough to go wash up. Breakfast was the leftover steamed buns from yesterday's team-building event that his mother had reheated, served with millet porridge. Listening to the cicadas outside, he felt the new day had started off steadily.

Wearing earphones, I listened to a podcast on Mechanical Design; it was discussing thermal error compensation for fixtures, which was exactly the bottleneck I hit last week. I was so absorbed that I almost missed the intersection. I rode from Huating International Community to Haitai Development Office Building.

I replied with a “unity is strength” sticker. At 8:10, Li Xiang came over with his laptop, and we looked at last week’s simulation results and repeatedly simulated the stroke and force of the fixture clamping mechanism in SolidWorks. We confirmed the tolerances for three key dimensions, updated the model, and I felt a weight lifted off my mind.

While waiting for the food, Zhou Tao brought up the mortise-and-tenon craftsmanship I had shown during the team-building activity. Li Xiang became interested and said he wanted to visit the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop on the weekend. I agreed right away. It happened that Master Qian had just developed a new dovetail joint structure, so I could take them along to try it.

Master Zhang said he was free at 9 a.m. on July 16, so I immediately noted in my phone memo: "July 16, 9:00, whole-house water and electrical inspection at Xiqing Yuan (Master Zhang)."

The senior engineer basically approved it, but pointed out with the drawings in hand that the verification of two fit tolerances was not rigorous enough, saying, “Young man, the rigor of a drawing is the lifeline of a product.” Wang Peng asked about the follow-up milestones from the project schedule perspective, and I gave a clear commitment to complete all revisions by July 15.

He packaged the updated model and documents and sent them to himself on WeChat for easy review at home.
