description: Left work on time at 17:30, rode my electric scooter through the intersection and headed toward Zhongbei Town. Passing a fruit shop, I remembered I hadn't bought fruit last night, so I stopped and bought a box of blueberries and a bag of bananas, planning to replenish energy after working out.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Limei Fitness Center, B1, NCC New City Center, No. 3, Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Recovery personal training session.
description: At 18:00 I arrived at the gym, changed into workout clothes, and Coach Wang Jian was already waiting there. He said, "Yesterday's team building was a whole day of walking mountain trails, so today we won't do heavy weights; let's start with recovery core training." Light-loaded planks, bird-dog, Swiss ball balance... Throughout the session the coach kept reminding me to "control your breathing, don't rush into exerting force." After finishing hip flexibility work, I felt much more relaxed, and the soreness was not as strong.
location: Limei Fitness Center, B1, NCC New City Center, No. 3 Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return home for a shower and family dinner
description: After working out, I biked home and arrived at 19:15. I took a shower and changed into loungewear. My parents had already cooked: tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried lettuce, and leftover braised pork from yesterday. At the dinner table, my mom asked if work went well today. I shared that the review meeting went smoothly and talked about my progress on the fixture design. My dad asked a few questions about the new house and mentioned that the drain pipes need to be checked.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 17, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening ankle care
description: After dinner, as usual, I went to my mother's room. I washed the area with warm water, disinfected it with povidone-iodine, applied ointment, and then gently wrapped it with an elastic bandage. I also carefully checked the swelling in her ankle; it had gone down a little more than yesterday. I reminded her to ice it once more tomorrow morning. Mother smiled and said, "With you taking care of me, I feel much more at ease."
location: Mother's bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 17, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Video call with Wu Bin to detail the Northwest road trip plan
description: At 8:00 p.m. sharp, Wu Bin sent a video invitation on time. The two of us chatted for a full two and a half hours, upgrading the originally vague dream of cycling around Qinghai Lake into a National Day execution plan for the 'Northwest Small Loop'. Departing from Tianjin on the afternoon of September 30, detouring through Shijiazhuang and Taiyuan, circling the lake at Xining, then returning via Lanzhou and Xi'an, the total distance was about 3,200 kilometers. I opened Excel, created an itinerary Gantt chart on the spot, and marked daily mileage, backup accommodation points, and a vehicle inspection checklist. The per-person budget was initially estimated at around 4,000 yuan, and I shared the file with him. Finally, Wu Bin laughed and said, 'Old Ye, your Excel is more detailed than my map.'
location: Study room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 17, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening tidying and financial planning
description: After the video call, I opened my personal Python financial script and skillfully used Pandas to add a new column called "Road Trip Fund" in the expense categories, setting a rule to automatically transfer 2,000 yuan each month. Then I took out my phone, entered today's blueberry and banana expenses into the electronic ledger, checked the overall spending progress for the month, and found that dining expenses were a bit over budget—I need to be more frugal.
location: Study room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 17, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: I lay in bed, tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep, my mind full of the curves of the lakeside road and the singing in the car. I opened the 'Ancient Coin Garden' forum, browsed a few new posts, and saw a discussion about a signed Yuan Shikai silver dollar from the third year of the Republic of China. I followed the replies and learned some identification points. Gradually I felt sleepy, set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, and prepared to sleep. Although I closed my eyes, the road-trip scenes I had just talked about with Wu Bin were still swirling in my mind, and the excitement kept sleep at bay. After tossing and turning for about half an hour, I finally slowly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 17, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and saying goodbye
description: The alarm went off right on time. After washing up briefly, Ye Mingxuan first checked his mother Wang Xiufang's ankle. She said the pain had lessened and the swelling had subsided. Ye Mingxuan skillfully prepared an ice pack and applied cold therapy to his mother's ankle for 15 minutes in the morning to consolidate the swelling reduction. After applying it, he helped her elevate her leg and told her to rest a while longer. Mother had already prepared breakfast: two pork and scallion buns, a bowl of millet porridge, and yogurt mixed with fruit salad. Father Ye Jianguo was reading a newspaper nearby. While eating, Ye Mingxuan talked about the weather forecast and reminded his father that there might be rain in the afternoon and to remember to take an umbrella when going out. After the meal, Ye Mingxuan organized his backpack, confirming that the drawing drafts, raincoat, gym clothes, and power bank were all in place. Before leaving, he squatted down to help his mother check whether the elastic bandage was loose, and told her that she could walk a few slow steps in the living room today, but she must hold onto the wall or a chair and not rush. Mother smiled and agreed.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute and preparations for starting work
description: The sky was overcast. Ye Mingxuan got on his electric scooter and set out from Huating International Community, riding along the familiar route toward the company. On the way, he stopped at the Lawson convenience store at the community entrance to buy an iced Americano to stay alert for the morning's focused work. After arriving at the 4th floor of Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, he clocked in and went to his workstation. He spread out the drawing drafts he had organized the day before, circled the two tolerance positions Senior Engineer Gao had pointed out with a red pen, then opened AutoCAD 2024, loaded the fixture model source file, and prepared to start the day's core drawing task.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Draw a 2D engineering drawing of the fixture.
description: Ye Mingxuan devoted all his energy to revising the 2D engineering drawings. First he dealt with two tolerances: the hole diameter tolerance of the locating pin hole was changed from H7 to the more precise H6, and the flatness of the mounting base surface was tightened from 0.05 mm to 0.02 mm, referring to the MechLib manual. After modifying the dimensions, he strictly followed the national standard, marked datum symbols A and B for geometric tolerances, and added surface roughness values to each surface one by one. Finally, in the technical notes column, he added requirements such as "unspecified chamfers C0.5" and "hardness HRC 40-45 after heat treatment." At around 11:00, he sent the completed PDF version to himself and Senior Engineer Gao for final proofreading.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday cross-check and discussion
description: Senior Engineer Gao passed by the workstation, and Ye Mingxuan called him over to show him the drawing on the tablet. Gao leaned in and carefully examined the revised tolerances and datum symbols, then nodded approvingly: "Well, the changes are spot on. Marking datum A this way is fine. Submit it for review this afternoon." With Gao's approval, Ye Mingxuan felt much more at ease.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and socializing with colleagues
description: Ye Mingxuan got on his electric scooter and took his colleague Li Xiang along. They reached the Lanzhou beef noodle restaurant near the company in five minutes. He ordered a bowl of beef noodles with extra meat, and Li Xiang ordered fried sliced noodles. While eating, they chatted about the simulation model Li Xiang had made yesterday, and Ye Mingxuan asked him a few questions about setting boundary conditions. After finishing, they rode back to the company.
location: Lanzhou Beef Noodles, Block B, Building 1, No. 15 Rongyuan Road, Huayuan Industrial Zone, Tianjin

name: Lunchtime socializing (with Zhou Tao)
description: After returning to the company, Ye Mingxuan went to the break room to get some water and ran into his colleague Zhou Tao. Zhou Tao asked how he felt after yesterday's team-building. Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he had signed up for an improv theater workshop over the weekend and found it quite interesting. Zhou Tao was very interested. Ye Mingxuan immediately took out his phone, sent him the registration link, and said, "Engineer Zhou, didn't you say during the last team-building that you wanted to try something new? Take a look at this—want to try it together?"
location: Tea room, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: Considering he had gone to bed late last night, Ye Mingxuan set a 15-minute alarm, put on an eye mask, and rested with his eyes closed at his workstation to briefly recover his energy.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drawing refinement and archiving
description: After waking from his lunch break, Ye Mingxuan felt much better. He opened the drawings again and made corrections one by one, based on the senior engineer's comments and the minor issues he had found during his own proofreading (one overlapping dimension line and one dimension number with a font size that was too small). After confirming everything was correct, he organized the DWG and PDF source files, saved them into the project folder, and submitted the review workflow for "Fixture Body Part Drawing - Version V2.0" in the PLM system, completing the engineering drawing wrap-up.
location: 4th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting to the gym after work
description: After finishing work, Ye Mingxuan cleaned up his desk and changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts. It was getting dark outside, but it hadn't rained yet. He picked up his backpack, got on his electric scooter, and rode from the Haitai Development Office Building along Fukang Road and Zhongbei Avenue for about 20 minutes to the Aikeshi International Fitness Chain in Zhongbei Town.
location: Aikeshi International Fitness Chain (Zhongbei Branch), No. 1 Xingguang Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Gym strength training.
description: After arriving at the gym, Ye Mingxuan saw the trainer Wang Jian instructing another trainee, so he did several sets of dynamic stretches and shoulder activation exercises in the corner. When Coach Wang was free, he arranged today's training plan: 1. Barbell bench press (4 sets x 10 reps); 2. Bent-over barbell row (4 sets x 10 reps); 3. Seated machine shoulder press (3 sets x 12 reps); 4. Core superset: plank (3 sets x 45 seconds) + Russian twists (3 sets x 20 reps). Ye Mingxuan completed all the exercises as required, sweating profusely during the training and feeling that the fatigue from staying up late was thoroughly released. After finishing, he did 10 minutes of static stretching.
location: Aikeshi International Fitness Chain (Zhongbei Branch), No. 1 Xingguang Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Stopped to shop on the way.
description: After leaving the gym, the sky had become completely overcast and a few sporadic raindrops began to fall. Ye Mingxuan got on his bike and, on the way, turned into the nearby Wumart supermarket. He bought a tray of the old-fashioned yogurt his mother liked, and also picked out a few bananas and a box of fresh blueberries. When checking out, he caught sight of the shower gel on the promotional shelf by the entrance; the one at home was almost used up, so he grabbed a bottle.
location: Wumart Supermarket (Zhongbei Store), Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Go home in the rain
description: Just as he left the supermarket, the rain got heavier. Ye Mingxuan quickly put on the raincoat from the trunk and rode carefully through the drizzle. As the streetlights came on and the rain soaked the road, he was more cautious than usual and finally returned safely to Huating International Community.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening care and encouraging walking.
description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan shook his wet hair and went to see his mother first. His mother, Wang Xiufang, was sitting on the sofa watching TV and was very happy to see her son back. Ye Mingxuan checked her ankle and found that the swelling had basically subsided, and it no longer hurt much when pressed. At his mother's request, he held her elbows with both hands to help her stand up from the sofa, and then in the living room she walked from the sofa armrest to the TV cabinet and back. She walked very slowly, but every step was steady. Although she was slightly unsteady, she didn't cry out in pain. Ye Mingxuan encouraged her, 'Mom, you walked really well today! At this rate, you can go grocery shopping by yourself on Sunday!' After she finished two laps, he helped her sit down and applied a hot towel to her for 15 minutes to promote blood circulation.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Father Ye Jianguo had already reheated the dishes. Dinner was braised hairtail, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg soup. While eating, Ye Mingxuan shared the day's work progress with his parents, saying the senior engineer praised the revised drawings. His mother also happily talked about her recovery. After dinner, the family snuggled on the sofa watching CCTV's weather forecast and news. Ye Mingxuan cut a plate of blueberries and bananas, and the family shared them, enjoying a warm family moment.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Caring for father's daily life
description: The news mentioned that a scam gang has recently committed crimes under the name of "pension investment". Seeing that his father seemed somewhat concerned, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to chat with him and reminded him that if he received unfamiliar links or transfer requests on his phone, he must discuss with family members first. His father nodded and said "I know".
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Secretly planning a phone stand as a gift
description: After his parents returned to their room, Ye Mingxuan went to the study alone, locked the door, and turned on the desk lamp. From under the bed, he took out his treasured wood storage box and pulled out the piece of cherry wood he had found at Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop last week. He ran his fingers over its fine grain — it felt great. He took out a pencil and an A4 sheet of paper and began sketching a tilted phone stand with a groove and an adjustable support rod. Considering his mother’s need to scroll Douyin and watch videos on her phone, he designed two support angles. On the base, he neatly wrote the phrase “Mom, keep it up” in imitation Song typeface, planning to carve it out later with a chisel.
location: Study, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Financial confirmation.
description: After finishing the sketch, Ye Mingxuan opened the mobile banking app and checked whether the automatic transfer of the monthly 2,000 yuan "road trip fund" set up yesterday had been successfully deducted. Seeing the "Transaction Successful" prompt, he closed the app with satisfaction.
location: Study, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After washing up, Ye Mingxuan used a foam roller to deeply relax the chest and back muscles he had trained that day. Lying in bed, he habitually opened the ancient coin collecting forum to see whether Teacher Zhao Jianguo had posted anything new, and browsed for five or six minutes. Then he set the alarm for 6:15 the next day and turned off the light and went to sleep contentedly, closing the curtain on a busy and warm day as drowsiness set in.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Early-morning interval running training and household chores.
description: 05:45 got up, washed up briefly, and drank warm water. At 5:55, I put on running shoes and walked from the north gate of Huating International Community to Jinxi Sports Park. Arrived at the park track at 6:05, warmed up for 5 minutes, and started interval running training at 6:10: 8 sets of 400 meters at a pace of 4 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, with 1 minute of slow walking recovery between sets, using Keep to record pace and heart rate. After finishing, I stretched, sent the data screenshot to my running buddy Xiao Chen, and discussed breathing rhythm by voice message. At 7:00 I finished running and walked home, arriving at 7:10. After taking a shower, I helped my mother Wang Xiufang with morning care, checked the swelling in her ankle, and gently massaged it with massage oil for 5 minutes. Then I had breakfast myself: two boiled eggs, a bowl of millet porridge, and a small dish of pickled vegetables.
location: Jinxi Sports Park, intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Xingguang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting to work
description: At 7:40 he changed into work clothes, put on a helmet, and rode his electric bike from Huating International Community along Zhongbei Avenue and the Outer Ring Road. At 7:55 he stopped at the Fuzhilin Pharmacy and bought Band-Aids and Yunnan Baiyao aerosol spray. At 8:20 he arrived at Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., parked the electric bike in the charging area to charge, swiped his employee card to enter the Haitai Development office building, met his colleague Li Xiang by the elevator, exchanged a brief greeting, and went upstairs together.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Refining details of the company's fixture model
description: At 8:30, he arrived at his workstation, brewed a cup of green tea, and opened the computer and SolidWorks. Based on the feedback that Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan gave at yesterday's preparatory meeting, he focused on checking two key fit tolerances, adjusted parameters on the model, and recorded the comparison results. At 10:00, Senior Engineer Gao passed by and asked about progress. Ye Mingxuan verbally reported the revision plan and received approval. At 11:30, he initially completed the tolerance check, added process chamfers, and resolved a potential assembly interference issue. He saved the modified model and prepared for the overall inspection in the afternoon.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and relaxation
description: At 12:00, colleague Zhou Tao came to call him for lunch. The two walked 8 minutes to their usual malatang restaurant in Huayuan Science Park. Ye Mingxuan chose vegetables, mushrooms, and beef slices, and while eating, chatted with Zhou Tao about taking his parents to see the new house in the afternoon. Zhou Tao teased that this was a major life event and asked about his choice of curtain colors. They finished eating at 12:45 and walked back to the company together.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wrapping up work and preparing to leave early
description: At 13:00 returned to his workstation and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes. At 13:20 woke up, opened the model he had finished checking in the morning, organized all the changes into a brief modification log, and updated it in the PLM system. At 14:00 checked the assembly again and confirmed there were no new interferences. At 15:00 saved the file and recorded progress in the work log. At 15:20 sent a message on the instant messaging software to project manager Wang Peng, requesting to leave work early at 16:00 because he needed to pick up his parents to see the new house. Wang Peng replied with approval.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Pick up my parents and head to the new house.
description: At 15:40, he packed up his personal belongings, shut down the computer, and left the company by electric bike. At 16:20, he arrived home; his father Ye Jianguo had prepared the cane, and his mother was in high spirits. After a short 5-minute rest, the family of three called a ride-hailing car at the entrance of the residential complex. At 16:40, they got in the car, drove along Zhongbei Avenue and Xinjin Second Branch Road, and arrived at the entrance of Vanke Xihuafu Residential Complex at 16:49, 9 minutes later. Ye Mingxuan helped his mother and swiped a card to enter the complex.
location: Vanke Xihuafu, Xinjin Erzhi Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Visit the new house, formaldehyde testing and soft furnishing discussion
description: At 17:35, Ye Mingxuan opened the door and immediately opened all the windows for ventilation. Using a portable formaldehyde detector, he measured the living room, master bedroom, and second bedroom; the readings all showed safe (0.03 mg/m³). He then gave his parents a room-by-room tour. At the large floor-to-ceiling window in the living room, his mother repeatedly said how bright it was, and discussed curtain colors with his father: she liked light gray, while his father preferred beige. Ye Mingxuan smoothed things over by suggesting a two-tone design, and used his phone to take panoramic and detail photos of each space. In his notes app, he recorded his parents' opinions about the master bedroom bed orientation and the second bedroom wardrobe dimensions. His mother remarked that she had originally thought the community was too remote, but it turned out her son had great taste; Ye Mingxuan was moved.
location: New house, Vanke Xihuafu, Xinjin Second Branch Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Warm dinner, sharing the joy
description: After the visit, the family of three walked five minutes to Old Ma's Noodle Shop at the entrance of the residential complex. Ye Mingxuan ordered a bowl of three-delicacy gravy noodles for his mother, and a bowl of beef noodles for himself and his father. His mother smiled and said that after moving in, she would cook for them every day. Ye Mingxuan felt a warm surge in his heart. Remembering the curtain style his mother liked, he took out his phone, shared a screenshot of his Taobao shopping cart with her, and said he would place the order that weekend for whichever one she liked. His mother smiled even more happily.
location: Old Ma's Noodle House, Xinjin Erzhi Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Took parents home.
description: After dinner at 19:20, Ye Mingxuan called a ride-hailing car and first took his parents safely back to their home in Huating International Community. He arrived home at 19:35, urged his mother to rest early, told her that he had a personal training session in the evening and that they didn't need to wait for him. After settling his parents in, he quickly changed into the sportswear in his gym bag and got ready to head out to the gym.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Heading to the gym
description: At 19:40, I rode an e-bike from home eastward along Zhongbei Avenue for about 10 minutes and arrived at Limei Fitness Center at 19:50. I bought a bottle of sports drink at the entrance and walked briskly into the training area.
location: Limei Fitness Center, at the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanyuan Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal training session at Limei Fitness Center
description: The personal training session started on time at 20:00. Coach Wang Jian led Ye Mingxuan through core stability and hip flexibility training. Core exercises included plank (5 sets of 60 seconds), bird dog (15 reps per side, 3 sets), and glute bridge (15 reps, 3 sets), followed by hip mobility exercises with a resistance band. The training intensity was moderate; he was drenched in sweat but felt great. Before the session ended, the coach guided him through a full stretch and scheduled the next session for Saturday morning.
location: Limei Fitness Center, at the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanyuan Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return home, organize photos, and wash up.
description: Training ended at 21:30, and he rode his e-bike home in 10 minutes. After arriving home at 21:40, he took a shower and washed up, washing away the fatigue. In loungewear, he sat at his desk, opened the photo album on his phone, and carefully looked through the dozen or so photos taken at the new house today. He picked out a few with good lighting and complete angles to send to the renovation company tomorrow for reference. At the same time, he organized the parents' opinions from his notes into a clear, structured memo, adding his own initial ideas about the color-block curtains.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Browsing an ancient coin forum, preparing for bed
description: At 22:30, before going to bed, he scrolled through his phone for a while, opened the ancient coin collecting forum to check new posts, and replied to a fellow collector's question about the 'Hubu Great Qing Copper Coin'. At 22:45 he put down his phone, turned off the desk lamp, thought back on the fulfilling day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wake up, morning care, and breakfast preparation
description: Woke up at 06:10 to the sunlight and the chirping of cicadas outside the window, feeling quite recovered. After getting up, I quietly went into my mother’s room to check her ankle. After confirming there was no redness or swelling, I helped her with 15 minutes of ice therapy and simple passive stretching. Then I washed up, went to the kitchen, reheated the leftover steamed buns and milk from last night, and cut a plate of fruit salad.
location: Room 1202, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Send the new home materials and commute
description: After breakfast, I organized the photos taken last night at the new house and the memo about curtain color combinations on my phone, then sent them to the interior designer's WeChat, leaving a message hoping to see the color samples soon. Then I checked the e-bike battery, put on sunscreen sleeves and a helmet, and left home on the e-bike at 07:25 sharp. Riding along Zhongbei Avenue, I arrived at the company at 07:50, taking about 25 minutes. On the way, I briefly outlined the logical framework of the BOM table.
location: Along the route from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Focused on standard parts selection and organizing the BOM draft.
description: Arrived at the workstation at 08:00 and briefly greeted Li Xiang, who had arrived early. After logging into the computer, he turned on professional focus mode. He opened the MISUMI e-catalog and the PDF version of the "Mechanical Design Manual" and began selecting standard parts such as springs, locating pins, and bolts one by one according to the fixture design requirements. He quickly calculated forces and checked dimensions on a paper notebook, entered the confirmed specifications and supplier information into Excel, and organized a BOM draft. At 10:30, Li Xiang came over to discuss a simulation parameter; after a brief exchange, he continued working.
location: Room 609, 6th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: At 12:00, Zhou Tao came over on time to call him for lunch. The two rode electric bikes to their usual malatang shop in Huayuan Science and Technology Park. While waiting in line, they talked about Ye Mingxuan taking his parents to see the new apartment the night before. Zhou Tao was very interested in the color-blocking curtain design and said he would also use it as a reference for his future renovation. After lunch, they bought cold bottled water at the convenience store downstairs and returned to the company.
location: Tiankai Huayuan Science Park Malatang Shop, street-level storefront, No. 1 Tianhua Road, Huayuan Science Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: In the afternoon, refined the BOM and received guidance.
description: At 13:00 he returned to his workstation, took a 15-minute lunch break, and by 13:15 pulled himself together to continue refining the BOM table and organizing the selection rationale. Around 15:30, Engineer Gao Zhiyuan passed by his workstation, and Ye Mingxuan immediately asked him to review it. After carefully flipping through it, Gao Zhiyuan pointed out that the fit tolerance for one pin hole was selected a bit high and suggested changing it to H7/g6, which would be more economical while still ensuring guiding accuracy. Ye Mingxuan immediately took out his calculator, recalculated, confirmed it was correct, revised the table on the spot, and thanked Senior Engineer Gao for his guidance. At 16:00, while getting water, he sent a WeChat message to his fitness trainer Wang Jian to cancel today's afternoon personal training session (because he had arranged an evening run).
location: Room 609, 6th Floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute after work and dinner
description: Left work on time at 17:30, rode an e-bike home, and arrived at 18:00. When he entered the house, his father was helping out in the kitchen and his mother was sitting and picking vegetables. Ye Mingxuan washed his hands, joined the meal preparation, and casually told his parents about how the senior engineer today praised and corrected his BOM. The family of three had dinner at 18:30 on time. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan voluntarily cleaned up the dishes and utensils.
location: Room 1202, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening rest and preparations before departure
description: At 19:00, he watched Xinwen Lianbo with his father and chatted about plans for tomorrow (Friday). At 19:30, he returned to his room, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes, and put on his sports watch. He set tonight's interval running plan (5 km, alternating fast and slow segments) on the Keep app using his phone. He put his keys and a small bottle of water into a waist pack, and while listening to the cicadas outside the window, he used a foam roller to briefly relax the backs of his thighs.
location: Room 1202, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening interval running training
description: At 20:10, he went downstairs and started jogging east along Zhongbei Avenue. Today's goal was interval training with alternating speeds, strictly following the plan: fast segments at a pace of 5:30 per kilometer, slow segments at 6:10 per kilometer, with heart rate controlled between 150 and 165 bpm. Although there was still summer heat, it was much cooler than during the day. Sweat soon soaked his clothes, and his breathing alternated steadily with the pace. He opened Keep to record the route. After completing 5 kilometers in 40 minutes, the pace met expectations, and he felt his cardiorespiratory load was moderate.
location: Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin (Huating International to Xizhuyuan section)

name: Accompany my father on a jog along the South Canal Greenway.
description: At 20:55, he jogged back into the community and happened to meet his father, who was just going out. The father and son exchanged a quick fist bump and walked together for 5 minutes to the South Canal Greenway. His father was in decent shape tonight, so the two jogged 3 kilometers at a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer. While running, his father complained it was too hot recently and he did not feel like running. Ye Mingxuan comforted him: "Dad, sweating in summer is detoxifying. Hang in there—just like when you repaired machine tools back then, you can't fall behind." After completing 3 kilometers on the greenway, they walked home.
location: Greenway of Nanyunhe Park, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and replying to messages about the new house
description: Arrived home at 21:30, sweating all over. Took a shower immediately, and also rinsed his burning feet with cold water. At 22:00, while drying his hair with a towel, he picked up his phone and saw that the interior design company's designer had replied at 9 p.m., had received the photos, but suggested adding two detail shots of the bedroom headboard background wall. Ye Mingxuan replied, 'OK, I'll go take more pictures on the weekend,' and agreed to look at the preliminary sample draft early next week. After that, he turned on the TV and watched a competitive variety show with his parents to relax.
location: Room 1202, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Secretly carving a phone stand
description: At 22:30, after confirming that his mother had gone to sleep and his father had also returned to his room, Ye Mingxuan quietly closed the study door, turned on the desk lamp, and took out the cherry wood piece that had already been roughly carved into shape and the carving knife. He began to concentrate on carving the "auspicious cloud pattern" and the words "Mom, keep going!". Around 23:00, while carving the last stroke of the character "jia", his cutting angle was slightly off, and the carving knife made a gash on his index finger. He drew in a sharp breath, quickly went to the living room to find a band-aid, applied it, and continued despite the pain. By 23:30, he had basically finished carving the characters and patterns, and the piece was beginning to take shape. He cleaned up the wood shavings and knives on the table, covered the stand with a cloth, and put it back in the drawer. Then, with a sense of accomplishment — "my finger hurts, but my heart feels warm" — he washed up and lay down in bed.
location: Study, Room 1202, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning care
description: After the alarm went off, he got up on time. He first went to his mother's room and saw that the swelling in her ankle had clearly subsided and she could get down and walk slowly on her own. Following the doctor's orders, he helped her with morning hot compresses and gentle massage to ensure the joint was fully mobilized. Then he washed up briefly.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: His mother had prepared fried eggs, bread, and milk. His father asked about today’s work schedule, and Ye Mingxuan said he needed to finish the fixture model and go to the new house in the evening to air it out and test for formaldehyde. His father said he would go with him this weekend to measure the curtains. After the meal, Ye Mingxuan checked the red toon wood offcuts and carving knife used for last night’s carving and confirmed they were all put away in the tool bag.
location: Huatong International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin; home dining room

name: Commute to company
description: I set off on my little electric scooter. The summer morning air was fresh. I rode along Zhongbei Avenue, crossed the Outer Ring Road, and turned onto Haitai Development Sixth Road via Fukang Road. The whole trip took about 30 minutes. On the way, I mentally ran through the day's work priorities: by morning I must finish drawing all the process details of the fixture model and generate the engineering drawings.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Concentrate on finishing the model details.
description: After arriving at my workstation, I didn't scroll on my phone and directly opened SolidWorks. Following the pin-hole fit adjustment plan guided by Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan yesterday, I added process features such as chamfers, undercuts, and relief grooves to the model one by one. I focused on parametric modeling, ensuring that every feature corresponds one-to-one with the equipment BOM table.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Engineering drawing annotations and file sending
description: After completing the model, he began refining the engineering drawing. He carefully checked and annotated the geometric tolerances and surface roughness on the three views. After confirming everything was correct, he packaged the STEP-format 3D model and the detailed PDF engineering drawing files before 10:00 and sent them to Li Xiang via the company's internal instant messaging software, with the message: “Engineer Li, I've sent you the model and drawings. Run a preliminary constraint check and see; if there are any problems, come find me anytime.”
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Follow up on drawing review and plan fine-tuning
description: Once free, he opened another drawing sent by Senior Engineer yesterday for a preliminary review. Meanwhile, colleague Zhou Tao came over to discuss the design of a fixture clamping point. The two sketched several options on the screen and finally settled on a locking structure that was both easy to operate and stable.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Preparing for a lunch break and answering calls.
description: Ye Mingxuan was about to go to the cafeteria when his phone rang. It was his college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng. He took the initiative to call and talk about new ideas for his company's new energy vehicle transmission components. Ye Mingxuan decided not to go after all and sat at his workstation to take the call.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: In-depth technical exchange with Zhao Xiaofeng
description: The two chatted for nearly half an hour about the torque distribution logic of the dual-motor coupling scheme. As he listened, Ye Mingxuan drew simple diagrams on sticky notes to analyze it, feeling that Zhao Xiaofeng's idea of “torque-vectoring distribution” was very insightful. He said, “Alright, let me digest this idea. How about we find an evening next week and go to the main Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken restaurant in Zhongbei Town for a good chat? You're paying.” Zhao Xiaofeng laughed and agreed.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and short break.
description: After hanging up, Ye Mingxuan rode his e-bike to the malatang shop near the company that he often visited. He ordered a bowl of malatang and a bottle of Arctic Ocean soda, and while eating, scrolled through woodworking tutorial videos on Bilibili for a while. Then he returned to his workstation, lay on the desk with his eyes closed, and rested for 20 minutes.
location: Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park Malatang Restaurant (290 m east of Huaxing Nanli South Gate)

name: Checking simulation boundary conditions with Li Xiang
description: Just after 1:30, Li Xiang sent a message on the internal messaging software saying he had initially set up a constraint and asked Ye Mingxuan to come over and take a look. Ye Mingxuan put down the standard parts manual and went over. Li Xiang's screen showed the pre-processing interface of the finite element analysis for the fixture assembly. The two of them went over three force diagrams under different working conditions, checking the clamping force magnitudes and constraint point positions one by one. Drawing on his own hands-on experience in the workshop, Ye Mingxuan suggested an adjustment to the constraint point position for one of the working conditions. Li Xiang thought it over and agreed. After confirmation, Li Xiang started the calculation, which was expected to run for a while. Ye Mingxuan told him to send an email once the results came out.
location: Li Xiang's workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Fazhan 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handled other work tasks.
description: After returning to my workstation, I checked whether there were any new emails or tasks in the afternoon. I started organizing the week's work log and next week's work plan. At the same time, I opened the standard parts selection manual to confirm the final specifications for the standard parts in the drawings. In between, I went to check the simulation status on Li Xiang's side; it was still running.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Check simulation results and prepare to leave work.
description: Near the end of the workday, Li Xiang's analysis and computation came to an end. He sent an email with the preliminary results. Ye Mingxuan quickly looked over the stress contour map and displacement map; the data were within the expected range. He replied to the email: 'Received, thanks for the hard work. I'll take a look at the data and we can talk on Monday at work.' Then he packed up his things, disconnected the power, and prepared to leave work.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute to the new house.
description: Got on my little electric scooter and headed to the new house. On a summer evening it was still light, and the breeze was comfortable. Starting from the company, along Haitai South-North Street, then turning onto Haitai South-North Road, crossing the Outer Ring Road, I arrived at Xizhuyuan Residential Community in about 20 minutes.
location: From Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Xizhuyuan Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Ventilation test for the new apartment and measuring curtain dimensions
description: After arriving at the new house, he unlocked the door and opened all the north and south windows fully to create cross-ventilation. He took out the detector, first measured the master bedroom, and it showed 0.02mg/m; the second bedroom and living room were also around 0.03mg/m, lower than last time, which made him feel much more at ease. Then he took out the tape measure and, as his mother requested, carefully measured the length and width of the living room window and the depth of the windowsill, recorded the dimensions in the memo app on his phone, and took photos for the record.
location: New house in Xizhuyuan Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Closed the windows, checked, and headed back.
description: Before closing the window, I checked the water valve and circuit breaker again, confirmed everything was fine, then locked the door. I rode my electric scooter home. Passing the vegetable market on the way, I thought there was enough food at home, so I didn't stop.
location: Xizhuyuan Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: When he got home, his mother had already prepared a meal, including his favorite braised eggplant. At the dinner table, Ye Mingxuan happily reported to his parents that the formaldehyde data were very good, already better than the safety standard, and that he had measured the curtains as well. His mother was very happy and said they could go to IKEA on the weekend or check out some color-blocked styles online. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan rushed to clear the dishes.
location: Huatong International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin; home dining room

name: Family leisure time
description: After helping his mother tidy up, Ye Mingxuan went to the living room to watch a live broadcast of a Chinese chess channel with his father, occasionally commenting on the moves.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Intricately carved phone stand
description: Returning to his own workspace, he took out the red toon wood phone stand that had been roughly shaped yesterday. Wearing a headlamp, he prepared for fine carving. There was still a band-aid on his finger; he carefully avoided his index finger and pinched the 0.5mm V-shaped knife with his middle finger and thumb, gradually deepening the strokes of the characters "Mom, keep going." At the same time, he used a smaller round knife to carefully refine the edges of the auspicious cloud pattern to make the lines smoother. After carving for about an hour, his wrist felt sore, so he switched to sandpaper of different grits (from 120 to 400 grit) and sanded the corners and surface of the base plate in sequence, making the wood feel warmer and smoother. During this, his father came in, looked at it, and nodded: "Not bad, following Master Qian wasn't in vain. Your carving skill is starting to show." Ye Mingxuan felt quite satisfied. Tonight's goal was to finish all the carving and rough sanding steps.
location: Balcony workspace at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing tools and checking the wood effect
description: Carefully used a brush to clean off the wood shavings and inspected the piece. The characters are clear, the auspicious cloud patterns have well-balanced depth, and the overall surface is smoothly sanded, so it is nearly 80 percent complete. I put the unfinished stand and tools back into the tool box, getting ready for tomorrow's waxing and fine sanding processes.
location: Balcony workspace at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: He took a hot bath to relax. Lying in bed, he scrolled through the notification on his phone for tomorrow afternoon's improvisational theater workshop, and confirmed the location and time. He felt that today had been especially fulfilling; work, family, and hobbies had all been taken care of. He remembered that he hadn't gone for a run tonight, so he simply took it as a deliberate rest day. He turned off the light and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Get up, family care, and breakfast preparation
description: Got up at 8 a.m., went to his mother's room first, helped her soak her ankle in warm water, checked the swelling, and applied ointment. Then he prepared breakfast: cooked millet porridge and reheated steamed buns and fried eggs.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Breakfast and plan discussion
description: Had breakfast with his parents and casually mentioned to his father that he would attend a drama activity in the afternoon and play basketball in the evening, and might not be home for dinner. His father nodded in agreement.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Woodworking wrap-up: sand and oil the phone stand.
description: In the balcony workshop, wearing gloves, he sanded the red toon wood phone stand that had already been carved 80% yesterday with 400-grit and 800-grit sandpaper in sequence to make the surface smooth. Then he dipped a cotton cloth in food-grade wood wax oil and applied it evenly, letting the stand absorb it naturally.
location: Balcony workspace at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Go to the new house for inspection and ventilation
description: While the wood wax oil was drying, he rode his electric bike to the new house. The ride took about 15 minutes. After arriving, he first used the key to open the windows for ventilation, took out a tape measure and carefully re-measured the living room windows' width and height, checked them against the design drawings saved on his phone, confirmed the dimensions were correct, and took photos as records.
location: New house, Vanke Xihuafu Residential Community, Xinjin Erzhi Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returned home and finished wrapping the gift.
description: He rode the electric bike home in about 15 minutes. He checked that the wood wax oil on the stand had dried and taken on a warm, soft luster. He carefully placed the stand into the gift box, laid raffia grass on top, and closed the lid. Then he took a greeting card from the drawer, wrote a birthday wish for his mother, put the card into the box, wrapped it carefully with gift paper and tape, and hid it in the corner of the wardrobe.
location: Balcony workspace at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Simple lunch and departure preparations
description: Cleaned the sanding tools, made egg-fried rice with last night's leftovers and rice for lunch, and washed the dishes and chopsticks after eating. Changed into a sports T-shirt and a light jacket, checked the backpack, packed the basketball jersey, knee pads, towel, and water, and sent a WeChat message to childhood friend Zhang Wei to confirm the departure time.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break
description: Sat on the living room sofa and scrolled through the phone, browsing new posts on a mechanical design forum and replying to netizens' questions about tolerance fits. Feeling sleepy, he leaned back on the sofa and took a nap for about 20 minutes.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Go to the improv theater workshop
description: Zhang Wei drove to the entrance of the community to pick up Ye Mingxuan. The two chatted in the car. Zhang Wei joked that Ye Mingxuan should not freeze up when he got on stage, and Ye Mingxuan responded with a wry smile. After a drive of about 30 minutes, they arrived at the Nankai District Cultural Center.
location: From Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Nankai District Cultural Center Grand Theater, Huanghe Road, Nankai District, Tianjin.

name: Attend an improvisational theater workshop and share insights
description: The workshop started on time, beginning with an icebreaker game of "Name Chain". Ye Mingxuan was a little nervous. During the core "Yes, And" exercise, he got stuck several times. His partner gave the setup "I'm eating a rubber chicken", and he froze for three seconds before replying, "Then... then give me a drumstick." The instructor encouraged him not to think about right or wrong, but to accept first. In the objectless performance, he imagined repairing an engine, and his body movements gradually became more relaxed. In the sharing session at the end, Ye Mingxuan said with emotion that he had always been a plan executor; today he had experienced the feeling of improvisation, and accepting everything in front of him actually opened up more possibilities. Afterward, he asked Zhang Wei to take a photo in front of the cultural center backdrop wall, and posted it on Moments with the caption: "Break out of your comfort zone, meet a different me. #ImprovTheatre #YesAnd"
location: Rehearsal hall and lobby of the Nankai District Cultural Center Grand Theater, Huanghe Road, Nankai District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner conversation with Zhang Wei
description: The two walked about 10 minutes to a Sichuan restaurant near the cultural center and ordered boiled fish in chili oil, mapo tofu, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan said that although his performance had been poor, the "Yes, And" mindset was inspiring for workplace communication; in unexpected situations, accepting first and then finding a solution is better than rejecting immediately. Zhang Wei suggested signing up for the advanced session next month. Ye Mingxuan thought it over and agreed to try.
location: "Shu Wei Xuan Sichuan Restaurant" near the intersection of Huanghe Road and Hongqi Road, Nankai District, Tianjin

name: Venue change and warm-up preparation
description: Zhang Wei drove Ye Mingxuan to the Tiangong University Gymnasium, about a 20-minute drive. On the way, Ye Mingxuan changed into basketball gear. After arriving at the gym, Zhang Wei left early due to other matters, and Ye Mingxuan entered the venue alone, stretching and warming up his joints in the open area to prepare for training.
location: From Shuweixuan Sichuan Restaurant near the intersection of Huanghe Road and Hongqi Road, Nankai District, Tianjin, to the gymnasium inside Tiangong University, No. 399 West Binshui Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Basketball training.
description: When training started, Ye Mingxuan was physically tired because the afternoon theater activities had consumed his energy, and he made several passing errors. But he was very active on the defensive end, worked hard to box out and grab rebounds, and actively organized and connected the offense. During breaks he drank water in big gulps, and teammate Zheng Kai patted him on the shoulder to comfort him. After adjusting his pace, he went back on court. After training, he carefully did a full set of stretches.
location: Indoor basketball court, gymnasium, Tiangong University, No. 399 Binshui West Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Return home.
description: After stretching, I rode a shared bike about 25 minutes back home. After entering, I took a cold shower and changed into dry loungewear.
location: From Tiangong University, 399 Binshui West Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to home at Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Father-son exchange: sharing “Yes, And” and watching NBA.
description: Ye Mingxuan came to the living room, where his father was watching an NBA replay. Riding on that mood, Ye Mingxuan shared the "Yes, And" communication principle he had learned that day with his father, giving an example: if his father didn't want to run, he could say, "Okay, then let's go for a walk, and take some good photos in South Canal Park along the way." His father was amused. When he saw LeBron James's strict pre-game diet and training plan, Ye Mingxuan took the opportunity to urge his father to keep exercising to help control blood pressure. His father nodded thoughtfully.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening care routine, bedtime preparation, and falling asleep
description: Ye Mingxuan went to his mother's room to massage her calves and ankles, and reminded her to apply the medication on time the next day. Back in his own room, he looked at the likes and comments on Moments, feeling somewhat pleased. He briefly reviewed the day's workshop insights and the physical sensations from basketball training, and set the alarm for the next morning. Then, after washing up, he turned off the light and lay down, thinking back on the fulfilling day and quickly falling asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Early morning 13-kilometer long run
description: At 5:30 in the morning I was awakened by my body clock, weighed myself on an empty stomach at 71.9kg and recorded it. I drank 200ml of warm water and ate half a banana for energy reserves. At 5:55 I set off from the west gate of Huating International Community, running east along the non-motorized lane of Zhongbei Avenue toward Outer Ring West Road. Today was forecast to be sunny and hot, and I kept my pace at 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. At about the 7km point, I stopped at the Lawson convenience store at the intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Outer Ring West Road to drink some water, adjusted briefly, and then turned back. I arrived home at exactly 7:00, stretched thoroughly in the shade downstairs in the community using the flowerbed steps, and used a foam roller to relax my calves and front thighs for 10 minutes.
location: Running route around Huating International Community and its surroundings on Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning family care and breakfast
description: After entering the house, he washed his face with cold water to drive away the heat. He then went into his mother's room. His mother, Wang Xiufang, was already awake and using a cane to move her ankle. Ye Mingxuan skillfully performed her morning care: first, he applied a towel soaked in warm water to the sprained ankle for 15 minutes to promote blood circulation; then he applied an ointment to promote blood circulation and resolve stasis and gently massaged around the bruise with his fingertips; finally, he re-wrapped and secured it with an elastic bandage using a figure-eight method. After that, he quickly showered and changed into casual clothes. Breakfast was millet porridge his mother had prepared earlier and a jianbing bought downstairs. He chatted while eating, quietly laying the groundwork for tomorrow's birthday surprise.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Order a birthday cake and wrap gifts.
description: After breakfast, he checked the phone stand gift he had finished making yesterday in the wardrobe. At 8:20 he left the house and walked to the "Maixiangyuan" cake shop on Xijingyuan Commercial Street in the neighborhood. He told the shop assistant that he was ordering a low-sugar cake for his mother, chose one with more fruit and less cream, and asked to pick it up at 8:30 the next morning. After paying, he carefully rolled up a card that read "Get well soon, Mom!" and placed it at the bottom of the cake box. When he got home, he took out the gift box, rewrapped it in a plain yet elegant wrapping paper with a subtle pattern, tied a bow on it, and placed it solemnly on the upper shelf of the bookcase in the study so his mother wouldn't find it.
location: Maixiangyuan Cake Shop, Xijingyuan Commercial Street, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing woodworking tools and confirming afternoon schedule
description: Back at the balcony workshop to prepare for going to the woodworking studio in the afternoon. He took out chisels, a fine-tooth saw, a marking gauge, a try square, a carpenter's pencil, and a hammer. He dipped a cotton cloth in a little walnut oil and carefully wiped the chisel edges and the bottom of the plane for maintenance. Then he sent a WeChat message to Master Qian to confirm that he would arrive at 1 p.m. and bring the boards over. Master Qian replied to bring a scriber and said he had some good materials to show him. After that, he browsed new comments on his Moments, replied to likes from his colleague Zhou Tao and Project Department Manager Wang Peng, and listened to his favorite post-rock playlist.
location: Balcony workspace at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Measured father's blood pressure and recorded health data
description: Ye Mingxuan saw his father Ye Jianguo sitting on the living room sofa watching the NBA Finals replay on his phone. He took out the home electronic blood pressure monitor and persuaded his father to have his blood pressure measured and recorded. He skillfully wrapped the cuff and pressed the start button. The reading showed 126/82 mmHg. He praised that the systolic pressure was more stable than last month and reminded his father to keep it up. Then he took out his phone, opened the shared Excel health diary app, and entered the date, systolic pressure, diastolic pressure, heart rate, and other data one by one.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Early lunch
description: Since they needed to arrive at the Yangliuqing workshop before 1 p.m., the family of three had lunch early. Mother stewed pork ribs and stir-fried a plate of greens. Ye Mingxuan finished eating quickly and reminded his mother to apply an ice pack from the refrigerator to her ankle for 15 minutes at noon. Father only said, "Be careful. Don't just rush — make sure you aim before you cut."
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to the woodworking workshop
description: At 12:20, Ye Mingxuan put on his backpack with tools ready, grabbed a bottle of water, went downstairs, and started the car. He set the navigation destination to "Liuxi Garden". He drove along Zhongbei Avenue and turned onto Jinjing Highway. The traffic was smooth. After about 17.8 minutes, he arrived outside Master Qian's house at around 12:40 and parked the car on the open ground.
location: On the way from Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Liuxiyuan Residential Community, Yangliuqing Town

name: Learning to make a dovetail storage box
description: When he entered, Master Qian had already prepared the pre-cut oak boards. Ye Mingxuan followed Master Qian, first using a marking gauge to precisely scribe the dovetail lines on the ends of the boards. Then he carefully sawed along the outside of the lines with a fine-tooth saw to cut the tenons, and used a chisel to trim the mortises bit by bit, repeatedly test-fitting and adjusting until the three side panels fit together seamlessly. Master Qian occasionally corrected the angle and force of his chisel grip. After assembling the four sides, they installed the bottom panel, and finally mounted a small handle on the top panel. A delicate storage box was basically taking shape. Master Qian praised him, saying, 'The dovetail shoulder lines are very even—you've made good progress,' and gave him a scrap piece of African blackwood.
location: Master Qian's backyard woodworking workshop in Liuxiyuan Residential Community, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Take photos after completion and exchange insights
description: Ye Mingxuan placed the newly made storage box on the woodworking table in the workshop, used his phone to find an angle and take photos, picked one, and posted it to Moments with the caption, "Sunday woodworking, first dovetail joint experience, smooth and warm to the touch [thumbs up]." After posting, he drank tea and rested with Master Qian in the courtyard, exchanging experiences about dovetail joints and the idea of trying to make a small stool in the future.
location: Master Qian's backyard woodworking workshop in Liuxiyuan Residential Community, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Driving home and maintaining the tools
description: At 16:40, Ye Mingxuan said goodbye to Master Qian and drove back. He arrived home at 17:00, about 19.8 minutes later. He went straight to the balcony workshop, washed the used chisels, saws, and other tools with clean water, dried them, and evenly applied maintenance oil. He carefully wiped the edges of the newly made dovetail storage box and solemnly placed it on the upper right corner of the workbench to store the several carving knives he used regularly.
location: From Liuxi Garden Community, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, finally ending up in the home balcony workroom.

name: Assist mother with evening care and family dinner
description: After a short rest, at 17:30 Ye Mingxuan began the evening care for his mother: first he applied a hot towel to her ankle for 20 minutes, then gently rubbed and massaged her calf with his palm to help relax the muscles. Afterwards, the family of three sat at the dining table for dinner. His mother had made winter melon meatball soup and a cucumber salad. He used the Pandas library to read the data and planned chart types. He wrote a Matplotlib script and successfully displayed his father's blood pressure and his own weight data on the same chart with dual Y-axes, generating a clear static line chart. He then began studying the Plotly library documentation, trying to build an interactive time-series chart that could be zoomed and explored. For a cooler 3D dynamic curve, he sketched out a basic framework and left it for later optimization.

At 23:15, I turned off the light and lay down, rehearsed tomorrow's plan for the special day in my mind, and fell asleep peacefully with anticipation and satisfaction.

Considering the water retention after yesterday's long run, I didn't think much of it. Then I laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of targeted lower back stretches, and used a foam roller to roll out the tight muscles in my lower back, feeling as though the muscle fibers were being smoothed out. After washing up, I walked into the kitchen to do the morning ankle care for my mother, who was sitting at the dining table: first I applied a warm towel compress for 10 minutes, then applied a blood-activating and stasis-resolving ointment and carefully secured it with an elastic bandage. While doing this, I chatted with my mother about the weather. She had already prepared breakfast—millet porridge, boiled eggs, and Goubuli buns. I ate with relish, with a secret plan in my heart to celebrate her birthday in the evening.

The morning breeze brushed his face, and on the way he played a crosstalk routine by Guo Degang on his phone to relax. He found stress concentration at the cantilever and wrote down the modification points 'increase fillet radius, locally thicken by 2mm' in his notebook, setting a goal to complete the modification before 11 a.m. He went to the break room to get a cup of hot water and tidied up the drawings on his desk. Then he attended the department's regular Monday morning meeting. Project manager Wang Peng summarized last week's milestones and emphasized this week's delivery tasks. He reported on his progress from last week and the day's optimization plan. The meeting was brief and efficient, ending on time at 9:00.

He opened the analysis model in SolidWorks and, using his mechanical design experience, increased the fillet radius at the root of the cantilever from 3 mm to 6 mm and increased the local wall thickness by 2 mm. After the modifications, he re-meshed and ran the simulation; the optimized model's stress value dropped to a safe range. He captured key data comparison charts, organized them into a brief report, sent it to Li Xiang through the internal system, and added a note inviting him to meet. At 11:30, he walked to Li Xiang's workstation with the model and report and explained the modification logic in detail. Li Xiang dragged the mouse to compare the before-and-after data, nodded in satisfaction, and confirmed that the review conclusion could be signed in the afternoon.

Then the father and son jogged 3 km one behind the other along the tree-lined greenway beside the South Canal, with Ye Mingxuan in front controlling a pace of about 7 minutes/km and his father following behind, his steps much lighter than the previous two days. On the way, his father asked about the progress of the new house, and Ye Mingxuan said he happened to be going to do the final inspection tonight.
