name: Post-workout relaxation and going home
description: After training, he did some simple stretching to relax his muscles, took a shower in the locker room, changed back into regular clothes, and then drove home.
location: From Limei Fitness Center, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community.

name: Moving and packing: sorting items and boxing them.
description: Back home, without time to rest, he drank a large glass of water and went straight to the study to start tonight's packing task. His mother had already helped set out the cardboard boxes and bubble wrap found from the storage room. He began working methodically: first, he tied up the heavy tome 'Mechanical Engineering Handbook' from the lower shelf of the bookcase and put it into a box; next, he carefully wrapped several beloved reference books such as 'Core Python Programming' in bubble wrap; then he wrapped the ancient coin collection album in layers of bubble wrap and placed it in a plastic storage bin; finally, he handled the woodworking toolbox from under the bed. Each box was clearly labeled with a number and contents using a marker, such as 'No.1 - Books - Reference books.' His mother helped pass tape and cut bubble wrap beside him, occasionally asking where the boxes should be placed.
location: Home study and bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After packing for two hours, I felt some soreness in my back, but looking at the neatly arranged 5 boxes and 1 storage bin in the room, I felt a sense of accomplishment. I cleaned up the scattered tape and scissors, then went to the bathroom to wash up and brush my teeth.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Lying in bed, he quickly ran through tomorrow's to-do list: in the morning, he needed to confirm the material list for the trial assembly, and in the afternoon, he needed to oversee the actual trial assembly process. Thinking that tomorrow would be another fulfilling day, he composed himself, closed his eyes, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: After waking up naturally, he first felt his mother's forehead with concern to confirm that she was fine. After washing up, he stepped barefoot onto the scale. It showed 71.5 kg, the same as last month, and he was in good shape. He then did some brief dynamic stretching to wake up his body. His mother had already steamed pork-and-scallion buns and golden millet porridge. While eating, Mingxuan quickly checked the weather forecast on his phone and learned that it would be overcast, 31°C, and muggy. After breakfast, he organized his commuter bag, checked his work badge and notebook, and packed his sports backpack with a quick-dry shirt, running shoes, and a bottle of Gatorade, getting ready for exercise after work.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Pack up in the early morning.
description: Using the last bit of time before departure, he wrote the numbers and contents on the cardboard boxes he hadn’t finished the previous night with a marker, such as “Z-05 college notes, textbooks, and old drawings.” His father helped him adjust the seal of one box, and together they pushed it to the wall, neatly arranging it with the other 7 boxes and 2 storage bins, moving the packing progress for the move one step further.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Listen to podcasts while commuting
description: Put on his helmet on time and set off on his e-bike. Facing the muggy morning breeze, he listened to the podcast 'Practical Knowledge and Skills in Mechanical Design' with noise-canceling earphones, focusing on application cases of tolerance fits in assembly to build up knowledge for the afternoon trial assembly.
location: Along Zhongbei Avenue to Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reporting for duty, inspection, and weekly meeting preparation.
description: After arriving at the Haitai Development Office Building, I brewed a large cup of tangerine peel white tea at my workstation. Then I grabbed my gloves and headed straight to the production workshop. I called Zhou Tao to confirm which machine tool the locating pin was on, crouched down, and carefully inspected the wear with a flashlight. After the inspection, I returned to my workstation on the 6th floor, opened my laptop, and checked the demo file of the CATIA personal feature library once more, confirming that the screenshots and key parameters were correct. At the end of the page, I added a note: “If you need the cloud link, you can share it in the department group.” Then I wrote “Confirm the afternoon trial assembly time with Senior Engineer” on a sticky note and pasted it on the monitor frame.
location: Production line workshop on the 1st floor and workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Shared CATIA training outcomes at the department weekly meeting.
description: After a brief opening, Gao Zhiyuan directly called on Ye Mingxuan to share what he had gained from last week's CATIA training. Mingxuan went up to the podium, turned on the projector, and showcased a personal feature library containing standard parts libraries, common features, and parametric templates, emphasizing that this feature library could save at least 30% of repetitive modeling time in similar structural designs. Senior Engineer Gao praised his solid work on the spot and asked him to compile the materials after the meeting and include them in the third-quarter technical improvement plan for the team. Zhou Tao whistled, and Li Xiang also nodded in approval.
location: Large meeting room, 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Weekly meeting review and trial assembly confirmation.
description: After the weekly meeting broke up, Mingxuan followed Senior Engineer Gao back to the office and reported that an adaptive hole feature could be added to the feature library, which Senior Engineer Gao approved. Then he got to the point, confirming the trial assembly arrangement with the production department at 2:30 p.m. Senior Engineer Gao nodded in agreement and told him to keep an eye on progress and communicate at any time if issues arose.
location: Office of Gao Zhiyuan, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Resolved the wear problem of fixture locating pins on the production line.
description: Returning to the production line with Zhou Tao, after confirming the amount of wear on the locating pin, Ye Mingxuan immediately drew a thickened nonstandard pin sketch in his engineering notebook, noting the material (40Cr), hardness (HRC40-45), and surface roughness requirements. Zhou Tao took the drawing to arrange expedited outsourcing, while Mingxuan agreed on an emergency plan with the line leader: wrap the existing pin with thin copper sheet to ensure the morning's simple assembly would not be interrupted. He then went back to his workstation and recorded the problem, cause analysis, temporary measures, and final solution in detail in the Notion project log. Soon after, he received a WeChat message from Zhou Tao saying the new pin would be ready before noon, and Mingxuan felt relieved.
location: Production line workshop on the 1st floor and workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Malatang lunch at the park.
description: Went downstairs with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to Zhang Liang Malatang on the second floor of Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park for a meal. Mingxuan ordered a bowl of medium-spicy malatang, deliberately adding extra vegetables and tofu and fewer meatballs. During the meal, Li Xiang shared the new finite element analysis software he was learning, while Zhou Tao asked about Mingxuan's moving progress and said the brothers could help move on the weekend. Mingxuan smiled and thanked him, saying he could finish packing first, and they could come over on Sunday for a housewarming.
location: Zhang Liang Malatang, 2nd Floor, Tiankai Huayuan Technology Park, 290 m east of the South Gate, Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and reading at the workstation
description: After lunch, he returned to his workstation and took a 15-minute nap on his forearms. Refreshed after waking up, he opened the e-book Coin Collection on his phone, read for ten minutes about the Guangxu Yuanbao made by the Beiyang Mint, and jotted down a few key variety features in his memo to build knowledge for his ancient coin collection.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work preparation and document organization
description: In the afternoon, as soon as work started, Mingxuan first went to the machining center to pick up the newly machined urgent locating pin, carefully checked the dimensions and surface finish with a vernier caliper, and confirmed it was qualified. Back at his workstation, he printed out the drawings, process cards, and the "comprehensive inspection checklist" needed for the afternoon trial assembly and put them into a folder. Then, as planned, he accessed the online exhibitor directory of the International Machine Tool Exhibition through the company intranet and downloaded product brochures from three companies of interest to prepare for the upcoming visit.
location: Machining Center and 6th-floor workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Participated in the trial assembly at the production department
description: At 3 p.m., Ye Mingxuan arrived on time at the trial assembly workshop. Together with production team leader Li Gang, he fixed the fixture sample onto the machine tool and carefully calibrated the clamping position. During the assembly process, he repeatedly used a vernier caliper to measure the fit clearance, confirming that all data were within tolerance. Gao Zhiyuan stopped by on an inspection round and nodded before leaving when he saw everything was going smoothly. The trial assembly succeeded, and Mingxuan took out his phone and captured several close-up photos of key mating parts for the records.
location: Trial assembly workshop, 2nd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Trial assembly feedback and tooling closed loop.
description: After the trial assembly, Mingxuan immediately called Zhou Tao over. The two worked together to replace the newly machined locating pin on the fixture, confirmed that it was securely installed and moved smoothly, and completely resolved the hidden problem from the morning. Then he returned to his workstation on the 6th floor, compiled the trial assembly data and photos into an email, sent it to Gao Zhiyuan and the production department, CC'd Zhou Tao, and included a note in the email that the fixture status had been updated.
location: Trial assembly workshop on the 2nd floor and workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wrap up the day's work and prepare to leave work.
description: In the 20 minutes before leaving work, Ye Mingxuan recorded in the "Technical Log": "Wear issue of the locating pin on production line tooling, temporary solution, and final repair method" and "The trial assembly data for the XX model fixture is normal, with a fit clearance of 0.02mm, meeting the drawing requirements." Then he tidied his desk, turned off the computer, and prepared to leave work.
location: Workstation on the 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work commute and community group buying.
description: He rode his e-bike home from work, stopping on the way at "Yiyi Community Group Buying Store", No. 12 Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road. In the store, he picked up two bottles of Gatorade for sports drinks, and also grabbed a roll of wide tape and a box of markers for packing. At checkout, the owner recognized him and asked with concern about the moving work. Mingxuan smiled and replied that he would move on the weekend.

participant.name: Shop owner
participant.relation: Owner of a community group-buying store.

location: Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When he got home, his mother was serving rice, and the aroma of braised pork ribs filled the house. His father poured him a glass of cold boiled water. At the dinner table, Mingfang put down his phone and proactively shared the highlights of the day: the feature library he worked on at the weekly meeting was praised by the senior engineer and included in the team's technical improvement plan; the afternoon trial assembly went smoothly, and the fixture looseness problem had been completely solved. His mother was delighted to hear this and gave him the largest rib.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening packing (1)
description: After a short rest following the meal, Mingxuan and his father continued packing. He opened the wardrobe, carefully folded the off-season down jackets and thick coats, and stuffed them into compression bags. His father used newly purchased wide tape to seal every corner of the carton tightly. In addition to clothes, the carton contained several heavy college textbooks and the previously packed ancient coin collection album. Mingxuan used a marker to write on the box surface: "Y-06 Autumn/Winter Clothes, Professional Books and Valuables".
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening interval running training
description: After wrapping up the packing, he changed into quick-dry shorts and a vest, put on lightweight running shoes, and took a few sips of Gatorade diluted with water. First, he did a systematic warm-up in the garden downstairs in the residential complex, including 20 each of high knees, butt kicks, and jumping jacks, as well as walking lunges and dynamic stretches to activate the core and joints. Then he went to the fitness trail along the Nanyun River and started the interval running mode on his watch: jog 800 meters (pace 6:15/km) followed by fast running 400 meters (pace 5:05/km), repeating the cycle. The muggy weather made him sweat profusely, but he kept adjusting his breathing, maintaining his rhythm, and hydrating when appropriate. In the end, he completed a 6 km run with an average pace of 5:38 per kilometer, then walked slowly for 600 meters as a cool-down. After returning home, he immediately used a foam roller for deep relaxation of the front and outer thighs and the buttocks; it was painful but effective. Then he took a cool shower and slowly finished the remaining half bottle of Gatorade, completing the entire workout.
location: South Canal Fitness Trail (Zhongbei Town section), Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Huating International Community.

name: Evening packing (2)
description: Feeling refreshed after a shower, Mingxuan continued packing precious items with his father. He brought out a suitcase-sized storage box, inside which several ancient coins collected over the past two years and a complete set of coin albums were carefully wrapped in bubble wrap; in another carpentry toolbox, chisels, planes, sandpaper and other tools were sorted and placed. He took photos of these two boxes specially and labeled them conspicuously with “Fragile — Ye Mingxuan”.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and planning.
description: Finished packing, walked to the parents' bedroom door to say goodnight. His mother reminded him to go to bed early because he had work the next day. Back in his room, he plugged in his phone, glanced at tomorrow's weather forecast—cloudy, 32—then set the alarm for 6:00 AM, getting ready for the next day.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep review and going to bed.
description: After turning off the light, in the faint city glow coming through the window, he quickly reviewed the day's work and training in his mind: the weekly meeting went smoothly, the work clothes were done, the fitting was successful, the run was completed, and important items were packed. He felt grounded and content; the physical fatigue instead brought spiritual fulfillment, and within a few minutes he fell into a deep sleep with even breathing.
location: On the bed at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, breakfast, and preparing to go out on a torrential rain day.
description: At 6:30 a.m., he was woken by the sound of heavy rain and got up right on time. After washing up, he walked into the living room wearing shorts and a tank top. His mother, Wang Xiulan, had already prepared breakfast: a bowl of millet porridge, a boiled egg, and two pork buns. While eating, Ye Mingxuan urged his mother not to go out in the storm and decided to drive his father's old Passat to work instead. After breakfast, he changed into long pants, an old outdoor jacket, and waterproof sports shoes. He took two folding umbrellas and a dry towel from the entryway cabinet and stuffed them into his backpack, preparing for the stormy commute.
location: Home, No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute to work with a detour in heavy rain
description: At 7:00 sharp, he set off in his old Passat from the underground garage of the residential complex. Even with the wipers at maximum, visibility was still blurry, so he could only keep the car at 20 km/h and turned on the hazard lights. Zhongbei Avenue was badly congested, and water had flooded over the road shoulder. Ye Mingxuan decisively turned around and detoured to the service road of West Outer Ring Road, but there he found a low-lying underpass where a vehicle had broken down and the water was already halfway up the wheels. He adjusted his route once more, taking a longer but relatively safe industrial park road. Along the way, the car radio kept broadcasting flooding and traffic control information. He drove nervously, and the original 40-minute journey ultimately took an hour and a half to reach the company.
location: The route along Zhongbei Avenue, via West Outer Ring Road, to Haitai Development Sixth Road in Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Change clothes and prepare for work
description: After parking, he quickly ran into the lobby of Haitai Development Office Building, dried his hair and face with a dry towel, took a spare T-shirt out of his backpack and changed out of the wet collar, then took the elevator to his workstation on the 6th floor. At 9:00, he made a cup of hot tea to warm himself up, calmed down from the tense commute, and prepared to devote himself to the day's work.
location: Workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Discussed fixture process deviations and formulated a contingency plan.
description: At 9:30, he met with supervisor Gao Zhiyuan and colleague Zhou Tao at the workstation. Regarding the 0.02mm fit clearance that was successfully trial-assembled yesterday, Ye Mingxuan raised the risk of potential process deviation and suggested re-verifying the flatness of the fixture base before mass production, and planned to add a fine grinding step to the process card as a contingency. Gao Zhiyuan agreed and asked him to organize it into a document before 10:00. Ye Mingxuan then used CATIA to pull up the model, mark the risk points, and write countermeasures. At 10:30, he sent the email and updated the technical log.
location: Workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch at convenience store and called family to confirm safety
description: The rain eased a little to moderate rain. Ye Mingxuan didn't go to the malatang shop as usual, but instead went to the convenience store downstairs from his office, bought a boxed meal and a hot drink, and ate quickly in the rest area. Then he called the home landline from his phone. His mother answered and told him that neither she nor his father had gone out, and the water in the community was not deep. After telling her to be careful with electrical safety, he hung up, feeling much more relieved.
location: Qijia Convenience Store, Ground-Floor Shop 4, Supporting Building 6, Xuefu Yunting.

name: Further refine the optimization plan and organize the technical documentation
description: At 13:00 he returned to his workstation and continued refining the morning's process deviation contingency plan. He used a Python script to perform parametric analysis on the fixture model, simulating stress changes at different temperatures, and confirmed dimensional stability under machining conditions. At 14:30 Zhou Tao came over to discuss; the two confirmed the feasibility of the fine grinding process as an optional solution and decided not to include it in the official process documents for now, waiting to communicate with the production department next week. At 15:30 Ye Mingxuan asked his colleague Li Xiang to help verify the simulation data, and Li Xiang said there was no problem after checking. Afterward, he returned to his workstation and compiled the discussion and analysis results into a technical document for filing. Near the end of the workday, he also used his phone's memo app to make a shopping list for Sunday's housewarming dinner, including disposable paper cups, drinks, beer, snacks, and optional hot pot ingredients.
location: Workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drive home slowly from work during the heavy rain.
description: He got off work at 17:00. Although the rain had weakened, the road was still slippery, and some sections still had standing water. Ye Mingxuan drove his old Passat back along a relatively safe but slightly longer route, staying highly alert and avoiding possible waterlogged areas. An hour later, at around 18:00, he arrived safely at the gate of Huating International Community.
location: Roads along the route from Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin via Jinjing Highway, Outer Ring West Road, and Zhongbei Avenue to Huating International Community

name: Found water accumulation in the residential community and actively participated in flood control and emergency rescue.
description: When he drove to the entrance of the community, Ye Mingxuan found rainwater overflowing the sidewalk and pouring into the community. At the entrance to the underground garage, property staff were using scattered sandbags to block the water, but water kept seeping in. He saw unused new flood-prevention sandbags stacked beside the fire hydrant cabinet. He immediately parked the car, took off his soft-shell jacket, rolled up his trousers, ran over, and suggested to the property supervisor that they use the new sandbags to completely seal the entrance. Then he called over four or five young neighbors, and together they carried sandbags back and forth from the fire cabinet to the garage entrance more than ten trips, building a waterproof wall. Afterwards, he also helped the property staff find and start the backup pump in the basement to drain the water. He was soaked through with rain and sweat, and blisters formed on his hands. During this time his mother called, and he shouted back that he was safe. Everyone took turns working until after 11 p.m., when the rain finally stopped and the water level had dropped significantly. The danger was basically under control. The property manager thanked them repeatedly, and the neighbors agreed to clean up the mud together the next day.
location: Underground garage entrance and pump room, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returning home late at night, feeling the warmth and contentment of family.
description: In the early hours, Ye Mingxuan returned home exhausted and covered in mud. His mother Wang Xiulan had not gone to bed; seeing him at the door, she quickly handed him the hot ginger soup and a clean towel she had prepared, and urged him with concern to drink it all to warm himself up and then take a shower. Ye Mingxuan drank the ginger soup in one gulp, feeling most of the chill in his body dispelled. After a hot shower and changing into dry clothes, he relaxed completely. He sat on the sofa, extremely tired, but when he thought of how he had worked with the neighbors to protect the garage and the lower-floor residents, a sense of pride and satisfaction from mutual neighborhood help welled up. He briefly told his mother about the night's emergency rescue efforts, and she smiled and praised him.
location: Home, No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Writing a diary before bed and resting
description: At 23:40 I returned to the bedroom and used my phone to write a short diary entry: 'July 30, 2025, heavy rain. Commute was tough, work went smoothly. In the evening I spent 5 hours with the neighbors holding back the water, my hands were worn raw, but it was worth it. With the lights of ten thousand homes, someone has to keep watch.' Then I checked the next day's weather forecast, which showed cloudy turning clear, and set the 7:00 alarm. At 1:00 a.m. I put down my phone and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 128 Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning recovery and breakfast
description: At 7:30 a.m., the alarm went off. When he woke up, he clearly felt soreness and fatigue in his shoulders and arms—the aftermath of moving sandbags during the community emergency response last night. After gently exercising his wrists and shoulder joints in bed, he got up and went to the bathroom to rinse his arms with hot water to promote blood circulation. Hearing his mother preparing breakfast in the kitchen, he changed into loungewear. At breakfast, his mother had already steamed flower rolls, boiled eggs, and millet porridge, and also served homemade pickled radish peel. His mother asked with concern how his body felt. Ye Mingxuan answered truthfully that his shoulders and arms were sore, and his mother told him not to overdo it today. His father, Ye Jianguo, interjected that everyone in the homeowners' group was praising him, and reminded him not to get too proud. Ye Mingxuan smiled and briefly shared the day's plan: write up his diary in the morning and buy supplies for Sunday's housewarming in the afternoon.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Writing in the study: July monthly reflection diary
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to the study, sat down at his desk, opened the locked notebook, and began writing the monthly reflection diary for July. He focused on reviewing the technical debate with his colleague Li Xiang on July 24, in which he applied [yes, and] thinking to turn 'No, your approach has a problem' into 'Yes, we see the problem; let's see if we can improve on that basis,' ultimately reaching a compromise design better than the original proposal. He recorded in detail how this methodology felt in practice in both work and family communication, admitting that it remains a challenge for an ISTJ personality, but it does work. He then looked through the July records, reviewed the entire process from his mother's emergency visit to the newly renovated house passing the formaldehyde test, and summed up this month's 'quiet upgrade' — not only an improvement in work ability, but also an awakening of emotional management and family responsibility. After finishing, he felt a sense of certainty.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Going out for fresh air and thanking the neighbors.
description: After finishing his diary, Ye Mingxuan decided to go out for a walk to relieve fatigue. Just as he stepped out of the building entrance, he ran into Uncle Zhang, a neighbor on the first floor. Uncle Zhang walked over quickly and patted his shoulder firmly, thanking him for participating in the emergency rescue last night to protect the basement. Ye Mingxuan humbly replied that as neighbors, it was only right to help. At the same time, he opened his phone and saw more than a dozen unread messages in the owners' group, all thanking him with @ mentions. Someone called him "the most handsome hero". He replied to the group: "Don't mention it, everyone. The community is our shared home. In the future, let's all support each other when anything comes up."
location: Downstairs at Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning household tasks: follow up on technical work and check the housewarming checklist.
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his study, opened his laptop, logged into the company email, and checked whether there were any emails related to the fixture precision grinding plan. He pulled up yesterday's chat history with colleague Zhou Tao, confirmed the arrival time of the non-standard pins, and sent Zhou Tao a WeChat message: "Zhou Tao, last night's emergency repair was a bit tiring, so I'll work from home today and keep an eye on things. How is the pin blank material coming along? Keep the copper sheet contingency plan ready." After handling work matters, he opened an Excel spreadsheet and rechecked the shopping list for Sunday's housewarming meal. Considering the hot weather, he decided to add a chilled sour plum drink, and sorted the shopping list by "wet market / supermarket", planning to take it with him in the afternoon.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch time
description: His mother called him to lunch. At noon she had made tomato and egg sauce noodles, served with leftover braised pork belly and stir-fried baby bok choy from the previous day. At the table, Ye Mingxuan told his mother about the plans for Sunday's housewarming gathering, saying that Zhou Tao would bring a few friends—probably five or six people. His mother was delighted and said that the first meal in the new house should definitely be a lively occasion. Ye Mingxuan also discussed with his mother what to buy in the afternoon. His mother suggested that in addition to buying ready-made dishes, they could also buy some pork ribs and chicken wings, and she could help marinate them in advance.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch break and packing preparations
description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan helped his mother put the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen, then returned to the bedroom. Still somewhat tired, he set an alarm for 13:40 and took a one-hour nap. When he woke up, he felt a bit better. He didn't go out shopping immediately. Instead, he walked to the hallway, looked at the moving boxes stacked there, and decided to sort out one box containing more books before the afternoon shopping. He used a marker to label the box with number Y-07 and contents "Professional Books / Technical Manuals", and reinforced the seal with wide packing tape. After that, he changed into a T-shirt and shorts for going out, took out the shopping list and eco-friendly shopping bags, and got ready to leave.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Sunday grocery shopping
description: Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike first to Yiyi Community Group Buying Store (Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road). Following the list, he bought two large bottles of Coke and Sprite, a pack of hot pot base, a pack of disposable paper cups, and bowls and chopsticks. The older woman at the store recognized him and said last night's emergency work must have been tough, so she gave him a small discount. After leaving the group buying store, he rode to Lijiayuan Vegetable Market. At the meat stall, he bought spare ribs and chicken wing mid-joints and asked the butcher to chop them; in the vegetable section, he bought potatoes, lotus root, green peppers, scallions, ginger, and garlic; finally, at the dried goods stall, he bought dark plums, dried hawthorn slices, licorice, and dried tangerine peel for making sour plum soup. After shopping, the front and rear of the electric bike were hung full of items.

participant.name: The lady at the group-buying store.

location: Yiyi Community Group Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the Zhongbei Town Lijiayuan Vegetable Market, south of Lijiayuan Village, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going Home to Organize the Purchased Items
description: After arriving home, his mother came over to help sort and put away the purchased items. He rinsed the pork ribs and chicken wings under the tap immediately, then put them in a bowl with cooking wine and ginger slices to marinate. Ye Mingxuan put the dried goods and drinks into the kitchen cabinet. After tidying up, he felt it was about time and prepared his running gear.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Evening recovery run.
description: Ye Mingxuan changed into a sports T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes, and put on his sports watch. Since his body still felt heavy, he spent over 20 minutes on a full pre-run stretching routine, focusing on his shoulders, hips, and ankles, and did several sets of high knees and jumping jacks. He filled his water bottle, took his phone and keys, and rode his electric bike to Jinxi Sports Park. He sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Xiao Chen to meet at the entrance. After they met, they jogged to warm up and caught up. Xiao Chen said he had pushed himself too hard in last night's rescue operation. The main run was recovery-focused, with a steady pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. The 5 km run was smooth, with no sprinting in the middle, and his breathing was steady afterward. Then he and Xiao Chen walked for a few minutes by the track doing static stretches, and he reminded Xiao Chen to come by the new apartment over the weekend if he had time. After saying goodbye, Ye Mingxuan rode his electric bike home, feeling much more relaxed in the cool evening breeze. Once home, he immediately took out a foam roller and spent 20 minutes carefully loosening his calves and the front and back of his thighs on the living room floor, feeling the tightness gradually melt away.
location: Jinxi Sports Park at the intersection of Fujin Road and Ziyang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Shower and data synchronization
description: After relaxing his muscles, Ye Mingxuan took a warm shower to wash off the sweat. Returning to the bedroom, he opened the sports app on his phone to sync the running data. July's mileage was fixed at 72.5 kilometers, and his weight was still 71.5 kilograms, which made him confident about getting under 70 kilograms next month. He sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Xiao Chen: “Finished the run, feeling good, as usual, pace was steady.”
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner and family time.
description: In the evening, my mother prepared a simple dinner: the leftover noodles with gravy and cucumber salad from lunch. The family of three ate and chatted. Ye Mingxuan shared what he had bought in the afternoon and how the run felt. His mother told him to eat plenty, and his father asked whether there were any remaining issues with the moving progress.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: August Plan: Moving and Training Plan
description: After dinner and a short rest, Ye Mingxuan sat back at his desk, opened a new notebook, and began planning August. He first listed the final moving milestones: after the housewarming on Sunday, August 3, his parents would help clean the new home, and he would finish moving and putting away all his belongings before the next weekend. Then, based on his July running mileage, he made an August training plan: increase weekly mileage to 25 kilometers, add interval runs and tempo runs, and build a foundation for the half marathon in September. He roughly marked the corresponding mileage and dates on his calendar.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Family time and bedtime preparation.
description: After finishing the planning, Ye Mingxuan came out of the study and saw his parents watching a competitive variety show in the living room, so he sat down on the sofa and watched with them for a while, chatting about how his running felt today and his idea of moving next week. His mother told him not to go to bed too late. Around 21:10, he got up, turned off the TV, and asked his parents to get some rest as well. Back in the bedroom, he laid out the clothes and commuter bag for work the next day.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Evening relaxation, recording inspirations, and bedtime.
description: After washing up, Ye Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, picked up his phone and browsed a mechanical design forum for a while, reading some new ideas about precision grinding of fixtures. Then he opened a notes app and jotted down a few thoughts from today about community volunteer services, such as whether they could work with the property management to organize a safety drill for the community. After that, he also browsed a WeChat official account about coin collecting to relax. By 22:30, he turned off his phone, confirmed the alarm was set for 7:10, checked the e-bike's battery, and ran through tomorrow's schedule in his mind: go to work as usual in the morning, and after work in the afternoon, he could pack another box of items. Though his body still felt a little tired, all of today's plans—monthly reflection, neighbor interaction, recovery run, shopping, and planning—had been completed. July came to a close with a fulfilling and reassuring end, and he soon fell asleep.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: The alarm clock rang right on time. He silenced his phone, sat up, and saw that it was already light outside, with a muggy feel. He checked the weather forecast on his phone: cloudy turning sunny, 27–35°C, high humidity. He rubbed his lower back, which was a bit sore from yesterday's emergency repair work, and felt fairly energetic. Confirming it was Friday, he went over his to-do list: revise drawings, reply to Senior Engineer's email, play basketball in the evening. After a quick wash, he went to the dining room, where his mother Wang Xiulan had already made mung bean soup and egg pancakes. While eating, he chatted with his mother about last night's rain and today's work schedule, and urged her not to go out in the heat and to beware of heatstroke. His mother also reminded him to avoid heatstroke and drink more water. After breakfast, he took his commuting bag and sports bag (basketball jersey, knee pads, spare T-shirt, towel), checked the tire pressure and battery of his e-bike, and confirmed that the wrench colleague Zhou Tao had asked him to return was in the basket, ready to return it to him today.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commuting to work
description: He got on his e-bike, left Huating International Community, and took his usual route to Haitai Development Office Building. The breeze brushed his face. Along the way, he listened to the podcast "Practical Mechanical Design Tips" using Bluetooth earphones. This episode discussed practical cases of tolerance fitting, and it was exactly relevant to the fixture project at hand. He listened with exceptional attention and mentally noted several key points for choosing fit clearances.
location: Cycling route from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Arrival preparation and colleague interaction
description: Arrived at Haitai Development Office Building, swiped in and went up to Room 904. After reaching the workstation, first watered the pothos and brewed a cup of jasmine tea. Colleague Zhou Tao was already at his desk. He returned the wrench from the bike basket to him and thanked him. The two briefly chatted about today's work priorities and next week's trial production plan.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Core work in the morning: drawing revisions.
description: He opened CATIA and focused fully on revising the drawings for the precision fixture project. Based on the issue from yesterday's trial assembly that the fit clearance was 0.02 mm too large, he carefully checked every dimension mark and adjusted the tolerance range of the clamping areas to ensure they met the H7/g6 precision fit requirement.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handle class reunion arrangements
description: His phone vibrated continuously. Li Na, an elementary school classmate, sent a message in the group chat saying she was returning to Tianjin on Sunday and wanted to organize a small class reunion, tagging Mingxuan, Wang Lei, Chen Hao, and others. Mingxuan immediately replied to confirm he would attend and volunteered to book the restaurant. He privately messaged Wang Lei and Chen Hao to confirm the time. After receiving positive replies, he began searching online for well-reviewed Tianjin restaurants in Xiqing District and initially selected "Jinmen Old Flavor" (Zhongbei Town branch) as the top candidate, planning to ask his parents for their opinion in the evening.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Technical collaborative work
description: Continued processing drawings, and during this time contacted Li Xiang via the company's internal communications software: “Li Xiang, I just revised the clamping force simulation parameters for the fixture. I've sent you the model. When you have time, could you take a look and see if the boundary conditions are set correctly?” Li Xiang quickly replied that he had received it and agreed to run the simulation, with feedback in the afternoon.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and data review
description: Walked to the malatang shop at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park near the company. Ordered a bowl of malatang. While waiting for the food and eating, I opened the running app and carefully browsed the detailed data for July's cumulative mileage of 85 km, checking the pace curve day by day and focusing on the heart rate changes in the two long runs (15 km and 17.5 km) and interval runs. I felt satisfied with this month's performance, and my weight had also dropped to 71.4 kg. Then I walked back to the company.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Develop the August training plan
description: Back at his desk, he used the lunch break to carefully work out the August running training plan in the notebook he carried with him, combining the data he had just reviewed and the fitness trend charts generated by the app. The target weekly mileage was 25 km, laying the foundation for the November half marathon. He planned to run 2–3 times a week: one interval run (400m*8), one tempo run (8km@5:40 pace), and one LSD (gradually increasing to 18 km). After finishing, he felt energized.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work communication and confirmation.
description: After starting work in the afternoon, I took my laptop and first discussed the non-standard pin solution with Zhou Tao. We decided to use a stepped shaft design to improve positioning accuracy. Then I emailed the senior engineer to report the progress of the drawing revisions and attached a link to the document for the fixture precision grinding plan. After that, I called Li Gang, the production line team leader, to confirm the equipment's free time in the afternoon and arranged the precision grinding test for next Monday.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Core afternoon work: drawing detail optimization
description: Back at his workstation, he began adding technical requirements to the drawings and drew a detailed diagram of the fine grinding process, marking key dimensions and surface roughness requirements so that production line workers could intuitively understand the key operating points. He also wrote a small Python script to quickly verify the extreme tolerances of several key dimension chains, leaving nothing to chance.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Work wrap-up and exercise preparation.
description: Finished work, organized the drawings, and filed all revision records. After doing some light stretching at my workstation, I opened the sports bag and checked again that the basketball shoes, knee pads, spare T-shirt, and towel were all ready for evening training.
location: Room 904, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute after work to the university gymnasium.
description: He clocked out and went downstairs to get his electric bike. He sent his mother a WeChat message saying he would be home late after playing ball that evening, so no need to save him dinner. Riding his e-bike east along Fukang Road toward Tiangong University, he deliberately slowed down to pass by the South Canal and glanced at the calm river to relax his tense nerves. He switched to an upbeat workout playlist on his earphones, and his mood became expectant.
location: Cycling route from Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Tiangong University Gymnasium.

name: Basketball training and stretching exchange.
description: Arriving at the Tiangong University gymnasium, he changed into his gear and warmed up and shot around with teammates. During training, he practiced the [yes, and] principle. When teammate Xiao Lin proposed a somewhat aggressive pick-and-roll play, he first affirmed it and added a plan to pull out to the right corner, so the team's coordination was very smooth. The scrimmage lasted three quarters, and he hit a key corner three-pointer, earning cheers. Afterwards, he did static stretches for the front and back of the thighs and calves to relax tense muscles, reviewed the highlights with teammates, and agreed to play again next week.
location: Tiangong University Gymnasium, 399 Binshui West Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening commute home
description: Riding an e-bike, he returned from Tiangong University to Huating International Community in Zhongbei Town. The night breeze was slightly cool and blew off the heat on his body, leaving him feeling completely relaxed. On the way, he stopped at a 24-hour convenience store and bought a bottle of chilled Gatorade.
location: Cycling route from Tiangong University Gymnasium to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: When he got home, his parents were watching the news, and there was a heated meal left on the table: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised hairtail, and a bowl of mung bean soup. While eating, he talked with his parents about the Sunday elementary school reunion. His father asked the location, and Mingxuan said he had chosen “Jinmen Laoweidao” (Zhongbei Town branch). Both parents agreed that the restaurant was close to home and convenient, and expressed approval.
location: No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Foam roller stretching and relaxation.
description: After the meal and a rest, he took out a foam roller on the living room floor and did deep stretching and relaxation for the front of his thighs, iliotibial band, and glutes. While stretching, he used his phone to confirm the shopping list for Sunday's housewarming gathering. Beverages and disposable tableware had already been bought on July 31, and he also listed the seasonings that needed to be replenished, planning to buy them tomorrow.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, No. 128, living room

name: Organizing moving items in the evening
description: Went to the study to look at the newly acquired Xianfeng Zhongbao ancient coin, but found it had already been sealed in a moving box. So I found a marker and wrote 'Study - Tools', 'Collection - Fragile', 'Books - History' and other labels on several unmarked empty boxes, making visual preparations for the move for easier sorting later.
location: Study, No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After washing up, he changed into comfortable pajamas. Leaning against the headboard, he picked up the "Handbook of Mechanical Design Taboos" and flipped through it for 10 minutes, adding two tips about heat treatment deformation to his phone memo. He turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light, and set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning. He quickly ran through Saturday's schedule in his mind: sleep in, go to the new house to check the walls, and prepare for next week's housewarming. Then he turned off his phone and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off, and he got up decisively. After some light activity, he weighed himself: 71.2 kg. He drank warm water, changed into a running vest, shorts, and running shoes, and put on a heart rate strap and sports earphones. He checked his running waist pack to make sure it had two energy gels and a bottle of electrolyte drink. He left quietly to avoid waking his parents.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Warm-up jog and LSD long-distance running training
description: Jogged slowly from home to South Canal Park at an easy pace of about 6:30/km as a warm-up before the long run. There were few people and cars on the way, and the air was fresh. After arriving at the park entrance, I did dynamic stretching to mobilize my hip joints and ankles. Then I started a 14K LSD training run with a target pace of 5:50/km. My heart rate stayed steady at 145-150 bpm for the first 5 km. At the 7th kilometer I took an energy gel and drank a little water, and topped up again at the 11th kilometer. In the last 4 kilometers my legs were a bit fatigued and the pace dropped slightly, but I still completed the full distance.
location: Greenway, Nanyunhe Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Post-run stretching, walking home, and showering.
description: By the pull-up bars in the park, he did about 15 minutes of post-run stretching, focusing on relaxing the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves, holding each stretch for 30 seconds. Then he used the small foam roller he had brought to deeply roll the front and back of his thighs. Afterward, he walked slowly home to let his heart rate settle. Once inside, he drank a large glass of plain boiled water, showered, changed into clean home clothes, and soaked the sweat-soaked running clothes in a basin.
location: Rest area of South Canal Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and home in Huating International Community

name: Breakfast
description: His mother had prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, chive and egg steamed dumplings, and cucumber salad. While eating, he chatted with his mother. His mother asked about tomorrow's class reunion and told him to have fun, saying she would take care of the packing at home.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Rest, check the owners' group, and the follow-up impact on the community
description: While resting on the sofa, he saw dozens of unread messages in the homeowners’ WeChat group. Several neighbors were recalling how they had helped with emergency rescue during the rainstorm on July 30, and the property management also sent a thank-you message. After reading through carefully, he replied, thanked everyone, and suggested forming a small emergency group in advance so that the division of labor would be more efficient. This earned a wave of likes from the neighbors. The community director noticed his performance through feedback from the property management, listed him as a promising community volunteer, and planned to contact him later.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Mother made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and the braised pork from last night. Father asked about the training; Ye Mingxuan said the 14 km run went smoothly and that there was hope for the half marathon in November. They also chatted about the local restaurant already booked for tomorrow's class reunion. Father praised the restaurant for its good food and told him to ride safely on the way.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: It's not good to exercise right after eating, so I went back to the bedroom and lay down to rest. I set the alarm for 13:30 and rested with my eyes closed for about 40 minutes to ensure I'd have energy in the afternoon.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Organizing moving items—professional books and woodworking tools
description: In the afternoon, the sky gradually darkened and rain began to fall outside the window. He took down all the professional books in the study and divided them into piles by category, such as Mechanical Design Handbook, Python Programming, and Mechanics of Materials; then he packed and labeled them with cardboard boxes and a marker. Next, he dealt with the woodworking toolbox, carefully wrapping chisels, planes, hand saws, and other tools with old cloth and bubble wrap to prevent scratches and collisions, and put them into another box.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Rest and tea break during a thunderstorm
description: Thunder rumbled outside and the rain grew heavier. He stood up to stretch his back, brewed a cup of jasmine tea, and stood by the window watching the rain for a short break. Meanwhile, he checked his phone and replied to the final confirmation message in the group chat from Li Na, the class reunion organizer, confirming again that he would attend on time.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize moving items — ancient coin collection album and miscellaneous items
description: The rain gradually let up, and I continued organizing. I carefully wrapped the five ancient coin collection albums from the drawer one by one in air-cushion film, put them into a small cardboard box, and labeled it “Ancient Coins - Fragile - Do Not Stack.” Then I sorted the pens, USB drives, old photos, and other miscellaneous items from the drawer into storage boxes. After each box was packed, I wrote the contents and the room it belonged to on the box with a thick marker.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon snacks and family leisure.
description: Tired from packing, walked to the living room. The rain had stopped, and the air was fresh and moist. Mother cut a watermelon, and the family sat on the sofa eating, watching TV news, and chatting about recent hot topics.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Go jogging with my father.
description: The air after the rain was especially fresh. He and his father put on running shoes and jogged to South Canal Park. They ran 3 km along the greenway at a pace of about 7:30 per kilometer. While running, they talked about the funny experience of applying the "Yes, and" principle in yesterday's basketball training, and his father also shared insights from his younger days when he held technical exchange meetings at the factory. After the run, Ye Mingxuan mentioned his left knee felt a bit tight, and his father suggested doing more wall sits to strengthen knee stability.
location: Greenway, Nanyunhe Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walk home.
description: After finishing the run, he didn't rush home. He walked back slowly with his father along the tree-lined path outside the residential complex, enjoying the coolness after the rain and continuing their discussion on knee care tips.
location: The tree-lined path outside Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner
description: My mother had already made dinner: stir-fried broccoli, braised hairtail, and tomato egg drop soup. The family ate and chatted in a warm atmosphere. My mother suggested bringing a jar of homemade sour plum drink to tomorrow's class reunion so everyone could try it.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Weekend evening leisure
description: After helping clear the table, he returned to the living room sofa, browsed a mechanical design forum on his phone, read some new posts about jig and fixture improvements, and bookmarked a few inspiring design ideas.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Free time — reading and games.
description: No high-intensity activities today. In the study, I spent half an hour flipping through the 'Mechanical Design Taboo Handbook', focusing on welding part design taboo cases and taking notes. Then I went back to the bedroom, put on earphones, and played two rounds of League of Legends: Wild Rift ARAM mode to relax.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bed preparation and confirmation of classmate gathering
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, he @-mentioned the organizer Li Na in the small class-reunion group to reconfirm meeting at 12:00 tomorrow at the 'Cangzhou Hotpot Chicken Main Store, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District'. Then he set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow morning.
location: Tianjin City, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bathroom and bedroom.

name: Going to bed
description: He turned off the desk lamp and thought back on the day: the morning run had gone well, packing had progressed smoothly, the neighbors' recognition was heartwarming, and accompanying his father for a run in the evening had been pleasant. He slowly fell asleep, feeling satisfied and grounded.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: The alarm rang right on time at 7:30. I first went to the bathroom and washed my face with warm water to fully wake up. When I got to the dining room, my mother had already set out breakfast: Goubuli baozi and steaming millet porridge, with a plate of homemade pickled vegetables. I briefly mentioned to my parents that I was going to have hotpot chicken with Li Na and the others in the afternoon, and they told me to drink more water in the hot weather and not eat too spicy. My father then asked about the software debugging this morning, and I said it was no big deal.
location: Restaurant at No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Home organization and stretching recovery.
description: After breakfast, I didn't rest. My left knee was still a little tight after yesterday's long run, so I first did two sets of wall sits on the living room carpet, 10 minutes each with a 1-minute rest in between. The feeling of tightness eased quite a bit. Then I started sorting out the moving boxes at the study door. I pushed the boxes labeled "Y-06 Books" and "Woodworking Tools" together and stacked them neatly to make the hallway more spacious. After finishing, I felt lighter and clearer in my mind.
location: Living room and study, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Final debugging and packaging of the parameterization tool
description: This is the core task for this morning. I sat down at my desk, turned on the computer, and went through the parametric design script I wrote last week from start to finish, fixing a few minor logic issues in parameter linkage. After confirming it was correct, as planned, I used PyInstaller to package it into a standalone .exe demo file. For convenience, I also wrote a concise operation manual in Markdown, highlighting the meanings of key parameters and the operation steps. Finally, I saved the .exe file and the manual to both the computer desktop and a USB drive to ensure everything was ready for the afternoon.
location: Study, No. 128, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going out to buy ingredients for sour plum drink
description: After resting at home for a while, I took my phone and a reusable bag, got on my little electric scooter, and went to the 'Yiyi Community Group-buying Store' not far from the community. In the dried goods section, following the recipe saved on my phone, I picked out a large pack of dark plums, dried hawthorn slices, licorice, dried tangerine peel, and rock sugar. When weighing, I saw dried osmanthus flowers nearby and grabbed a small bag, thinking that sprinkling it on after cooking would add a nice aroma. When paying, the owner's wife recognized me and asked if I was the young man who had helped carry sandbags in the community during the last rainstorm. I smiled shyly and said it was the least I could do.
location: Yiyi Community Group Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Having lunch with parents.
description: When I got home, my mother was stir-frying. Lunch was authentic Tianjin home cooking: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, minced pork eggplant, plus a large pot of refreshing mung bean soup. During the meal, I shared with my parents the software packaging work from the morning. Although they didn't quite understand it, seeing me happy made them happy too. My father reminded me not to ride the electric bike when going out in the afternoon because it was too hot, and told me to take a taxi instead.
location: Restaurant at No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, I helped clear the dishes and chopsticks, then went back to the bedroom for a nap. I set the alarm for 2:40 p.m., drew the curtains, and had the air conditioning on. Outside the window, the cicadas were chirping merrily, but I soon drifted off to sleep, saving up energy for the afternoon gathering.
location: Room 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Making sour plum soup and preparing for the outing.
description: After the alarm went off, I got up. I went to the kitchen first, rinsed the smoked plums, hawthorn, and other ingredients bought in the morning under clean water, put them all into a clay pot according to the tutorial, added enough water and rock sugar, brought it to a boil over high heat, then turned to low heat and simmered slowly. When done, I turned off the heat, let it cool, strained out the residue with a strainer, and poured the liquid into a 1.5-liter thermos that had been scalded with boiling water and cooled. Finally, I sprinkled a small pinch of dried osmanthus flowers, and the aroma came out immediately. Afterward, I went back to the bedroom, took a quick shower, and changed into a clean light blue polo shirt and casual shorts.
location: Kitchen and bedroom, No. 128, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Verify Location, Check Equipment, and Print Documents
description: Going to the study, I first opened Amap on my phone and re-confirmed the location of "Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken Zhongbei Town Main Store" and saved it as a favorite. Then I checked my backpack: laptop, a USB drive containing the .exe, and a thermos. I turned on the computer, tested the demo version, and confirmed it ran properly. After thinking it over, I decided to bring a printed copy of the user manual as well, for Li Na's convenience. So I rode my e-bike to the "Pingyi Advertising Copy & Photo" shop near the neighborhood, used the USB drive to print the document in color, and had it bound into a booklet.
location: Pingyi Advertising, Copy, and Photo Shop, No. 55 Hui'an Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Set off early for the hot pot chicken restaurant
description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, the sun was scorching. Following my father's advice, I didn't take the electric scooter and hailed a taxi at the entrance of the residential complex. The air conditioning in the car was very strong, which made me feel much better immediately. Along the way, I chatted with the driver idly and watched the sun-blanched streets outside the window. Instead, I took out my notebook from my bag and began to organize the key points I would cover when presenting the tool later: first introduce the design concept, then demonstrate the core features, and finally leave time for questions. I also wrote down in advance a few questions Li Na might ask about the interaction logic, fully prepared.

We hadn't seen each other for more than four years, and seeing one another again was deeply moving. We ordered a large pot of the signature hotpot chicken and chatted while eating. We recalled climbing over the school wall to buy snacks in primary school and serving together as class representatives for the handicraft class, and laughter never stopped. We also talked about our careers: Li Na works as a UX designer in Shenzhen, Wang Lei does embedded development, and Chen Hao is a software engineer in Tianjin. Around 19:30, I took out my computer and showed Li Na the parametric tool. After reviewing it, she professionally pointed out that the interface was too much like engineering commands and suggested adding graphical previews, parameter dropdown menus, and operation hints. I carefully wrote down every suggestion in my notebook and felt very inspired. When the conversation was in full swing, Li Na proposed creating an old-friends group chat called “Shenzhen-Tianjin,” and I scanned the QR code on the spot to join.

Around 21:40, the taxi stopped at the entrance of the residential complex, and I walked home carrying the empty thermos and my bag.
location: In a ride-hailing car on the way back from Cangzhou Hot Pot Chicken Zhongbei Town Main Store, No. 18, ground-floor commercial unit of Xiqingyuan, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community on Zhongbei Avenue.

After revising each module, I tested it to make sure the logic was fine. Late at night, I finally completed the first improved version. After naming and archiving the old and new versions separately, I closed the computer with satisfaction. Then I went to the bathroom to brush my teeth, washed my face with cold water, lay in bed, thought back over the fulfilling day, set the alarm for 7 a.m. on Monday, and quickly fell asleep.

name: Arrived home to share the good news about the review.
