location: Living room at home, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Changing into casual clothes and dividing up the packing tasks
description: Ye Mingxuan changed into a loose old T-shirt and sweatpants, and discussed the packing division of labor with his parents: his father was responsible for the odds and ends in the living room and balcony, his mother for the remaining items in the bedroom and kitchen, and he himself for books, woodworking tools, and ancient coins.
location: Home living room and bedroom, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Systematically packing things for the move
description: Ye Mingxuan packed the professional books into cardboard boxes by size and labeled them "Study - Books," wrapped precision woodworking tools in bubble wrap and placed them in a medium-sized cardboard box, stuffing in newspaper for cushioning, and inventoried his ancient coin albums and appraisal tools, placing them in a lockable storage box labeled "Carry by self." His father helped gather personal items such as tennis rackets and a desk lamp, and his mother folded the remaining clothes into a suitcase and added mothballs to prevent dampness.
location: Home study and various rooms, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: Mother boiled frozen dumplings for dinner. While eating, Ye Mingxuan described the review process in detail. His father reminded him to pay attention to his posture when lifting heavy objects during tomorrow's move and not to strain his lower back.
location: Home dining room, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Packing up and checking the list
description: After dinner, continued packing. Eight cardboard boxes and two suitcases were lined up in the living room. Ye Mingxuan took out the 'Valuables Checklist' and checked one by one: the ancient coin album, laptop, certificates, portable hard drive, etc., confirming they had been placed in the 'carry-on' organizer box and backpack.
location: At home in the living room and all rooms, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Saying hello in the new neighbors group chat
description: Ye Mingxuan sent a message in the 'No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue New Home Owners Group' introducing himself as a resident of Building 2, Room 301, and said he would move in the next day. Several neighbors who had already moved in replied with welcomes. He replied to each politely and asked for their understanding in advance about the noise from moving.
location: Living room at home, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime personal tidying and washing up.
description: Ye Mingxuan put tomorrow's change of clothes and toiletries bag at the bedside, checked the latches of the 'self-carry' organizer box. Then notified the family group that packing was done and told everyone to rest early. Afterward, took a hot shower to relieve fatigue and blow-dried his hair.
location: Home bedroom and bathroom, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reading and forum browsing before bed
description: Lying in bed, he browses the Guquan Yuandi forum on his phone, checking and liking replies to yesterday's post. Feeling relieved that today's review passed, he then looks through the waist structure illustrations in Ming Furniture Research to plan for tomorrow's woodworking workshop.
location: Home bedroom, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going to bed
description: Set the alarm for 6:00 AM tomorrow, charge the phone, turn off the lights, and gradually fall asleep to the sound of rain outside the window, looking forward to moving into the new home tomorrow.
location: Home bedroom, Room 601, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine: washing up, appreciating ancient coins, breakfast, and health check
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ye Mingxuan got up, finished washing up, and did some simple stretching to relieve soreness in his shoulders and neck. Then he went to the study to admire his collection of ancient coins, examining the details with a magnifying glass. At seven o'clock, his mother prepared longevity noodles. Ye Mingxuan had breakfast with his parents and discussed the moving arrangements. After the meal, he measured his father's blood pressure; the reading was 136/86, which was stable, and he did a final check of the moving plan.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Finishing the move and putting furniture back in place
description: At 8 a.m. the moving company truck arrived downstairs. Ye Mingxuan and his father directed the workers as they unloaded and carried items, while his mother guided placing items in the designated locations in the new house to avoid damage. By 11 a.m., the last rosewood wardrobe was installed, and the move was wrapped up.
location: Outside Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and Room 202, Unit 1

name: Rest and hydration after the move
description: After seeing off the workers, the family rested on the sofa in the living room, and his mother poured plain water for everyone. Ye Mingxuan took a screenshot of the positive review he gave the workers and saved it. Everyone drank some water and took a short break.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Took my parents to Enlaishun Hotpot to celebrate a birthday.
description: Ye Mingxuan drove his Passat, taking his parents to the Meijiang Enlaishun Hot Pot Restaurant, about a 23-minute drive. In the reserved private room, they enjoyed traditional copper-pot instant-boiled mutton. He served food for his parents and apologized for missing an appointment last week due to work; his father said he understood. After lunch, they packed up the leftover ingredients and drove back to the new home along the same route.
location: Enlaishun Hotpot (Meijiang Branch), Suijiang Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Succulent placement and a midday rest
description: After returning home, Ye Mingxuan moved the succulent plants to the new plant stand, rearranged their positions, and watered some of them. Then he took a short nap in the master bedroom for about 40 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's sorting.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: The whole family divided up the tasks to tidy up the kitchen and master bedroom.
description: After the lunch break, the whole family divided the work: his mother folded clothes and spread out bedding; his father adjusted the wardrobe hinges; Ye Mingxuan put kitchen supplies back in place and arranged the seasonings neatly. After two hours of tidying, the new home started to feel more lived-in.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handled express parcels and personal hygiene
description: Ye Mingxuan picked up the package, took out the cabinet door damper his father had bought online, and placed it next to the toolbox. Then, since he had worked up a sweat from moving things, he took a quick shower and changed into clean clothes.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Preparing and Cooking a Simple Housewarming Meal
description: Ye Mingxuan took out the packaged lamb rolls and tripe to thaw, washed the lettuce and pea shoots, and prepared the cooking utensils. Then he tied on an apron and cooked, stir-frying the meat in the wok and stir-frying vegetables, while his mother helped on the side by handing him seasonings.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Plating and a casual meal for housewarming and birthday.
description: Ye Mingxuan set the dishes on the table, poured drinks for his parents, and adjusted the lighting. His father raised his glass and said, 'Boy, 26 years old, and what a housewarming! May your new home and new life rise higher and higher!' His mother said, 'Happy birthday, son. May you be healthy and safe!' The family had dinner together under the warm light.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Clean up the kitchen after the meal
description: Ye Mingxuan cleared the table, washed and dried the dishes, put them back in the cabinet, wiped down the stove and range hood, and the kitchen was restored to order.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Tidying up the study and logging into the game
description: Ye Mingxuan put the ancient coin collection box into the desk drawer, set up his laptop, and placed the books neatly on the bookshelf. He then logged into League of Legends, saw his friends Liu Yang and Zheng Kai online, and greeted them in the voice channel to warm up.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Teamed up with friends to play games and received a birthday skin
description: Ye Mingxuan, Liu Yang, Zheng Kai, and two teammates formed a five-person team for a gaming session. After the third round, Zheng Kai sent the 'Craftsman's Soul' skin, based on the beechwood cabinet from his Moments, as a birthday gift. Ye Mingxuan happily shared it on Moments; colleague Li Xiang commented with praise, and friends liked it one after another.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and stretching to relax.
description: After the game, Ye Mingxuan washed up and used a foam roller to stretch his legs in the living room, relieving the muscle soreness from moving.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime safety check and going to sleep.
description: Ye Mingxuan checked the doors, windows, and natural gas valve, turned off the computer, and set the alarm clock. He stood by the window looking at the neighborhood's night view, then drew the curtains, turned off the lights, and went to bed. The fulfilling day came to an end.
location: Room 202, Unit 1, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The alarm went off on time. Ye Mingxuan got up, opened the curtain to check the weather, and confirmed it was cloudy turning overcast. He drank half a glass of warm water, weighed in at 72.0kg, washed up briefly, and was in high spirits.
location: Master bedroom of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Preliminary planning for a balcony woodworking corner in the early morning.
description: Before breakfast, Ye Mingxuan took a tape measure and a laser distance meter to the balcony and carefully measured the dimensions. On the tablet, he used drawing software to quickly sketch the layout of the workbench and the three-tier tool storage rack, with the load-bearing wall position specifically marked. He planned to check the tools moved in yesterday, confirming that the handsaw, plane, and chisel were all there. He also found a folding umbrella in the balcony drawer for later use.
location: China, Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, Building 5, Unit 2, south-facing balcony of the new home

name: Family breakfast and a brief conversation.
description: His mother, Wang Xiulan, reheated the copper-hotpot broth and hand-cut lamb that had been packed up yesterday, and cooked a pot of plain rice porridge. Ye Mingxuan had breakfast with his father, Ye Jianguo, and his mother. At the table, Ye Mingxuan told them today's plan: first visit Master Qian to discuss the community handicraft class, and then go to the neighborhood committee to finalize it. His father nodded in agreement, and his mother told him to get things done efficiently.
location: New home dining room, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Tidying up and preparing to set out.
description: Ye Mingxuan went back to the study, took out the smart home kit that had arrived yesterday (smart speaker, smart bulb, security camera), checked the accessories, and placed it on the living room coffee table, ready to install it in the afternoon. He also put the ancient coin box back on its designated layer of the bookshelf. Then he slung on his crossbody bag, took his phone, keys, and notepad, and got ready to go out.
location: Study and living room of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Cycling to Master Qian's home
description: Ye Mingxuan scanned the QR code at the entrance of the residential community to unlock a shared bike, rode west along Zhongbei Avenue to Liuxia Road, and then turned toward Master Qian's old bungalow. The morning air was slightly humid; the ride was about 4 kilometers, which he treated as a warm-up.
location: On the bike ride from Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, to Liuxia Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District.

name: Visit Master Qian and accept the community teaching recommendation
description: Ye Mingxuan arrived at Qian's Woodworking Workshop, where Master Qian Jianguo was sanding the edges of a small rosewood box with fine sandpaper. Master Qian got straight to the point, saying that the community residents' committee wanted to recruit a lead instructor for a youth handicraft class and considered Ye Mingxuan the most suitable candidate. Ye Mingxuan remembered he had agreed to something similar earlier in the year, so he readily accepted and thanked Master Qian for his trust. Master Qian reminded him that the first class should emphasize safety precautions, especially the proper use of power tools. The two then talked about the move and the progress of the smart home setup, and Ye Mingxuan said that at least the woodworking corner could be set up today.
location: Qianji Woodworking Workshop, Liuxia Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China (inside Master Qian's single-story house)

name: Go to the community committee to discuss teaching matters.
description: Ye Mingxuan said goodbye to Master Qian and rode a shared bike back to his own residential community. After parking the bike at the designated spot downstairs, he walked to the cultural and sports activity office on the second floor of the neighborhood committee and talked face-to-face with Director Li, who was in charge of cultural and sports activities. Director Li introduced the community's expectations: two trial lectures in autumn, each 1.5 hours, for teenagers aged 8 to 12. The community would provide a classroom with a projector and long tables, but he needed to bring his own tools. Ye Mingxuan used the memo app on his phone to record details such as course duration, student age range, and classroom configuration, and promised to prepare the course outline and send it to Director Li for review. The communication went smoothly, and he felt this was something he could use his strengths for.

participant.name: Director Li
participant.relation: Person in charge of cultural and sports activities at the neighborhood committee

location: Office for Cultural and Sports Activities, Second Floor, Neighborhood Committee, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Chatting with neighbors on the way home
description: Ye Mingxuan walked home from the neighborhood committee office. In the central garden of the residential complex, he ran into his neighbor Aunt Wang, who was returning from her walk. Aunt Wang greeted him warmly and asked about the move. Ye Mingxuan politely replied that the move was done and invited Aunt Wang to come over for a visit when she had time. The two chatted briefly about the move and the weather, and the neighborly relationship was harmonious.
location: Central Garden, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Arriving Home and Pre-Noon Preparation
description: After Ye Mingxuan arrived home, his mother was already preparing lunch in the kitchen. He took the tools for the previously planned balcony carpentry corner (tape measure, electric drill, level, etc.) out of the toolbox and laid them out in advance, getting ready for the afternoon setup.
location: New home: Building 5, Unit 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch and afternoon rest
description: Lunch was simple: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and some leftover mutton packed from yesterday. His mother Wang Xiulan started nagging again about Ye Mingxuan's personal life. Ye Mingxuan skillfully changed the subject, bringing up the community handicraft class he had arranged that morning; both parents were very supportive. After the meal, Ye Mingxuan scrolled through his phone for a while on the living room sofa. Noticing the sky outside gradually clouding over, he decided to take a 15-minute nap to recharge, since the afternoon would be busy.
location: Dining room and living room of the new home, Building 5, Unit 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon rain shower interrupted the shopping trip
description: At 1 p.m., Ye Mingxuan grabbed his umbrella and rode his bike to the Xinjin Road convenience hardware store nearby, intending to buy some metal fittings and expansion screws. He had just ridden out of the community onto Zhongbei Avenue when, in less than five minutes, the sky suddenly changed and large raindrops began pelting down on him. He quickly turned the bike into the shelter of the eaves of a roadside convenience store. Twenty minutes later, the rain gradually lightened, but the weather forecast said there would be scattered light rain in the afternoon. He decided not to wait any longer, turned the bike around and went home, planning to use the fittings he already had at home first.
location: Under the eaves of a convenience store on Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Set up a woodworking corner on the balcony
description: After returning home, the rain had basically stopped. Ye Mingxuan changed into his work clothes and moved the solid wood workbench from the corner of the living room to the balcony to position it. He used a tape measure to determine the position of the rack, drilled holes with an electric drill, installed expansion anchors and screws, and fastened the custom metal rack to the wall. Then, from the toolkit, he took out a hand saw, a plane, a chisel, and a file and hung them in order of frequency of use; he also sorted different grades of sandpaper and glue into the two drawers beneath the workbench. His father, Ye Jianguo, came over to help pass tools and lift boards, and nodded with satisfaction when he saw the neat tool wall. Finally, Ye Mingxuan placed a small succulent bought from Caozhuang Flower Market on one corner of the workbench, adding some life to the woodworking corner.
location: South-facing balcony of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Whole-house smart home system installation and commissioning
description: After basically completing the woodworking corner, Ye Mingxuan moved the smart devices from the living room coffee table to the master bedroom. First, he replaced the light sockets in the master bedroom and living room with smart bulbs with adjustable color temperature. Then he opened the mobile app, paired the devices one by one, and tested voice control of the switch and brightness adjustment. Next, he placed the smart speaker in the center of the TV cabinet, adjusted the sound quality and wake-up settings, and played a Deyun Society cross-talk performance to ensure the sound was clear and free of noise. Finally, he went to the entry door and installed the security camera in the corner above the door frame. After powering it on, he set up motion detection alerts through the app. His father Ye Jianguo watched with great interest. Ye Mingxuan invited his father to try it. His father smiled and said, 'Turn on the light.' The living room ceiling light lit up immediately, and his father was amazed.
location: New home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China (living room, master bedroom, second bedroom, entrance door)

name: Wrapping up and tidying things back into place
description: After all the smart devices were set up and debugged, Ye Mingxuan cleaned up the packaging boxes, tools, and remaining accessories and put them into the storage cabinet. He wiped the workbench and the surfaces of the smart home devices with a damp cloth. He opened the balcony window for ventilation to let the smell of sawdust and glue dissipate. Looking at the afternoon's results, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: New home at Building 5, Unit 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Evening posts and ancient coin exchange
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his study, turned on the computer, transferred the photos he had taken that day of the woodworking corner and smart home devices to his phone, and wrote a nine-grid WeChat Moments post with the caption: “The first step in the new home, the fusion of technology and craftsmanship. A fulfilling weekend.” He published it. Then he took out his keys, opened the small drawer in the bookcase, took out the several ancient coins he had acquired yesterday, photographed details of the edge teeth and patina with a macro lens, and sent them via WeChat to Zhao Jianguo, a collector friend in Xi'an, along with a voice message: “Old Zhao, take a look at this Guangxu Yuanbao minted in Jiangnan Province. The patina looks interesting, but I'm not sure about the edge teeth.”
location: Study room in the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner and casual conversation.
description: At dinner, my mother, Wang Xiulan, made several home-style dishes: fish-flavored shredded pork, stir-fried cabbage, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family ate and chatted. Mother asked about the progress of the community handicraft class, and Ye Mingxuan said it was going well and would start in September. Father, Ye Jianguo, exchanged woodworking tool maintenance tips with Ye Mingxuan, suggesting buying some walnut oil to maintain the plane. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan sat in the living room with his parents and watched the news for a while.
location: Dining room and living room of the new home, Building 5, Unit 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Reading alone and delving into hobbies.
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to the study, took out Ming-style Furniture Research from the bookshelf and continued reading. While flipping through the plates, he sketched a few diagrams of the 'mitred corner tenon' joint in his notebook, thinking about whether he could put it into practice in next year's woodworking projects. When he got tired of reading, he went back to the living room and played a crosstalk performance by Deyun Society on the newly installed smart speaker, enjoying the comfort of his new home.
location: Study and living room of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Replying to messages and organizing the checklist.
description: Ye Mingxuan received likes and joking comments from his friends Zhou Tao and Li Xiang on his new WeChat Moments post, and replied to each one. Collector friend Zhao Jianguo sent a message giving a positive evaluation of that Jiangnan Province coin, and suggested taking another close look at whether the stroke style of the four characters 'Guangxu Yuanbao' was a bit soft. Ye Mingxuan created a new Excel spreadsheet on his computer to organize the key points from the handicraft class he learned today at the neighborhood committee, listing key information such as the outline for 'Children's Woodworking Safety Operation Guide' and the list of tools participants need to bring, in preparation for future lesson planning.
location: Study room in the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Ye Mingxuan took a shower in the bathroom to wash away the day's fatigue and sawdust. After changing into pajamas, he did some simple stretching and relaxation in the bedroom to soothe his muscles. He drank a little water and plugged in his phone to charge.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Reading and bedtime
description: Ye Mingxuan lay in bed, reading the last few pages of "Ming-style Furniture Research." When he felt drowsiness coming on, he closed the book. Thinking about today's experiences - connecting with the community, completing the woodworking corner in his new home, and getting the whole-house smart system in place - he felt a sense of accomplishment. He turned off the light at 22:40 and got ready for sleep, recharging for the new work week starting tomorrow.
location: Master bedroom of the new home, Unit 2, Building 5, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning preparation and heading to the subway station
description: Got up hastily at 8 a.m. and found the alarm hadn't gone off. Having stayed up late the night before and slept only about five and a half hours, I felt groggy. Quickly washed up, shaved, weighed 71.9 kg, and changed into a gray T-shirt and dark blue work pants. Took frozen buns and soy milk out of the fridge, ate while packing the commuter bag. Then went downstairs, scanned a shared bike at the community gate, rode about 8 minutes to Caozhuang Metro Station, locked the bike and entered the station. The wind along the way helped shake off some drowsiness.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Metro commute and work reflection
description: After entering the subway, he stood at the junction between carriages, put on noise-cancelling headphones to block out the noise, and used the commute time to sort out the day's work plan in his head: confirm the approval status of the fixture trial production report and think about the newly assigned design task. He transferred from Metro Line 2 to Line 3 and arrived at High-tech Zone Station after about 45 minutes.
location: From Caozhuang Station on Tianjin Metro Line 2 to Gaoxin District Station on Line 3 (transfer via Yixingfu Station)

name: Arrive at the office and prepare for the morning design work.
description: After getting off the subway, he walked about 8 minutes to the company, swiped his access card, and went to his workstation on the 3rd floor. He brewed strong tea to refresh himself, then opened his computer and logged into the company document system. He found a comment from Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan from yesterday at 17:21, saying that the fixture trial-production report contained detailed data and could serve as a basis for mass production, which made him feel reassured. Then he opened SolidWorks and began a new task: designing a flexible gripping fixture for special-shaped parts. He conceived the structure, sketched rough drawings, and considered materials and pneumatic drive. He performed parametric calculations for the clamping force requirements, initially selected a cylinder with a 20 mm bore, and realized that incoming material deviation required a floating compensation mechanism. He noted down the issues to be resolved.
location: 3rd Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Design Optimization and Discussion with Colleagues
description: After building the basic model in SolidWorks, I tried two approaches for the floating compensation mechanism: a spring plunger and a cross slider. I discussed it with my colleague Li Xiang via WeChat Work. Li Xiang suggested using the slider approach and recommended consulting the Machine Tool Fixture Design Manual. After checking the manual, I decided to use the slider approach, preparing for the next step of detailed design.
location: 3rd Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: I went to the company cafeteria for lunch with colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang; there were braised pork ribs and other dishes. While eating, I shared the good news that the fixture report had passed the review. Zhou Tao praised it, and Li Xiang asked about mass-production costs. During the chat, Zhou Tao complained that it had rained on the weekend and he hadn't gone running by the river, while Ye Mingxuan mentioned that he was tired from moving. The three chatted casually, which strengthened their bond as colleagues.
location: Company cafeteria, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon design work and deliverable organization
description: After lunch, felt a bit drowsy and splashed cold water on his face to refresh himself. Continued refining the floating compensation mechanism design, adding cross-slider groove details in CAD, and considering machining costs, leaving a message to consult a colleague in the manufacturing department. After finalizing the plan, spent nearly two hours organizing the design calculation process and preliminary plan into a document, and captured a structural schematic, preparing for the next day's project meeting. Finally, archived all files and set reminders. Stayed focused throughout to ensure progress on the task.
location: 3rd Floor, Tower B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: End-of-day wrap-up and driving home.
description: At 16:30 he began tidying up his workstation and turned off the computer and monitor. He briefly reported the day's design progress to the senior engineer via WeChat Work. At 17:00 he put on his backpack and chose to drive home, which was faster than the subway. A light rain was falling. The drive took about 25 minutes, and he arrived at the underground garage of Huating International Community around 17:30.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Received a friend's gift and shared the joy
description: After entering the unit building, he spotted an SF Express insulated box sent from his friend Zheng Kai in Shenzhen, containing specialties such as fresh sea urchin, dried shrimp, and dried scallops, along with a note wishing him a happy birthday. He carried it home joyfully and opened the box. After unboxing, he arranged the sea urchin and dried shrimp on a plate, took an overhead photo with his phone, and posted it on Moments with a caption thanking him. Then he sent Zheng Kai a 35-second voice message to express his thanks. Zheng Kai replied with a laughing emoji and hinted there would be another surprise next week. He felt warm and moved.
location: Room 602, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: His parents were at home; his mother was cooking and his father was watching the news. He showed them the seafood gift. His father reminded him not to eat too much, and his mother said she would make dried shrimp porridge another day. The whole family sat together for a homely dinner: stir-fried broccoli, tomato scrambled eggs, and braised beef. During the meal they talked about work progress and settling into the new home, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Room 602, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Watching TV and tasting dried shrimp.
description: After the meal, he cleared the dishes and chopsticks, then watched TV with his parents in the living room. CCTV Sports Channel was rebroadcasting Olympic competitions. He casually picked up the dried shrimp a friend had sent, opened the package, and tasted them. They were salty, fragrant, and crispy, and he thought they would go well with congee. While watching TV, he ate three or four. He did not notice any discomfort.
location: Room 602, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Sudden severe allergic reaction and emergency treatment at the hospital.
description: About ten minutes after eating the dried shrimp, his face suddenly felt a prickling itch. Looking in the mirror, he found large red hives on his face and neck, and felt difficulty breathing and a blocked throat. He immediately called for help. Seeing this, his father immediately called 120. Paramedics arrived about 15 minutes later, provided oxygen and monitoring, and made a preliminary diagnosis of a severe seafood allergy. His mother brought her medical insurance card and phone, and helped Ye Mingxuan into the ambulance with his father, heading to Xiqing Hospital. On the way, his condition did not improve, and he kept using oxygen, feeling panicked and shaken inside.
location: Room 602, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Emergency diagnosis and urgent treatment.
description: The ambulance arrived at the emergency department of Xiqing Hospital and sent him directly to the resuscitation room. Based on the symptoms and food history, the doctor diagnosed an acute severe allergic reaction and immediately administered an intramuscular epinephrine injection and intravenous antihistamine drip. About half an hour after the injection, the red rash on his face gradually subsided, his breathing became calmer, and the feeling of pressure in his throat eased. His mother and father waited anxiously in the corridor, and only felt a little relieved when they saw his condition stabilize.
location: Emergency Department, Xiqing Hospital, Liuxia Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Staying under observation and taking leave to rest
description: Moved to the emergency observation ward, needing continued monitoring for 2-4 hours to prevent delayed reactions. He was connected to a monitor, and an IV cannula in his left hand was infusing the third group of medication. His mother stayed by the bed to comfort him. He decided to completely change his diet management. At 23:30, he sent a WeChat message via his phone to project manager Wang Peng to request half a day of leave. Wang Peng quickly replied with understanding and concern. Afterwards, under the effect of the medication, he gradually fell asleep, ending the eventful day.
location: Emergency observation ward, Xiqing Hospital, Liuxia Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: In the morning, treat the rash and reassure the family.
description: Ye Mingxuan woke up in the master bedroom; it was cloudy outside the window. He rolled up his sleeves and noticed a few pale red rashes on the inside of his arm. The itching was lighter than last night but had not completely subsided. He walked into the living room, where his mother was ladling out white rice porridge and his father was sitting on the sofa watching the morning news; his father looked at him with concern as he came out. He first applied calamine lotion to the rashes; the cool feeling temporarily suppressed the itching. Then he sat down and drank a small bowl of white porridge, declined pickled vegetables and boiled eggs, and explained to his parents that he was avoiding allergenic foods according to the doctor's orders.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (master bedroom to living room)

name: Checked succulents, browsed new books, and gathered medical appointment documents
description: After finishing the porridge, Ye Mingxuan went to the balcony to water the succulents and check the leaves, then picked up the newly arrived 'Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Structures in Ming and Qing Furniture' and flipped through a few pages of diagrams on the 'shoulder tenon' and 'corner tenon' joints, warming up for designing the handicraft class outline in the afternoon. Then he returned to the bedroom, put his medical insurance card, medical records, and ID card into the canvas bag, and brought a light jacket in case the hospital air conditioning was too cold.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (from balcony to study)

name: Took a taxi to Xiqing Hospital.
description: Ye Mingxuan hailed a taxi at the entrance of the residential community and went to Xiqing Hospital, a ride of about 14.9 minutes. On the way, he looked at the street scene through the window and mentally planned the things he needed to do today: a follow-up visit, picking up medicine, a blood draw, and also sending a message to comfort his friend Zheng Kai, and applying to his supervisor Wang Peng for full-day remote work.
location: Emergency Department entrance, Xiqing Hospital, south side of Xiqing Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin (starting from the entrance of Huating International Community)

name: Hospital follow-up, treatment, and blood draw, while handling work and social matters in parallel
description: After arriving at the emergency department of Xiqing Hospital, Ye Mingxuan registered and waited to see a doctor. The doctor reviewed last night's emergency record and this morning's skin rash, determined it was a continuation of the acute allergic reaction, prescribed oral antihistamines and a topical ointment, and arranged a blood draw for a serum allergen-specific IgE test. While waiting in line at the blood collection window, he sent a text message via WeChat to Manager Wang Peng explaining last night's acute allergy and attaching the emergency medical record, requesting to work remotely for the rest of the day, which was approved. He also sent a voice message to Zheng Kai explaining that the allergy was caused by eating the dried shrimp Zheng Kai had sent; Zheng Kai apologized repeatedly, and he reassured him that it was okay. After the blood draw, he picked up his medicine at the pharmacy and rested in the waiting area.
location: At Xiqing Hospital on the south side of Xiqing Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin: emergency department consultation rooms, waiting area, and the second-floor blood collection window.

name: On the way home, reported to my mother that I was safe and bought some groceries.
description: After leaving Xiqing Hospital, Ye Mingxuan took a taxi home. On the way, he called his mother, briefly explained the diagnosis, saying that a blood test for allergens showed the doctor believed it was caused by seafood and had prescribed medication, and told her not to worry. After hanging up, he asked the taxi to stop at Liangtian Fruit and Vegetable Store (Building 19, Huating International) at the entrance of the neighborhood, got out and bought half a kilogram of greens, a piece of old tofu, and a few tomatoes, planning to have light vegetarian dishes for both lunch and dinner.
location: Liangtian Fruit and Vegetable Store (Huating International Branch), Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (en route from Xiqing Hospital to the residential community)

name: Walk home
description: After buying groceries, Ye Mingxuan carried the bags and walked back to the apartment building. The weather was nice, and the green belts in the community were neatly trimmed.
location: Inside Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (from Ziliang Sweet Fruit and Vegetable Shop to Building 9, Unit 2)

name: Had lunch and discussed the week's menu with his mother.
description: After arriving home, Ye Mingxuan handed the vegetables to his mother, who quickly made stir-fried greens, tomato and tofu soup, and white rice. While eating, he pulled up his phone memo and, together with his mother, made a list of foods to avoid for the coming week: no shrimp, crab, shellfish, sea fish, or trigger foods such as chives, beef, or mutton; staple foods should be mainly rice, noodles, and porridge; eat more seasonal vegetables; and temporarily use chicken and pork as substitutes for meat. His mother wrote it down and planned to go to Caozhuang Vegetable Market the next day to buy according to the list.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (restaurant)

name: Midday nap
description: Half an hour after the meal, Ye Mingxuan took an oral antihistamine, and the effect made him feel noticeably drowsy. He drew the bedroom curtains, set an alarm for 13:05, lay down on the bed, and soon fell asleep, conserving energy for the afternoon.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (master bedroom)

name: Get up and prepare for remote work
description: After the alarm rang, Ye Mingxuan woke up, rubbed his eyes, went to the bathroom to wash his face with cold water, prepared one dose of medication for the afternoon in a portable pill case, then walked into the study holding a thermos cup and turned on the desktop computer and desk lamp.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (master bedroom to study)

name: Design trial-lesson outlines for two sessions of the community handicraft course.
description: In the study, Ye Mingxuan opened a blank Word document and designed the outline for the community handicraft class, referring to the illustration on page 42 of the Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Structures in Ming and Qing Furniture and online woodworking tutorials. The first session is themed "Understanding Wood and Making a Small Wooden Spoon": it covers the smell, grain, and hardness of five common types of wood, demonstrates the sanding process, and introduces liquid paraffin oil for maintenance. The second session is themed "Advanced Small Furniture — Your Own Little Stool": it introduces right-angle tenon and cross lap joint structures, uses 3D model screenshots to demonstrate assembly steps, and lists tools and consumables. Around 15:30, he sent the draft link to Director Li via WeChat and raised several suggestions about venue ventilation and child safety.
location: In front of the computer in the study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Rest, walk around, and reply to messages from collector friends and colleagues.
description: Ye Mingxuan stood up and walked to the balcony to stretch, and he noticed that the succulents were in good condition. Back in the study, he picked up his phone and checked WeChat: his coin-collecting friend Zhao Jianguo had sent a link to a thread on the Ancient Coin Garden forum about the varieties of the Yuan Datou silver coins from the 9th year of the Republic of China. He opened and read it, then replied with an emoji and a brief comment. His colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang also sent greetings, and he briefly replied, "Much better, working remotely from home, thanks for your concern."
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (balcony, study)

name: Walked around the neighborhood and organized his thoughts on work.
description: After sitting for a long time, his lower back felt stiff. Ye Mingxuan changed into running shoes, went downstairs, and walked for about 15 minutes on the path in the central garden of the residential complex. A gentle breeze was blowing, and the itching from the rash eased a bit. As he walked, he mentally outlined the framework of the project summary report he would write in the evening: process parameters, test data, modification records, simulation result attachments, and so on. His thoughts gradually became clearer.
location: Central garden footpath, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Dinner and chatting with parents.
description: Dinner was made by his mother according to the light diet plan Ye Mingxuan had drawn up: garlic choy sum, stir-fried tofu, served with millet porridge and corn segments. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan mentioned the blood draw at the hospital today. His father nodded and said, 'Once they’ve checked everything, we can feel at ease.' His mother mentioned that his aunt Wang Xiufang wanted to come visit on the weekend. Ye Mingxuan quickly said not to make her take a special trip—he would go see her in Nankai once he recovered. The family chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was much more relaxed than the previous evening.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (restaurant)

name: Light entertainment and housework after the meal.
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan sat on the living room sofa and scrolled through his phone. He browsed the Ancient Coin Garden forum, saw several valuable replies under a post shared by Zhao Jianguo, and bookmarked them. He then checked the second-hand apartment in Xiqingyuan previously listed on the Fang.com app, whose status was still "No viewing yet." After that, he got up, gathered his and his family's dishes, and rinsed them clean at the sink.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (living room and kitchen)

name: Complete the summary report for the precision fixture project.
description: Once he focused, Ye Mingxuan sat down at his desk, opened the company document management system, and compiled the project summary report for the trial production of precision fixtures. He pulled up the simulation analysis report that his colleague Li Xiang had done last week, copied the key parameter screenshots and conclusion section as an attachment; filled in the processing parameters, modification records, and dimensional measurement data from January to August into Excel according to the process log timeline, and generated a line chart; finally wrote the main body of the report, analyzing item by item the reasons for tolerance adjustments at key stations and proposing improvements. Around 20:00 he finished the final draft. After reading through it to check, he uploaded it to the document library and informed Manager Wang Peng via WeChat. Wang Peng replied, “Received, thanks for your hard work.”
location: In front of the computer in the study, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Finalize the handicraft course outline and soak feet and apply medicine.
description: After submitting the report, Ye Mingxuan reviewed the afternoon's outline document, added a line to the "small wooden spoon" section about sandpaper grit recommendations (progressing from 80 grit to 240 grit), then saved the final version and sent it to Director Li. Afterwards, he went to the bathroom and soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes, while browsing the Guquan Yuandi forum on his phone to read Zhao Jianguo's new coin appraisal post. After soaking, he dipped a cotton swab in calamine lotion and carefully applied it to the old and new rashes on his arms and abdomen; the itching was temporarily brought under control.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (study and bathroom)

name: Leisure activities in the evening.
description: After changing into home clothes, Ye Mingxuan sat on the living room sofa and continued reading The Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Structures of Ming and Qing Furniture under the balcony floor lamp, focusing on the chapters on the pipe-bowl tenon and round-member frame joinery, and took a few photos with his phone for later use. He then thought about playing a game, but seeing that League of Legends had an update and considering that he had not fully recovered, he exited and instead logged into WeChat Reading to listen to a half-hour history podcast. After listening to two chapters, he got up and went to the bathroom to brush his teeth with mouthwash.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (living room, study, bathroom)

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After brushing his teeth, Ye Mingxuan briefly rinsed his face with warm water and applied a small amount of anti-allergy ointment to his forehead and the back of his neck. Back in the bedroom, he set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning, fluffed the pillow, and placed a glass of warm water on the nightstand. Before turning off the light, he looked at the rash on his arm by the light of his phone flashlight. Most of it had faded, leaving only a few light red marks, and he believed tomorrow would be better.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (bathroom and master bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Ye Mingxuan turned off the light and lay down, and the bedroom went dark. Reviewing the day, the doctor's visit, reporting that he was safe, the design outline, and submitting the report had all been completed smoothly. He closed his eyes and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 9, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (master bedroom bed)

name: Morning routine: getting up, washing up, applying medicine, and breakfast
description: Ye Mingxuan woke up to the alarm. Because the rash on his arms and face from last night had faded but left pigmentation, he carefully washed his face with warm water, then applied a thin layer of calamine lotion in the mirror. The forecast predicted sunny and hot weather, 32°C. He thought about buying groceries after work to make dinner for his parents. After washing up, his mother handed him warm millet porridge and a boiled egg, and again reminded him to avoid seafood. Ye Mingxuan smiled and nodded in agreement. His father quietly put some fermented bean curd on his plate, and the family chatted warmly.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to the office.
description: Ye Mingxuan habitually glanced at the weather forecast. After confirming that it would feel muggy in the afternoon, he closed the bedroom window and went downstairs. He drove from Huating International Community, took Zhongbei Avenue, turned onto West Outer Ring Road, then onto Fukang Road, and arrived at Haitai Development Building in about 16 minutes. Along the way, he listened to traffic radio and organized his work priorities for the day.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning work: workstation preparation and design modifications.
description: After arriving at the company, Ye Mingxuan first brewed a cup of green tea, opened his computer, and checked his email. Then he took out his phone and, referring to the handicraft class outline, went through the teaching materials list item by item, including more than ten items such as a small saw, sandpaper, and wood glue. He marked the prepared and to-be-purchased items in his memo, planning to go to the hardware market on the weekend to replenish. After that, he focused on modifying the dimensions of the locating pin in the fixture structure, adjusting the tolerances in CAD according to Senior Engineer Gao's comments. Midway, he took the drawings to colleague Li Xiang to discuss the force calculations, and after confirming everything was correct, he sent the revised version to Senior Engineer Gao before 11:00.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: At noon, Ye Mingxuan deliberately avoided the seafood counter in the company cafeteria and went with his colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to a malatang restaurant in Tiankai Huayuan Technology Park for lunch. The three chatted while eating. Zhou Tao complained about the client’s ever-changing requirements, Li Xiang shared an interesting mechanical structure video he had seen the night before, and Ye Mingxuan also mentioned the Python tech salon he would attend on the weekend. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Malatang restaurant, 290 m east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work and study activities
description: After returning to his workstation, Ye Mingxuan logged into the bimonthly technical salon page of the Python community, filled in the information to register for the offline event held at a maker space in Nankai District on August 23. Then he opened the family financial analysis Python script he had written, sorted through the data scraping and visualization modules, and prepared to make a PPT. Feeling tired, he leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for ten minutes. After waking up, he browsed the Ancient Coin Garden forum and left a comment on the condition of a Xuantong large-size coin. In the afternoon, his main focus was improving the project document for the flexible gripping fixture for irregular parts, checking the simulation report, updating the technical instructions, organizing the assembly drawing list, and before archiving, he handled two urgent emails and replied to project manager Wang Peng's confirmation about tomorrow's meeting.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Contact the fitness trainer and report early leave from work
description: Ye Mingxuan called Wang Jian, his trainer at Limei Fitness Center, to say that this week's personal training session needed to be suspended because the severe allergic reaction on August 18 had not fully recovered. Coach Wang understood and told him to rest well. Afterward, he tidied his workstation, notified his supervisor via the internal messaging software that he needed to leave half an hour early due to feeling unwell, and after getting approval went downstairs to leave.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Buy ingredients after work and head home
description: Ye Mingxuan drove for 16 minutes and arrived at Wangzhuangzi Dongxingli Vegetable Market. Following the no-seafood principle, he avoided the aquatic products area and selected pork belly, pork ribs, cucumbers, tomatoes, and eggs. When passing the seasoning section, he saw a light soy sauce on special offer. He only glanced at the price and the brewing label, grabbed a bottle without thinking, and completely ignored the ingredient list. Afterwards, he walked 16 minutes back to his home in Huating International Residential Community, greeted his mother, who was picking vegetables, put the meat and vegetables into the refrigerator by category, and placed the newly bought soy sauce on the kitchen counter.
location: Dongxingli Vegetable Market, Wangzhuangzi, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take a short rest and change into loungewear
description: Ye Mingxuan changed into comfortable loungewear, sat on the living room sofa for a while, casually browsed the news on his phone, and relaxed briefly.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare dinner together with parents.
description: Ye Mingxuan put on an apron, walked into the kitchen, and took on the task of cutting vegetables: he smashed and chunked the cucumber and cut the tomatoes into wedges. Mother used the pork belly he bought to make her signature braised pork, and Ye Mingxuan seasoned the dish with the new bottle of soy sauce, full of anticipation. Father was organizing newspapers in the living room and occasionally poked his head in to ask if help was needed. The family interacted between the kitchen and living room, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner together and rest after the meal
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. After tasting a piece of braised pork, the mother praised the soy sauce for the nice color it gave, and Ye Mingxuan felt rather pleased. After the meal, he leaned back on the sofa and browsed the news on his phone, feeling a faint, barely noticeable drowsiness.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Sudden delayed allergic reaction
description: At about 19:40, Ye Mingxuan suddenly felt a tingling itch on his face. He subconsciously scratched it, only to find large red wheals spreading across his face in an instant. Then his arms, chest, and back also became unbearably itchy as if ignited. His heart tightened, and he immediately felt tightness and a foreign-body sensation deep in his throat, making it hard to breathe.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Father called 120 and waited for the ambulance.
description: The allergic symptoms worsened sharply within minutes, and the laryngeal edema intensified as Ye Mingxuan began to wheeze. His mother turned pale with fright, and his father, Ye Jianguo, dialed 120 without hesitation. While waiting, Ye Jianguo forced himself to stay calm, followed the dispatcher's instructions to have Ye Mingxuan sit upright and lean forward to ease breathing, and kept reassuring him.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Ambulance transport to hospital and emergency treatment with observation
description: The ambulance arrived quickly. The paramedics put an oxygen mask on Ye Mingxuan, established intravenous access, and asked about his allergy history. His father, Ye Jianguo, accompanied him in the ambulance and followed all the way to the emergency department of Tianjin People's Hospital. The emergency physician quickly diagnosed anaphylactic shock and immediately administered intramuscular epinephrine, oxygen therapy, and intravenous fluid resuscitation. Half an hour later, his vital signs gradually stabilized, the laryngeal edema eased, and the rash began to fade. However, Ye Mingxuan still felt extremely weak and was transferred to the emergency observation ward, where he was placed on a cardiac monitor. During this period, the doctor carefully asked about the dinner ingredients. When the bottle of discounted light soy sauce was mentioned, his father went home and took a photo of the ingredient list. In the photo, the phrase "oyster extract" was clearly listed. Looking at it, Ye Mingxuan felt a wave of fear and regret. His father decided to stay in the hospital to accompany him. Ye Mingxuan lay on the hospital bed, listening to the steady beeping of the cardiac monitor. His body was exhausted but his mind was clear, and he deeply realized his severe allergy to seafood derivatives and his negligence in daily life details. He spent a sleepless night in the observation ward.
location: Emergency Department, Tianjin People's Hospital, 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Wake up, wash up, and get ready
description: At 8 a.m., he woke up in the emergency observation ward of Tianjin People's Hospital, washed up, organized the examination reports, and sent a message to the project manager informing him of the hospitalization.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Attending doctor's rounds and confirmation of the patient's condition.
description: The attending physician, Director Wang, led the resident doctor Xiao Li on ward rounds, checked the rash regression, reviewed the complete blood count report, informed that vital signs were stable, suggested that discharge might be possible after a blood recheck tomorrow, and explained precautions regarding the aftereffects of laryngeal edema, advising avoiding strenuous exercise for one week after discharge. Dr. Li helped organize the monitor leads and instructed bed rest.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Communicate about work matters online
description: Logged into the company system on my phone to check project messages, communicated with colleague Li Xiang on WeChat about the dimensional tolerances of the fixture design, explained in detail the tolerance requirements for the mating surfaces, and emphasized that if there is assembly interference, photos can be taken for online troubleshooting. Browsed the lunch invitation in the colleague group chat and replied that I couldn't attend because I was hospitalized.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Joint consultation by the allergy department
description: Walked to the allergy department consultation room on the 5th floor, and held a joint consultation with community family doctor Liu Wentao and Dr. Li Min from the allergy department. Described in detail the timeline and symptoms of the two allergic reactions. Dr. Li performed a skin prick test; fifteen minutes later, the results showed shrimp strongly positive and sea urchin mildly positive. It was confirmed that shrimp is the main allergen and sea urchin causes cross-allergy, and both shrimp and sea urchin must be avoided for life. Used a phone memo to record the dietary restriction list, and Dr. Liu helped check it. After the consultation, walked back to the ward.
location: Allergy Consultation Room, 5th Floor, Tianjin People's Hospital, 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin.

name: Hospital lunch and midday rest
description: In the ward, he ate the hospital meal: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, plain congee, and steamed pumpkin. After eating, he leaned back against the headboard and browsed the Guquan Yuandi forum on his phone, replying to fellow collector Zhao Jianguo's discussion about silver dollar varieties from the General Mint. Then he put down his phone, closed his eyes, and took a half-hour nap.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Browse tutorials for community handicraft classes
description: After the lunch break, I prepared for the weekend handicraft class material shopping. I searched on Bilibili and saved two tutorial videos: one on safe woodworking for children and one on sanding techniques for small wooden spoons. Using my phone's memo, I recorded the quantities and online prices of consumables to buy, planning to send the purchase plan to Director Li of the handicraft class for confirmation after discharge.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Learn how to self-inject with an epinephrine auto-injector
description: Allergy department nurse Huang Ling came to the bedside and taught using an epinephrine auto-injector training simulator. She demonstrated the steps: remove the safety cap, hold the pen, point the orange end downward, press firmly against the outer thigh, and hold for 10 seconds. Under her guidance, he practiced three times on a thigh model and gradually became proficient. The nurse helped him add the key operation mnemonics and the note to call 120 after the injection to the memo app on his phone.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Leisure and socializing
description: After studying, he sent a WeChat voice message to his friend Zheng Kai, telling him that the dried shrimp had caused an allergic reaction and hospitalization, and asked him not to send any more. Zheng Kai called back, and they talked for more than ten minutes. Ye Mingxuan gave him a detailed account of the new allergy conclusion, reassured him, and reminded him to check the ingredient list on light soy sauce. Then he chatted with collector friend Zhao Jianguo on WeChat about the diagnosis. Zhao Jianguo expressed his sympathy and suggested ordering from a reliable takeout place when he was too absorbed in his work to eat. He walked slowly in the ward corridor to get some exercise, and went to the hot water room to fetch hot water.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin, and the corridor

name: Organizing first aid notes and sharing them with family
description: Back in bed, he consolidated the consultation conclusions, the dietary restriction list (with special notes on shrimp and shrimp derivatives, sea urchin, and seasonings containing oyster sauce or fish sauce), and the mnemonic for using the epinephrine auto-injector, and created the memo Ye Mingxuan Allergy First Aid Manual v1.0. He condensed it into an illustrated text summary and forwarded it to the family group chat Happy Family, adding a message to reassure his parents not to worry.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Rest and reading the mortise-and-tenon joint pictorial
description: Before his parents' visit, he leaned against the headboard reading the electronic edition of the Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Structures of Ming and Qing Furniture, flipping through the chapter on the Bawang Cheng brace, immersed in traditional woodworking wisdom.
location: Bed 10, Area A, Emergency Observation Ward, Tianjin People's Hospital, No. 190 Jieyuan Road, Hongqiao District, Tianjin

name: Parents' visit and dinner

Then walked with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to the Time-Honored Malatang restaurant in Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, and the three had lunch together, talking about the handicraft class and the follow-up arrangements for the badminton team finalized last night. He felt the satisfaction of having everything under control. Then he went to the balcony, watered the succulents lightly, checked their leaves, and used only half the usual amount of water because the weather was humid.

Used the iPad to plan tomorrow's to-dos: go to the woodworking workshop in the morning to discuss drawings with Master Qian, and research the newly acquired ancient coins in the afternoon. name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm rang, and Ye Mingxuan turned over and got out of bed. Outside the window was a typical early-autumn rainy day in Tianjin, feeling slightly cool. He habitually weighed himself: 70.5 kg, consistent with previous data. He put on a dark gray sports T-shirt and running pants, stuffed a towel, water bottle, and notebook into his sports bag, and got ready for the team's first training session.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Breakfast and departure greetings

He chatted briefly with his father, telling him he was going to the gymnasium of the University of Technology for the team's first training and would be back home for lunch. His father nodded and told him to be careful.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drive to the sports hall.

name: The badminton team's first training session.

As captain, Ye Mingxuan gathered everyone for a brief introduction, then had the more skilled members lead the warm-up. He was still in the allergy recovery period, so he did not participate in intense play; instead, he spent the session observing the basic swing drills and tactical explanations. He took out his notebook and quickly sketched position diagrams, recording each person's forehand clear hitting habits, footwork rhythm, and reaction speed. He found that two members had solid fundamentals, while the other four needed correction starting with how they held the racket. Before the end of training, he organized everyone into a WeChat group and shared next Saturday's training schedule and court rotation plan.
location: Badminton Hall, Tiangong University Gymnasium, No. 399 Binshui West Road Extension, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove home
description: After the training ended, it was still drizzling. Ye Mingxuan drove back, thinking about next week's training plan on the way.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: After getting home, he sorted the laundry that had piled up over the week into the washing machine, poured in laundry detergent, and set it to the standard wash plus air-dry mode. While the washing machine was running, he used the vacuum cleaner to carefully clean the living room floor, and put odds and ends on the coffee table—including his father's blood pressure medicine bottle and the remote control—back in their proper places. After he finished, the washing machine had just completed its cycle, so he took out the clothes, hung them one by one on the balcony drying rack, and switched on the ventilation mode.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: His mother went to visit relatives, and his father watched TV in the living room. Ye Mingxuan cooked by himself: he found two tomatoes, two eggs, and a bundle of dried noodles in the fridge, and there were also pickled cucumbers his mother had made beside the stove. He skillfully boiled water, blanched and peeled the tomatoes, scrambled the eggs, and cooked the noodles. A steaming bowl of tomato egg noodles with pickled cucumbers was refreshing and appetizing. After the meal, he checked the fridge and confirmed that the milk had not expired, the frozen shrimp were still well packaged, and there was no unusual smell.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: Feeling a little sleepy after lunch, he took a 30-minute nap on the living room sofa. After waking up, he picked up his phone and saw that Xu Ming had shared a technical post about database performance optimization in the group. He tapped in to browse it and saved the link for later optimization work.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

He first swept the sawdust away with a brush, then took out the handsaw, chisels, and plane irons from the toolbox one by one, carefully wiped them with a cotton cloth, and applied a thin layer of anti-rust oil. Next, he rearranged the tool rack layout, placing the most-used medium handsaw and two chisels on the right, and measuring tools such as the vernier caliper and try square on the left. During the adjustment, he found that the handle of the fine-toothed small saw was a bit loose, so he found a screwdriver and tightened it until it felt right in hand. The whole maintenance process made him feel grounded.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

He picked up his phone, opened a previously saved article about the China Guardian 2025 autumn ancient coins special auction, carefully read the transaction prices and condition descriptions of a few coins of interest (such as Xianfeng Zhongbao and Guangxu Yuanbao), and briefly noted some market trends in his memo.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Ye Mingxuan followed his line of thought and added analysis from the perspectives of tolerance fitting and torque transmission. He opened his personal electronic diary document and began to focus on reviewing August. In his diary, he wrote that this was a month of 'upheaval and reconstruction': in the middle of the month, he moved into a new home, experienced the fright of a seafood allergy, completed adjustments to his investment portfolio, successfully transformed his woodworking skills into a community public welfare course, formed the department badminton team, broke through the technical bottleneck of the crawler database, and also started his first open-source project. He recorded these weighty gains and marveled at his dual growth in body and mind. Finally, he wrote an ending: 'September begins with the first sound of the saw in the community classroom, and also with the first pull request on GitHub.'

After washing up, he checked his phone and confirmed that he had no meetings to worry about the next day. Lying in bed, he briefly browsed the updates from other developers in the "DataTools" project group without commenting. At 22:20, he put down his phone, turned off the bedside lamp, and the last night of August slowly came to an end in peace and contentment.

After a quick wash and waking himself up, he noticed it was fine weather outside — clear with some clouds — so he put a folding umbrella into his commuter bag. Then he did about 5 minutes of dynamic stretching in the living room, including shoulder circles and lunge twists, to wake up his sedentary body. After stretching, he returned to the bedroom and changed into work clothes: a dark blue polo shirt and khaki casual pants.

Ye Chen told his father that today was his first day as head of the technical task force. His father calmly advised him to stay patient, listen first, and then decide, which made him feel much more at ease. Later, his mother Wang Xiulan served breakfast: millet porridge, pork and scallion buns, and boiled eggs. When she heard that Ye Chen had become the team leader, she was delighted and asked with concern whether he would come home for lunch. name: Arrival and pre-kickoff meeting work preparation
