Senior Engineer Gao, based on past casting failure cases, pointed out the risk of stress concentration at the connections and suggested adding reinforcing ribs; Zhou Tao, from an assembly perspective, suggested that the threaded hole positions needed fine adjustment to ensure wrench clearance. Throughout the session, modification priorities were recorded, and it was decided to first implement Senior Engineer Gao's comments and complete the initial modifications that afternoon.
location: Small meeting room, 7th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Organize meeting minutes and move forward with initial revisions
description: Back at his workstation, he organized the review meeting notes into structured minutes, specifying the person responsible for each modification and the estimated completion time. Then, following the senior engineer's feedback, he made parametric modifications to the design model in SolidWorks, adding rib features and adjusting thickness to form an initial version, planning to send it to the senior engineer for confirmation in the afternoon.
location: 7th Floor Office, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Efficient lunch and return to the office.
description: I quickly went downstairs with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang and headed to the usual malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park. We quickly selected vegetables, tofu, and luncheon meat, finished lunch in a few minutes, and meanwhile asked Li Xiang about the preliminary technical parameters of three special steel materials. After the meal, we immediately walked back to the company workstations to prepare for the afternoon's work.
location: Malatang shop, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, Tianjin

name: Core afternoon tasks: steel material selection and progress on design modifications.
description: At 12:30, he started the afternoon work by proactively contacting Li Xiang to obtain the complete simulation report. At 13:20, he called the newcomer Wang Qiang to the workstation, showed key data confirming that the ordinary alloy steel did not meet the fatigue life requirement, and then organized a comparative discussion on the machinability and cost of three candidate special steels. They preliminarily settled on high-chromium nickel alloy steel, and Wang Qiang was assigned to compile the supplier quotation list and technical documents for that steel before this Friday. He then continued to systematically refine the structural modifications from the morning review, deepened the design drawings based on Senior Engineer Gao's comments, and at 15:30 sent a progress report email to Senior Engineer Gao with new model screenshots attached.
location: 7th Floor Office, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prepare and drive to the badminton gym
description: To avoid the evening rush, he packed his training gear in advance, checked the badminton racket strings, and tidied himself up. At 16:10 he drove from the company's underground parking lot to Xiaoyu Badminton Hall at No. 58 Jintang Road, Hedong District, playing music to relax on the way; the drive took about 25 minutes.
location: On the way from the underground parking lot of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Fazhan 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Xiaoyu Badminton Hall, No. 58 Jintang Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Badminton training
description: After arriving at Xiaoyu Badminton Hall, I met up with the department team members. First, I led everyone in reviewing the grip and swing power-generating postures learned last week, then conducted 15 minutes of fixed-point multi-ball feeding drills. Afterward, we split into groups for half-court rally practice while I walked around the court giving guidance, focusing on correcting problems such as new members using too much arm strength and having an unstable core. I reminded everyone to watch their exercise pace and avoid injury. The actual amount of exercise was about 45 minutes.
location: Xiaoyu Badminton Hall, No. 58 Jintang Road, Hedong District, Tianjin

name: Return after training and go back to the office to wrap things up.
description: Training over, he took a quick shower and changed clothes, then drove back to Haitai Development Office Building. He returned to his desk at 17:55, browsed the afternoon's new emails, confirmed that Senior Engineer Gao had replied saying the revision direction was correct, put away his racket bag, and shut down the computer, ending the day's work.
location: From Xiaoyu Badminton Hall, No. 58 Jintang Road, Hedong District, Tianjin to the office on the 7th floor of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Return home after work, help prepare dinner, and have family dinner.
description: Left the company by car at 18:10, relaxed listening to piano music along the way, and arrived home at 18:30. Greeted my mother who was busy in the kitchen, explained that I was a bit late because I had been playing ball. Then washed my hands and helped peel garlic and pick vegetables. After my father came back from his walk, the three of us had dinner together, enjoying braised hairtail, garlic broccoli, and rice. During the meal, I shared the good news that the review had gone smoothly and the material selection had been finalized; my father was in a good mood.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Repairing the old electric fan with his father
description: After a short rest following dinner, I repaired the faulty desk fan together with my father. We moved the fan to the coffee table in the living room, disassembled the safety guard and fan blades, cleaned the accumulated dust from the shaft, and dripped sewing machine oil on it for lubrication. I turned the blades repeatedly to let the oil spread evenly. After plugging it in, the motor ran normally and the blades spun smoothly. My father contentedly recalled his early years repairing large machine tool fans in the factory, and the family atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal interest time and skill recharge
description: After putting away the repair tools, he returned to the study, turned on the computer, and entered the key characteristics of the Yuan Shikai portrait silver coin, Republic of China Year 3, Xinjiang edition, into his cloud notes for ancient coin collecting. Then he took out the Sandalwood Material Atlas and flipped through the ebony chapter to supplement content for Sunday's handcraft class trial lecture, and on the flyleaf he noted down teaching preparation remarks about the use of hardwood grain, immersing himself in personal hobbies and part-time skill accumulation.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-sleep preparation, daily review, and rest
description: At 21:30, he started washing up. At 22:00, he returned to the living room and used a simple notes app on his phone to review the day: work and material selection progressed as planned, badminton training went well, and family time was satisfying. Then he planned the next day's priorities: organize the revised design drawings and reply to client emails. At 22:30, he turned off the living room lights, returned to the bedroom, turned off the lights on time, and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Home (study, living room, bedroom), Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning activities at home
description: At 6:30 a.m., the alarm went off on time. I got up, opened the curtains, and confirmed the good weather: sunny turning cloudy. Then I did some simple stretching in the bedroom. I went into the bathroom, washed my face with cold water to wake up, brushed my teeth thoroughly, shaved, and followed my daily skincare routine. My mother, Wang Xiulan, had breakfast ready in the dining room: millet porridge, boiled eggs, meat buns, and pickled vegetables. As I ate, I browsed last night's industry news on my phone and checked the weather forecast, noticing that the UV index would be strong in the afternoon. After the meal, I helped my mother put the dishes into the kitchen sink, then went back to my room and packed my commuter bag with the ancient coin storage box, laptop, CATIA dongle, notebook, fountain pen, power bank, and the epinephrine auto-injector I always carry. After checking that everything was in order, I put on my work jacket.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving commute and entering the company.
description: I drove my white Volkswagen Lavida out of the underground garage of Huating International Residential Community, drove west along Zhongbei Avenue, turned onto Haitai Development Sixth Road, and headed for Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. Traffic was smooth along the way; I turned on traffic radio to follow road conditions, while mentally reviewing the day's core task — optimizing the airflow channel with CATIA freeform surfaces. After arriving, I parked in my fixed space on the basement level, took the elevator to the first floor with my briefcase, swiped my card through the gate, nodded to the security guard, and entered the office area.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District

name: Morning work: preparation and CATIA advanced surface modeling
description: After arriving at my workstation, I first filled my thermos with hot water and brewed Tieguanyin tea, then turned on the computer, logged into the internal system, and quickly scanned unread emails. Next, I pulled up the sketch model and review records completed yesterday and launched CATIA. I put on headphones and played white noise, fully immersing myself in free-form surface modeling. Based on the review comments, I created control points in the software, adjusted surface curvature, and repeatedly optimized the shape of the runner inner wall to reduce turbulence effects. I spent the entire morning in deep focus, barely leaving my seat except to drink water, and finally made smooth progress on the core task.
location: Workstation, Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., Office Tower A, Haitai Development, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Confirm progress and have lunch with colleagues
description: After saving the work file, I stretched my stiff shoulders. Seeing that progress was going well, I asked my colleague Zhou Tao via WeChat about lunch plans. Then I went with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to the first-floor cafeteria, which was serving my favorite braised pork ribs and scrambled eggs with tomatoes today. After the meal, considering the forecast of strong afternoon UV rays, I deliberately went to the convenience store downstairs and bought an iced lemon tea and a box of sliced watermelon as dessert.
location: Canteen on the 1st floor of Haitai Development Office Building A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the convenience store downstairs

name: Lunch break walk
description: The three of them did not return directly to the office. Instead, they walked along the green belt in the company campus, breathing fresh air and discussing the afternoon's simulation arrangements. Zhou Tao mentioned that Li Xiang had already prepared the CFD tasks and was only waiting for the numerical model to be ready. After the walk, I returned to my workstation, lay down on the desk for a 20-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: The area around Haitai Development Office Building A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon: finalizing CATIA optimization.
description: After a refreshing lunch break, I continued with CATIA modeling, completed the smoothing of the remaining surfaces, and thoroughly checked the model's integrity and engineering parameters. At exactly 14:00, I clicked save on time, packaged the optimized 3D model files, and prepared for the handover.
location: Company workstation, Office Building A, Haitai Development, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Hand over the model and assist with CFD simulation verification.
description: I took the USB drive to Li Xiang's workstation, copied the CAD model file to him, and explained the key geometric features of this optimization. Li Xiang immediately imported the model into Fluent software, set the boundary conditions and turbulence model, and started the calculation. I stood by watching the progress, feeling both nervous and eager to see the verification results.
location: Li Xiang's workstation at the company, Haitai Development Office Building A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Simulation result analysis, reporting, and material selection review.
description: The CFD calculation finished, and the results showed that the turbulent kinetic energy in the airflow passage dropped by about 22%, exceeding expectations. Li Xiang gave me a thumbs-up. I quickly organized the key data and contour plots, then called Wang Qiang to go with me to Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan's office to report. After carefully reviewing the report, Engineer Gao was very satisfied with the results, praised them on the spot, and agreed to incorporate the optimized design into the overall plan. Then I took the opportunity to present the pre-prepared material selection report for the high-chromium-nickel alloy steel, and organized a 15-minute quick review with Engineer Gao, Li Xiang, and Wang Qiang. Engineer Gao signed to confirm approval.
location: Gao Zhiyuan's office and workstation, Office Building A, Haitai Development, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Writing the design report and tidying up before leaving work
description: Back at my workstation, I struck while the iron was hot and systematically organized the design approach, before-and-after optimization comparisons, simulation data, component selection results, and review comments into a PDF technical report. After carefully proofreading it twice to ensure the parameters were correct, I uploaded it to the project management system and sent an email copying manager Wang Peng and engineer Gao Zhiyuan for archiving. Then I shut down the computer, tidied my desk, chatted briefly with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang beside me, agreed to continue next week, and ended the day's work with a sense of accomplishment.
location: Company workstation, Office Building A, Haitai Development, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving home
description: I set off from the company's underground garage, drove along Haitai Development Sixth Road and turned onto Zhongbei Avenue, and drove back to Huating International Residential Community in the glow of the sunset. Along the way, I turned off the radio and enjoyed the peace and relaxation after work.
location: From Haitai Development Office Tower A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District

name: Family dinner and after-dinner chat
description: As soon as I entered the house, I smelled the aroma of food. My mother, Wang Xiulan, had made steamed sea bass, braised pork, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. At the dinner table, I happily shared today's work breakthrough with my parents, Ye Jianguo and Wang Xiulan. My father nodded approvingly repeatedly, while my mother kept putting food on my plate. After dinner, I voluntarily cleared the dishes, then sat with my parents on the living room sofa, watching TV news while listening to my mother talk about what she had seen at the market and my father mention the recent situation of an old colleague.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal interest: cleaning and researching ancient coins
description: Walking into the study and turning on the desk lamp, I took out the small Republican-era copper coin I had found last night from the desk drawer, put on white gloves, gently brushed away the surface dust and rust with a soft brush, then carefully examined the coin's patina, inscriptions, and casting technique under a magnifying glass. I opened a dedicated notebook, recorded the coin's condition features and my preliminary judgment, and casually drew a brief sketch.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Contacted a childhood friend to plan a trip to Ancient Culture Street on the weekend.
description: After carefully putting it back into the storage box, I picked up my phone and sent a WeChat message to my childhood friend Zhang Wei, inviting him to go to Ancient Culture Street on Saturday afternoon to browse around and hunt for ancient coins to relax. Zhang Wei readily agreed, and the two then chatted on a voice call for nearly half an hour, venting about this week's work stress and bosses, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, and finally settled on the exact meeting time.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Learning the application of Python in mechanical design.
description: Still wanting more, I turned on my computer, clicked into a saved tutorial video, put on my headphones, and carefully watched the chapter about parametric part model generation with Python. While watching, I typed the sample code along in the code editor, practicing generating simple models myself and broadening my technical horizons.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Relaxation and shower
description: After finishing a study session, I went to the living room to drink a glass of water and do some light stretching. Then I went to the bathroom and took a comfortable hot shower, washing away the day's fatigue, changed into pajamas, and got ready for bed.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and evening reading
description: Comfortably lying in bed, I first checked tomorrow's weather and the route to Ancient Culture Street on my phone, set the alarm, and placed the cloth bag of ancient coins on the shoe cabinet by the door. Then I scrolled through the simulated cloud images saved in my phone gallery today, feeling a surge of accomplishment again. After that, I picked up Ming and Qing Furniture Woodworking Structures from the bedside and read it intently, fully absorbed.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Falling asleep
description: At 23:00 I turned off the bedside lamp on time, closed my eyes, and reviewed today's fulfilling and efficient work and warm family time. With a sense of satisfaction, I soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Early morning walk with father by the river
description: After waking up naturally, Ye Mingxuan changed into his workout clothes and walked with his father Ye Jianguo to the bank of the South Canal near the residential community. The two walked slowly along the river for about 1.5 kilometers; the morning breeze was slightly cool. His father brought up the ad for the mortise-and-tenon class he had seen yesterday, and Ye Mingxuan shared the course link he had found online. His father suggested practicing with old wood from home first, and the two set an initial direction for the afternoon woodworking.
location: Along the South Canal in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (Zhongbei Avenue section, near Huating International Community)

name: Returning home, washing up, and family breakfast
description: After the walk, Ye Mingxuan returned home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. His mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared breakfast, including millet porridge, jianbing guozi, and boiled eggs. The family of three sat around the table. Ye Mingxuan shared the discussion with his father about carpentry training; his mother expressed support and said she would make three-delicacy dumplings at noon.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Strolled around Caozhuang Flower Market to buy succulents and accessories.
description: After breakfast, Ye Mingxuan drove to Caozhuang Flower Market at 08:35. At his usual regular succulent stall, he picked out four excellent potted succulents — two variegated Black Rose succulents, one White Bear, and one Laul — and then went to the hardware section to buy 10 stainless steel wood screws and a box of self-tapping screws, preparing materials for the afternoon balcony plant stand, for a total of 82 yuan.
location: Caozhuang Flower Market, 260 meters northeast of the intersection of Feixia Road and Yuhe Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Balcony cleanup and flower stand fabrication and installation
description: After arriving home at 09:48, Ye Mingxuan put the newly bought succulents in a shaded spot and began clearing out the clutter on the balcony. He organized the out-of-season flowerpots and cartons, freeing up a 1.2-meter-wide work area along the east wall. His father, Ye Jianguo, took the initiative to hand him tools and reminded him to use a spirit level to make it even. Ye Mingxuan nailed together a two-tier shelf using leftover pine strips and drilled holes with an electric drill, while his father helped hold the boards upright to ensure they were vertical. At 10:50 the main frame was completed, and at 11:20 it was fixed to the east wall. After finishing, he rearranged the old succulents and new potted plants, and the east side of the balcony was completely transformed. His father was full of praise.
location: Balcony at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch.
description: His mother, Wang Xiulan, brought out dumplings with three-delicacy filling. Seeing the brand-new balcony, she repeatedly praised Ye Mingxuan for his improved craftsmanship. Ye Mingxuan ate two plates of dumplings, and his father, Ye Jianguo, also made an exception and drank a small glass of erguotou to celebrate. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan promised to set up a few wall-mounted flower pots next week.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal and clearing the table, Ye Mingxuan went back to the bedroom, lay down, set an alarm for 13:15, and rested quietly with his eyes closed for half an hour to conserve energy for visiting the Ancient Culture Street in the afternoon.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Hunting ancient coins, tasting snacks, and catching up with Zhang Wei on Ancient Culture Street.
description: At 13:25, Ye Mingxuan drove to Ancient Culture Street. He arrived at the North Gate parking lot around 13:55, sent a WeChat message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, and they met under the opera stage. The two strolled along the main street hunting for treasures. At the "Jubao Zhai" stall, Ye Mingxuan patiently picked through the items and finally negotiated 160 yuan for a well-preserved Yuan Datou silver dollar from the third year of the Republic of China and three Qing dynasty copper coins. Zhang Wei also spent 30 yuan on a small copper coin as a pendant, and they exchanged insights on collecting. Later, they bought classic sour pear cake at the roadside "Sister Yang's Cooked Pear Cake" stall, then each ordered a bowl of tea soup brewed from a dragon-mouth brass kettle at "Tea Soup Li". They ate and chatted; Ye Mingxuan vented about the project progress, Zhang Wei griped about the heavy overtime at his new job, and they agreed to find time next week to have hot pot.
location: Ancient Culture Street, Nankai District, Tianjin (main street, near the opera stage, Jubaozhai, Sister Yang's Shuli Gao, Chatang Li, etc.)

name: On the way back, stopped by to buy crucian carp.
description: At 16:35 he left the parking lot, and Ye Mingxuan drove back. At 17:00 he arrived at Wangzhuangzi Dongxingli Market in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, and bought 1.5 jin of live crucian carp and a bunch of cilantro to add a crucian carp soup to dinner.
location: Dongxingli Vegetable Market, Wangzhuangzi, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Helping in the kitchen and family dinner
description: After getting home, Ye Mingxuan gave the crucian carp to his mother to clean, while he took charge of picking cilantro, peeling garlic, and mixing the vinegar dip. He also put the screws and leftover wood bought during the day into the toolbox. Dinner was braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and crucian carp and tofu soup. The family chatted while eating. Ye Mingxuan showed photos of his newly acquired ancient coins on his phone. His father was very interested in the Yuan Datou silver coin, and his mother talked about tomorrow's menu.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Post-meal chores and resting in the living room
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan was in charge of washing dishes, wiping down the stove, and taking out the trash. Then he brewed a pot of jasmine tea, sat with his father in the living room to watch the second half of Xinwen Lianbo, and listened to his father comment on international news.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: In the evening, sorted and cleaned ancient coins and recorded the collection.
description: Ye Mingxuan entered the study, took out the Yuan Datou silver coins and Qing Dynasty copper coins he had found during the day, used a soft brush to clean the loose dirt on the surface, and carefully wiped them with a small amount of anhydrous ethanol. Then he used the phone's macro lens to take high-definition photos of both sides, and entered them into the Excel collection database by year, variety, and condition. Finally, he posted on the Ancient Coin Garden forum: 'Small Harvest on Saturday, September 6, 2025, at Ancient Culture Street', and @ed teacher Zhao Jianguo to ask for authentication.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Free leisure time: watching videos and playing games.
description: Ye Mingxuan first watched a woodworking tutorial video on Bilibili about the structure of a Luban lock (25 minutes), studying the internal mortise-and-tenon design. Then he logged into League of Legends on the living room TV and played two ARAM rounds with college roommates Liu Yang and Zhao Xiaofeng, winning the first by skill and losing the second due to team composition issues.
location: Study/living room at home in Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: After turning off the computer, Ye Mingxuan took a shower, washed his face, dried his hair, and put on pajamas. In the memo on his phone, he noted down the dimensions of today's balcony flower stand so that he could buy hardware fittings next time. He set the alarm for 8:00 a.m. tomorrow and planned to go to Master Qian's carpentry workshop. He turned off the lights and lay down before 11:00 p.m., relaxed, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Tianjin, Xiqing District, Zhongbei Town, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, home bedroom

name: Waking up in the morning, going for a morning run, and contacting suppliers
description: The phone alarm went off. I turned over and dismissed it. Outside the window, the sky was already bright but the clouds were thick. My body still felt heavy, but I got up decisively, put on running shorts and a T-shirt, and wore my earphones and armband. Then I left the community and headed to Lvshuiyuan Park. After stretching at the park entrance, I jogged 2 km along the circular track, keeping the pace at around 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, I encountered an elderly person walking a dog and nodded in greeting. After the run, I walked home. In the living room, I contacted the wood supplier by phone and learned that the ordered pine offcuts would be delayed until the next afternoon. I expressed my thanks and agreed on a pickup time. Then I showered and washed up. My mother had prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, peanuts with aged vinegar, and pork buns. I ate while thinking about the morning plan.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning personal affairs and ancient coin sorting
description: After breakfast, I called Mr. Li, a community worker, and sincerely discussed postponing the originally scheduled public-interest class by one week, citing that the wood materials had not arrived. Mr. Li agreed and set it for 9:30 a.m. on September 13. After hanging up, I told my father, who was reading the newspaper. Then I took out the Yuan Datou silver dollar from the third year of the Republic of China and two Qing Dynasty copper coins I had picked up yesterday. I lightly brushed off the dust with a soft brush, used a cotton swab dipped in warm water to wipe local areas and bring out the patina layers, and took high-definition macro photos with my phone for reference. After that, I asked my mother about her rehabilitation care appointment time. She said firmly that it was set for 2 p.m. on the 13th, and that Dr. Liu is hard to book, so it could not be changed. I silently noted it. Back in the study, I opened my laptop and proactively canceled my registration for an advanced workshop, writing in the remarks, “Having experienced it is enough; focusing on the present matters more.” I felt much lighter.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Remote collaboration: finite element analysis and document organization
description: I opened my laptop, connected to the company server via VPN, called my colleague Li Xiang on Tencent Meeting, and began finite element analysis on a key structural component. I pointed out the stress concentration areas; Li Xiang adjusted the mesh density. After several iterations, we decided to add transverse ribs at the weak spots. Li Xiang ran the final simulation, which showed that the maximum principal stress decreased by about 15%. We did a brief review and agreed to run the full model again on Monday. After the simulation, I struck while the iron was hot and compiled the optimization process, parameters, simulation comparison screenshots, and conclusions into a document titled "XX Component Finite Element Analysis Optimization Record". I then logged into the company collaboration board and updated the corresponding task from "Under Simulation Verification" to "Pending Archival", adding the key conclusions.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch preparation and family meal
description: I walked into the kitchen and saw my mother trimming chives, so I took over and helped her wash the vegetables, chatting about next week's plans. I mentioned that when hauling lumber tomorrow afternoon, I could stop by and buy some small succulents. Mother agreed, saying there was still room on the balcony shelf for another pot. Lunch was hearty; Mother made her signature braised pork, stir-fried greens, and tomato and egg soup. The three of us sat around the table. I poured jasmine tea for my father, Mother praised me for being quick with the morning chores, and Father said we would study the old table saw together in the afternoon.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and balcony afternoon tea
description: After the meal, I cleared the table and then sat on the living room sofa. I opened the "Ancient Coin Garden" forum app and saw that under yesterday's post about the Yuan Datou coin, "Quanhai Sanren" had replied that the patina was natural and it was a genuine piece that was "obvious at a glance". I was in a good mood. Then I made a cup of jasmine tea, carried it to the small round table on the balcony, and leaned back in the chair. Outside the window, the sky soon darkened, and large raindrops pattered down. The thundershower arrived as expected. I drank tea and watched the rain, while the succulent leaves on the balcony were dotted with water droplets, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Household tidying and repairing the table saw.
description: After the rain let up, I returned to the study and used the vacuum cleaner to clean the sawdust off the workbench, wiped the chisels and saws clean and put them back in the tool box, neatly arranged the books on mechanical design and Ming and Qing dynasty furniture, and placed the newly bought succulents in a suitable spot on the windowsill. Then my father and I carried the old table saw from the storage room to the balcony. My father pointed out that the blade guard latch was loose, so I found a hex wrench and carefully adjusted the bolt. We also studied the variable-speed function of the hand drill together. He then sent messages on the OA system to colleague Li Xiang and quality inspector Wang Qiang, agreeing to meet at the quality inspection room at 9:00, and organized last Friday's design report. At exactly 9:00, he arrived at the quality inspection room, and the three began sampling the steel and conducting mechanical performance tests. Wang Qiang operated the equipment, Ye Mingxuan closely watched the data, and Li Xiang took notes. The tests showed that both yield strength and impact toughness failed to meet the standards. Ye Mingxuan requested repeated retests with consistent results, immediately took photos and videos as evidence, arranged for Li Xiang to notify the procurement department and Zhou Tao, and took the preliminary report to report to the manager.

Manager Wang asked to immediately activate the emergency plan, with Ye Mingxuan leading the search for replacement suppliers. Lao Liu from the purchasing department provided contact information for backup suppliers. After returning to his desk at 11:00, Ye Mingxuan quickly opened the "Emergency Supplier Directory" Excel file and, combining the recommendations of engineer Gao Zhiyuan and the purchasing department's list, sorted out 6 qualified manufacturers. Working with Li Xiang, he quickly searched the supplier database and Qichacha for their scale, reputation, and reviews, and shortlisted 4 most promising key targets.
location: Manager Wang Peng's office and Ye Mingxuan's workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Afterward, he went to the employee shower room for a quick shower and change of clothes. When he returned to his workstation, he found two missed calls from suppliers and immediately called back on the landline to communicate preliminary intentions.

location: Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop, 28 Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Visit Master Qian, present tea, and learn his craft.
description: At 18:05, he arrived at the woodworking workshop, where Master Qian Jianguo was sanding a square stool with mortise-and-tenon joints. Mingxuan gave him a Longjing tea gift box and wished him a Happy Teachers' Day. Master Qian happily accepted it. The two chatted in the studio about the upcoming mortise-and-tenon training class. Master Qian pulled out hand-drawn blueprints from his youth and told stories about the hardships and joys of learning the craft. Mingxuan was captivated and felt the weight of passing on the craft, then took the initiative to help Master Qian organize his tools.
location: Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop, 28 Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving home
description: At 19:20, he said goodbye to Master Qian and drove back along the same route. The sky was getting dark, and a soothing piano piece was playing in the car. On the way, he called his mother Wang Xiulan to tell her he would be home soon for dinner.
location: Along the route from Liukou Road, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town.

name: Family dinner
description: Arrived home at 19:45, and my parents had already prepared dinner. The meal included stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised fish fillets, and tomato and egg soup — nutritious and delicious. Mingxuan had a good appetite and ate two big bowls of rice. At the table, we talked about Master Qian's craftsmanship and today's work details, and his parents listened with great interest.
location: Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Making tea for my father and discussing the Double Ninth Festival outing.
description: After the meal, Mingxuan took out the newly bought Longjing tea, brewed a cup for his father Ye Jianguo in a glass cup, and made one for himself. The father and son sipped tea and chatted; his father praised the tea's good aftertaste. Taking the opportunity, Mingxuan proposed that they go together to Panshan Mountain in Jizhou to enjoy the red leaves for the Double Ninth Festival. His father said it was feasible, and his mother added that they should bring dry provisions and thermos cups. The three discussed the general itinerary.
location: Living room, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure time watching TV.
description: Accompanied his parents in the living room watching CCTV News Channel, following reports on Teachers' Day activities across the country and technological innovation, occasionally exchanging a few words about the news.
location: Living room, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal research and organization of ancient coins
description: Returning to the study, he took out the Yuan Shikai silver dollar from the third year of the Republic of China and the Qianlong Tongbao from the Qing Dynasty that he had picked up last weekend. He carefully wiped them with a soft cloth, observed the details with a magnifying glass, and photographed them to record in the "Ancient Coin Collection Log" in his phone memo. Then he turned on his work computer and further refined the "Python_Toolkit" folder he had created at noon, creating three subfolders: core functions, automation cases, and study notes.
location: Study, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Writing a diary and preparing for sleep.
description: He sat back down at the desk, took out his diary, and recorded today's reflections from conversations with his supervisor, the senior engineer, and Master Qian, as well as the warmth of the family dinner. He wrote, “Today is the most fulfilling day since I caught a cold; I felt the power of being respected and cared for.” Then he went to wash up and get ready for bed.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Bedtime reading
description: Leaning against the headboard, he read the chapter on "Republican-era silver dollars" in the Illustrated Guide to Ancient Coin Collecting, focusing on the variant features and authentication methods of "Yuan Datou" silver coins.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Turned off the lights at 23:15, reviewed the day's events, felt peaceful and fulfilled, and fell asleep looking forward to the Double Ninth Festival outing.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Early morning exercise and breakfast.
description: Woke up at 06:20 to the classic Nokia ringtone. The cold had healed, weight 69.8kg. After getting up, drank warm water and completed a 15-minute home stretching routine for the hips and iliotibial band. While washing up, took along 'Illustrated Study of Ming and Qing Furniture'. Then had breakfast with mother Wang Xiulan, eating millet porridge, jianbing guozi, and boiled eggs, and took vitamin C. Mother reminded that it would rain in the evening; checked and brought a folding umbrella. Confirmed the rehabilitation care appointment for Saturday at 2 p.m. Picked up the commuting bag and umbrella and got ready to go out.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute by car
description: He drove out of the underground garage of Huating International Community, headed along Zhongbei Avenue, and listened to traffic radio. Along the way, he thought about the morning's mentoring plan and considered how to weave the senior engineer's point about viewing supplier certificates dialectically into the discussion. It took about 40 minutes to reach the parking lot of Building A at the Haitai Development Office Building.
location: Route from Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building A, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Arrive at work, prepare, and mentor new hires
description: I swiped my card to enter the office on the 3rd floor of Building A of the Haitai Development Office Building. After making coffee, I processed three emails. I reported the afternoon prototype functional testing plan to Engineer Gao Zhiyuan, who approved it and reminded me to record the data. Then I took the newcomer Wang Qiang to small meeting room 315 to explain the force analysis of a cantilever beam. I covered four methods, but Wang Qiang had difficulty understanding the moment of inertia and kept asking similar questions. I felt frustrated inside but held back my temper. When I explained for the third time, I slowed down and drew a cross-section diagram.
location: Office and Meeting Room 315 on the 3rd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Took a short break to clear my mind and calm down.
description: Frustrated by the setback in mentoring, he used the excuse of fetching materials and went downstairs alone to the small garden at Haitai Innovation Park. He sat on a stone bench to rest for 10 minutes, took deep breaths, and played a round of Happy Elimination to distract himself, thinking about how to teach from a different angle.
location: Small garden, Haitai Innovation Park, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize materials and internal communication
description: Returned to his workstation, adjusted his mindset, and prepared for the afternoon supplier communication: printed the key technical clarification points for Tianjin Hengda and Hebei Yuanda and the key pages of the “Interim Assessment Report on Alternative Suppliers for Special Steel.” Called Manager Wang Peng and arranged to meet in person at 3 p.m. to discuss internal technical assessment matters, emphasizing the urgency of prototype testing. Meanwhile, colleague Li Xiang came over to discuss next week's project simulation requirements.
location: Workstation on the 3rd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch
description: Ate alone in the company cafeteria, getting scrambled eggs with tomatoes, twice-cooked pork, and rice, and finished quickly. Scrolled through new posts on the ancient coin forum on his phone to relax his mind.
location: Company cafeteria, Basement 1, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Fifth badminton team training
description: Organized the company badminton team to test serve accuracy. I marked three 1-square-meter landing zones on the opposite court, and each person served 10 times and recorded the results. In my own right rear court zone, I hit 7 out of 10, leading by example. I recorded all the data and let my mind go blank, temporarily forgetting the worries of mentoring.
location: Company badminton hall, 4th floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Shower break and data aggregation
description: After training, he took a quick shower and changed into a spare T-shirt, returned to his workstation to rehydrate, compiled serving test data in Excel, and updated the team's technical gap matrix.
location: Bathroom and workstation, 3rd floor, Block A, Haitai Fazhan Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Second round of in-depth communication with suppliers
description: Contacted representatives from Tianjin Hengda and Hebei Yuanda suppliers by phone in succession to discuss the feasibility of flexibly adjusting steel dimensions by 0.5 mm to match existing inventory while ensuring strength. Tianjin Hengda needs to consult with the general contractor; Hebei Yuanda believes it has the technical reserve but will charge an additional mold fee. Recorded the advantages, disadvantages, and points of divergence of both parties.
location: Workstation on the 3rd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Prototype functional testing
description: Go to the workshop test room to conduct working condition tests on the assembled cooling water channel cover plate prototype, focusing on recording pressure (reaching 0.85 MPa), temperature (stable at 70), and sealing data. The whole process went smoothly, bringing some comfort.
location: Workshop test room, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Coordinate internal technical assessment
description: Took the preliminary prototype test data to Manager Wang Peng, reported the test results and supplier communication status, presented the key points, and emphasized the need to organize an internal technical evaluation as soon as possible to determine the selection direction. Manager Wang Peng agreed to hold a short meeting early next week.
location: Manager's office, 3rd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Data organization and work wrap-up
description: Back at his workstation, he entered the test data and supplier communication minutes into the computer and updated the Supplier Evaluation Form. He drafted the work log and sent it to the project team. At 17:15, he shut down the computer, tidied his desk, and picked up his umbrella; outside the window, a light drizzle was already falling.
location: Workstation on the 3rd floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work commute
description: The rain wasn't heavy but fell steadily. I slowed down and drove home, turned on the radio to listen to music, and replayed the mentoring episode and the anticipated conversation with my father, feeling a bit more relaxed.
location: The road section from the parking lot of Haitai Development Office Tower A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community on Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: After arriving home, put away the umbrella, change into loungewear, then help mother peel garlic and wash greens. Dinner included steamed sea bass, garlic baby bok choy, and braised pork. During the meal, I poured out my frustrations about mentoring to my parents. Father Ye Jianguo talked about his experience mentoring apprentices when he was young, and advised that passing on a craft is about passing on patience and character. This made me feel relieved and I resolved to adjust my approach. After dinner, I watched the weather forecast with my parents, confirmed the 14:00 rehabilitation care appointment on Saturday afternoon, and promised to accompany them personally.
location: Home dining room and living room, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening study and hobby organization
description: In the study, he used Excel to make a badminton serve test chart, then logged on to the 'Ancient Coin Garden' forum to reply to a fellow collector's question about Double Flag coin varieties. He took out a Yuan Datou copper coin and examined the edge reeding with a magnifying glass. Then he reviewed the data processing functions in the Python_Toolkit folder. Finally, he picked up *Illustrated Study of Ming and Qing Furniture* to read the chapter on mortise-and-tenon structures, planning to discuss it with Master Qian on the weekend.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: After washing up, he set the alarm for 06:20 the next day and checked that the rain outside the window had stopped. Leaning against the headboard, he continued reading 'An Illustrated Study of Ming and Qing Furniture' and thought about trying to make a small mortise-and-tenon model at the woodworking workshop next week. He turned off the light at 23:15 and fell asleep with a sense of relief and reflection.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning indoor activity
description: Woken by the rain and chill outside the window, a bit earlier than the alarm. I threw on a jacket, went to the living room to pour a glass of warm water, and saw my mother already up preparing breakfast. I reminded her that the temperature had dropped sharply today and to put on a light jacket when going out. Taking advantage of the quiet, I went over today's work priorities in my mind—the final solution for the supply chain.
location: Bedroom and living room at home: Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After washing up, he changed into a long-sleeved work uniform and a windbreaker jacket. Breakfast was millet porridge cooked by his mother and bought jianbing guozi. His father, Ye Jianguo, talked about precautions for working in the rain when he was young and reminded him to drive carefully. After the meal, he took vitamin C. Back in the bedroom, he checked his commuter bag and made sure to bring his folding umbrella, printed records of all supplier communications, and a USB drive.
location: Bathroom and dining room at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute by car
description: The rain gradually weakened, but the road was still slippery, so I drove carefully. On the way, I listened to the local traffic broadcast and learned that there were several minor accidents on the outer ring road, so I chose to detour via Ziyuan Road. While driving, I used the car Bluetooth and a voice command to send a short WeChat message to Zhou Tao: “Brother Tao, I have an urgent matter today and want to ask you to help make a connection. Call me back when you're free.” This warmed up the follow-up communication.
location: From Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Arriving at the workstation and preparing for work
description: After parking the car, I took the elevator upstairs. At my workstation, I first wiped the backpack that had gotten wet from the rain, turned on the computer, and filed the printed materials. I quickly scanned the work email and confirmed there were no urgent matters. I placed the final confirmation records for today's supplier communication and the 3D printing alternative proposal document on the desktop.
location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Formally report the decision change to the senior engineer.
description: He arranged a half-hour in-depth meeting with Senior Engineer in the small conference room. Ye Mingxuan took out the completed full-chain analysis table and presented one by one the detailed data showing how the final three suppliers failed to meet the requirements on the 'performance, price, and delivery time' triangle, and clearly concluded that the traditional machining route would no longer work. Then, with clear logic, he proposed initiating the metal 3D printing solution and showed the preliminary information and success cases of a Shenzhen startup found in earlier research (introduced by Zhou Tao). Senior Engineer frowned, but after listening carefully, acknowledged the persuasiveness of the data and stated: 'Worth a try, but we must quickly get trial samples and price comparisons. I want to see preliminary conclusions at Monday's internal meeting.'
location: Small company meeting room, 6th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Refined plan waiting for external feedback
description: Back at his workstation, following the Senior Engineer's instructions, he began to write a more formal "Application Report on Launching the Metal 3D Printing Alternative Plan," writing down the key points of the briefing. At the same time, he treated waiting for Zhou Tao's reply as the most important thing at the moment and refreshed WeChat every 15 minutes. During gaps, he opened a technical podcast titled "Comparison of FDM and SLM Forming Processes," put on his earphones, and sorted files while listening.
location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and the crucial help request
description: The rain stopped, and he went with a colleague to the malatang shop near the office that they often visited. Just as they sat down and ordered, Zhou Tao called back. Ye Mingxuan moved to a corner outside the shop and explained the project's difficulties and needs in a few words. Zhou Tao was very direct: 'I'll immediately send you the contact of our Shenzhen branch's metal 3D printing supplier. They just helped us make a prototype of a precision part last week, and the quality was very stable.' After hanging up, Ye Mingxuan let out a long sigh of relief and quickly finished the malatang.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday rest and follow-up
description: Back at the workstation, Zhou Tao's WeChat business card had already been sent over. He immediately sent a friend request with a brief self-introduction and project needs. While waiting for it to be accepted, he leaned back in his chair, closed his eyes, and rested for 15 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Successfully liaised with the supplier and sent the drawings
description: The friend request was quickly approved. Ye Mingxuan had a 20-minute phone conversation with the other party's technical representative, clearly explaining the part material (die steel), performance requirements (high temperature and high pressure resistance), dimensional tolerances, and expected delivery date. The other party's technician was experienced and, after asking a few key parameters, said, "It should be doable," and asked Ye Mingxuan to send the 3D drawing (STP format) first for a preliminary manufacturability analysis (DFM). Ye Mingxuan immediately sent the optimized drawing via company email with an urgent note. The other party replied, "Received. We'll try to give you initial feedback before the end of the workday."

participant.name: Technical representative from a Shenzhen manufacturer

location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Handled routine work and organized his collection.
description: Feeling much more relaxed. While waiting for the DFM feedback, he opened a green-covered notebook, carefully wiped the Xuantong three-year Da Qing silver coin he received yesterday with a soft cloth, and observed the dragon scale details with a magnifying glass, recording the condition and preliminary valuation in the notebook. Afterwards, he spent another hour continuing to watch the Python data processing tutorial he hadn't finished last night, and tried using the pandas library to perform simple statistical analysis on the ancient coin valuation data he had recorded.
location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wrap-up work and preparation to leave
description: The initial DFM feedback email from the Shenzhen manufacturer arrived on schedule, concluding that 'the process is feasible, and it is recommended to optimize a rounded R-angle to reduce cost.' Ye Mingxuan marked it and planned to make the changes on Monday. Meanwhile, colleague Li Xiang passed by and they chatted a bit about project progress. Ye Mingxuan shared the good news, and Li Xiang was happy for him too. He began to tidy his desk, shut down the computer, and get ready to leave work.
location: Company workstation, 6th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Went to the community activity center.
description: Drove away from the company; the rain had completely stopped and the air was fresh. Along Fukang Road, turned onto West Outer Ring Road, and arrived at the Zhongbei Town Community Activity Center after about a 25-minute drive. Found a spot in a nearby public parking lot and parked.
location: From Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Zhongbei Town Community Activity Center, No. 100 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town

name: Collected marathon race materials.
description: At the “materials distribution point”, he gave his name and ID number and successfully received the bib (M0125), timing chip, and red race T-shirt for tomorrow's mini marathon. The volunteer reminded him to arrive and assemble before 7 a.m. He browsed the community bulletin board nearby and noticed a “Voting Notice for the Re-election of the Community Owners' Committee on the 20th”, and decided to go out that morning to vote.
location: First-floor lobby, Zhongbei Town Community Activity Center, 100 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Return home.
description: Drove home in a few minutes. Put the race gear on the entryway cabinet and changed into loungewear.
location: From Zhongbei Town Community Activity Center, No. 100 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Residential Community

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: His mother made his favorite stir-fried seasonal vegetables and braised hairtail fish. At the dinner table, Ye Mingxuan proactively brought up today's turning point at work, saying the problem now had a direction for resolution, to reassure his parents. He also mentioned tomorrow morning's public class and the afternoon marathon. His mother told him not to push himself too hard and to stay safe.
location: Dining room at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Evening core: prepare woodworking materials for the public welfare class
description: After dinner, he rested for a while, changed into a work apron, and went to the workbench on the balcony. First he inventoried the tool bag: hand plane, coping saw, try square, F-clamps, sandpaper, etc. Then, from the stack of boards, he took out the pre-cut pine boards (cut yesterday), and according to the drawings, he used a pencil to accurately mark reference lines and tenon positions at key joints. Afterwards, he divided the boards, screws, and wood glue needed for each child tomorrow into 5 kraft paper bags, and wrote the basic step instructions on the bags. Finally, he neatly arranged all the tools into a tool storage box. The whole preparation process was meticulous and focused, taking about 1 hour and 40 minutes.
location: Home study balcony work area, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening relaxation and stretching
description: After putting away the tools, I did a simple full-body stretch, focusing on relieving the lower back, shoulders, and neck after prolonged sitting. I turned on the TV and watched sports news for a while to relax my mind.
location: Living room at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Applied a hot towel to my face and washed up. Checked tomorrow's weather forecast, confirmed no rain tomorrow, and placed the marathon shorts, running shoes, and T-shirt on the nightstand. Set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning.
location: Bathroom at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime reading
description: Leaning against the headboard, he opened An Illustrated Study of Ming and Qing Furniture and carefully studied the structural diagrams of the 'zongjiao mortise-and-tenon joint,' comparing them with the reference lines he had marked this evening. He penciled his insights in the margins of the pages.
location: At home, on the bed in the bedroom, Building 3, Unit 2, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Journaling and going to bed
description: In the phone memo, I briefly wrote down a few key points of today: "The supply chain made a decisive switch to 3D printing, Zhou Tao helped make the connection, and the Shenzhen factory has sent the drawings; tomorrow's public service class materials are ready; marathon supplies have arrived." Then I turned off the light, listened to the lingering sound of raindrops outside the window, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Unit 2, Building 3, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up, pre-race preparation, and walking to the starting point
description: At 6:00 on Saturday morning, Mingxuan was woken by his alarm and felt in good shape. He drank a glass of warm water and ate whole-wheat bread and a banana as pre-race energy. Then he changed into his race T-shirt and shorts, pinned on bib number M0125, and checked his shoelaces. Before leaving, he again confirmed the public-welfare class toolbox and kraft paper bag hanging by the bedside. At 6:35, he walked out of Huating International Community and headed along Zhongbei Avenue to the starting point at Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center. Along the way, he saw neighbors also wearing race outfits, exchanged greetings, breathed the fresh morning air, and felt cheerful.
location: Huating International Residential Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and surrounding roads

name: Pre-race check-in and warm-up
description: Arrived at the plaza of Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center, where it was already very lively. Mingxuan collected his timing chip with his race bib and tied it to his shoelace. Then, led by volunteers, he entered the warm-up area and, along with other runners, did dynamic stretching, high-knee lifts, and other activities, gradually getting his body into race mode.
location: Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center Square, No. 189 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Community 5 km mini marathon.
description: After the starting gun, Mingxuan ran the first three kilometers steadily at a pace of about 4:45 per km, with good control of breathing and cadence. On the gentle uphill at 3.5 km, his legs felt heavy and his pace dropped to 5:10 per km. He adjusted his breathing, increased his arm swing, and pushed through the final 1.5 km, crossing the finish line in 24:48, placing 12th. The course went along Zhongbei Avenue to Wanyuan Road and back, with volunteers guiding and cheering along the way.
location: Zhongbei Avenue to Wanyuan Road turnaround course, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Post-match rest, stretching, showering and changing clothes.
description: After crossing the finish line, Mingxuan walked slowly for a few minutes to cool down, and then did a 10-minute full-body stretch on the grass. While stretching, he used the memo app on his phone to record the pace changes and a summary: "First 3K at 4'45", slowed at 3.5K, adjusted in the latter part, total time 24'48"." He thought the starting pace was a bit fast, so he needed to strengthen tempo runs and hill training in the future. Then he went to the restroom at the community activity center, took a quick shower to wash off the sweat, changed into a gray polo shirt and dark casual pants, and felt refreshed.
location: Finish area and restrooms, Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center, 189 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Set up the venue for the public welfare class.
description: Mingxuan pushed a cart loaded with materials and tools to the multifunction hall on the second floor of the community activity center. His father Ye Jianguo had already arrived early and was arranging tables and chairs with the community staff. They quickly arranged 10 long tables into a U shape, placed a kraft paper bag, a piece of sandpaper, and an F-clamp on each table, and neatly lined up tools such as hand planes, coping saws, and try squares on one side of the podium, preparing for the upcoming public woodworking class.
location: Second-floor multi-function hall, Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center, 189 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Held a public-interest class on making simple bookshelves and received recognition.
description: The class officially started at 9 o'clock. Mingxuan first explained woodworking safety rules and how to use the hand plane and coping saw, and demonstrated how to draw reference lines on pine boards. Then 10 teenagers aged 9 to 14 worked in pairs, while he and his father moved around to help the children hold the saws and do sanding. Most of the children finished sawing and sanding by 11 o'clock and moved on to the assembly stage. Before the class ended, a 9-year-old girl with a ponytail gave him a hand-drawn card that read “Thank you, Uncle Ye,” and Mingxuan's heart warmed. Then Director Liu of the community presented him with a certificate of honor for “Community Public Welfare Star” and invited him to run two more sessions in the fall; he readily agreed.
location: Second-floor multi-function hall, Zhongbei Town Community Cultural Activity Center, 189 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Cleaned up the venue and returned home
description: After the public interest class, Mingxuan and his father helped community staff clean up the venue, sweep up sawdust, and put the tools back. Each carrying a toolbox full of leftover wood pieces, they walked back to their home in Huating International Community, chatting and laughing.
location: From No. 189 to No. 128 along Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup. At the table, Mingxuan shared how he had received a thank-you letter and been commended that morning; his mother was very happy. After the meal, he cleared the dishes on his own initiative and then rested for 20 minutes on the living room sofa.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Accompanied mother to the hospital for rehabilitation care.
description: After the lunch break, Mingxuan drove his mother to Tianjin Zhongbei Hospital and arrived about 15 minutes later. On the second floor in the rehabilitation department, his mother received physical therapy and massage for her knee joint, under the guidance of rehabilitation therapist Dr. Liu. Mingxuan waited nearby and also asked about his own knee soreness after running. name: Evening organization: woodworking tool maintenance and course confirmation

Then he went into the storage room, opened his woodworking tool bag, took out the marking gauge, plane blades, and several chisels, wiped off the dust with a cotton cloth, then unscrewed the special blade oil bottle, dipped an oil-absorbing paper into a little oil, and applied it evenly over the metal surfaces. While maintaining the tools, he checked the clamps for the rosewood pieces used in tomorrow's square lap mortise-and-tenon joints against the checklist Master Qian had sent on his phone, confirming that all catches and screws were intact. After maintaining the tools, Mingxuan sent Master Qian Jianguo a voice message on WeChat to confirm the meeting at Qian's Woodworking Workshop in Yangliuqing at 9 a.m. the next day. Master Qian replied that everything was as usual and reminded him again to bring a few sheets of fine sandpaper for polishing the finished pieces. Mingxuan took a small pack of sandpaper with varying grits from the storage room, carefully checked it, and placed it into the tool bag he would carry the next day.

With this sense of fulfillment, he quickly fell asleep.

He introduced his background in structural design at a precision machinery company and asked an independent designer alumnus with the screen name 'Dream Workshop' for industry experience. After the meeting, I said goodbye to Professor Chen Jianguo and thanked him for the introduction.

Based on last Friday's project weekly meeting decisions, I reviewed the material numbers and supplier information item by item. For the alternative parts plan discussed at the meeting, I added the material specifications for 3D-printed replacement parts and the recommended supplier contact information in the remarks column. After confirming everything was correct, I clicked "Submit for Review," and the workflow was directed to Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan. After completing this, I @-mentioned Senior Engineer Gao and project manager Wang Peng on the project collaboration software, briefly explaining that it had been submitted and asking them to review it.

During the meal, Zhou Tao joked about his weekend blind date, Li Xiang shared the simulation algorithm he had been researching recently, and Ye Mingxuan also shared his experiences from yesterday's alumni seminar, but did not go into detail about his 3D printing side business idea.

name: Returning home for free time and preparing dinner
date: Natural wear is usually concentrated on the high points of the coin surface, such as the cheekbones and hair strands of the portrait, whereas wear on fakes is often blurred across the entire surface. In addition, the provisional coinage struck by the Chongqing Mint, due to process limitations, often has shallow and irregular edge reeding, which can be used as a reference for comparison. For the project, I suggest organizing it into two modules: an 'appraisal case library' and a 'feature atlas'. Each case should include high-definition images, measurement data, and the judgment logic, to facilitate reuse and community feedback.
description: After arriving home, he changed into comfortable loungewear. First, he went to the balcony to look at the several pots of succulents he had been growing; they were in good shape. Then he walked into the living room and chatted a few words with his father Ye Jianguo, who was watching the news, saying that work today had gone "pretty smoothly." His father nodded and continued watching the news. Then he helped his mother Wang Xiulan bring the cooked dishes to the table and set out the bowls and chopsticks.
location: Unit X, Building X, Huating International, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Family dinner

His mother asked about the BOM form submission, and Ye Mingxuan replied, “I got it done in the morning.” The atmosphere at the table was warm and harmonious, and they chatted about everyday matters such as the property management change and the temperature drop next week.
location: Restaurant, Unit X, Building X, Huating International, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Research on a 3D printing side business
description: After clearing the dishes, I went into the study and opened the computer. I organized the ideas recorded in my phone memo yesterday onto the computer and formally began systematic research. I successively opened online platforms such as Mohou.com, Future Factory, and JLC 3D Printing to check prices, material options, lead times, and minimum order quantities for small-batch orders such as figure models and custom home accessories. At the same time, I searched Baidu and Zhihu for keywords like "designer taking orders" and "3D printing side hustle", browsed popular posts in several related forums, noted common pricing methods and key points for client communication, and took screenshots of typical quote cases. I organized all the data into a newly created Excel spreadsheet with columns such as "platform name", "common materials", "price range", "advantages", and "disadvantages".
location: Study, Unit X, Building X, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Discuss side business ideas with my father
description: Ye Mingxuan took the printed market data tables and screenshots of key information to the living room and solemnly proposed to his father, Ye Jianguo, that he wanted to use his woodworking foundation combined with 3D printing technology to take outsourced orders as a side business, and showed him the research data. His father was silent for a moment after hearing this, slowly put down his teacup, and seriously reminded him that a side business could be used to explore the path and test the waters in spare time, but it must never distract from or affect his main career. He should first firmly set the goal of becoming a senior engineer; that was the foundation. Ye Mingxuan listened carefully, said he understood, and decided to focus first on the technical research stage.
location: Living room, Unit X, Building X, Huating International, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Home stretching

He walked to the yoga mat in the living room and started a 20-minute stretching routine at home, focusing on relaxing his shoulders, neck, and the lower back that had become tense from sitting too long. While doing core activation exercises, he reviewed the day's work and his father's words in his mind and decided to anchor his current energy in the "technical research" phase.
location: Living room, Unit X, Building X, Huating International, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

He had been writing for less than half an hour when he realized that the script was very incomplete because there were no labor-hour estimation data for models of varying complexity. He sighed, wrote 'Data insufficient; labor-hour estimation module to be added later' in a code comment, and saved the file. Then he went to the bathroom, washed up, and changed into pajamas.

Combining the researched 3D printing technology and woodworking lathe knowledge, I imagined the possibility of using printed parts to replace traditional wooden structural parts, and lightly sketched a few concept diagrams in pencil on the page margins. After about 20 minutes I felt sleepy, closed the book, turned off the light, and prepared to sleep. The BOM was submitted smoothly today, and the side-project idea got preliminary data support and my father's advice. Though busy, I felt grounded and fulfilled.

He ultimately adopted the suggestion, updated the model, and packaged and sent the latest files to the cooperative mold factory, CCing the project manager and senior engineer. Afterwards, he began organizing the day's electronic and paper documents, archiving the scanned copy signed by Senior Engineer Gao, and replying to two customer emails about drawing version confirmations. After expressing my thanks, I opened my tablet and displayed the September household financial report and cash flow forecast chart I had generated with Python. "Manager Zhang, you see, my data shows that this month's discretionary spending ratio is 5% higher than the bank plan's, and your allocation of low-risk products is on the high side, which may affect my short-term fund flexibility." We discussed in depth for nearly an hour. Zhang Wei acknowledged that my data was detailed, but suggested that the bank still had an advantage in long-term planning. Inwardly, I preferred self-management, so I politely said I would evaluate comprehensively and agreed to meet again next quarter.
