location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Father drove him to the airport
description: In the early morning, traffic was sparse on Zhongbei Avenue. Father Ye Jianguo drove Ye Mingxuan to Terminal 2 of Tianjin Binhai International Airport. On the way, the father and son chatted about family matters. Ye Mingxuan reminded his father to dress warmly and measure his blood pressure on time, while his father asked him to say hello to relatives in Shenzhen on his behalf. The drive took about 40 minutes and they arrived smoothly at the departure level.
location: From Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Tianjin Airport Avenue, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Check in and wait for the flight
description: After saying goodbye to his father, Ye Mingxuan walked into the terminal, printed his boarding pass at a self-service kiosk, chose an aisle seat, and then queued through security. Near the gate, he found a seat with a charging outlet, sat down, took out his iPad to confirm the offline course videos, and checked WeChat group messages, seeing a message from Li Na about waiting for gathering arrangements.
location: Departure hall of Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Tianjin Airport Avenue, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Fly to Shenzhen and study during the flight
description: The plane took off on time. Ye Mingxuan put on his noise-cancelling headphones and began studying the advanced operations on DataFrame and data-cleaning functions in the Pandas library from the “Python Data Analysis Advanced Course,” taking notes with a mind-map app. After the flight stabilized, he connected to the on-board Wi-Fi, told everyone in the “Shenzhen-Tianjin Old Friends” WeChat group that he had taken off, and finalized the gathering plans with his friends. Around 10 o’clock, he put away his electronic devices and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Air China flight CAxxxx (from Terminal 2 of Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Dongli District, Tianjin, to Terminal 3 of Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province)

name: Arrive in Shenzhen and meet up with my cousin
description: The plane landed smoothly at Bao'an Airport. Ye Mingxuan met his waiting cousin Ye Mingyuan at the exit of the arrival hall. They greeted each other warmly. Ye Mingyuan took his backpack, told him the car was parked underground, and planned to go to the hotel first to check in and drop off luggage, then go to lunch.
location: Arrival hall, T3 Terminal, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Check in and lunch.
description: His cousin drove Ye Mingxuan to Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science and Technology Park Branch). Ye Mingxuan checked in, put away his luggage, and rested briefly. Then the two went to Chaoweixuan Chaoshan Restaurant next to the hotel for a meal. Ye Mingxuan specifically told the waiter about his seafood allergy and asked that all dishes be prepared without shrimp, crab, shellfish, or oyster sauce. They ordered scallion oil chicken, blanched choy sum, dry-fried beef ho fun, and lotus root and pork rib soup. While eating, they chatted, and his cousin asked about Ye Mingxuan's father's health.
location: Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science & Technology Park Branch), Shennan Avenue, Science & Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, and nearby Chaoweixuan Restaurant

name: Helping his cousin decorate the wedding room.
description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan and his cousin drove to the wedding apartment in a garden community in Houhai, Nanshan District. The living room and dining room were already piled with balloons, double-happiness stickers, petals, and streamers. They divided the work: Ye Mingxuan inflated balloons and tied them into bunches, while his cousin put up the double-happiness characters and hung streamers. As they worked, they talked about their experiences working hard in Shenzhen and the idea of combining 3D printing with traditional woodworking. The room gradually filled with a festive atmosphere.
location: Cousin Ye Mingyuan's new home in a garden community in Houhai, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Return to hotel to rest and report that all is well
description: You want to consolidate your current achievements while organizing technical documentation and optimizing details in advance, to build up deeper technical feasibility evidence for the next report?
location: Room at Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science and Technology Park Branch), Shennan Avenue, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Attend a clan reunion dinner.
description: In the evening, Ye Mingxuan arrived at a private room in the third-floor Chinese restaurant of the hotel and gathered with several clan relatives, including uncles and aunts. The elders asked about his work, house-buying, and relationship status. Ye Mingxuan answered them one by one, saying that his job was stable, he was looking at houses, and he would let fate decide when it came to a partner. His older male cousin beside him helped deflect the questions and praised his talent. When the meal began, Ye Mingxuan specifically told the waiter that his portion should avoid any seafood, dried shrimp, and scallops. The gathering was harmonious, and everyone talked about life in the two places and old family stories.
location: 3F Chinese Restaurant, Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science Park Branch), Shennan Avenue, Science Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Post-dinner walk and route check
description: After the dinner gathering ended and he saw off his clan relatives, Ye Mingxuan did not return to his room immediately. Instead, he took a ten-minute slow walk along the streets near the hotel to digest dinner. Back in his room, he opened the map app on his phone to plan the route and travel time to the wedding hotel the next day, ensuring he would arrive on time. His watch showed he had already taken 8,500 steps that day, meeting his exercise goal.
location: Streets near the Science and Technology Park Hotel, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, and room at Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science and Technology Park Branch)

name: Evening personal time
description: Ye Mingxuan sent WeChat messages to his good friends Zhou Tao and Zheng Kai, letting them know the trip went smoothly and updating them on the wedding preparations. Then he took out the copy of Ming-style Furniture Research he had brought with him and leaned against the headboard to read. When he came to the section on the “Bawangcheng” structure, he thought of the day's wedding room layout and the load-bearing design of parts at work. He took out his notebook, drew a few simple sketches, made annotations, and felt inspired.
location: Room at Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science and Technology Park Branch), Shennan Avenue, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Bedtime preparations
description: After an hour of reading, Ye Mingxuan felt sleepy. He turned off the bedside reading lamp and set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning. He plugged in his phone to charge, and checked the power bank, phone, and room card he needed to carry the next day. Lying on the hotel bed, he felt both the reassurance of a completed plan and anticipation of the lively wedding. He fell asleep right at 23:30.
location: Room at Vienna Hotel (Shenzhen Science and Technology Park Branch), Shennan Avenue, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Morning long-distance run
description: Got up on time at 5:30, changed into running gear, and followed the route planned on the phone map last night. Starting from Vienna Hotel Shenzhen, jogged along Keyuan South Road to Baishi Road, then turned onto the coastal greenway of Shenzhen Bay Park. The morning sea breeze brushed my face; I ran about 8.2 km with a steady pace of 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer and a heart rate of 148 bpm. Along the way, I saw morning exercisers and felt Shenzhen's vitality. Ran back to the hotel at 7:00 and did 15 minutes of static stretching for the front and back of the thighs and calves.
location: Shenzhen Bay Park Coastal Greenway, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Washed up and changed clothes
description: Took a shower to wash off the sweat, then put on the light blue long-sleeved shirt, dark gray trousers, and brown casual leather shoes prepared for the wedding. Checked his small bag: room card, phone, wallet. Carefully placed the small wooden gadget he had prepared the night before—a beech wood piece with pre-drilled holes and a cotton string tied to it—into the inner pocket of the bag. Took one loratadine tablet to guard against a possible seafood allergy at the wedding banquet.
location: Guest room, Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Meet up with the bridal escort team and set off
description: At 7:40, I went downstairs on time and met up with my cousin and the groomsmen in the lobby. The atmosphere was lively. My cousin, wearing a custom suit, looked a little nervous. I showed off a small wooden mechanism I had made, and the groomsmen found it novel. At 8:00, we set off in a black sedan as the lead car, while I and the other relatives rode in the car behind. Traffic was smooth, and we arrived at Lianhua North Village, where the bride's family lives, about 20 minutes later.
location: Lobby of Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Door-blocking segment during bridal pickup
description: After going upstairs, the bridesmaids had set up challenge levels. The best men successfully cleared the first two levels. For the third, I showed a small woodworking mechanism: a wooden board and a knotted rope, requiring the coin to pass through the rope loop without damaging the board or the knot. The bridesmaids tried but could not do it, and we finally broke through. Then came the tea ceremony and the address-changing ritual, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Inside a residential building in Lianhua North Village, No. 1116 Lianhua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Wedding ceremony
description: After picking up the bride, the motorcade moved to the Renaissance Hotel. The ceremony was held on an outdoor lawn under bright sunshine; it was simple yet solemn. As one of the representatives of the groom's family and friends, I went on stage at the end of the ceremony for a group photo with the newlyweds and their families. Watching my older male cousin exchange rings with the bride, I felt genuinely happy for him.
location: Outdoor lawn at Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Wedding banquet
description: I was seated next to the main table, together with relatives from Tianjin and Hebei. The dishes were abundant, and I deliberately avoided seafood such as poached shrimp and steamed fish, focusing instead on garlic ribs, roast duck, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and other dishes. During the meal, I raised my glass with the elders to toast the newlyweds, listened as they chatted about family stories, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Grand Ballroom, Shenzhen Bay Renaissance Hotel, No. 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Catching up with relatives
description: After the wedding banquet, I took the initiative to sit down in the rest area with my second uncle, third aunt, and my cousin and her husband for tea. My second uncle asked about my work progress. I briefly introduced the BOM table situation of the new project, and he praised me for being down-to-earth. My cousin asked about my personal life. I smiled and replied that work comes first, and I asked about her child's studies.
location: Rest area outside the banquet hall, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, 18 Keji South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Met up with an old classmate.
description: As agreed, met Li Na and Wang Lei at the lobby bar and ordered three lattes. Li Na shared her UI design works, and I expressed appreciation and asked about the interaction logic. Wang Lei complained about overtime, and we jointly reflected on the ups and downs of working in tech, recalling our college days. Finally, we settled on having hotpot tomorrow at 12:00 at Old Chengdu Hotpot in Coastal City, Nanshan District, and I’ll take charge of using the app to queue up in advance.
location: Lobby Bar, Renaissance Shenzhen Bay Hotel, 18 Science and Technology South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Rest and organization at the hotel.
description: Saying goodbye to his classmates, he took a taxi back to the hotel. After showering, he changed into a comfortable T-shirt and sports shorts. He went through the wedding photos taken on his phone today and used a photo-editing app to make simple adjustments to a few photos with good expressions and lighting. He then had a video call with his mother on WeChat for about 15 minutes, showed her the photos, and told her amusing stories from the door-blocking segment and the wedding banquet. After that, he took out "Ming-style Furniture Research" from his suitcase, leaned against the bed and read for half an hour, focusing on the structural drawing of the "zongjiao mortise-and-tenon joint."
location: Guest room, Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Dinner with my cousin and the groomsmen.
description: My older male cousin sent a WeChat message inviting me to dinner with the groomsmen, and I walked to Lao Banzhang Hunan Restaurant. We ordered chopped pepper fish head (I confirmed again that it contained no seafood), stir-fried pork with green peppers, stir-fried yellow beef, and other dishes. During the meal, we recalled funny moments from the wedding, and the groomsmen were full of praise for the wooden mechanisms I had designed. The atmosphere was lively. I drank one glass of beer, and drank coconut juice for the rest of the time.
location: Laobanzhang Hunan Restaurant, Nanshan Science and Technology Park, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Walk and reading review.
description: After dinner, I said goodbye to my cousin and his group and walked alone along the tree-lined path in the Technology Park back to the hotel, about 15 minutes. Back in my room, I used a notes app on my phone to record today's expenses: the red envelope for the social gift had been prepared in advance, and dinner was shared by the groomsmen, so my personal spending was about 80 yuan. I continued reading Ming-style Furniture Research, focusing on the mechanical application of the "bawang cheng".
location: Guest room, Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Stretching exercises
description: Considering the 8 km run in the morning and standing and walking all day, I did 20 minutes of targeted stretching: wall calf stretches, child's pose, hip stretches, etc. Then I brushed my teeth, washed my face, and applied skincare. I weighed myself at 71.2 kg. I set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow.
location: Guest room, Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Bedtime routine and sleep
description: Lying in bed, he wrote a brief review of the day in his phone memo: “Successfully attended my cousin's wedding, socializing went well, training met the target. Tomorrow, dinner at Coast City. Remember to rest; need to pack luggage before returning to Tianjin tomorrow.” Then he checked the phone charger. He turned off the light, put on his eye mask, and, being quite physically exhausted, quickly fell asleep.
location: Guest room, Vienna Hotel, No. 15 Keyuan Road, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Morning stretching and luggage check
description: After waking up at the hotel, he did a 5-minute full-body stretch to relax the calves and lower back that were tight from rushing around at yesterday's wedding. Then he opened his suitcase and backpack and checked each item one by one: electronic devices, cash and documents, change of clothes, and wedding souvenirs. He especially checked the charging cable for the tablet used for organizing woodworking notes to ensure it had enough charge.
location: Room 1510, Vienna Hotel (Nanshan Science Park MixC World Branch), Kefa Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Hotel Breakfast and Phone Calls
description: At the hotel's first-floor restaurant, he had the buffet breakfast: preserved egg and lean pork congee, boiled eggs, youtiao, and soy milk. While eating, he checked WeChat messages on his phone, replied to his mother's voice message asking about his arrival time, and called his father Ye Jianguo to tell him the flight number and estimated landing time. His father said he would be at Tianjin Binhai Airport on time to pick him up.
location: First-floor restaurant, Vienna Hotel (Nanshan Science Park MixC World Branch), Kefa Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Check out and organize gear.
description: Returned to the room, washed my cup and utensils, put the tablet, woodworking notebook, and pen into my backpack, and after confirming everything was packed, went downstairs to the front desk to check out, showed my ID, got the invoice printed, returned the room card, and took all my luggage.
location: Room 1510 and the front desk of Vienna Hotel (Nanshan Science Park MixC World Branch), Kefa Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Take a taxi to Coastal City
description: Used Didi Chuxing to hail a car from Vienna Hotel to Nanshan Coast City Shopping Center, about 12 km in total, taking Shennan Avenue onto Nanhai Avenue. Along the way, I checked traffic conditions on the mobile navigation and looked through my phone album to revisit yesterday's wedding photos, selecting 10 key photos to share with my parents.
location: From Vienna Hotel, Kefa Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province to Coastal City Shopping Center, No. 33 Wenxin Fifth Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Getting a queue number at Coastal City and personal time
description: After arriving at Coast City, I went to B1 to take a number and line up at the Hakka restaurant 'Keyu' for the old classmates' dinner. Then I went to the CITIC Bookstore on the second floor to browse woodworking books and take photos of key improvement ideas. Then I went to the third floor to order a drink at 'Nayuki Tea,' sat by the window, used my tablet to organize wedding photos and diary drafts, and set an evening to-do list alarm.
location: Nanshan Coastal City Shopping Center, No. 33 Wenxin Fifth Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Caught up with an old classmate at a beverage shop.
description: After the old classmates arrived, he met Wang Lei, Li Na, and Liu Yang at Nayuki Tea on the third floor of Coastal City. The four chatted freely about what they had been up to: Li Na showed her new UI design work, Wang Lei shared an incident from an embedded development project, Liu Yang complained about overtime at the electronics factory, and Ye Mingxuan talked about 3D printing technology and insights from woodworking. They also agreed to bring all materials to the side-business discussion meeting on October 4.
location: Nayuki, 3rd Floor, Nanshan Coastal City Shopping Center, No. 33 Wenxin Fifth Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Dinner gathering with old classmates and seeing them off after the meal.
description: The four went to the 'Keyu' Hakka restaurant on Floor B1 for a group meal. Ye Mingxuan ordered dishes that catered to everyone's tastes: Hakka stuffed tofu, salt-baked chicken, Mei Cai Kou Rou, and more. During the meal, they continued discussing side-business topics such as smart home products. They split the bill equally, 110 yuan per person. After the meal, they strolled on the square and along the Houhai River embankment to aid digestion, took group photos as souvenirs, and said goodbye after wishing each other well.
location: Keyu Hakka Restaurant and Plaza, B1 Floor, Nanshan Coast City Shopping Center, No. 33 Wenxin Fifth Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Take a taxi to Bao'an Airport.
description: Used Dida Chuxing to call a ride from Gate 1 of Coast City to Terminal 3 of Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, taking Binhai Boulevard then the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Riverside Expressway, about 35 kilometers in total. Feeling sleepy after lunch, I rested with my eyes closed for 20 minutes in the car and arrived smoothly at the departure level at 13:45.
location: From Nanshan Coast City Shopping Center, 33 Wenxin Fifth Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province to T3 Terminal, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Go through check-in, security screening, and wait for the flight.
description: At Terminal T3, I printed my boarding pass at the self-service check-in kiosk (seat 14C), with no baggage to check. After passing through security, I reached Gate 7. While waiting, I watched a woodworking video course on the three-way miter joint on my tablet and took handwritten notes, and wiped my glasses lenses, which had become sticky from humidity.
location: Departures level, Terminal 3, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province; Security Check Area 2; Boarding Gate 7.

name: Boarding and in-flight
description: Boarding started at 15:00. After boarding, Ye Mingxuan took seat 14C, fastened his seatbelt, and set his phone to airplane mode. During the flight, he focused on organizing notes from the teaching video on the mitered corner mortise-and-tenon joint, listing steps, common mistakes, and tool requirements in an Excel spreadsheet, and drew a processing sequence diagram. Later, he rested with his eyes closed for half an hour to relieve fatigue.
location: Inside the cabin of flight CA1359 (Shenzhen to Tianjin)

name: After landing, collected luggage and met up with his father.
description: The plane landed on time at Terminal 2 of Tianjin Binhai International Airport. Ye Mingxuan retrieved his luggage, waited 10 minutes at baggage carousel 6, and got his suitcase. When he walked out of the arrivals hall, he saw his father Ye Jianguo waving from outside the railing. He quickly stepped forward to meet his father, exchanged a few pleasantries, and headed to the parking lot together.
location: Arrival hall, Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Father picked him up at the airport and drove home.
description: His father drove along Jinbin Avenue and turned onto the Outer Ring Road to return to Huating International Community. On the way, Ye Mingxuan told his father about the grand wedding in Shenzhen, details of visiting relatives, and the characteristics of Shenzhen as a city. His father occasionally asked about the relatives' health and work situations. They arrived at the community at 19:10, parked the car, and carried the luggage upstairs.
location: From Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Dongli District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Family dinner
description: When he returned home, his mother Wang Xiulan had prepared a hearty dinner: steamed sea bass, braised pork ribs, garlic broccoli, and more. Ye Mingxuan first cast the TV screen to show his parents 10 selected wedding photos and group photos, explaining the details. During the meal, he proactively served food to his parents, expressed concern about their clothes for the changing season, and after dinner helped clear the dishes into the kitchen.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organized woodworking notes into an electronic document
description: In the study, opened the laptop and handwritten notebook, and compared against the recorded video to complete the 3 error-prone steps in the mitre mortise-and-tenon notes. Created a dedicated folder in OneNote, organized the production steps, data tables, hand-drawn diagrams, and sandpaper adjustment tips into an electronic document, backed it up to the cloud drive and a portable hard drive, and felt satisfied.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Complete online check-in and airport pickup reservation for October 4
description: Opened the Air China app to check in online for flight CA1359 on October 4, selected aisle seat 8D, generated the electronic boarding pass, and saved a screenshot. Then booked an airport transfer service in Didi Chuxing for 19:30 on October 4 from Shenzhen Bao'an Airport T3 to Vienna Hotel, paid a deposit of 50 yuan, and sent the order details to the old friends' group to inform them.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: A slow stroll around the neighborhood.
description: Changed into sneakers and a light jacket, walked two laps on the circular walkway inside Huating International residential complex, about 1.6 kilometers, looking at the garden lights and night view in the distance, and relaxing his neck and shoulders. His phone played white noise, and he simply cleared his mind. When he got home at 22:10, he felt mentally refreshed.
location: Circular walking trail inside Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Take a shower to clean hair and body; dry hair and apply moisturizer, focusing on the face that became dry from the long flight; change into pajamas; brush teeth and floss.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening reading and bedtime
description: I turned on the bedside lamp and read *Ming-style Furniture Research* for 15 minutes, savoring the harmony of mortise-and-tenon joints and wood grain. At 22:45 I closed the book, turned off the light, set my phone to Do Not Disturb and plugged it in. Taking a deep breath, I reviewed the day's itinerary, feeling content and tired from the trip. I set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning and gradually fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Early rising and mood journal
description: Woken by his phone alarm in the early morning, he saw the sky outside already bright and felt the familiar laziness of a makeup workday. He opened the “Family Shared Diary” template on his iPad, added a “Workday Mood Index” entry, chose a mood emoji, gave today 5 points, and added the note “The self-cultivation of a makeup-workday person…”. After posting, his mother instantly replied from the living room with a hug emoji, warming his heart.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Morning run in the neighborhood
description: Put on running gear, went downstairs to the community trail, and started a 5 km easy run. Since I had just returned from Shenzhen, I focused on recovery and kept the pace at 6:10 per kilometer. The morning breeze was refreshing; after the run I was lightly sweating, and much of my drowsiness and lethargy dissipated. My mood index rose back to 7.
location: Footpath inside Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Shower, change clothes, and breakfast
description: After returning home, he took a shower and changed into a casual commuter shirt. His mother had already prepared breakfast: a steaming bowl of xiaozha porridge, two Goubuli buns, and a plate of dressed shredded potatoes. While quickly eating, he talked with his mother and told her that dinner would be later tonight because he needed to sort out the financial statements, so they agreed on dinner at seven.
location: At home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China (bathroom and dining room)

name: Commute by car
description: After breakfast, he picked up his commuting bag and thermos and left. He drove off at 7:50, going along Zhongbei Avenue and turning onto Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road. Traffic was lighter than usual, so the commute was smooth. In the car, he played a technology podcast and listened to the latest developments on the use of lightweight materials in robotic arm design. He arrived at the company's underground parking lot around 8:05, then walked to Building A of the Haitai Fazhan Office Building. The entire commute took about 40 minutes.
location: Drive from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning: handling backlogged work and pre-holiday wrap-up
description: After arriving at his workstation, he logged into the computer and set the Shenzhen wedding photos as the wallpaper. He started processing backlogged emails and replied to three suppliers' questions about drawing details. Then he filled out the leave system to apply for two days after the National Day holiday (October 4 and 5), with the reason handling family matters. Colleague Zhou Tao came over to chat about what he had seen and heard in Shenzhen and shared the amusing story of using wooden mechanisms to break through the challenges during the wedding pickup. Afterwards, he confirmed with Li Xiang the delivery milestone for the last simulation task before the holiday.
location: Office on the 3rd floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Document archiving and leave approval review
description: Before the lunch break, he did the final organization and archiving of the transmission mechanism project documents he had participated in designing, compiled the technical reports, revision logs, and other files into electronic versions, uploaded them to the company shared server, and tagged them properly. At that moment, he checked his phone and found that Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan had already approved the earlier leave request with online comments.
location: Office on the 3rd floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Shared Shenzhen experiences with colleagues over lunch.
description: At noon, walked with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to the malatang shop in Tiankai Huayuan Science Park that they often visit near the company. We ordered the mild spicy bone broth base, and a colleague ordered the medium spicy. During the meal, we talked about the plan to go to Shenzhen again on October 4, sharing fun stories of reunions with old friends like Wang Lei and Liu Yang. Zhou Tao teased about the frequent "flyer" schedule. After lunch, we took a short walk nearby and then returned to the company.
location: Malatang Restaurant, Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Noon break and browsing the news.
description: After lunch, he returned to his workstation, put on an eye mask, leaned back in the ergonomic chair, and took a 20-minute nap. After waking up, he opened the ancient coin forum on his phone, quickly browsed the new posts in the “Guangxu Yuanbao” section, and took a few extra looks at a photo of a Beiyang 34th-year dragon dollar. Then he refreshed mechanical design industry news for a while.
location: Office on the 3rd floor, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Afternoon design review and on-site confirmation
description: In the afternoon, I first continued checking the last assembly drawing in the office, then walked to the workshop to find Li Xiang and confirm on-site the tolerance fit issue for a part. After returning to the office, I briefly discussed the post-holiday work plan with Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan and reconfirmed the work handover during my leave. Senior Engineer Gao said he would help keep an eye on the project progress.
location: China, Tianjin, Xiqing District, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Haitai Development Office Building (office and workshop).

name: After-work commute
description: At 17:00, he packed up his work area on time, turned off the computer, said goodbye to colleagues who were still working overtime, and drove home. description: Went into the kitchen to help my mother Wang Xiulan prepare dinner. I was in charge of cutting the tofu into thick slices and pan-frying them until golden on both sides, while also washing and chopping the scallions for later use, taking part in making scallion-braised tofu.
location: Kitchen at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: Dinner was relatively light, with scallion-braised tofu, black fungus salad, and leftover ribs from lunch. Ye Mingxuan reported to his father on the day's progress in code module encapsulation. Although his father didn't understand the technical details, he was deeply gratified by his son's planning.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: The ultimate programming challenge — end-to-end stress test
description: After a short rest following the meal, he started the stress test. He wrote a test script to simulate importing 20 sets of data in different formats and batch exporting. The first round of testing revealed a memory leak, so he immediately added batch processing and a gc garbage collection mechanism; in the second round, he also found an encoding boundary issue with file names. After nearly two hours of repeated debugging, the program was finally able to handle all parameters stably and correctly. During this time, his mother Wang Xiulan brought over cantaloupe and cookies. Finally, he tagged version V1.0-RC in the Git repository with the comment "Test passed, waiting for final UI tweaks tomorrow." His father also came by to check on progress.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and relaxing with a foot soak
description: After completing the task, he took a shower to wash away fatigue, then soaked his feet in the living room while replying on his phone to Professor Zhao Jianguo's discussion about ancient coin varieties, and watched Master Qian's newly released mortise-and-tenon teaching video to learn new techniques.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening in-depth study and review
description: Back in the study, I recorded in my notebook what I learned in woodworking that morning—the dovetail groove method for preventing shelf deformation and the principle of matching flower rack slat spacing to flowerpot diameter. Then I summarized my insights from solving today's programming issues: a memory leak and a filename encoding bug, including the use of the gc module. I set a Pomodoro timer to focus on reading the chapters on metal connectors and wood stress calculation in the Mechanical Design Manual, building up knowledge for the future hands-on work.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening personal time and going to sleep.
description: He closed his laptop and went back to the bedroom. Lying in bed, he browsed WeChat official accounts in the field of mechanical design and industry forums, and downloaded a sample chapter of a new book on Python data structures. Then he put down his phone and, in the darkness, reviewed the fulfilling day—the smell of sawdust in the woodworking workshop, the code that was successfully packaged, the sense of accomplishment from passing tests, and the care of his parents—feeling a surge of tranquility and steadiness inside. Around 23:30, he gradually fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: Ye Mingxuan was woken by the alarm at 7:10, then washed up and got ready. He then ate millet porridge, boiled eggs, pork buns, and pickled vegetables prepared by his mother in the dining room. While eating, he checked the weather in Shenzhen on his phone to prepare for packing.
location: At his home in Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wrote tool documentation and ran the initial packaging test.
description: In his study, Ye Mingxuan began writing the V1.0 user guide for the automated report generation tool, composing the feature overview and system environment requirements. He then used PyInstaller for the first packaging and passed the test in a Windows virtual machine. Next, he continued writing the installation steps and quick-start sections, and captured screenshots of the operation steps to insert into the document.
location: Home study at Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Multi-system packaging testing, documentation finalization and distribution
description: Ye Mingxuan tested the packaging in Windows 11, macOS Monterey, and Ubuntu 22.04 virtual machines and solved the Ubuntu dependency library path issue. He completed the FAQ chapter of the documentation, converted the document to PDF, and packed and compressed it together with the installation packages for the three platforms. He uploaded it to the company cloud drive and set up a scheduled email asking colleagues to complete installation testing and provide feedback by 10 a.m. on October 9.
location: Home study at Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Helping prepare lunch and family lunch
description: Ye Mingxuan helped set out the bowls and chopsticks and poured wine, then had lunch with his parents. The dishes included braised pork, garlic broccoli, cold cucumber salad, and tomato and egg soup. His mother reminded him to be safe on the trip to Shenzhen, and his father asked about his older male cousin's recent situation; Ye Mingxuan answered each question.
location: Home dining room, Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch break and WeChat communication
description: After checking his luggage, Ye Mingxuan rested in bed for 20 minutes. Then he contacted Master Carpenter Qian Jianguo via WeChat to discuss the dovetail groove dimensions for the flower stand design. Master Qian suggested he visit IKEA or building materials markets in Shenzhen to broaden his thinking.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal free time
description: Before leaving, Ye Mingxuan searched for food guides near Jingtian Metro Station in Futian District, Shenzhen, and saved a rice noodle roll shop and a tea restaurant; replied to his childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat to confirm they would get in touch in the evening; played a warm-up match of League of Legends: Wild Rift, then packed his backpack and checked the doors and windows before getting ready to leave.
location: At his home in Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take a taxi to Tianjin Binhai Airport
description: After saying goodbye to his parents, Ye Mingxuan used Didi to hail a ride to Terminal 2 of Tianjin Binhai International Airport, a journey of about 40 minutes. On the way, he replied to WeChat messages from his gaming partner Zheng Kai.
location: From Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Airport check-in and waiting for the flight
description: Ye Mingxuan printed his boarding pass at the self-service check-in kiosk. After passing through security, he put on noise-canceling headphones in the waiting area, browsed Shenzhen food guides on his phone, and bought a bottle of water while waiting to board.
location: Departure Hall, Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Board the plane and fly to Shenzhen
description: Ye Mingxuan took a flight from Tianjin to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport. On the plane, he took out his notebook to sort out the backend logic and data flow diagram of the Flask web interface, then closed his eyes to rest and enjoyed the in-flight meal (beef rice and yogurt). The flight arrived at around 21:10.
location: On the flight from Tianjin Binhai International Airport Terminal 2 to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport.

name: Land, collect your luggage, and take a car to the hotel.
description: After the plane landed, Ye Mingxuan received a WeChat notification from his cousin that the airport pickup driver was waiting in the P2 parking lot. After retrieving his checked suitcase, he found the driver and rode via the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway and Shennan Avenue to Jingtian Hotel in Futian District.
location: From Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, to Jingtian Hotel, No. 133, intersection of Jingtian Road and Lianhua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Check in and drop off luggage
description: Ye Mingxuan checked in at the front desk of Jingtian Hotel. After entering the king room on the 18th floor, he put down his luggage, washed up briefly, and changed into a thin T-shirt.
location: Jingtian Hotel, No. 133, at the intersection of Jingtian Road and Lianhua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Brief meet-up with my cousin and his wife
description: Ye Mingxuan walked 12 minutes to the Banana FUN Hotel at Wantuo Jiayuan to meet his cousin Ye Mingyuan and his cousin's wife, and gave them Tianjin mahua as a gift. After a brief chat, he took his leave and agreed to meet for morning tea the next day.
location: BANANA FUN HOTEL, 3rd Floor, Wantuo Jiayuan, at the intersection of Jingtian Road and Lianhua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Before-bed tidying and rest
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his room, recorded work points and new Flask ideas in his phone's memo, and did stretching exercises to relieve fatigue. After taking a hot shower, he sent his mother a WeChat message letting her know he was safe, charged his phone, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: Guest room at Jingtian Hotel, No. 133, at the junction of Jingtian Road and Lianhua Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Get up, wash up, and tidy up.
description: The alarm clock rang, and he got up right on time. When he opened the curtain, the weather was gloomy; the forecast showed showers turning overcast, 24–30°C. After a quick wash, he put on a light windproof jacket and packed the power bank, folding umbrella, and room card he would need that day into his backpack. Looking out the window, he followed the suggestion from his older male cousin the night before and booked a ticket for 10:00 a.m. to the OCT-LOFT Creative Park on his phone.
location: Room 8301, Jingtian Hotel, 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Check out and store luggage
description: Since he had already checked in last night, he decided to check out first, store the large luggage at the front desk, and travel light. He explained the situation to the staff, completed the storage procedures, and took the luggage tag. Then he sat down on the sofa in the hotel lobby, opened Amap, and planned a route from the hotel to the morning tea restaurant. He found that walking would take about 20 minutes, but considering it might rain, he decided to take a taxi.
location: Front desk at the lobby of Jingtian Hotel, No. 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Take a taxi to the dim sum restaurant
description: I called a ride-hailing car through a mobile app and set the destination to "Jincui Imperial Palace Restaurant (Diamond CBD Building Branch)". The ride took about 15 minutes. On the way, I contacted my cousin on WeChat to confirm, and he said they had already saved seats at the restaurant.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing, route: Jingtian Hotel to Jincui Huanggong Restaurant.

name: Having Cantonese dim sum with my cousin and his wife
description: Arrived at the restaurant and met up with his cousin and his cousin's wife. The three ordered classic dim sum such as Pu'er tea, shrimp dumplings, red rice rolls, steamed chicken feet, and boat congee. His cousin shared funny stories from their honeymoon trip to Dali, and his cousin's wife was very interested in Tianjin's mahua and jianbing guozi. Ye Mingxuan showed several photos of his woodworking workshop pieces on his phone, and everyone chatted happily. During the meal, his cousin suggested taking a walk in Talent Park in the afternoon, and Ye Mingxuan readily agreed.
location: Third-floor hall, Jincui Palace Restaurant (Diamond CBD Building), Jinji Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Took a taxi to OCT Creative Park
description: After morning tea, the three of them walked out of the restaurant, and a fine shower began to fall outside. They quickly called a ride-hailing car and headed to OCT-Loft. Ye Mingxuan sat in the front passenger seat and, through the curtain of rain, observed the urban landscape of Nanshan, comparing it with Tianjin's planning style.
location: Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing, route: Jincui Palace Restaurant to OCT Loft

name: Visit OCT Loft
description: The rain gradually subsided, and the three of them strolled through the park with umbrellas. They first visited the old factory buildings in Area A. Ye Mingxuan was very interested in the exposed steel frame structure and discussed with his cousin how this industrial aesthetic differed from old Tianjin factories. Then they browsed an independent designer concept store, where Ye Mingxuan took a liking to a titanium alloy tool set, but it was expensive, so he decided not to buy it for now. The three then spent nearly half an hour in the "Old Heaven Bookstore" in Area B, where Ye Mingxuan was drawn to a picture book on bridge structure design.
location: OCT-Loft Creative Cultural Park, No. 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Lunch
description: It was nearly noon when they left the bookstore. The three had lunch at "A+ Cafe" in the creative park. Ye Mingxuan ordered an avocado chicken salad and an iced Americano, while his cousin and cousin's wife tried the restaurant's signature pasta. During the meal, they talked about what they had seen and felt that morning.
location: A+ Cafe, OCT Creative Park, 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Took a taxi back to the hotel.
description: Considering the afternoon walk in Talent Park, I need to change into a more comfortable pair of mesh breathable sneakers. I took a taxi alone back to Jingtian Hotel.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing, route: OCT-LOFT Creative Culture Park to Jintian Hotel

name: Hotel rest, shoe change, and video check-in.
description: Returned to the hotel lobby, retrieved luggage from the front desk, and quickly changed into sneakers. Taking advantage of this time, made a WeChat video call to his mother, gave a detailed report of the morning's itinerary, and told her that his male cousin and his wife had taken very good care of him. His mother told him not to drink at the evening dinner and to stay safe. After about 15 minutes, he hung up, put the exchanged leather shoes into his backpack.
location: Lobby and luggage storage, Jingtian Hotel, No. 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Take a taxi to Shenzhen Talent Park
description: After resting, he took a taxi again to Talent Park in Nanshan District. On the way, he closed his eyes and rested, saving energy for the afternoon walk.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing, route: Jingtian Hotel to Shenzhen Talent Park

name: Strolling in Talent Park and reminiscing about old times
description: In the afternoon, the weather turned cloudy, with occasional breaks of sunshine. The three of them walked slowly side by side along the lakeside path. Ye Mingxuan and his older cousin walked ahead, while his cousin’s wife took photos behind. They talked about their childhood days in the attic of the old Tianjin house—flipping through picture-story books and making wooden slingshots. His cousin remarked that marriage had brought more responsibility. Ye Mingxuan shared his experience learning woodworking from Master Qian, saying, “Woodworking, like mechanical design, leaves no room for the slightest error.” His cousin also talked enthusiastically about his ideas for future cooperation on intelligent fixture projects.
location: Shenzhen Talent Park, No. 3329 Keyuan South Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province (lakeside trail, Starlight Bridge)

name: Took a taxi back to the hotel and tidied up
description: At 17:00, the light began to soften. The three decided to end the walk and prepare for the evening gathering. Ye Mingxuan took a taxi alone back to the hotel. He took a quick shower, changed into a clean dark blue polo shirt, and put his phone, power bank, and business card holder into his shoulder bag.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing car, route: Shenzhen Talent Park to Jingtian Hotel

name: Free time and waiting
description: He went downstairs early and sat on the sofa in the hotel lobby. He browsed a few cutting-edge articles on his phone about the application of LLMs in industrial design. Then he sent a message to his cousin to confirm that the dinner location was Chef Hong Chicken Pot (Futian Store) at Chegongmiao.
location: Lobby, Jingtian Hotel, No. 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Took a taxi to the dinner venue
description: After receiving the confirmation from his cousin, he immediately called a ride to “Chef Hong's Chicken Pot (Futian Store)” at No. 18, Tairan 8th Road. On the way, he started looking forward to tonight's gathering.
location: Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, ride-hailing, route: Jingtian Hotel to Hongdachu Chicken Pot (Futian Branch)

name: Attended the dinner party organized by his older male cousin
description: The dinner was warm and lively, and his cousin and his wife were very hospitable. Ye Mingxuan sat next to an engineer working on backend development at Tencent, and the two had an in-depth discussion about the application of algorithms in industrial automation. During the meal, he unexpectedly saw Chen Hao, a high school classmate, and Wang Lei, a middle school classmate. The three happily clinked glasses and caught up, and agreed that Ye Mingxuan would take the lead in getting together again at noon the next day. The dinner had a rich selection of dishes; he tried the signature chicken pot and other specialty dishes.
location: Private room on the second floor of Chef Hong's Chicken Pot (Futian Branch), No. 18 Tairan 8th Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Walk back to the hotel and review contacts.
description: After the dinner, he politely declined a ride from a friend who was going the same way and chose to walk back to the hotel alone. The evening breeze was pleasant. As he walked, he recorded the day's observations in the memo app on his phone and sent a WeChat message to Chen Hao to confirm that they would meet again at 12:30 pm tomorrow at the restaurant in OCT Creative Park.
location: From Tairan 8th Road to Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, about 2 kilometers on foot.

name: Picking up luggage, washing up, and preparing for bed.
description: First returned to the hotel front desk to retrieve the checked luggage and checked in. After returning to Room 8301, he charged his phone, power bank, and earbuds case. While washing up, he felt his skin was a bit dry from being out in the wind all day, so he applied a moisturizing mask provided by the hotel. Lying in bed, he briefly browsed a podcast outline on "Python automation" using his iPad and set an alarm for 8:30 the next morning.
location: Lobby and Room 8301, Jingtian Hotel, No. 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Falling asleep
description: The room quieted down, and a glimmer of the city's neon lights outside the window seeped in. Recalling the fulfilling day — the industrial aesthetics of the creative park, the lake breeze at Talent Park, and the reunion with old friends and new acquaintances at dinner — he felt grounded and content. He adjusted his pillow and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 8301, Jingtian Hotel, 133 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Waking up, morning preparation, and itinerary confirmation
description: At 7:30 a.m., the phone alarm went off on time. After habitually staying in bed for five minutes, Ye Mingxuan got up and washed up, splashing cold water on his face to fully wake himself. Then he sat on the edge of the bed, opened the notes app on his phone, and checked today's key to-dos: check out before 10:30, have lunch with Li Na, Chen Hao, and Wang Lei at Nanshan at 11:30, and take the 15:20 flight back to Tianjin. Confirming everything was on plan, he felt calm.
location: Guest room at Jingtian Hotel, No. 133, intersection of Jingtian Road and Shangbao Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Hotel breakfast and diet planning.
description: Ye Mingxuan went alone to the breakfast room on the second floor of the hotel and deliberately chose a corner seat a little away from the buffet. Facing the array of breakfast options, he resisted the urge to eat more and only took a bowl of plain congee, a boiled egg, two slices of whole-wheat bread, and a small plate of dressed cucumber. In his mind he repeated that this was the last day he could indulge, and that he would have to strictly control his weight when he returned to Tianjin. He ate the breakfast slowly, chewing carefully.
location: Jingtian Hotel Breakfast Restaurant, No. 133, at the intersection of Jingtian Road and Shangbao Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Check-out and heading to OCT Creative Park
description: Ye Mingxuan carefully checked the bedside table, drawers, bathroom, and wardrobe. After confirming nothing was left behind, he dragged his suitcase and carried his backpack to the front desk to check out. He ordered a ride-hailing car on his phone, setting the destination as the North Gate of OCT Creative Culture Park. The driver was a local, and the ride was smooth. Ye Mingxuan enjoyed Shenzhen's cityscape through the window, occasionally chatting with the driver about the weather and the National Day crowds. They arrived at the creative park around 9:00.
location: North Gate, OCT-LOFT Creative Culture Park, No. 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Alone time at the coffee shop and further refining the tool concept.
description: To avoid the morning rush hour crowds, Ye Mingxuan dragged his luggage into the Old Heaven Books coffee area, found a quiet seat in a corner against the wall, and ordered an Americano. He put down his backpack, opened his laptop, created a new document titled 'Python Tool Webification Concept_v0.2', and, fully focused, reviewed last night's conversation and began writing the core ideas: encapsulate the core algorithms as independent modules, use the Flask framework to build a lightweight web interface, preliminarily envision using Plotly for data visualization, and design user permissions and a logging system. As he wrote, he sketched a brief architecture diagram in his Moleskine notebook.
location: Old Heaven Books coffee area, OCT-Loft Creative Culture Park, No. 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Stroll around the creative park and get in touch with an old friend.
description: After leaving the bookstore, Ye Mingxuan felt clear-headed and decided to take a walk around the creative park to clear his mind. He visited two design product stores, became interested in a modular combination furniture piece, took photos with his phone, and thought he could refer to it later when designing woodworking projects. He checked his watch; it was nearly 11 o'clock. He sent Li Na a WeChat message telling her his location and asking whether she had arrived.
location: Inside OCT-LOFT, No. 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Meet up with old classmates in advance.
description: Ye Mingxuan received a reply from Chen Hao saying that he and Wang Lei were already at the entrance of A+ Cafe, where they had met yesterday. Ye Mingxuan walked over quickly and, seeing the two chatting from afar, went up and patted their shoulders in greeting. Chen Hao said Li Na would arrive in another 10 minutes, and the three decided to head to the restaurant first to get a good spot.
location: Outside A+ Cafe, near No. 8 Jinxiu North Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Dinner with old classmates to catch up
description: The four of them took their seats at the Cantonese teahouse Jincui Imperial Palace that Chen Hao had booked and ordered Tieguanyin. The conversation revolved around Li Na's suggestion to make the Python tools web-based. She explained in depth how to collaborate better with non-technical people, Wang Lei gave professional opinions on backend stability and concurrency, and Chen Hao joked that once it was done, it could be used for internal testing at his company. Ye Mingxuan shared his plan for settling down after returning to Tianjin. They also talked about the housing price gap and pace of life between Shenzhen and Tianjin, and the embarrassing high school memories of skipping class together to play The King of Fighters. Ye Mingxuan tried hard to restrain himself and only ate some white-cut chicken and steamed shrimp.
location: Jincui Palace (OCT Branch), Xiangshan East Street, OCT-Loft, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Wang Lei gave a ride to the airport on the way
description: After the dinner gathering, Wang Lei, who happened to be going to the airport to pick up a friend, offered to give Ye Mingxuan a ride to the airport on the way. Ye Mingxuan stored his luggage and got in the car. On the way, the two continued discussing career bottlenecks and views on technical growth. Wang Lei shared some of the reality of involution in Shenzhen's internet industry and a mindset of actively seeking change. About 25 minutes later, the car stopped steadily at the entrance to the departure hall, and the two shook hands and said goodbye.
location: Departure hall of T3 Terminal, Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport, at the intersection of Bao'an Avenue and Airport South Road, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Waiting at the airport, security check, and document refinement
description: Ye Mingxuan quickly printed his boarding pass at the self-service machine, queued through security, and entered the departure hall. He found a seat near the gate, set down his luggage, opened his laptop again, and added the inspiration he had gotten from Li Na at the dinner table—'add a case library feature so users can access historical designs'—to the morning document. He scanned it once to confirm the logic was clear, and closed the computer with satisfaction.
location: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport Terminal 3 departure hall, at the intersection of Bao'an Avenue and Airport South Road, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Took a flight back to Tianjin.
description: Flight ZH9139 took off on time. After the climb leveled off, Ye Mingxuan took out his notebook and neatly wrote down the to-do item "Consider using Flask to build the internal web frontend." Then he put on his noise-cancelling headphones and thought about how to report the results of the Shenzhen trip to the senior engineer after work the next day. During the second half of the flight he dozed off against the window for about thirty minutes. After waking up he felt much refreshed and, seeing the plains and city lights outside the window, knew he was almost home.
location: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport to Tianjin Binhai International Airport Flight ZH9139

name: Arriving in Tianjin, picking up luggage, and taking a taxi
description: After the plane landed at Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Ye Mingxuan immediately sent a WeChat message to his parents to let them know he was safe, and also sent Li Na a message saying he had landed. He retrieved his suitcase smoothly, walked out of the arrivals hall, and queued in the official taxi waiting area. After getting in the car, he told the driver the address "Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District", and the car drove away from the airport.
location: Terminal 2, Tianjin Binhai International Airport, Jinbin Avenue, Dongli District, Tianjin

name: Returning home, having dinner together, and sharing stories
description: By the time he arrived home, his mother Wang Xiulan had already prepared a table of steaming hot dishes. Ye Mingxuan called out to his parents as he walked in, then took out carefully wrapped Cantonese pastries and the wedding candy his cousin had asked him to bring from his suitcase. At the dinner table, while eating his mother's braised pork, he vividly described the bustling street scenes of Shenzhen, the amusing details of his cousin's wedding, and the conversations from the gathering with old classmates, focusing on Li Na and the others' positive views of the Python tools. His father Ye Jianguo listened with great interest and even asked a few technical questions, while his mother was more concerned about whether he had eaten well and whether he was tired.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Packing luggage, relaxation, and self-reflection
description: After the meal, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table. He returned to the bedroom and systematically organized his suitcase: he picked out the shirts and jackets that needed dry cleaning, and put away electronic devices such as the portable hard drive, power bank, and charging cables. Then he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did about 15 minutes of systematic stretching, focusing on relaxing the stiff lower back, shoulders, and neck from the long flight. He felt his whole body loosen up considerably.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Leisure with family and online material exploration
description: He sat in the living room with his parents watching TV, discussing a prime-time competitive variety show. Ye Mingxuan took out his phone, opened the Tianjin Woodworking Enthusiasts Forum and the Red Star Macalline online mall, searched keywords such as "Tianjin hardwood," "bubinga wood," and "elm square lumber," browsed information on large-dimension hardwood stores, and bookmarked several links that looked promising. Then he wrote in his memo: "Before Oct. 7: 1. Contact XX building materials market to inquire; 2. Compare prices; 3. Determine dimensions."
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Ye Mingxuan took a comfortable hot shower to shake off the fatigue of the day. After washing up, he changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and took out the Mechanical Design Handbook to review hinge design content, warming up for the next day's work. Then he opened the Guquan Yuandi forum and saw a new post by Professor Zhao Jianguo about varieties of the Yuan Shikai portrait silver coin from the third year of the Republic of China. He read it carefully and left a reply.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Deep reading and bedtime preparation
description: It was about time, so Ye Mingxuan switched his phone to Do Not Disturb mode and put the book back on the bedside table. Closing his eyes, he briefly reviewed the day: from checking out to keeping the appointment, having an in-depth conversation with his old classmate, flying, and returning home, the whole process was tight and orderly. He had gained initial insights both into the direction of the Python tools and the plant stand materials, and he felt calm and fulfilled. He silently repeated, 'Tomorrow I'll get back to my normal rhythm,' and soon fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up, washing up, and stretching
description: Ye Mingxuan woke up in the early morning, and sunlight streamed into the room through the curtains. After admiring the succulents on the balcony, he washed up in the bathroom and did some shoulder and neck stretches to relieve fatigue. While warming up, I observed the runners around me; some were wearing fun cosplay outfits, and an energetic silver-haired old man was in high spirits. The atmosphere was lively and orderly. I entered the half-marathon starting area by bib zone and could see the timing arch ahead. I adjusted my sports watch to pace mode and silently recited the strategy of keeping a steady pace for the first 5 km. As the national anthem played, the atmosphere reached its peak.

As I passed the 'Tianjin Eye' Ferris wheel, the enthusiastic cheers from the spectators felt great. At the 15-kilometer mark, the wall arrived as expected. My legs felt heavy as lead and my breathing became rapid. I proactively slowed to a 6:40 pace, took out an energy gel, squeezed it into my mouth, and drank some water. After adjusting for about 500 meters, my body gradually recovered. In the last 3 kilometers, I heard the music and broadcast from the Olympic Sports Center near the finish line. I took a deep breath and started to sprint. Amid the roaring crowd, I crossed the finish line with a gun time of 2 hours 12 minutes. Then I checked my watch and saw a net time of 2 hours 10 minutes 38 seconds. At that moment of crossing the line, a tremendous sense of achievement and physical exhaustion were intertwined.

His father excitedly patted him on the shoulder; Senior Engineer Gao and Li Xiang took turns giving him high-fives. The four of them took several group photos with their phones in front of the finish-line backdrop. He deliberately shook their hands with a steady wrist and felt in good condition.
location: Tianjin Olympic Center Stadium finish rest area, No. 3 Binshui West Road, Nankai District, Tianjin.

Li Xiang vividly described his heroic sprint earlier, and Ye Mingxuan shared the difficult wall at the 15-kilometer mark and how he adjusted his mindset to overcome it. Senior Engineer Gao toasted with tea in place of wine, congratulated him on achieving his goal, and affirmed the perseverance he had shown in work and running.
