location: Balcony workstation at home, Huating International Residential Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was steamed sea bass, tomato scrambled eggs, and rice, all prepared by his mother. Eating with his parents, he proactively shared the outcome of today's promotion talk with the Senior Engineer, and his parents were very happy. His father urged, "You must turn your goals into actions every day." He nodded in agreement and cleared the table after the meal. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening study: career goal information search.
description: After dinner, feeling energetic, I went to the study and carried out the action plan I made at noon. I turned on the computer, logged into the official website of the National Intellectual Property Administration, found and downloaded the utility model patent application template, key points for writing claims, and drawing requirements, and saved them to the "2025-Patent Application" folder. Then I logged into the PMI website, checked the PMP eligibility requirements (confirmed that 35 hours of project management education is required) and the exam schedule, searched for well-reviewed local PMP training institutions, and organized the key information into an Excel spreadsheet. Initial plan: start patent drafting in November and register for PMP training in December. A solid step forward for my career development.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Casual browsing and relaxation
description: After studying, he relaxed his mind by opening a live-streaming app on his phone, searching for 'Caozhuang Flower Market,' and watching a 20-minute live broadcast by a succulent shop owner featuring new stock. He spotted several 'Peach Egg' varieties in excellent condition and decided to go to the market in person to pick some out on the weekend. Relaxing and leisurely.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Brushed my teeth, washed my face, and soaked my feet in hot water for 10 minutes to promote blood circulation. Before bed, I checked my phone, looked at tomorrow's weather forecast (cloudy turning to light rain), and set the alarm to 7:00. Finished my bedtime routine.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, he browsed the chapter on tables and stands in *Ming Furniture Research*, thinking about the structural details of the rosewood small table. At 22:30, he turned off the lights on time and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Re-prepare materials and calibrate tools.
description: Without any hesitation, he took a new piece of rosewood leg stock from the material rack. He measured and marked it again, calibrating all the tools more carefully than before. Taking a deep breath, he told himself that although it was late, quality had to be ensured. After composing himself, he was ready to start sawing again.
location: Woodworking workshop at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Light cleaning and going to bed
description: He let out a long breath and simply tidied up the scraps and tools. After quickly washing up, with a sense of relief from sticking to his principles, and also with the exhaustion of being frustrated by his mistake and determined to do better tomorrow, he lay down on the bed and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Woodworking workshop and bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: His biological clock woke him up right on time. While washing up, he checked his right leg; the soreness from the half marathon had basically disappeared. At breakfast, his mother had steamed pork and scallion buns. Mingxuan ate while telling her that there was a badminton team-building activity at the company that evening and he would not be home for dinner. His mother reminded him not to catch a cold from sweating while playing badminton in the colder weather.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute by car.
description: Drove out of the neighborhood; the weather was gloomy and ginkgo leaves covered the roadside. Turned on the car stereo and played the crosstalk "I Want Happiness" by Guo Degang and Yu Qian, driving to the office in a lighthearted, humorous atmosphere. Traffic was normal on the way, and he felt relaxed.
location: Driving route from Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road.

name: Arrival at work and office preparation.
description: Arrived at the company. After clocking in, I went to the pantry to brew a cup of chrysanthemum and goji berry tea I had brought from home. At my workbench, I took out the tenon drawing for the entryway side table that I had rechecked with hand drawings last night, and confirmed the key dimensions again with a pencil, preparing for the technical briefing for tonight's woodworking work.
location: Workstation at Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd., Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drawing review and technical recheck
description: Turn on the computer and professional software, and officially get into work mode. Today's main task is to review the design drawings of a high-precision milling fixture for a new project. Comparing with the electronic version, I carefully marked two questionable tolerance boundaries on the printed drawings with a red-and-blue pencil, and wrote on a sticky note: "It is recommended to confirm process feasibility with Senior Engineer Gao here." Light music played on loop to keep me focused.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Technical discussion with the senior engineer
description: After organizing the questions on the drawings, I took my notebook and went to find Gao Zhiyuan. The two of us had a brief ten-minute discussion about the two marked points, confirming that one was a secondary requirement and the other indeed needed optimized annotation.
location: Gao Zhiyuan's workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Technical documentation writing and email handling.
description: After returning to my workstation, I began writing a technical description document for internal drawing archiving, clearly recording part names, drawing numbers, modification reasons, and dates. During this time, I also replied to three customer emails asking about delivery dates and approved a batch of bushing material warehousing requests.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Lunch and team-building details confirmation
description: Asked Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to go to the malatang restaurant downstairs for lunch. While eating, he took out his phone, opened the chat history of the company badminton group, and finally confirmed with them: "The group notice says tonight at 7 pm, courts 3 and 4 at Jinhui Court. Zhou Tao and I are one team, and Li Xiang, you are with Xiao Zheng? The organizer said they bought new shuttlecocks, so we don't need to bring any." Zhou Tao also said that he had already contacted two colleagues from the production department to join.
location: Malatang restaurant near Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Internal technical sync-up meeting.
description: Project manager Wang Peng chaired this week's internal technical sync meeting. During the meeting, Mingxuan and Li Xiang each gave a five-minute progress update on their respective modules and submitted a request for coordinating test resources. Wang Peng confirmed the testing schedule on the spot.
location: Company meeting room, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drawing modifications and document updates
description: After the meeting, he returned to his workstation and, based on the morning discussion with the senior engineer, revised the annotation that needed optimization on the CAD drawing and updated the technical specification document from the morning.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Woodworking material preparation and pre-off-work organizing
description: There was still a little time before getting off work. I opened the phone album, pulled up the macro close-up photos of three machine-made coins taken at home last night, and confirmed that the angle and clarity were sufficient for online communication. Then I organized today's to-do list, shut down the computer, and packed my commuter bag.
location: Company workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute to the court after work
description: Clocked out from work and drove directly from the company's downstairs parking lot. A fine autumn rain began to fall; he turned on the wipers and thought, luckily the basketball court was only about 2 kilometers away from the company, so it would take just a few minutes to get there.
location: Tianjin driving route: Haitai Development Office Building to Jinhui Badminton Hall, Huayuan Industrial Park, Xiqing District.

name: On-court warm-up and court preparation
description: Arrived at the sports hall and changed into sports gear in advance. First did 5 minutes of dynamic stretching at the side of the court to loosen up the joints. Then met up with the organizer Ye Mingxuan and helped hang the simple banner reading 'Every Wednesday, Badminton Date With You.' Checked the court lighting, and after confirming everything was fine, each person took a tube of new shuttlecocks and waited for colleagues to arrive one after another.
location: Jinhui Badminton Hall, Haitai South-North Avenue, Huayuan Industrial Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: First regular departmental badminton team-building activity
description: The department's first regular badminton team-building activity started on time. A total of 12 colleagues participated. I led everyone in two laps of jogging around the courts, then guided them through a set of badminton-specific warm-up exercises. As a player, I performed steadily in the doubles rotation, with focused eyes and crisp net kills. I teamed up with two colleagues from the production department for a few games, proactively chatted with them, and asked about their production line situation. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. At the end of the activity, everyone took a group photo at the sideline and agreed to play again next Wednesday.
location: Courts 3 and 4, Jinhui Badminton Hall, Haitai South-North Street, Huayuan Industrial Park, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Drove back home
description: After the activity ended, I said goodbye to my colleagues and packed up my backpack. Since I had sweated a lot, I took a spare jacket from the car and changed into it. The air was fresh after the rain on the way. I turned on the traffic broadcast and listened to the evening news. The drive of about 20 minutes gradually calmed me down from the excitement of the exercise.
location: Tianjin self-driving route: Jinhui Badminton Hall via Zhongbei Avenue to Huating International Community.

name: Quick shower.
description: After getting home, he went straight into the bathroom and took a slightly hot five-minute shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue, then changed into a soft old-man shirt and sports shorts as work clothes for the studio.
location: Bathroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Making a small entryway table: cutting and planing.
description: Entering the workshop, he turned on the high-power LED desk lamp and the ceiling light to ensure bright lighting. From the corner, he carried out several pieces of rosewood purchased the day before, wiped off the dust with a damp cloth, and placed them on a shelf against the wall to acclimate to the workshop's temperature and humidity. At the same time, he neatly arranged the vernier caliper, triple marking gauge, try square, pencil, and printed CAD drawings on the workbench. Then, following the drawings, he marked the centerlines and rough outlines of each part on the wood with a pencil and began hand planing. The sound of the plane was crisp in the quiet night. He focused on planing the four leg pieces and four cross brace pieces flat and straight, checking their straightness repeatedly with a try square, with complete concentration.
location: Woodworking workshop at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (area partitioned off on the south side of the study)

name: Short rest and an online appointment with a collector friend
description: After half an hour of continuous planing and polishing, he stopped to rest and drink some water. He took out his phone, sent several close-up photos of ancient coins taken last night to Zhao Jianguo, a collector friend in Xi'an, and wrote: "Old Zhao, the three pieces I sorted out last night—pretty good condition, right? Did you get the photos?" At the same time, he casually sent a voice message: "Are you free next Saturday evening? Let's have a good online chat about the market for these few pieces."
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Machining the tenons on the legs of the entryway side table
description: After a rest, he focused on processing the most critical part—the tenon on the leg. He picked up the vernier caliper, repeatedly measured the 15mm thickness marked on the drawing, and then formally began sawing. However, because it was close to midnight, his body began to feel fatigued. While sawing the second tenon, he suddenly felt the blade pressure was wrong. Stopping and measuring, he found the tenon had been cut about 2mm too thin. He clicked his tongue in annoyance, rechecked three times with the vernier caliper, and confirmed it was indeed only 13mm. Staring at the thinned leg piece, he remembered his promise to Zhang Wei and his own quality bottom line, and decisively decided to discard this batch of parts and start again from material preparation. In his work notes, he wrote: "Better to be late than to deliver defects."
location: Woodworking workshop at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up and morning hygiene routine.
description: Woke up to the phone alarm in the early morning and felt the cool air coming in through the window, remembering that today is Frost's Descent. I lay in bed for a moment to collect myself, then weighed myself on the digital scale: 71.6 kg, 0.4 kg lighter than yesterday. It struck me that this might be due to staying up late, and I reminded myself that I had to finish the entryway side table being reworked at the woodworking shop tonight. After getting up, I opened the curtains and confirmed it was drizzling outside. I took a thin down vest out of the wardrobe and put it on, then went into the bathroom to wash up quickly, splashing cold water on my face to wake myself up.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin - bedroom and bathroom

name: Family breakfast and keeping-warm adjustments for Frost's Descent
description: Entering the dining room, his mother Wang Xiulan had already set hot soy milk and Goubuli buns on the table, and had deliberately replaced the water in the thermos with warm water, reminding him not to drink cold water in cold weather. His father Ye Jianguo planned to replace the living room screen windows with insulating window film later and lay a flannel blanket on the sofa. Ye Mingxuan nodded in response while eating the buns, feeling the warmth of home and his parents' attentive care.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drive to work
description: After greeting his parents, he grabbed his commuter bag and folding umbrella and went downstairs, then drove out of the underground garage. The rain was not heavy, but the road was slippery, so he deliberately slowed down. He turned on the car radio and tuned it to a crosstalk channel. Listening to Ma Sanli's routines, he drove relaxed along Zhongbei Avenue toward Haitai Development 6th Road.
location: Inside the car, driving along Zhongbei Avenue to Haitai Development Sixth Road

name: Morning work: drawing review and design checking.
description: After arriving at his workstation on the 12th floor of Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, he first went to the break room, rinsed a cup, and brewed a cup of Tieguanyin tea. He turned on his computer and checked his email; there was a confirmation letter from a client about last week's fixture drawings. Then he opened his work log and planned the day's priorities. Next, he began working on the unfinished milling fixture drawings from yesterday, marking items awaiting review on the printed drawings with a red marker, and raising questions about two geometric tolerances in particular. At about 9:30, he went to the neighboring workstation to consult Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan. The senior engineer agreed with his judgment and suggested a more conservative tolerance zone. After returning, he opened CAD to perform force verification calculations on key components and recorded data points that needed to be discussed with Li Xiang, a simulation colleague. Nearing 11:00, he paused the complex calculations and updated the draft of this week's report, writing the confirmed drawing issues and the senior engineer's suggestions into it. While he was doing this, colleague Zhou Tao passed by and chatted about last night's badminton team-building activity. Ye Mingxuan said they could arrange a fixed court next time.
location: Research and Development Department Office Area, 12th Floor, Block B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Midday emergency response, lunch, and rest
description: Li Xiang sent over a preliminary simulation report on pin-hole fit and needed urgent confirmation of the fitting parameters. Ye Mingxuan spent half an hour carefully checking the model against his own design files and gave clear feedback, ensuring Li Xiang could continue before his lunch break. At 12:00, Zhou Tao called everyone to go to the cafeteria; because that day had braised pork ribs, the three went together to the first-floor employee cafeteria. During the meal they talked about last night's badminton team-building; Li Xiang asked how it went, Zhou Tao complained that he lost two games, and they agreed to have a rematch next week. At 12:40 he returned to his workstation. Since he had gone to bed late in the early morning, sleepiness surged, so he lay directly on the desk, set a 30-minute alarm, and took a nap. After the alarm rang, he got up and did stretches next to his workstation, moving his neck and wrists.
location: Haitai Development Office Building Tower B, 12th-floor workstation and first-floor employee cafeteria, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon design review, client communication, and wrap-up
description: After the lunch break, I returned to the component design verification work left unfinished in the morning. Based on the model suggested by Senior Engineer Gao, I carefully checked each fit parameter and updated the technical documentation. At 15:00, I replied to the client's confirmation email about the drawing modification plan and copied the project manager. At 16:00, I received Li Xiang's complete simulation report, spent an hour checking the data, and gave final feedback after confirming there were no errors. Half an hour before leaving work, I organized the day's files, recorded progress and tomorrow's to-dos in the Notion work log, and used the final ten-plus minutes to browse my bookmarked ancient coin forum, confirmed the time for the online discussion with Teacher Zhao from Xi'an on October 28, and set a reminder in the calendar.
location: Workstation in the R&D Department, 12th Floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Driving home from work.
description: At 17:00, I clocked out and left work on time. By then the rain had stopped, but the road was still slippery. I started the car, turned on the radio to listen to road conditions on the traffic channel, and drove along Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road toward Zhongbei Avenue. With the heater on, I felt tired holding the steering wheel, but I was satisfied with my work efficiency that day.
location: In a self-driven car, from Haitai Development Sixth Road to Zhongbei Avenue

name: Going home to rest, sorting ancient coins, and family life
description: First, he drove into the underground garage of the Huating International community and stopped, but did not immediately turn off the engine. He took out his phone and quickly took a few photos of the ancient coins sorted yesterday, adding notes so he could share them with Teacher Zhao on the weekend. Then he went upstairs, changed out of his work clothes, and sat on the sofa in the living room. He sprayed water on the succulents on the balcony. Observing their growth, he noticed that the leaves of a pot of Yulu were a bit shriveled, so he planned to water it thoroughly in a couple of days. Meanwhile, he smelled the aroma of white fungus and fish wafting from the kitchen.
location: Underground garage of Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and the living room and balcony of Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7

name: Family dinner, seasonal eating for Frost Descent, and after-dinner activities
description: Dinner was served at exactly 6 PM. Mother specially brought out white fungus and pear soup, steamed sea bass, and sautéed seasonal vegetables, saying they were good for moistening the lungs during Frost's Descent. During the meal, Ye Mingxuan talked with his parents about the senior engineer helping to confirm the drawings. Mother told him not to work too hard, and Father said, "Technical work requires patience and focus." He drank two bowls of white fungus soup and felt especially warm. After dinner, he walked back and forth in the living room to aid digestion, then went to the balcony to remove a few withered leaves from the succulents, and afterward did ten minutes of shoulder, neck, and arm stretching with a phone app in the living room to loosen his joints for the upcoming woodworking.
location: Dining room and living room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Woodworking time: building the main body of the entryway side table
date: The bus arrived at Lu Xun's Hometown.
description: At 19:00, he entered the temporary family workshop converted from the study, turned on the desk lamp, and, having learned from yesterday's lesson, first rechecked the dimensions of the rosewood stock with a high-precision angle gauge to make sure everything was exact. Then, strictly following the process Master Qian had taught him, he carefully cut the tenons and mortises for the four legs and six horizontal stretchers, measuring each tenon three times with a vernier caliper. Around 21:30, his mother came in carrying a bowl of white fungus and pear soup and gently told him he had to stop by 11 at the latest. After three hours of focused work, he successfully completed the initial assembly of the four legs and the horizontal stretchers. The structure was stable, the lines were straight, and the main body of the small table took shape. He carefully marked each joint with a pencil, ready for fine sanding the next day.
location: Study (Home Office), Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Evening wash-up, review, and going to bed
description: At 22:00, following his mother's reminder, he stopped work on time, briefly cleaned up the wood shavings in the workshop, and went to the bathroom to rinse his hands with hot water to relieve the fatigue from gripping tools. While washing up, he reviewed the evening's production process in his mind and felt quite satisfied. At 22:20, he lay down on the bed, planning to later record the successful rework experience in his diary as work notes and briefly plan the weekend: Saturday morning could be spent visiting Caozhuang Flower Market, and in the afternoon sorting photos of ancient coins to prepare for next week's online exchange. At 22:35, he turned off the lights and closed his eyes, feeling grounded about the evening's woodworking progress, and fell asleep quickly with a calm mind.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: First order delivery of the woodworking sideline and establishment of business goals.
description: At 5:43 a.m., Ye Mingxuan woke up and went directly to his woodworking workshop at home to finely sand and wax the entryway side table that had been assembled the night before. He first used 180-grit sandpaper to round the edges and corners, then used 320-grit, 400-grit, and 600-grit sandpaper in sequence to bring out a mirror-like luster. After applying wood wax oil, he rubbed it repeatedly with a soft cloth until the grain showed a warm amber color. Finally, he used a strong flashlight to carefully inspect every mortise-and-tenon joint to ensure a tight fit. At exactly 7 o'clock, he took five detail photos of the side table in natural light (overall view, wood grain, tenon, bottom, and a group photo with the nearby succulent plant) and sent them to client Zhang Wei. In less than five minutes, Zhang Wei replied by voice message: "Mingxuan, this craftsmanship is incredible! I'll transfer the 800 yuan we agreed on right now!" A WeChat transfer came through immediately. Ye Mingxuan stared at the payment record, his heartbeat quickening slightly — this was the first income from his woodworking side business, enough to cover the out-of-pocket portion of his mother's Chinese medicine treatment at the rheumatology department last month. He solemnly wrote in his workbench notebook: "Woodworking side business — annual target: 5000 yuan," and drafted rules: at most 2 orders per month, profit 600 yuan per order, prioritize referrals from acquaintances, and never encroach on his main job or family time.
location: Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Family breakfast and first aid drill proposal
description: After a quick wash, he put on a thin down vest to ward off the morning chill. His mother, Wang Xiulan, set warmed soy milk and freshly steamed Goubuli buns on the table and asked Ye Mingxuan with concern whether he had stayed up late again last night. Ye Mingxuan smiled and replied, "The little table came out perfectly! Thanks to you, I even earned 800 yuan this morning." His father, Ye Jianguo, came out of the bedroom in a flannel shirt and suggested holding a family first aid drill this month, focusing on practicing AED and CPR, and told Ye Mingxuan to discuss it together when he came back in the evening. Ye Mingxuan agreed and said he could be responsible for finding tutorials.
location: Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Confirmed AHA first aid course during commute
description: He left home at 7:43, started the silver-gray VW Sagitar, took Zhongbei Avenue and turned onto West Outer Ring Road, and drove to the company. While waiting at a red light, he looked through the message from the city emergency center on his phone, confirmed that his registration for next week's AHA first-aid provider course (a 2-day weekend class) was successful, and noted in his memo to bring his ID card and a two-inch photo. He planned to download the preview materials in advance after arriving at the company.
location: The commuting route from Zhongbei Avenue to Haitai Development Sixth Road in Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Review drawings and discuss tolerance plan
description: At 8:01 he swiped his card to enter his workstation at the Haitai Development office building, brewed Tieguanyin tea, and opened his work log. The core task of the morning was to review the milling fixture drawings submitted last week and to provide a modification plan for the two geometric tolerance issues raised by Engineer Gao. Around 10 o'clock, Ye Mingxuan sorted out his revision approach and met his colleague Li Xiang, who handled simulation analysis, in the pantry for a preliminary discussion on how the tolerance adjustment for one of the difficult points would affect assembly precision. At 11 o'clock, he returned to his workstation and began organizing the system BOM list for the fixture, preparing for the afternoon short meeting.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Download the AHA course preview materials
description: Using the half hour after finishing the morning work, Ye Mingxuan opened the municipal emergency center's official website, found the AHA course page, and downloaded the Student Handbook (electronic version) and a set of pre-course practice questions to his phone. He quickly skimmed the table of contents, got a general impression of the Basic Life Support (BLS) process, and planned to read it carefully during the weekend lunch break.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Lunchtime sharing good news about a side business with colleagues
description: At exactly noon, Ye Mingxuan left the office building with his colleague Zhou Tao and walked along the street for six minutes to a malatang restaurant in Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park. While eating and chatting, he couldn’t help sharing the good news that his small side table had gained recognition that morning and he had received his first side income of 800 yuan. Zhou Tao was happy for him and teased, “Master Ye, from now on we’ll have to call you Boss Ye. Later, make me a carved wooden Guan Gong statue as a guardian treasure for the house.” Ye Mingxuan also told him about his plan to go to Master Qian’s workshop on Sunday to prepare for the public welfare class.
location: Malatang Restaurant, Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Finalize the fixture drawing modification plan
description: At 13:00, the lunch break ended, and Ye Mingxuan found Li Xiang and confirmed the final modification plan for the geometric tolerance issue discussed in the morning, incorporating the simulation analysis data he had provided. He annotated the CAD drawing clearly, generated a modification list, and organized it into several PPT slides in preparation for the 3 p.m. project progress meeting.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Attend a short project progress meeting.
description: At 3 p.m., the project department held its weekly progress brief meeting. At the meeting, Ye Mingxuan reported on the progress of the milling fixture drawing revisions and the organization of the tooling BOM, and explained the upcoming work plan. Project manager Wang Peng expressed approval of the progress, and Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan added suggestions on material selection. The meeting ended on time at 3:30.
location: Conference room, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Archive work results and plan for tomorrow
description: After the short meeting, he returned to his workstation and saved and archived the drawings, BOM sheets, and meeting minutes handled today. At the same time, he added two to-do items in Notion: go to Caozhuang Flower Market tomorrow morning to buy new succulents and repot the shriveled Haworthia; in the afternoon, organize the ancient coin photos to prepare for the online exchange with fellow collector Teacher Zhao from Xi'an next Wednesday.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Going to Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop to prepare for the public service class
description: At 16:30, Ye Mingxuan left work on time, took the expressway and drove straight to Yangliuqing, a 25-minute drive, using the time to relax his tense nerves. After arriving at Master Qian Jianguo's workshop, they began preparing for Sunday's second public woodworking class, "Parent-Child Little Bird's Nest." Together they checked the pine boards, wood glue, sandpaper of various grits, and anti-cut safety gloves prepared for 5 families. Ye Mingxuan specifically measured the thickness of the boards to prevent thin materials from causing injuries to children when cutting. Afterwards, they optimized the lesson plan and added a "Fun Woodworking Facts" segment to make the class more interesting.

name: Return home for dinner together and plan the family emergency drill

name: Family first aid drill
description: After the meal, Ye Mingxuan proactively cleared the dishes, then cleared a space in the middle of the living room with his father. He took out the upgraded first aid kit from yesterday and checked the CPR face shield, medical gloves, and the teddy bear used as a practice prop. He had his father practice the kneeling position in advance to ensure he could comfortably perform compressions on the soft floor. At 8 PM sharp, the drill officially began. Ye Mingxuan played the role of rescuer and coach: starting with "discovering mother suddenly collapsing," he called out loudly for help, instructed his father to call 120, checked consciousness and breathing, and then demonstrated a full cycle of 30:2 chest compressions and rescue breaths. Next, he had his parents take turns practicing on the teddy bear. Ye Mingxuan noticed his father's compressions were slightly shallow and his mother forgot to check the mouth for foreign objects, so he corrected each issue and repeatedly emphasized, "Like pressing a spring, press down at least 5 centimeters." His father successfully completed a timed 2-minute compression session for the first time, and his mother successfully performed her first effective rescue breath under guidance. After the drill, Ye Mingxuan briefly reviewed the process, and his father suggested practicing again next Thursday. He recorded the process in the family health diary.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Take a walk around the neighborhood with parents.

They chatted as they walked: his mother mentioned that the radiator needed to be bled, and his father said he would find someone to look at it next week. Ye Mingxuan took out his phone and showed his father a few short videos about small woodworking lathes making pen holders and vases: "Dad, I was thinking, on that empty spot on our balcony, we could add a small one. Later I can make you a back scratcher or a tea tray. The budget is about 2,000 yuan, and we can wait for Double 11 to see the discounts." His father's eyes lit up as he watched the machines in the video, and he patted him on the shoulder: "Alright, Dad supports this. Buy a good one, and we'll play with it together!"

Dad supports the balcony wood lathe plan, to be purchased on Double 11. I submitted the initial first aid training proposal to Director Sun of the community. Li Xiang led the modeling while Ye Mingxuan watched the parameters. They ran several rounds of simulation: Path A deviated too much and was eliminated immediately; after multiple rounds of fine-tuning Path B, the deformation contour plot shown in the fourth simulation finally came very close to the theoretical value, with the deviation reduced to within 0.5 degrees. Ye Mingxuan immediately took a screenshot and saved the key data. After leaving the meeting room, they compiled the simulation report and emailed the key parameters and conclusions to Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan. Gao quickly replied, approving the plan to proceed with subsequent durability testing and requesting that the test plan be submitted in the afternoon. Ye Mingxuan and Li Xiang verbally confirmed the test focus and the number of specimens, and Gao nodded and signed off.

name: Drawing modifications and technical learning
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation full of energy. He first revised the project drawings: based on the new simulation results, he corrected the locating dimension of the loading point on the fixture and added a note about the material yield strength. Then he opened the Pandas tutorial and spent about 40 minutes learning how to use pivot tables, trying to turn the recent test data into a statistical dashboard for practice. His colleague Zhou Tao passed by and asked how the morning was going. Ye Mingxuan shared that things went smoothly, and they agreed to have lunch together.
location: Company workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunchtime exchange in the cafeteria.
description: At 11:30, Ye Mingxuan, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang went together to the second-floor cafeteria for lunch. While waiting in line, they discussed the rollout of the Python automation script they had been working on over the past few days. After sitting down, Ye Mingxuan suggested using a lunch break next week to give an internal demo to the department colleagues. Zhou Tao took the initiative to write the operation manual using Markdown with screenshots; Li Xiang suggested recording a video in case someone didn’t know how to set up the environment. Ye Mingxuan joked that they could ask his childhood friend Zhang Wei to do the voice-over—he works in car sales and has a quick tongue. Everyone burst into laughter, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Second floor cafeteria, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Noon break
description: After eating, Ye Mingxuan returned to his workstation, put on a steam eye mask, and slept face-down on the desk for 30 minutes to ensure afternoon energy.
location: Company workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon drawing revisions and drawing review
description: After recovering his energy in the afternoon, Ye Mingxuan continued the drawing modification work from the morning. After adjusting the tolerances on the new version of the tooling drawing, he exported it to PDF and saved it. His colleague Zhou Tao sent him a part drawing for review. He put on his glasses and carefully checked the dimension chain, and found that one chamfer might cause interference. He circled it in red on the screenshot and left a comment saying that the root chamfer needed to be increased by another 0.5 mm to avoid interference with the housing during assembly.
location: Company workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Online socializing and email processing
description: After finishing the drawings, Ye Mingxuan opened the ancient coin forum and browsed the "Tianjin Edition Yuan Datou" section. Remembering the O-type triangular yuan he found in Caozhuang yesterday, he picked up the macro lens on the desk, took a high-definition photo, and sent it to Zhao Jianguo, a collector friend in Xi'an, via WeChat, asking him to examine the reeded edge. After that, he handled several emails regarding project progress.
location: Company workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Routine work and document updates
description: Ye Mingxuan logged into the project management system, updated the morning's simulation results into the BOM table remarks, and replied to the production department's inquiry about part delivery dates. He then organized the day's work log, recording the simulation process and key data.
location: Company workstation, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Test communication and prepare to leave work.
description: Project manager Wang Peng came over to discuss the afternoon durability test plan. Ye Mingxuan briefly discussed the number of test samples and priorities with him, and confirmed the test platform schedule. Wang Peng asked him to submit the formal plan early the next morning. Afterward, Ye Mingxuan tidied his desk, backed up all files to the company cloud drive, closed the software, clocked out and left. He calculated that he could get home before 6 PM and just make it in time for dinner.
location: Company workstation and testing area, Block A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: After-work commute
description: Ye Mingxuan took Bus 616 home. There were more people on the bus than in the morning, and he stood for most of the ride. Along the way, he scrolled through Bilibili for a while and watched a restoration video about mortise-and-tenon structures in Ming and Qing furniture, thinking that on the weekend he could try the shoulder mortise and tenon joint at the Yangliuqing woodworking workshop. He got off at Zhongbei Avenue Station.
location: Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, Bus 616 (Haitai Development Sixth Road to Zhongbei Avenue)

name: Buy fruit on the way.
description: After getting out of the car, he walked about 5 minutes and turned into the Yiyi Community Group-buying Store in the street-level shops of Mengheyuan. Ye Mingxuan saw winter jujubes displayed at the entrance, picked a bag, and also took three Red Fuji apples. The cashier auntie recognized him and chatted while weighing, mentioning that his mother said yesterday she wanted to buy pears. Ye Mingxuan then bought a few more pears. After paying, he carried the fruit home.
location: Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Arrived home and had family dinner.
description: After a 10-minute walk, he arrived home. His mother Wang Xiulan was cooking in the kitchen, and the aroma of braised pork ribs wafted out. His father Ye Jianguo was watching the news in the living room. Ye Mingxuan put down the fruit, greeted them, and went back to his room. He took the Kindle out of his bag and checked the battery, font, and warm light mode one last time to make sure everything was ready. Then the family of three sat around the dining table. His mother had made braised pork ribs, stir-fried baby bok choy, and tomato and egg soup. As he ate, Ye Mingxuan talked about the details of the successful simulation that morning. His father commented, "Technical work is something you chip away at step by step, steady and reliable." His mother, meanwhile, chattered about the gift money for a weekend community wedding or funeral. Ye Mingxuan listened with a smile, feeling very grounded.
location: Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Gifting Kindle and teaching
description: After the meal, Ye Mingxuan solemnly took the Kindle out of its protective case and handed it to his father, who was about to go to the balcony for a cigarette. His father was taken aback for a moment and took the unfamiliar device, with a look of confusion and curiosity. Ye Mingxuan sat down beside him and taught him step by step how to turn it on and off, turn pages (tap and swipe), adjust the font size, and turn on the warm light mode. Considering his father's presbyopia, he set the font size to extra large and explained that it would not be harsh on the eyes at night. His father tried flipping through a few pages of "Those Things in the Ming Dynasty," quickly got the hang of it, smiled and read out, "Started with a bowl," then put on his reading glasses with great interest.
location: Living room, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Father and son read together and communicate on the balcony.
description: After teaching, Ye Mingxuan suggested going to the balcony to sit and read for a while, and his father readily agreed. The two came to the south-facing enclosed balcony, each in a rattan chair, with water cups and hot tea on the small tea table between them. Father held a Kindle reading Those Things in the Ming Dynasty, while Ye Mingxuan studied wood structure with Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Joints of Ming and Qing Furniture. Mother was washing dishes in the kitchen, with the soft sound of water and the clatter of dishes coming through. The two read quietly together for about an hour, and this warm atmosphere surpassed any small talk. Afterwards, Father put down his Kindle and remarked that Zhu Di was amazing at fighting wars, so Ye Mingxuan took the cue and told a short story about the Yongle Emperor, and then they returned to the living room together.
location: South-facing enclosed balcony, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Personal leisure and study
description: Ye Mingxuan returned to his room and turned on the computer. He first checked the ancient coin forum; his collector friend Zhao Jianguo had replied on WeChat, saying that the reeded edge photo looked fine, it was an authentic piece, and worth around a thousand yuan. Ye Mingxuan happily replied: Got it. Then he opened the Python environment, continued the afternoon course, and completed the Pandas pivot table hands-on case, feeling he had gained a lot. Midway, his roommate Liu Yang sent a WeChat message inviting him to play games, but he politely declined, saying that there was something going on at home tonight and he wasn't in the mood.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Washing up and recording
description: Ye Mingxuan took a comfortable hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. Back in the bedroom, he recorded the day's situation in the family health diary: “Nov. 3, Monday, sunny. Weight 70.2kg. In the morning, the simulation plan with Li Xiang was approved. In the afternoon, revised drawings. In the evening, gave Dad a Kindle, and we read together on the balcony for 1h. Initially built a sense of companionship. Felt very good.”
location: Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (bathroom and bedroom)

name: Reading and preparation before bed
description: Ye Mingxuan lay in bed, picked up another Kindle, and continued reading Introduction to Collecting Modern Chinese Machine-Struck Coins, focusing on the chapter on 'O-version triangular yuan' and cross-referencing it with what he had seen during the day. At exactly 23:00 he turned off the light, set the alarm for 7:00 the next morning, and the fulfilling day came to an end.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Getting up and morning routine
description: At 06:50 in the morning the alarm went off; it was gloomy outside. After getting up, I went to the bathroom and used the electronic scale to record my weight as 70.3 kg. I checked the weather app and confirmed today would be overcast turning to light rain, with a high of 12°C. After washing up, I put on thick work trousers and a dark blue down jacket. My mother was in the kitchen heating milk and steaming pork-and-scallion buns. While eating breakfast, I listened to the weather forecast and decided to wear a windproof shell jacket. After the meal, I packed my backpack and checked my employee badge, test drawings, notebook, folding umbrella, and power bank, then sprayed water on the balcony succulents.
location: Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Commuting to work
description: At 07:27 he left home and walked about 15 minutes to the Zhongbei Avenue bus stop, seeing elderly people returning from morning exercise on the way. At 07:42 he took bus No. 616 toward Haitai Development. The bus was well heated, and he put on earphones to listen to a machinery podcast about online monitoring technology for metal fatigue crack propagation. Around 08:20 he arrived at Development 6th Road Station, walked 2 minutes to the Haitai Development Office Building. After arriving at the office, he swiped his card to enter, put down his backpack at his desk, turned on the computer, made a cup of hot black tea, quickly browsed his inbox, and reviewed the key parameters in the simulation report sent by Li Xiang.
location: From Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, via Zhongbei Avenue Bus Stop and Bus No. 616.

name: Pre-Test Communication and Preparation
description: At 08:35, I took the test flow charts and drawings to the second-floor workshop office. First, I confirmed the test sample status and tooling readiness with Master Zhang, then met up with Li Xiang, who had just arrived. The three of us spent 20 minutes going through the morning test steps and assignments. At 09:15, we entered the second-floor durability testing lab together. I was responsible for checking sensor numbers, Li Xiang used a multimeter to inspect the signal wires, and Master Zhang clamped the new parts onto the test bench. After confirming everything was correct, Master Zhang started the fatigue testing machine. Data began flashing on the screen, and the experiment officially began.
location: Workshop office and durability testing laboratory on the second floor of Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Software development during test intervals.
description: The test needs to run for at least 45 minutes to observe the initial trends. Returning to his workstation, he used this time to package the Python automation tool V1.0, generate the installer, and write the deployment documentation, clearly listing the dependency environment and precautions. Afterwards, he contacted Engineer Wang from the IT department via WeChat to schedule a discussion the next day about enabling terminal permissions.
location: Personal workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Test follow-up and key breakthroughs.
description: After the equipment had been running for about 55 minutes, I returned to the laboratory, and the data curve became stable. Master Zhang pointed out that the key data showed over 20,000 cycles with an error within 0.3 degrees. I carefully checked the records and compared them with Li Xiang's simulation trends; the match was very high. When the part smoothly passed the 30,000-cycle mark and the phase angle offset did not exceed the threshold, the three of us smiled at each other—the fatigue life exceeded the expected indicator by about 25%. I quickly exported all the data, and after repeated confirmation, I solemnly signed the test report.
location: Durability Test Laboratory, 2nd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At lunchtime, went to the first-floor cafeteria with Li Xiang and Zhou Tao. Ordered tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried broccoli; Li Xiang and Zhou Tao had kung pao chicken rice. During the meal, shared the good news about the morning testing breakthrough and agreed to hold a short meeting at 4 p.m. to announce it officially. After eating, at 12:00 went alone to the plaza downstairs to walk and aid digestion; the sky was overcast, and stretched the neck and shoulders. At 12:30 returned to the workstation, put on a jacket, and took a 30-minute nap at the desk.
location: No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, Haitai Development Office Building, first-floor cafeteria and the square below.

name: Data organization and meeting rehearsal.
description: Refreshed after the lunch break, at 13:00 he imported the morning's raw data into Excel and Python scripts, generated charts and trend graphs for the test report, and wrote an illustrated internal project breakthrough bulletin. At 14:30, he notified Zhou Tao and Li Xiang to come to the small meeting room, rehearsed the afternoon briefing for 20 minutes, and reached consensus on technical details and possible issues.
location: Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, personal workstation and small meeting room

name: Email processing and document finalization
description: Returned to the workstation, processed several backlogged internal emails, and replied to the production department's inquiry about parameters for another regular project. At the same time, he checked the final installer of the Python tool sent by Li Xiang, and after confirming it was correct, saved it to the team shared drive.
location: Personal workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Team internal briefing
description: Holding the printed key test curve charts, he gathered relevant colleagues in the department's common area and briefly announced the project breakthrough results. Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan arrived, affirmed the team's efforts, and arranged a small-batch trial production plan. The meeting was short and uplifting.
location: Haitai Fazhan Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Fazhan 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China; department common area (next to the pantry)

name: Project summary and preparation to leave work.
description: His tense nerves relaxed. He returned to his workstation, organized and archived all work documents, drawings, and test records, confirmed the computer was off and the desk was tidy, put his foldable umbrella into his backpack, and prepared to leave work.
location: Personal workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Commute after work and buy fruit on the way
description: At 17:00, I put on earphones, played some light music, and walked 2 minutes to the Fazhan Liudao bus stop. At 17:02, I took Bus 616 for the return trip; a fine drizzle filled the air outside the window. Around 17:45, I got off at Zhongbei Town Station, walked to Yiyi Community Group-buying Store at Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, picked out fresh winter jujubes and crown pears, paid with WeChat, then walked back to Huating International Community. The rain had mostly stopped.
location: From Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China to Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, via Fazhan Sixth Road Bus Stop, Bus No. 616, and Yiyi Community Group Buying Store (Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road).

name: Family gathering to celebrate.
description: Arrived home at 18:20, put the fruit on the coffee table, told his parents about the project breakthrough, and suggested going out to celebrate. The family of three decided to go to Jinghexuan Tianjin-Flavored Restaurant on Ligongci Street, Hebei District. At 18:40 they left through the north gate of the community, called a ride-hailing car using his phone, and arrived after about a 15-minute drive. After being seated, they ordered dishes, and he specifically told the waiter that the whole family is allergic to shrimp, crab, and shellfish, so no seafood products could be used in the dishes. They ordered braised beef, Qianlong cabbage, candied yam, and stir-fried chicken slices. They chatted while eating; he detailed the technical problem-solving process to his father, and his mother kept putting food on his plate. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Jinghexuan Tianjin Flavor Restaurant (Tianjin Eye Branch), 2nd floor inside Gate 2, Tianjin Curtain City (Lebinhui), Ligongci Street, Hebei District, Tianjin, China

name: Walk home after the meal
description: The meal ended, and I paid the bill by mobile payment and took a taxi back to Huating International Community. The rain had stopped, and the three of us walked slowly on the community's circular fitness trail to help digestion. Mother moved her ankle and said it was recovering well; Father praised the spirit of research. The three chatted about everyday matters, feeling at ease.
location: Huating International Residential Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China - circular walking trail

name: Evening home routines and going to bed
description: At 20:45, returned home and recorded the dinner expense in the shared family income and expense spreadsheet. Then he took a pleasant hot shower and changed into cotton pajamas. At 21:15, leaning against the headboard, he browsed an ancient coin forum to check the market for Yuan Datou silver dollars; afterward, he opened Bilibili to relax by watching woodworking videos of handmade mortise-and-tenon stools. At 22:30, he turned off his phone and wrote the day's summary on a sticky note: "November 4, the new part passed the fatigue test, exceeding expectations by 25%. The whole family celebrated in the evening; I was happy. Tomorrow I will start preparing for small-batch trial production and tool promotion." He set the 7:00 alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep, falling asleep peacefully with a sense of accomplishment and family warmth.
location: At home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China.

name: Waking up and breakfast
description: Ye Mingxuan was awakened by his biological clock at 7 o'clock, and his weight measured 70.5 kg. After a quick wash, he enjoyed the breakfast prepared by his mother: millet porridge, two pork buns, and one boiled egg. He ate until about 70% full, and while eating, silently recited the key data and logical chain of the report in his mind to ensure the presentation went flawlessly. After the meal, he drank a few sips of warm water and felt full of energy.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Getting ready to go out.
description: Checked my commuter backpack, which contained a laptop, a printed test report (I had gone through it again the night before; the curve charts were clear), and a USB drive with tools. Put on a thin down jacket and my employee badge. Said hello to my parents and told them I had a team dinner tonight, so they didn't need to wait for me for dinner.
location: Entryway of the home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute and presentation rehearsal
description: Took Bus No. 616 from Huating International bus stop to Haitai Development Office Building. On the bus, wearing earphones and with eyes closed, he silently rehearsed the opening remarks and key data points of the presentation, focusing on reviewing the curve chart for 'part fatigue life improved by 25%' and the comparative data from three key test scenarios, ensuring that every argument was at his fingertips.
location: On Bus 616 from Huating International Bus Stop on Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Haitai Development Office Building, Haitai Development 6th Road.

name: Arriving at the company and preparing the report
description: He bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at the convenience store downstairs from the office. Swiping his card to enter the office, he briefly greeted his colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, who had already arrived. He tidied his workstation, hung the printed presentation blueprint on the whiteboard, and opened the PPT again to check the projector connection.
location: Company workstation area, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Report on key breakthrough results
description: Held an important project presentation in the First Meeting Room on the fourth floor of the company. Facing project manager Wang Peng, senior engineer Gao Zhiyuan, the department head, and colleagues Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, Ye Mingxuan first reviewed the project background and pain points, then presented the core data—comparison curves from three sets of durability tests, clearly marking a 25% improvement. He used facts and data to explain the design change rationale, the accuracy of simulation verification, and the small-batch trial production results. Senior Engineer Gao and Manager Wang raised questions from time to time, and Ye Mingxuan answered calmly. Around 10:00 the presentation ended. Senior Engineer Gao affirmed the technical breakthrough, and Manager Wang decided on the spot to prepare the documents for small-batch trial production and praised his project management ability.
location: First meeting room, 4th floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development 6th Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Review and rest after the report
description: Back at his workstation, Ye Mingxuan felt relieved. He spent 15 minutes jotting down in his notebook the detailed suggestions raised by the Senior Engineer and Manager Wang during the presentation (such as adding extreme operating condition data), planning to refine them later. He then went to the pantry to get a glass of water and stretched his neck.
location: Company workstation area and pantry, 3rd floor, Tower A, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Pre-deployment preparation and task assignment
description: Ye Mingxuan convened a brief huddle with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang beside their workstations. He took out a handwritten 'deployment process checklist' listing the distribution of the 12 computer workstations that needed Python tools installed, dependency library versions, and key points for compatibility testing. He assigned tasks: Li Xiang was responsible for verifying the compatibility of the core scripts with different Windows versions on the test server; Zhou Tao was responsible for notifying each colleague in advance to set aside time; Ye Mingxuan would finally check the USB drive installation package to confirm the latest version.
location: Company workstation area, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lunch and deployment briefing
description: Ye Mingxuan, Senior Engineer Gao, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang walked to a malatang restaurant near the company for lunch. Ye Mingxuan ordered a bowl of malatang and, while eating, confirmed the detailed deployment process for the afternoon with the others. He especially emphasized solutions to possible compatibility issues (such as a missing VC++ runtime library), and confirmed that he would be responsible for the core installation and presentation, Zhou Tao would assist with verification, and Li Xiang would handle tricky problems.
location: Malatang restaurant at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Deployment of Python automation tools in the department.
description: After lunch, Ye Mingxuan took a USB drive and a checklist and began visiting colleagues' workstations one by one to deploy the Python automation tool. On each computer, he patiently explained the two core functions of the tool — “one-click test report generation” and “automatic data comparison” — and guided the colleague through one operation. During the process, Master Zhang's old computer lacked the Python environment, so Ye Mingxuan skillfully configured the environment variables manually and solved it in 10 minutes. Meanwhile, project manager Wang Peng came to the site to check progress, praised the tool, and joked, “Ye's magic tool really lives up to its name.” By 16:00, all 12 computers had been deployed, and the department colleagues gave positive feedback.
location: Colleagues' workstations on the east and west sides of the 3rd floor of Haitai Development Office Tower A, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organizing deployment feedback and making code adjustments
description: Back at his workstation, Ye Mingxuan recorded the feedback collected in the afternoon (such as adding CSV export format and adding image annotation functionality) item by item in Excel. For a small bug in automatic chart generation, he modified a line of judgment logic in the source code and verified it on the test machine. He then entered the supplementary points mentioned by Manager Wang during the morning report into the project document.
location: Company workstation area, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: After-work tidying and dinner appointment
description: He turned off the computer, packed his backpack, and carefully put away the USB drive and deployment checklist. He said goodbye to Zhou Tao and Li Xiang, who were still working overtime, and agreed to meet at Huijie Jiayuan Mala Xiangguo Restaurant at 7 p.m. Ye Mingxuan set off first to save seats. He sent a WeChat message to his mother telling her not to wait for him for dinner and to just leave the door unlocked.
location: Company workstation area, 3rd Floor, Building A, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Walk to the dinner venue
description: Considering that Huijie Jiayuan Mala Xiang Guo Restaurant was about 1.5 kilometers from the company, Ye Mingxuan decided to walk there, which would avoid the evening rush hour and stretch his body after sitting for a long time.
location: On the road from No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, to Huijie Jiayuan.

name: Get to the restaurant early and order dishes
description: Ye Mingxuan arrived early at Huijie Jiayuan Mala Xiangguo Restaurant, confirmed the private room with the server, and specifically emphasized that someone in the team had a seafood allergy, requesting that all dishes be made without shrimp, crab, or shellfish, and that soups and cold dishes also be handled with care. He only felt reassured after watching the server write this note on the menu. Then he ordered the signature mala xiangguo (mildly spicy, with chicken and pork belly), a few cold dishes, and beer.
location: Huijie Jiayuan Mala Xiangguo Restaurant, No. 7, Area A, ground-floor commercial units, Huijie Jiayuan, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Team dinner celebration
description: Senior Engineer Gao led everyone into the private room on time, and the atmosphere was lively. Everyone raised their glasses together to celebrate the success of the morning report and the smooth deployment in the afternoon. Senior Engineer Gao patted Ye Mingxuan on the shoulder, praised him for his rapid growth, and encouraged him to consider a higher-level technical direction. Zhou Tao joked that “Teacher Ye” should give more guidance in the future. Ye Mingxuan felt grounded, chatted freely with everyone about the project's next steps and fun stories from daily life, and the team's cohesion grew stronger.
location: Private room, Huijie Jiayuan Mala Xiang Guo Restaurant, No. 7, Zone A, Ground-Floor Commercial Units, Huijie Jiayuan, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: End of dinner gathering and farewells
description: The dinner gathering ended, and everyone said goodbye slightly tipsy. Ye Mingxuan said farewell one by one to Senior Engineer Gao, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang.
location: At the entrance of Huijie Jiayuan Spicy Pot Restaurant, No. 7, Zone A, ground-floor commercial units of Huijie Jiayuan, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commute home and make quick-reference cards.
description: He took the last bus (Route 616) home from the bus stop near Huijie Jiayuan. On the bus, the breeze kept him alert as he sketched out the quick-reference card content in his mind. After getting home, he took a hot shower, then sat at the computer in the study in his loungewear and began making the 'Python Automation Tool Quick-Reference Card.' Rather than simply copying the instructions, he wrote up the error-prone points and common issues from the afternoon feedback in a more conversational Q&A and 'pitfall avoidance guide' format, and drew the five core operating steps as a flowchart. Finally, he sent the polished PDF to the department WeChat group with a note saying he was available for questions.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and tomorrow's plan
description: After sending the files, Ye Mingxuan felt that the day's work had been completely closed out. He brushed his teeth and washed his face, changed into pajamas, and wrote down the next day's key to-dos in the memo on his phone: 1. Follow up on the arrival of small-batch trial production materials; 2. Organize supplementary data for extreme working conditions for Senior Engineer Gao. Then he checked that the 7 a.m. alarm for the next day was set correctly.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing stretching and reading before bed
description: Although he didn't go to the gym today, Ye Mingxuan didn't want his body to get too stiff, so he did 10 minutes of stretching on the bedroom floor, focusing on relaxing his lower back from sitting for long periods and his tense shoulders. Afterward, he leaned against the headboard and leafed through the Illustrated Guide to Mortise-and-Tenon Structures in Ming and Qing Furniture to let his mind relax.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Nighttime sleep
description: Ye Mingxuan turned off the light and went to sleep on time. Looking back on the busy yet fulfilling day: the presentation was a success, the tool was promoted, and the team was harmonious; everything progressed as planned or even better. With a relaxed and satisfied mood, he quickly fell asleep, building up energy for tomorrow.

name: Getting up and washing up.

Today's plan was an easy 3 km run at a steady pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer, enough to break a light sweat. The client just left, so I'm free. How about trying that 'Hutong Lane Bistro' we talked about last time? I heard their bao san yang is pretty good." I replied "OK", and we agreed to meet at 11:50 at the restaurant entrance.

name: Fine polishing of the small offering cabinet
description: After breakfast, I plunged into my little corner on the balcony. Yesterday I had already prepared the sandpaper and beeswax. I put on a mask and goggles, and began focusing intently on finely sanding a small Ming-style rosewood offering cabinet. Starting with 200-grit sandpaper, I sanded every flat surface and corner evenly along the wood grain, then switched progressively to 400, 600, 800, and 1000 grit. With each increase in grit, I could feel the wood surface become smoother and finer, and the originally somewhat rough texture became as smooth as a baby's skin. The natural grain of the rosewood also gradually emerged clearly, and the process was very relaxing. Midway, my father came over with his teacup, took a look, and nodded approvingly.
location: Balcony Workshop, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

We chatted while eating. He complained that the car market is in its off-season recently and it's not easy to sell cars. I excitedly shared with him the progress I made sanding the wooden cabinet this morning. He teased that with my skills I could set up a street stall. After the meal, I rushed to pay the bill and happened to use the 200 yuan in cash I had set aside.

name: Hot wax finishing and final polishing
description: The afternoon sunlight was perfect. I opened the balcony window for ventilation and used an air blower to remove all the dust from the polished small offering cabinet. Then I slightly heated the beeswax block with a heat gun to soften it, dipped a cotton cloth into the beeswax, and applied it evenly and quickly over the surface of the small offering cabinet. The heat from the heat gun quickly melted the wax, allowing it to penetrate the wood grain. A faint scent of beeswax filled the air. After the wax layer cooled and turned white, I wiped and polished it repeatedly with a clean cotton cloth. As I wiped, the wood grain became as warm and smooth as jade under the wax, and a luster shone from within. The piece finally achieved the ideal texture. I carefully held it in my hands, examined it over and over, and a sense of accomplishment welled up.
location: Balcony Workshop, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Organized tools and set up the balcony reading nook.

Following the idea we had discussed last week, I arranged the rattan chairs, plugged in a newly bought floor lamp, rearranged the potted succulents on the balcony, trimmed dead leaves, and sprinkled some water. My father looked at it for a while and suggested, “If we could put a small bookshelf here with a few books we read often, it would be more convenient.” I nodded and took a photo with my phone to mark the spot, planning to temporarily use a small shelf I had made before as a substitute until the wood lathe arrived.

My mother gently stroked the smooth surface, her eyes full of admiration, and smiled: 'My son's hands are so skillful, just like his father when he was young.' Hearing my parents' praise, I felt happier than if I had eaten honey.

name: Family first-aid drill and debrief, plus first-aid kit inspection
description: At 9:10 in the morning, the second practical consolidation of the family emergency drill began. Ye Mingxuan laid out the CPR manikin, towels, and a rigid pad in the center of the living room and quickly reviewed the key points of the previous CPR and Heimlich maneuver training. The three took turns practicing: mother Wang Xiufang played the role of a choking patient, father Ye Jianguo performed abdominal thrusts with the Heimlich maneuver, and Ye Mingxuan corrected the force application position; father lay flat to simulate cardiac arrest, and Ye Mingxuan and mother performed CPR one after another, with Ye Mingxuan emphasizing vertical arms, compression depth, and rhythm. The drill ended at 10:40, and they sat in a circle to review, pointing out subtle deviations such as chest recoil and thrust direction. Mother wrote the key points in the family health diary. Afterwards, Ye Mingxuan opened the first aid kit in the balcony storage cabinet to check it, confirmed the epinephrine pen was within its expiration date, took out and discarded expired band-aids, and wrote a note to buy waterproof band-aids and elastic bandages, sticking it on the refrigerator door.
