name: Photographed woodworking pieces, posted them on Moments, interacted, and rested.
description: At 1:10 p.m., he placed the newly completed Ming-style small offering cabinet and the previously flawed entryway side table side by side next to the reading corner on the balcony. Using the afternoon light, he took six photos with his phone. He then opened WeChat Moments and carefully composed a post: "I made a new one, and kept an old one. I pursue perfection, but also face imperfection. This is the daily life of a craftsman." He set the location to "Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin" and published it. Then he lay on the sofa and scrolled through Moments, receiving more than a dozen likes and comments in less than ten minutes. Colleague Li Xiang commented: "This is the best portrayal of an engineer's spirit! You can bring the new piece to the department as an ornament." Zhou Tao commented: "You call that a flaw? That's a monologue of style!" Ye Mingxuan replied to them one by one, feeling delighted.
location: At his own home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Home-based rehabilitative exercise (waist relaxation training)
description: At 2:20 p.m., given his lumbar muscle strain, he changed into a sports T-shirt, spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and followed the "Core Strengthening for Lower Back Relief" course on the Keep app for 15 minutes, including glute bridges, dead bugs, planks, and full-body stretches. Afterward, the tightness in his lower back was clearly relieved.
location: Bedroom in his own home, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize woodworking tools and clean the balcony work area
description: At 2:50 p.m., after exercising, I returned to the balcony, stacked the leftover wood from yesterday neatly, rolled up the different types of sandpaper and put them in the toolbox, wiped the workbench in the corner of the balcony with a rag, and vacuumed up the wood shavings from the floor. The entire reading corner was fresh and tidy again.
location: Balcony of his home in Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Deep personal interests: coin microphotography and learning mechanical design knowledge.
description: At 3:30 p.m., he returned to the bedroom, took out the Republic of China error nickel coin with the 'A' missing a stroke, took clearer photos with the macro lens, and uploaded them to his database. Then he sat on the balcony chair, opened Zhihu on his phone, searched 'How much potential does Python automation have in mechanical design?', and browsed an open-source library related to parametric-driven modeling recommended by Xu Ming. He felt he had gained a lot.
location: At his own home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family free time, dinner preparation, and family dinner.
description: At 4:30 PM, he came out of his room and heard the TV playing the competitive variety show “Battle of Champions.” His father, Ye Jianguo, was watching intently, so Ye Mingxuan sat down beside him and watched for a while. His mother, Wang Xiufang, was in the kitchen making pork and cabbage dumplings. Ye Mingxuan washed his hands and wrapped a dozen or so. Although they were not as pretty as his mother's, she praised him for improving a lot. Dinner began at 5:30, with handmade dumplings, cold pork skin jelly, and minced garlic. At the table, his father brought up the afternoon's Moments post, saying the caption was nice, and someone had asked whether the flawed little side table was for sale. His father joked, “Your ‘flaw’ has now become a story,” and the atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan helped his mother clear the dishes and wipe the table, then brewed a cup of light tea for himself and his father and carried them to the small reading table on the balcony to prepare for reading together.
location: At his own home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Father-son reading and history discussion.
description: Just before 6:55 p.m., Ye Mingxuan and his father sat down on time in the reading corner on the balcony. His father put on his reading glasses, opened the Kindle, and continued reading the fourth volume of Those Things About the Ming Dynasty, while Ye Mingxuan opened Chapter 8 of Core Python Programming. Half an hour later, his father took off his glasses and remarked that Zhu Di was capable but ruthless, and that the war with his nephew Zhu Yunwen was too tragic. Ye Mingxuan responded that historical assessment is complex, but Zhu Di's achievements, such as moving the capital to Beijing and compiling the Yongle Encyclopedia, were great. For the first time, father and son had such an in-depth exchange about historical figures; they talked for more than twenty minutes until his mother came over to refill tea and interrupted them.
location: The balcony reading corner at his home in Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up, relaxing, and reminiscing before bed
description: After exchanging goodnights with his father at 8:30 p.m., Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and carefully brushed his teeth and washed his face. After washing up, he wrote a brief note for the day on the sticky note on the nightstand: “Family first aid drill passed; Moments post received praise; talked with Dad about Zhu Di, it was great.” Then he put on earphones, played white noise (rain sounds) on his phone, lay in bed recalling the fulfilling and satisfying moments of the day, and turned off the light to sleep at about 10:25 p.m.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at his own home, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: At 7:00, the phone alarm went off on time. I turned it off but didn't get up right away; instead, I did a five-minute cat stretch in bed to loosen my back, which was a bit stiff from working at the desk last night. After getting up, I stood on the scale, which read 70.5 kg, about the same as yesterday.
location: Master bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up, breakfast, and family conversation
description: After washing up, soy milk, boiled eggs, and steamed buns were already set out on the table. As I ate, I said to my mother, 'Mom, I'm tired of eating at the company cafeteria at noon. Can we make braised pork tonight?' Mother readily agreed, and my father chuckled from the side, 'You little rascal, you crave it if you go a week without eating it.' The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Bathroom and dining room, Huating International Residential Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

The weather was cold and overcast, with an east wind of level 3, and the apparent temperature was very low. While waiting at a red light, I took out my phone and quickly glanced at WeChat. Seeing no new comments on Li Xiang's Moments from last night, I felt a little relieved. After about 40 minutes of riding, I arrived downstairs at the company at 8:25.
location: From Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Then I opened the “Woodworking Portfolio” folder on the computer desktop, organized the carefully edited product photos from my phone by date and saved them, and also saved the screenshot of Li Xiang's like and comment from yesterday as a visual business card for future orders. At 9:30, Senior Engineer Gao came to ask about part parameters, and we had a brief half-hour discussion. After that, I focused on modifying model details to ensure accurate simulation results.

That Moments post last night really helped me a lot—now friends are already coming to order custom pen holders.” Li Xiang said proudly, “I told you, you should promote this craft.” We chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was pleasant.

I opened my mobile browser, searched for "PMP certification", browsed an official course outline, gained an initial understanding of the project management system, and thought about whether to sign up for study to improve my career competitiveness. After reading for about 15 minutes, I decided to make the decision in the evening, then leaned back in my chair and rested with my eyes closed for 20 minutes.
location: Office workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

A customer who found me through Li Xiang's Moments asked about a custom African blackwood pen holder. I replied immediately, and after 20 minutes of discussion on size, style (with copper ring), and price (500 yuan), the order was finally settled. After hanging up, I took out my work notebook, opened a “side business ledger” on the last page, and, strictly following the engineer habit, wrote neatly: wood material 120 yuan, copper ring 15 yuan, total cost 135 yuan, quoted price 500 yuan, net income 365 yuan. Afterward, I finished organizing the afternoon's simulation analysis results and sent them to project manager Wang Peng before 17:00.
location: Office workstation, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Commuting and returning home
description: At 17:30, I clocked out on time. I got on my e-bike and joined the evening rush hour traffic. On the way, Li Xiang called to invite me to play games tonight. I told him, 'I have woodworking to do tonight — I need to start on the new ebony pen holder and strike while the iron is hot. Let's schedule another day.' I arrived downstairs at the community at 18:20.
location: From Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China, to Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family dinner and evening preview.
description: Dinner indeed had the braised pork made by my mother, along with stir-fried seasonal vegetables and tomato and egg soup. I excitedly announced while eating: "Dad, Mom, I took a job today to make a custom pen holder, and the client is quite satisfied." My father smiled and said, "Not bad, this craft of yours really can make money." I then went on to say, "Dad, Mom, after dinner I'll be using the table saw and electric drill in the study. It may be a bit noisy, so you two may need to turn up the TV volume." My parents said they understood.
location: Restaurant, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Evening leisure and sharing household chores
description: After dinner, I volunteered to clear the dishes and wipe the table so my mother could rest. Then I went to the living room and watched about an hour of evening news with my father, occasionally exchanging a few words about international events—a simple way to unwind on a workday.
location: Living room, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Core task: rough machining of the pen holder
description: At 20:20, I drew the study curtains, took out the African blackwood and copper rings cut yesterday from the material cabinet. Changed into old work clothes, put on goggles, a dust mask, and gloves. First used measuring tools to draw reference lines on the wood, then started the table saw and carefully cut the wood into the rough shape of a pen holder, using a vacuum cleaner to promptly clean up the black wood shavings. Next, I switched to an electric drill and precisely cut the mounting slot according to the diameter of the copper rings. The whole process took about 1 hour and 20 minutes. After finishing, I placed the rough piece and copper rings on the workbench and cleaned the work area.
location: Study in Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Washing up and side-business log

Back in the bedroom, I took out my work notebook and added an entry under the “Side Business Ledger”: “November 10: rough machining of the pen holder is complete, and its condition is acceptable.” I also wrote down tomorrow's plan: “Fine sanding and waxing.”
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Huating International Residential Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Bedtime reading and planning

Then I opened Bilibili, searched for a few tutorials on 'fine sanding a purple sandalwood pen holder,' and learned how to use sandpaper with different grits, preparing for tomorrow’s fine finishing work. At the same time, I thought about the PMP certification again and decided to finish researching the course outline and sign up within this week.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

I felt fulfilled. I set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning, turned off the desk lamp, and fell asleep peacefully at 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

After a brief five-minute warm-up, they played a doubles round-robin. Chen Rui was in good form; his smashes and movement had improved. location: Workstation, 7th Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Fine sanding and assembly of the pen holder
description: He entered the study on time and neatly placed the previously rough-processed purple sandalwood brush pot blank, sandpaper, wood glue, copper rings, clamps, cotton cloth, and wood wax oil on the workbench. Strictly following the technique demonstrated in yesterday's woodworking tutorial, he sanded from 240-grit sandpaper in one direction along the wood grain, gradually changing to 2000 grit, checking the surface reflectivity with a damp cloth after each change. At about 20:10, the surface of the brush pot achieved a mirror effect. Then he took out the pre-polished copper ring, applied wood glue in the groove, carefully inserted it, tapped it gently with a rubber mallet, and secured it with clamps. After cleaning up the excess glue, he used the time waiting for the glue to cure to organize tools and sawdust. Finally, he dipped a cotton cloth in homemade wood wax oil and wiped the entire brush pot, giving the luster a warmer and calmer tone. At 21:00, he used his phone to take photos of the finished product from different lighting angles, and sent them to Li Xiang and Master Qian with the caption: 'Second custom piece, done!'
location: Study, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Relaxing with games and venting
description: After finishing the woodworking, I was in a great mood. I turned on my computer and launched League of Legends, teaming up with my friend Zheng Kai in voice chat. During the game, Zheng Kai complained about the tight project schedule, while Chen Rui shared updates on his badminton and new project. The two of us cooperated well and achieved a record of two wins and one loss, logging off at 22:00 on time.
location: Study, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 22:00, I quickly took a hot shower to wash off the sawdust smell and the excitement from gaming. After changing into pajamas, I stepped on the scale, which showed 70.8 kg. Back at the desk, I wrote in my sticky-note diary: "Weight 70.8kg, finished polishing the pen holder today, feels great; praised at the weekly meeting, new project brings pressure but also motivation; vented to Zheng Kai to relieve stress, won two games and lost one." Then I put down my phone, picked up Core Python Programming from the bedside, and flipped through it for ten-odd minutes. At 22:30, I turned off the bedside lamp on time and fell into a deep sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: The phone alarm (looping The Irish Thrush) rang on time at 7:00. Ye Mingxuan woke up without lingering in bed and turned over to sit up. Because of the badminton game the previous day and his ongoing lumbar rehabilitation, he first sat on the edge of the bed and did cat-cow stretches for 5 minutes, feeling his spine move segment by segment. When he finished the movement, the stiffness in his lumbar spine had noticeably eased. Then he weighed himself, which showed 70.9 kg (same as the previous day), and recorded it in his phone memo.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

Ye Mingxuan sat down and ate while listening to his father comment on the economic policies in the news, occasionally responding. The conversation naturally avoided last Sunday's family first aid drill and his father's advice to take the civil service exam. Out of habit, he connected his Bluetooth earbuds and played the in-depth lecture audio for the object-oriented chapter of Core Python Programming, downloaded the previous day. While waiting at red lights, he quickly sorted out the logical relationship between classes and objects in his head, making efficient use of the 40-minute commute and fully immersing himself in study.
location: Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin (cycling route)

name: New process pre-research kickoff meeting and task division
description: 8:20 Ye Mingxuan arrived on the 3rd floor of the Haitai Development Office Building. At 8:30, he, Zhou Tao, and Li Xiang entered Meeting Room 302 on time; Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan was already there. The meeting got straight to the point. Senior Engineer Gao once again reaffirmed the importance of the task “Pre-research on Intelligent Forming Process for New Lightweight Alloy Structural Parts” and announced that Ye Mingxuan would serve as the technical lead, Zhou Tao would be responsible for preliminary data collection and market research, and Li Xiang would be responsible for building the simulation model. Ye Mingxuan opened the mind map he had sorted out the night before and presented a preliminary idea: use Python to write an automatic optimization algorithm for cutting parameters and build a process database in combination with simulation data. His approach was recognized by Senior Engineer Gao. The three then discussed the direction of data collection and stage milestones in detail. The meeting ended at 10:45. Afterward, Ye Mingxuan organized the meeting minutes and planned the follow-up work.
location: Small meeting room 302, 3rd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Light lunch and market review.
description: After the meeting, Ye Mingxuan decided to go to the Lawson convenience store outside the company to buy lunch. He walked about 38 minutes to LAWSON (Agricultural College North Gate store). He chose a box of Smoked Chicken Breast Cobb Salad (for protein, low carbs) and a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea. He sat down in the in-store dining area and, while eating the salad, opened the Republic of China Nickel Coin Auction Information PDF that Zhao Jianguo had sent last night on his phone. He carefully looked at the condition description, actual photos, and current bid for a Republic of China Twenty-fifth Year Sun Yat-sen Fifty-cent Nickel Coin, compared it with the market average price, and thought the coin's patina and reeded edge were quite distinctive and worth attention. After eating, he sorted the meal box and threw it into the trash.

Then he took out his phone, and without disturbing Professor Zhao, he first organized a brief note on the value analysis of nickel coins, planning to send it to him during the evening exchange.
location: Workstation, 3rd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Refine the draft of the new process plan
description: The afternoon work began. Ye Mingxuan's mind was full of the morning's discussions. He opened Jupyter Notebook and turned his thoughts into a Python code prototype—defining a series of functions to calculate tool life and surface quality under different cutting speeds, feed rates, and depths of cut. He retrieved the simulation data for common materials sent by Li Xiang for preliminary validation, found that the reference parameters output by the algorithm deviated from the actual model, flagged the issue points, and planned to discuss them in detail with Li Xiang the next day. During this time, he occasionally communicated with Zhou Tao and Li Xiang about technical details.
location: Workstation, 3rd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

location: Workstation, 3rd Floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

Thank you for your trust and support [fist]."

name: Return home for dinner
description: When Ye Mingxuan arrived home, his mother had already prepared dinner: steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and brown rice. Remembering Coach Wang's advice, he proactively served himself half a bowl less of rice and only took fish and broccoli. The second attempt went smoothly, and his mother finished tying the tourniquet, applying pressure, and bandaging within three minutes. Afterward, the three reviewed the process, emphasizing that the tourniquet should not be used for more than two hours and should be marked, and had his mother demonstrate calling 120 and describing the injury.

From the Guangxu silver coins, Republic of China double-flag coins, and Great Qing copper coins he had on display, I carefully inspected the edge serrations and patina using a small transparent round case, and scanned the coin varieties with my phone. In the end, I chose a Hunan Province double-flag coin denominated as twenty cash (30 yuan) and a Hubei Great Qing copper coin denominated as ten cash (50 yuan), spending 80 yuan. I chatted with Lao Liu for half an hour about market conditions and learned that Guangdong Guangxu silver coins had risen to more than 800 yuan.

name: Driving to work
description: After finishing the last sip of soy milk, I grabbed my backpack and folding umbrella and headed out. Worried about thin ice on the road, I deliberately slowed down and drove steadily along the familiar morning rush-hour route. The car stereo played the latest episode of the Tech Know Early podcast, which discussed industrial internet trends, warming me up for the day's work.
location: During self-driving from Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Sixth Road

name: Morning work preparation and technical annotations.
description: Arrived at the company early and made a cup of hot tea. Opened the computer, reviewed the supplementary technical explanation email from the supplier, identified the key points to respond to, and cleaned up the desktop files. Then printed out the email and attached drawings, and went through them line by line with a red pen against yesterday's review meeting notes. He drew question marks beside two key dimension tolerance notations and wrote down his own understanding deviations, laying the groundwork for the follow-up phone call.
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Technical communication with the supplier.
description: Called the supplier's technical supervisor, Manager Tang, and in a professional and direct tone pointed out that there was a misunderstanding in the interpretation of the two dimension datums on the drawing. After five minutes of clarification, the two parties reached an agreement, and the other side said they would revise the drawing and resubmit it as required.
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Organize meeting minutes and update documents
description: After hanging up the phone, he organized the communication minutes into an email and sent it to the Senior Engineer, copying the project manager. Then he opened the B-07 project design document, updated some simulation parameter settings according to the latest technical details, and sorted out next week's work to-do list to ensure an orderly wrap-up on Friday.
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Technical discussion with colleagues
description: Colleague Zhou Tao asked for advice on a fitting clearance issue between parts. Ye Mingxuan walked over to his workstation, gestured with a vernier caliper, and drew a force diagram on the drawing, patiently explaining the reasons for the tolerance choices. After the discussion, the two went to the cafeteria together.
location: Company office and pantry at Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Company lunch
description: On Friday, the cafeteria served vegetable noodles in clear soup, with a marinated egg and a small portion of smashed cucumber, fitting the low-oil, low-salt diet plan. While eating, he deliberately slowed down and chewed thoroughly.
location: Company cafeteria, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon walk
description: After lunch, instead of going straight back to his workstation, he walked two laps around the green space below the ground-floor shops of the office building, breathing fresh air to stay alert in the afternoon, and saw a few scattered snowflakes beginning to fall.
location: Outdoor area downstairs, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Afternoon work and next week's plan
description: After returning to his workstation, he opened Excel and made a detailed work plan for the next week, including items such as Tuesday's father's medical checkup and Wednesday's follow-up on the supplier report. Then he handled a few daily technical consultation emails.
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Video call with friends
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Preparation before leaving work
description: After the video call, he was in a good mood. He wrapped up all his pending work, tidied his desk, turned off the computer, and checked whether there was anything he needed to take home.
location: Company office, Haitai Development Office Building, 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Going to the gym
description: Changed into workout gear and drove to the Iron Factory Fitness Zhongbei Town branch. Light snow continued along the way; he turned on the car heater and front windshield defroster and drove carefully.
location: On the drive from Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Kaiyuan Road.

name: Muscle-building workout at the gym.
description: Training went well. I first did 4 sets of squats as a warm-up, then bench press and barbell rows, 4 sets each, 8-12 reps per set. I tried a new movement, lunges; the first two sets were a bit unsteady, and I found the rhythm in the third set, feeling soreness in my thighs and glutes. Finally, I completed 30 minutes of cardio on the elliptical at a constant heart rate, tired but fulfilled.
location: Iron Factory Fitness (Zhongbei Town Branch), Kaiyuan Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Buy healthy ingredients at the supermarket
description: After finishing his workout, went straight to Wumart Supermarket, took out the weekly menu he carried with him, and bought whole-wheat bread, skinless chicken breast, broccoli, lettuce, fresh sea bass, grass-fed beef, apples, and oatmeal. In the kitchenware section, he found an oil-control bottle and a salt-restriction spoon with clear markings and put them in the shopping cart. At checkout, the supermarket was not crowded, and there was no line.
location: Wumart Supermarket (Zhongbei Store), Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Had a small incident on the bus ride home.
description: Carrying shopping bags and walking from the supermarket to the bus stop, I found the road slippery. In a moment of carelessness, my feet slipped; I didn't fall, but an apple rolled out of the shopping bag. I quickly bent down to pick it up, shook off the water, and felt a bit embarrassed. After waiting 5 minutes for the bus, I got on, put the bags on my lap, watched the snow falling outside the window, and thought about how nice it would be to have a bowl of hot soup at home.
location: From the bus stop near Wumart Supermarket in Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Huating International Community, on the bus.

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When he got home, his mother had already made tomato and egg soup. At the table, Ye Mingxuan showed off his newly bought oil-control pitcher and salt-restriction spoon, and his father examined them with interest. He shared details about successfully communicating with the supplier and his muscle-building training, while his mother fussed about the slippery snowy roads and told him to be careful in the future. The family chatted while eating, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Huatong International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin; home dining room

name: Evening study and hobby research
description: After dinner, back in the study, he first opened the Python programming documentation to learn how to process CSV data with Python, hoping to automatically organize his ancient coin collection list in the future. During a break, he took out the Republic of China double-flag copper coin, wiped it with a soft cloth, and studied the patina and reeded edge features under the light of his phone flashlight, comparing them with the appraisal opinion sent by Teacher Zhao Jianguo.
location: Study at home, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime bookkeeping and journaling
description: After washing up, sat at the desk, ran the Python script I wrote, and entered the supermarket shopping expenses (oil-control bottle 39.9 yuan, ingredients totaling 183.5 yuan) into the household income and expenditure ledger. Then, with a pen, wrote down today's key matters in the paper diary: completed the supplier technical reply and phone communication, had a video call with a friend, completed the muscle-building workout, and purchased healthy ingredients and an oil-control bottle.
location: Study at home, Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime reading
description: Turned off the main light, turned on the bedside lamp, and read the chapter on huanghuali wood grain in Ming-style Furniture Research. When drowsiness set in, set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning run in the snow.
description: Although light snow was falling outside the window and the outdoor temperature had dropped to -5, he still went out for his morning run as planned. He put on a windproof jacket and slip-resistant running shoes and completed an 8-kilometer tempo run along the Zhongbei Avenue trail. The first 4 kilometers were steady at a 5:45 per kilometer pace; the later section slowed to 5:55 due to some snow on the road, with an average pace of 5:50 per kilometer. The air was crisp in the snow, and after the run his body felt warm, while the soreness in his hips and legs was relieved.
location: Zhongbei Avenue pedestrian walkway, Xiqing District, Tianjin (from the north gate exit of Huating International Community to the Wanhui Road intersection)

name: Post-run recovery and phone handling
description: After returning from my morning run, I dried myself with a dry towel right away. I found that the phone's earpiece was damp from the snow and sounded muffled. I immediately turned on a hair dryer and blew warm air on the earpiece and charging port for about 5 minutes, and only relaxed after confirming that everything was back to normal. Then I did two sets of post-run stretching, mainly for the calves and quadriceps, to ease muscle fatigue.
location: Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family breakfast and communication
description: Mother had prepared warm millet porridge, two boiled eggs, and a meat bun for breakfast. While eating, Ye Mingxuan reminded his father Ye Jianguo again that tomorrow morning's physical exam required fasting, and told him to bring his medical insurance card. Mother Wang Xiulan, meanwhile, was murmuring about going to Caozhuang Flower Market in the afternoon to buy two pots of cold-hardy succulents to decorate the balcony. The family's everyday exchange felt warm.
location: Dining room, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Heading to Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop
description: The snow had stopped, and the roads were slightly damp. Ye Mingxuan chose to take the bus so he could enjoy the post-snow street views. He walked 5 minutes from home to Zhongbei Amusement Park Bus Stop, took Bus No. 824 to Liuxia Road Station in Yangliuqing Town, and arrived about 40 minutes later. After getting off, he walked to Master Qian's studio in the street-level commercial space of Rhine Town.
location: Take Bus 824 from Zhongbei Amusement Park Bus Stop on Zhongbei Avenue, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Liuxia Road Station, Yangliuqing Town

name: Learn to make a small wooden box using dovetail joints.
description: After arriving at the workshop, Master Qian Jianguo had already prepared the wood and tools. Today's task was to make a small dovetail box. Master Qian guided him hand by hand on how to mark precisely with a marking gauge, how to adjust the saw angle, and how to use the chisel. Ye Mingxuan calmed down and repeatedly adjusted the tenon sizes. On the third attempt, he finally got all 12 mortise and tenon joints to fit together seamlessly. Master Qian said approvingly: "You have a steady hand now. A few more practices and you'll be ready to graduate."
location: Room 102, ground-floor commercial unit, Building 20, Rhine Town, Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (Qian Jianguo Woodcraft Workshop)

name: Returning home
description: He returned satisfied with the finished small wooden box. From Yangliuqing he took Bus 824 back to Zhongbei Leyuan Bus Stop and then walked home. On the bus, he sent a WeChat message to his mother saying he was almost home, and on the way he stopped at the Cainiao station at the entrance to pick up the package that had arrived the day before yesterday — a copy of Illustrated Research on Ming and Qing Furniture.
location: From Yangliuqing Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, took Bus No. 824 to Zhongbei Town, passing by the Cainiao Station at Huating International Residence.

name: Family lunch.
description: His mother used the newly bought oil-control pitcher to stir-fry broccoli and shredded pork with green peppers, with brown rice as the staple. The family of three chatted while eating. Ye Mingxuan showed off the wooden box he had made today, and his parents both liked it. His father picked it up and examined it closely, saying the tenons were neatly done. After the meal, Ye Mingxuan voluntarily cleared the dishes and put the new books in the study.
location: Dining room, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Writing a program to manage ancient coin collection
description: Opened the computer and continued writing a simple ancient coin collection management program using Python and SQLite. Progress went smoothly. He completed the filtering functions for 'by coin type', 'by year', and 'by province', and successfully imported the previously organized Republic of China machine-struck coin data (including the Hunan Double Flag coin, Hubei Great Qing copper coin, etc.) for testing. Looking at the neat list, he felt a great sense of achievement. During this, he found a query index bug and spent 20 minutes locating and fixing it.
location: Study, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Online exchange with fellow collectors
description: Sent a screenshot of the program interface to collector friend Zhao Jianguo in Xi'an. Zhao Jianguo quickly replied: "Not bad! Much better than using Excel. By the way, I looked at the patina on your Double Flag copper coin. It shows circulation wear, but the condition is decent. 120 yuan is not a loss; worth keeping." Ye Mingxuan replied with thanks and chatted about recent price trends for Xinjiang red coins in the ancient coin market.
location: Study, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (online exchange)

name: Recharging, resting, and reading.
description: Turned off the computer and took a carton of sugar-free yogurt from the refrigerator. Stood on the balcony for a while, enjoyed the sky clearing after snow in the distance, and moved a few pots of cold-sensitive succulents to the indoor windowsill. Opened Chapter 5 of Illustrated Research on Ming and Qing Furniture, which had just arrived today, studied the stylistic features of the Ming-style round-back armchair, and made two pages of reading notes.
location: Living room balcony, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Get ready to go out for an appointment.
description: Put on a clean hoodie and organized his wallet and keys. Glanced at the time on his phone, confirmed that he was meeting Zhang Wei at 18:00 at Old Ma's BBQ. It was about a 15-minute walk, so no need to rush out.
location: Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner with childhood friends
description: The two of them ordered lamb skewers (10 lean), grilled chicken wings, grilled steamed bun slices, and a plate of cold cucumber salad at Old Ma's Fusion Barbecue. Ye Mingxuan specifically asked for a large glass of warm water, strictly maintaining the low-oil and low-salt principle, and chose leaner skewers as much as possible. Zhang Wei talked in detail about his idea of jumping to NIO; from the perspective of a mechanical engineer, Ye Mingxuan helped him analyze how well his precision-machinery background matched automotive manufacturing processes, as well as the technical prospects of the two companies. They also chatted about the auto show they had recently seen and new standalone games, and amid the lively atmosphere their friendship grew stronger.
location: Intersection of Zhongbei Avenue and Wanhui Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (Old Ma's Fusion BBQ)

name: Walk home
description: The slightly cold wind felt pleasant, and I took a walk to help digest. My phone buzzed with a message from the family group chat; my mother asked what time I would be back, and I replied that I was already on the way.
location: Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, walking from Lao Ma's BBQ to Huating International Community.

name: Evening leisure and review
description: After getting home, I watched half an episode of Chinese Poetry Conference with my parents. Then I went back to the study, opened the household income and expense recording script on my computer, entered today's food and bus expenses, and wrote a diary entry. Then on Bilibili I watched two videos about advanced dovetail joint techniques in woodworking and favorited a practical method for quickly locating the mortise.
location: Living room and study, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After washing up, I put the morning running gear and the medical insurance card and outpatient medical records needed to take my father for his physical exam tomorrow on the shoe cabinet in the entryway. I set the alarm for 6:30 the next day. After lying down, I browsed the new posts on the Guquan Yuandi forum on my phone, and closed my eyes at exactly 22:50.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 102, Building 3, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wake up, wash up, and prepare.
description: The 8 o'clock alarm went off right on time, and Ye Mingxuan got up briskly. Since it was the weekend, instead of work clothes he put on a dark gray hoodie and casual pants. After washing up quickly in the bathroom, he checked his personal items: wallet, keys, phone. He also made a point to remind himself to bring his father's medical insurance card and physical examination report — these were the highlight of this morning.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Remind my father and check the items.
description: In the living room, Father Ye Jianguo had already put on his coat. Ye Mingxuan checked the documents in the paper bag on the entryway cabinet once more: 'Dad, your medical insurance card, ID card, and physical exam appointment form are all here. Remember to fast today—you can't eat anything before the blood draw.' He patted his father's shoulder and said calmly, 'It's fine, everything is arranged. Just follow me.'
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Accompany father for physical examination
description: Ye Mingxuan drove out of the community, along Zhongbei Avenue, and pulled smoothly into the Zhongbei Hospital parking lot 8 minutes later. He accompanied his father through the process of taking a number and queuing. During the blood draw, his father looked a bit nervous, so Ye Mingxuan quietly chatted about last night's car news to distract him. It was not until 9:45 that all the items (blood draw, ultrasound, electrocardiogram) were finished.
location: Tianjin Zhongbei Hospital Physical Examination Center, 76 Xingguang Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Returned home; father was resting.
description: While his father was eating breakfast in the waiting area, Ye Mingxuan had already settled the bill in advance. He drove his father home and said on the way, "Dad, go home and rest well. The results will be out this afternoon, and you can see them on WeChat." After arriving home, his father went to the living room sofa to watch TV and rest, while Ye Mingxuan headed to the study to deal with another important matter.
location: On the drive back from Tianjin Zhongbei Hospital to Huating International Community, then arrived home.

name: Compare and purchase self-driving travel accident insurance.
description: Ye Mingxuan sat at his desk, opened his laptop, and logged into the Alipay insurance channel. He first looked at Allianz's 'Antu Wuyou' plan, then compared Ping An's 'Highland Self-Drive Edition' and CPIC's 'Leyou Tianxia'. He focused on comparing key terms such as the coverage amount, emergency rescue, and whether highland activities at an altitude not exceeding 5,000 meters were covered. After careful consideration, he chose the product with the best value: 500,000 yuan in coverage, including emergency medical transport, with an annual premium of 368 yuan. He entered his personal information, paid by scanning a QR code, and then saved a screenshot of the key pages of the generated policy to the 'Qinghai Self-Drive Plan' folder.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Getting ready to head out for a family dinner.
description: After sorting out the insurance, Ye Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and changed into a brighter navy-blue wool sweater to look more spirited. He told his parents he would head off first, and that they would go with relatives' car later. He picked up his car keys, went out, and drove to Dasi Town.
location: On the drive from Huating International Community to Jinweixuan Restaurant

name: Family gathering with relatives and friends, and calmly responding to marriage pressure.
description: In the private room of the restaurant, relatives gathered around a table in a lively atmosphere. After a few courses, the conversation turned, as expected, to Ye Mingxuan's marriage prospects. His cousin aunt said with a smile, "Mingxuan, you really are a diamond bachelor now. Do you have a partner? Your Aunt Li's daughter has a master's degree and works as an executive at a foreign company. Why not meet her?" Ye Mingxuan didn't avoid the topic. He put down his chopsticks and said with a smile, "Auntie, thank you for your concern. I think this kind of thing depends on fate; it can't be rushed. I've just started to make progress in my career, and I want to build a solid foundation first. Only when I'm strong enough can I give the other person a stable future, don't you think?" His tone was sincere and his attitude calm. Seeing that he had his own plans, the elders let the subject drop and moved on to other topics.

participant.name: Uncles and other relatives and friends.

location: No. 128 Jingang Highway, Dasi Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, 'Zeyuan' Hall, Jinweixuan Restaurant

name: Drove home and had a heart-to-heart talk with his father on the balcony
description: After the dinner, Ye Mingxuan drove his parents home. Once home, he changed into slippers and, as usual, walked to the balcony with his father in tacit agreement. The winter sunlight spread warmly across the floor. Ye Mingxuan handed his father a cup of hot tea and said candidly, "Dad, you saw what happened today. It's not that I'm not anxious—I really want to have everything ready before getting married. I want to go to Qinghai first and also start saving for a house. I don't want to make the girl go through hardship with me." His father took a sip of tea, looked out the window, and said slowly, "I was like that when I was young, feeling I wasn't ready. Then I met your mother, and it happened naturally. It's good that you think this way; being steady is better, but don't put too much pressure on yourself. Dad supports you."
location: Balcony of home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Reading on the Balcony and Father-Son Reading Time
description: The afternoon on the balcony was quiet and pleasant. Ye Mingxuan took out the newly purchased Illustrated Study of Ming and Qing Furniture from the study and carefully studied the mortise-and-tenon structure diagrams inside, occasionally picking up his phone to zoom in on the images in the book. His father sat on the other side, wearing reading glasses and reading a copy of The Romance of the Yang Family Generals. When he reached an exciting part, his father cheerfully recounted the details of She Taijun taking command. Ye Mingxuan put down the book and responded with interest: "Dad, I think in those battles, logistics was actually more important than charging into battle; if the equipment couldn't keep up, everything else was useless." The father and son talked from storytelling to history, and then to the physical examination report just now, in a warm and relaxed atmosphere.
location: Balcony of home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Free activity: optimizing ancient coin program and stretching to relax
description: Back in the study, Ye Mingxuan opened the Python development environment. He remembered the ancient coin management program he had written last Saturday and felt that the “filter by dynasty” feature was not convenient enough. So he spent an hour adding a “filter by weight range” condition and wrote a set of test data. After running it successfully, he let out a long breath, stood up, and did a few simple shoulder, neck, and forward-bend stretches on the floor to relieve the fatigue of sitting for too long.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Went out to buy fresh ingredients and started cooking.
description: Ye Mingxuan glanced at the time, put on his coat, and decided to walk to the nearest fresh supermarket, “Qingzhixuan Boxiansheng Wanyuan Road Store,” to buy groceries. Following his planned list, he picked them out one by one: a live sea bass, a bunch of tender scallions and ginger, a head of broccoli, a chicken breast, and a box of wood ear mushrooms. On the walk home, he walked a bit faster, which counted as a little light exercise. After getting home, he tied on an apron and started prepping the ingredients: he cleaned the sea bass and rubbed it with cooking wine and ginger slices, broke the broccoli into florets and soaked them in lightly salted water, and sliced the chicken breast into thin pieces, marinating them with cornstarch and light soy sauce.
location: Walked from Huating International Residential Community to the Qingzhixuan Boxiansheng Wanyuan Road Store (Wanyuan Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin) and then returned home.

name: Personally cook a healthy dinner that is low in oil and low in salt
description: In the kitchen, Ye Mingxuan skillfully used a salt-restriction spoon and an oil-control pot. He first lit the fire and steamed the sea bass; then he started another pot of water to blanch the broccoli. Next came the step requiring the most skill — pan-frying the chicken breast. Because the oil temperature was slightly too high, the chicken breast in the pan gave off a cloud of smoke, which quickly triggered the kitchen smoke alarm. His mother Wang Xiulan hurried over at the sound and laughed: "Oh, Chef Xiao Ye, are you cooking or setting off a smoke bomb?" Ye Mingxuan scratched his head sheepishly: "Mom, I'll turn the heat down next time." He quickly turned down the flame and opened the window for ventilation. In the end, steamed sea bass, blanched broccoli with wood ear mushrooms, pan-fried chicken breast with less oil, and a bowl of mixed grain rice were successfully served.
location: Kitchen at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Enjoy a warm dinner with parents
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Ye Mingxuan introduced the dishes to his parents: 'The fish is steamed, with no oil; the chicken breast was pan-fried with a little oil, and the salt was controlled.' His father tasted a piece of fish and praised, 'Mmm, not bad, very fresh!' His mother also picked up a piece of chicken breast: 'Tender, this pan-fried one is okay.' At the table, Ye Mingxuan also talked about the details of screening insurance in the afternoon, saying he found a product that could cover self-driving on the plateau. His father was reassured and told him to put safety first when out and about.
location: Dining room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Tidy up the kitchen and chat with my mother
description: After dinner, Ye Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table and carry the dishes into the kitchen. His mother tied on an apron and started washing the dishes, while Ye Mingxuan dried them with a clean dish towel beside her, and the two chatted about family matters. 'Mom, what do you think of the person that cousin aunt introduced to me at noon today?' 'You should make your own decision. Mom respects you.' His mother smiled while scrubbing the pot and said, 'With your father backing you up, how would I dare to say too much?' Ye Mingxuan smiled knowingly at this.
location: Kitchen at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Family leisure and personal study time
description: After cleaning up, the family went to the living room. Ye Mingxuan turned on the TV and changed to the opera channel his father liked. He curled up in a corner of the sofa and used his phone's memo app to briefly record a few key decisions of the day: insurance purchased, the dinner gathering went well, and the father-son relationship took a step forward. After recording, he went back to the study, turned on his computer, and played two ranked matches in League of Legends with his college classmate Zhao Xiaofeng, chatting about Zhao's job-changing plan while playing. After the game, he opened Bilibili and watched a tutorial video about the Python Flask framework to learn something new.
location: Living room and study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After gaming and studying, Ye Mingxuan did his washing-up routine. He brushed his teeth carefully, washed his face, and applied basic moisturizer. Back in the bedroom, he took out the light blue shirt and dark trousers for work the next day and hung them on the hook behind the door. Then he checked his phone and charger, and set the alarm for 6:40 the next morning.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Write diary and reflections
description: Ye Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, opened his diary app, and recorded today's state of mind: “December 14, 2025, Sunday, sunny. The medical checkup with Dad went smoothly, and the insurance matter was settled too. It feels like I'm one step closer to Qinghai. At the family dinner, my responses were appropriate, without the awkwardness of previous years. The deep talk with Dad on the balcony made us more in tune with each other. The low-oil, low-salt dishes at dinner were well received by Mom and Dad. The family relationship has undergone a gentle recalibration, and I feel relieved.” After writing, he turned sideways and switched off the bedside lamp.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Outside the window the night was deep, and the neighborhood was quiet. Ye Mingxuan closed his eyes and ran through tomorrow's schedule in his mind. With the peace of mind of having completed the day's plan and the warmth of family, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home bedroom in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning routine
description: The alarm went off at 6:30 in the morning. After checking the weather and work messages, I did 15 minutes of core activation and dynamic stretching, including cat-cow pose and dead bug exercise. After washing up, I changed into a thick polo shirt and casual pants, and had breakfast with my mother, eating a bowl of millet porridge, two boiled eggs, and a small dish of Tianjin preserved vegetables. During the meal, we talked about the news that my father's physical exam results were normal. After breakfast, I packed my gym bag, work badge, car keys, and other items.
location: Home, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Drove to work.

It was already dark, the streetlights were on, and I drove smoothly into the neighborhood.
location: Driving from No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, to Huating International Community

name: Father-son inheritance of lathe skills and spinning top making.
description: After changing into an old hoodie and entering the garage, I cleaned up foam scraps and paper packaging bags, vacuumed the floor and corners, placed the wrenches, way oil, and cotton cloth on the workbench, and turned on the heater fan to preheat it to 20°C. At 18:30, my father Ye Jianguo arrived wearing a dark blue work jacket and carrying a canvas tool bag, and I welcomed him into the garage. First, he checked the smoothness of the slide rails, tightened the bolts, and listened to the motor running. Satisfied, he began to demonstrate the key operating points, explaining how much force to use when clamping the workpiece and the "feel" of chuck tightness, and demonstrated sanding with sandpaper. I quickly wrote down tips such as "judge the feed force by the sound of cutting." Then I got on the machine myself, chose an oak offcut, and turned a spinning top with my father guiding me. After more than twenty minutes, I completed a spinning top with smooth lines. My father took it, gave it a spin, and it spun steadily; he smiled, praised me, and kept it. At the end, my father instructed me on the three daily maintenance tasks, and we agreed to do maintenance together every month. I wrote down "the second Saturday afternoon of each month is maintenance day." After seeing my father off, I spent 15 minutes putting the tools back, cleaning up wood shavings and dust, and wiping down the slide rails, then turned off the lights and left.
location: Home garage, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: At-home core training

After training, he recorded the completion on his phone and sent Coach Wang a voice message reporting how the workout felt and promising to watch the diet over the weekend.
location: Living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

At 21:20, Liu Yang and Sun Jing came online, and we first played a game of League of Legends ARAM to warm up. Then Sun Jing asked about the progress of the transmission case weight reduction, so I shared my screen and showed the three options. Liu Yang, from an embedded systems perspective, suggested trying topology optimization to preserve the key load paths; Sun Jing, from a project management perspective, reminded me to first confirm the assembly weight tolerance limits with the client. The suggestions from both of them were very inspiring, and I took screenshots and saved them to my study notes.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

description: Opened the knowledge management notes and entered tonight's operation insights taught by my father—such as judging the feed by the sound and feeling the chuck force—along with technical suggestions from Liu Yang and Sun Jing, into the "Woodworking and Machinery" electronic notes by category. Afterwards, poured a glass of warm water, closed my eyes in the chair and cleared my mind for a few minutes, recalling the full day and feeling solid and calm.
location: Study at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

I sent a message to carpenter Qian Jianguo asking about sharpening and maintenance, and made an appointment to go to the woodworking shop tomorrow afternoon. Then you checked your phone for any urgent work messages from last night; seeing that everything was calm, you felt even more relaxed.

As you ate, you chatted briefly with her about how Father taught you the lathe the night before. Mother smiled and said, “Your dad just loves tinkering with those things. You two are really alike. As for Weizi, tell him to come home for a meal this weekend if he has time, instead of always eating hot pot outside.” You agreed and said you would set it up at dinner tonight.
location: Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

description: After breakfast, you changed into old work clothes and put on cut-resistant gloves. First you went to the garage, turned on the fan heater to preheat it, then from the scrap wood purchased online yesterday you picked out a piece of oak with smooth grain. Remembering the lesson from yesterday when you got stuck by a wood splinter, you first carefully sanded the edges and end faces of the wood with sandpaper to make sure the surface was smooth. Then you checked and confirmed that the lathe tool post and tailstock were locked, installed the sharpened high-speed steel turning tool, and confirmed that the emergency stop button was working properly.
location: Garage, Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: In-depth lathe practice in the garage
description: The core task of the morning. You started the lathe and began seriously practicing the chuck clamping and feed techniques your father taught you. First you turned several small-diameter cylinders to get a feel for the operation, focusing on the coordination between spindle speed and feed rate. After practicing for about half an hour, you switched to a slightly larger piece of wood, planning to try turning a more complex stepped shaft. Halfway through the turning, even though you were wearing cut-resistant gloves, a rough splinter on the wood that had not been sanded clean pricked your left index finger, and the pain made you flinch. You immediately stopped the machine, took off the gloves, and carefully pulled out the tiny wood splinter with tweezers. The wound was not deep, but a little blood oozed out. You bandaged it carefully, laughed at yourself wryly, and firmly kept the lesson in mind—subsequent work on blanks must be done more carefully. After resting for a moment, you adjusted your state and continued practicing.
location: Garage, Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

name: Clean and organize the garage.

You wiped down all the tools and put them back in place, and organized the used scraps and new wood. The garage was restored to a neat and orderly state.
location: Garage, Building 6, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, China

She was preparing steamed sea bass and garlic broccoli. While helping, you talked to her about your experience practicing on the lathe in the morning, mentioning that you got pricked by a wood splinter. Mother felt a little distressed and urged you to be very careful.

Father replied, “Every beginner goes through that. The key is to learn from it. Checking and sanding before cutting are basic skills.” You nodded in agreement. The steamed sea bass was delicious, and you ate quite a bit, together with broccoli — a balanced meal.
