location: Study, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Father-son shared reading and intergenerational debate on the balcony.
description: He brought fruit to the balcony, where his father had already brewed tea, and the two read "River Transport in the Ming Dynasty" together. The sun slanted westward with warm light. His father offered his view on the Ming Dynasty's maritime ban policy, believing that self-isolation and complacency led to decline. Ye Mingxuan, citing an alternative analytical framework from the book, rebutted by starting from the limitations of the natural economy during the Little Ice Age. Father and son debated calmly for about twenty minutes. Although they did not reach a consensus, they enjoyed the time of equal dialogue.
location: Balcony, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Light meal, getting ready to go out, and driving to the dinner gathering.
description: Mother reheated the leftover diced chicken and rice from noon and paired them with seaweed and egg drop soup as a simple meal. After eating, he quickly changed into a black turtleneck sweater and a dark blue work jacket, prepared his wallet, phone, and car keys, and deliberately put copies of recent design drawings into his bag to share. He left on time at 18:00, drove along Zhongbei Avenue-Fukang Road-Hongqi South Road-Baidi Road toward Nankai District, while rehearsing the technical problem-solving logic chain to share in the evening.
location: On the way from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Baidi Road, Nankai District

name: Year-end dinner with college classmates: shared the experience of tackling precision transmission components.
description: Arrived early at Jiangnan Kitchen on Baidi Road, Nankai District, greeted the classmates who had already arrived, and sat down. The atmosphere at the gathering was relaxed, and everyone shared their experiences of the past year. Ye Mingxuan took out a copy of the design drawing and described in detail the whole process of his independently designed precision transmission component, from being questioned to finally passing acceptance, including details such as finite element analysis optimization, weight reduction, and stress distribution iteration. His classmates listened attentively. Zhao Xiaofeng led the applause and praised him. This sharing made Ye Mingxuan once again confirm the clear trajectory of his professional growth.
location: Jiangnan Kitchen, Baidi Road, Nankai District, Tianjin

name: Returning home after the gathering, evening wash-up, and preparation for tomorrow.
description: After the gathering, he said goodbye to everyone and drove back along the same route, feeling happy. When he got home, he briefly shared the pleasant get-together with his parents, who were still awake. He went to his room to charge his phone and sports watch, and did some simple stretching for his legs and lower back to make up for not having formally exercised that day. Then he took a quick shower to wash off the smell of hot pot, changed into pajamas, and checked the backpack he would need the next morning (work badge, notebook, power bank, etc.) to make sure everything was ready.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and on the way back

name: Browsing before bed and reviewing the day.
description: Lying in bed scrolling through his phone, reviewing photos from the dinner gathering. Before turning off the light, he recorded the day's keywords in his memo: lathe tool sharpened, Hubu Guangxu recorded in the register, reduced-salt pickled mustard greens successful, father-son debate 4.0, smooth component sharing at the classmate dinner, and self-awareness reconfirmed. He turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Waking up early and preparing breakfast
description: Woken up by the alarm clock, I got up after some light stretching in bed. Looking out the window, the sky was gloomy, and I remembered the weather forecast said it would snow in the afternoon. While washing up, I deliberately used warm water and checked whether I had my scarf and gloves in my bag. Then my mother had already prepared breakfast: millet porridge, boiled eggs, and vegetable buns. Over breakfast, I chatted with her briefly about the traffic possibly being bad today and that I would leave a bit earlier. After eating, I quickly went down to the garage, checked the tire pressure and windshield washer fluid, cleared the thin ice from the front and rear windshields, and warmed up the car in advance.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Monday morning rush hour commute
description: Setting out from Huating International Residential Community, he drove to the Haitai Fazhan Office Building. Due to wet roads and heavy traffic, traffic was slow on Zhongbei Avenue. Ye Mingxuan stayed patient and drove steadily while listening to a tech podcast on his phone about a quick overview of new features in SolidWorks 2025, using the time to supplement his professional knowledge. In the end, it took him nearly 20 minutes longer than usual.
location: From Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to No. 6, Haitai Development Sixth Road, along the driving route

name: Arriving at work and warming up for the day
description: Arrived at the office area of Tianjin Haitai Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. on the 5th floor of Building B, Haitai Development Office Building. After parking the car, walked quickly into the office and sat down just before 9 o'clock. First turned on the computer, logged into the company OA system to clock in, then went to the pantry to make myself a cup of hot tea. Back at my workstation, opened the folder of 3D models of precision transmission components compiled last night, and prepared to start an efficient day of work.
location: Office area, 5th floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning work: final review of the precision transmission component plan and application for compensatory leave.
description: During the golden hours of the morning, I focused on the final review of the transmission assembly model. I opened SolidWorks and performed static interference checks on each part exported by the designers one by one, paying special attention to the assembly clearance between the bearing housing part that Zhou Tao was responsible for and the stiffening rib I designed. After finding a hidden interference point, I marked it precisely with the measurement tool and had a brief discussion with senior engineer Gao Zhiyuan. Gao approved the finding and gave fine-tuning suggestions. After completing the model corrections and updating the plan document, I packaged the results and sent them to Gao's email, and submitted an afternoon flexible work adjustment request in the company's internal workflow system. My colleague Zhou Tao passed by my workstation, asked what to eat for lunch, and confirmed the location and time of the evening dinner.
location: Office area, 5th floor, Building B, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6, Haitai Fazhan Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Weekday lunch and lunch break
description: As usual, the three went to Hongjie Malatang at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park near the company. Because it was Monday, the place was quite busy. Ye Mingxuan ordered a mildly spicy bone broth pot base with plenty of vegetables and a small amount of soy products. During the meal, Li Xiang brought up the topic of Python data processing. Ye Mingxuan shared a few concrete examples of using the Pandas library to process table data, saying they could discuss them in detail in the evening. Zhou Tao, on the other hand, complained about the schedule pressure on his project. After lunch, they returned to the company. His compensatory leave application had been approved, so he leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes. Then he cleaned up his desk, saved the phone number of an old supplier he planned to contact at the timber market in the afternoon, and opened a map app to check the bus route to the Outer Ring Timber Market in Xiqing District.
location: Sister Hong's Malatang shop at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 m east of the south gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin; and the workstation on the 5th floor of Building B, Haitai Development Office Building

name: Trip to the lumber market for supplies and return.
description: Changed into a more dirt-resistant jacket, took a canvas shopping bag and gloves, walked from the office to the Haitai Building bus stop, and waited for Bus No. 757. Took the bus to Hongfa Timber Wholesale Market at No. 17 West Outer Ring Road, Xiqing District, and went straight to the familiar stall, where the owner had already prepared the goods. Carefully checked the grain and dryness of three boxwood timbers, confirmed the diameters and lengths met requirements, and also picked several acrylic rods of different diameters. After the transaction, specifically asked for a receipt and took photos of the wood with his phone for records. Then carried the heavy bag of wood, took a bus back in the opposite direction, walked home after getting off, first moved the wood to the ground-floor garage, and unpacked it to let the wood acclimate to the temperature and humidity in the garage.
location: Haitai Building bus stop, Xiqing District, Tianjin; Hongfa Timber Wholesale Market, No. 17 West Outer Ring Road; and the home garage at Huating International Community

name: Home woodworking preparation and maintenance.
description: After putting the wood away, I went back inside, drank a glass of water, rested briefly, and organized the receipts and photos of the wood I had just purchased. Then I went to the garage, opened the dust cover of the lathe, first wiped down the bed rails and tailstock with a clean cotton cloth to remove dust, then applied lubricating oil to each lubrication point, and moved each handle to check whether the movement was smooth. Finally, I changed to the new high-speed steel lathe tool I had bought earlier, carefully adjusted the tool tip height and centering to prepare for the precise turning of the lantern connector parts, and carefully put away the old tool, planning to ask Master Qian for the essentials of hand sharpening next time I go to the woodworking shop.
location: Garage and living room at home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Resting at home and recording finances
description: After finishing work in the garage, he went back inside. His mother was already preparing ingredients for dinner and told him there would be a dinner gathering that evening. Ye Mingxuan responded, went to his room first, took off his coat, washed his face, then sat on the sofa, opened the mobile memo, and entered the specifications, prices, and receipt information of the wood purchased this afternoon into the household financial management spreadsheet, which was generated by a Python script he had written and could automatically categorize items and generate reports. Afterwards, he looked through the WeChat group for the evening gathering and confirmed that Zhou Tao and Li Xiang would both arrive on time.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Drive to the dinner venue
description: He changed into a casual jacket, said goodbye to his parents, and went out. Driving the family car, he followed the navigation guidance to Yuwei Fragrant Pot Restaurant on Baidi Road in Nankai District. Road conditions were acceptable, and the drive was smooth.
location: En route by car from Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Baidi Road, Nankai District

name: Year-end dinner and experience sharing with colleagues.
description: The three sat around a steaming mala xiangguo, and the mildly spicy flavor was just right. The conversation ranged from year-end project wrap-up to personal growth. Zhou Tao was extremely interested in the Python financial analysis script Ye Mingxuan had mentioned earlier. Ye Mingxuan started with the idea of writing an automated script because manual bookkeeping was tedious, then talked about how he systematically learned through online courses and successfully applied it to family financial management, and demonstrated the script's running interface on his phone on the spot. He also recommended two beginner resources to them: Learn Python the Hard Way and Runoob. Li Xiang then asked questions about the performance differences between Python and MATLAB in data visualization and matrix operations. The three discussed enthusiastically, and Ye Mingxuan's accumulated knowledge made him the technical speaker of the evening. After the meal, they said goodbye, and Ye Mingxuan drove home, with soft light music playing in the car, planning to go to the gym later tonight.
location: Yu Wei Xiang Guo Mala Xiangguo Restaurant, 168 Baidi Road, Nankai District, Tianjin, and on the return trip.

name: Evening workout
description: After arriving home, he didn't sit down to rest. He went straight to his room to change into quick-dry workout clothes, shorts, and running shoes, grabbed his gym bag, told his parents he was going to the gym, and drove a few minutes to Limei Fitness Center. After changing in the locker room, he did five minutes of dynamic stretching first. Tonight's workout was to make up for the session missed on Wednesday: squats 4 sets x 10 reps at 60 kg, bench press 4 sets x 8 reps at 45 kg, and seated rows 4 sets x 12 reps at 40 kg. Then he spent 30 minutes on the elliptical at medium resistance, keeping his heart rate around 140. At the end of the workout, he recorded the training data in a mobile app and especially noted his dinner in a message to his personal trainer Wang Jian. The coach replied that he should drink more water and weigh himself tomorrow morning.
location: Limei Fitness Center, Ziyang Road, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin, and home at Huating International Community

name: Pre-bed tidying, washing up, and going to sleep.
description: After returning home, I first did a 5-minute static stretch on the living room floor mat, covering the calves, back of the thighs, and thoracic spine, then took a hot shower in the bathroom to wash away my fatigue. I changed into pajamas, sat at the desk, took out a sticky note pad, and quickly jotted down today's key events and feelings: the model passed final review, I bought high-quality boxwood at the lumber market, I had a great time talking about Python at the dinner gathering, and I completed the make-up workout check-in. After closing the notebook, I briefly reviewed a few programming techniques from tonight's discussion in my head, feeling that my knowledge system had become more solid. I turned off the lights and went to bed, thinking that tomorrow I still need to follow up on the progress of the model revisions and read a chapter of 'Python Core Programming' during my lunch break.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Morning preparations at home and family breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, he got up. Opening the curtains, he saw light snow falling outside and the temperature was -4°C to 1°C, so he deliberately put on a thick fleece jacket to keep warm. While washing up, he combed his hair with a wooden comb and checked his work bag to make sure he had his work badge and car keys. Then he went to the dining room to have breakfast with his parents. His mother had prepared millet porridge, vegetable buns, and fried eggs. His father reminded him to drive slowly on the snowy and slippery roads. Ye Mingxuan drank three bowls of porridge, ate the buns and eggs, and quickly ran through the day's schedule in his mind.
location: Huating International Residential Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Commuting by car in snowy weather while listening to a tech podcast
description: Set off ten minutes earlier than usual. The road was slippery from snow, and traffic was slow on Zhongbei Avenue. Ye Mingxuan connected his Bluetooth, played the podcast "SolidWorks Tips and Optimization," and listened to the feature on "equation-driven modeling" for inspiration for the afternoon's transmission part modifications. He drove at a moderate speed the whole way and reached the company's underground parking garage in about 40 minutes.
location: Driving route from Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Binhai High-tech Zone

He checked the 'Transmission Component Model Modification Comments' sent by the senior engineer in the early morning and went through the three dimension-chain dimensioning issues one by one. Focusing on resolving the key interference points, he successfully eliminated static interference by adjusting assembly constraints and fine-tuning the tolerance band of the connecting shaft. He regenerated the engineering drawings, updated the fit dimensions, and wrote the modification records into the work log.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Wrap up work and have a brief exchange with colleagues.

Zhou Tao asked about the Python script shared earlier, and Ye Mingxuan forwarded it to him via WeChat. After a brief exchange, the three went downstairs together.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Colleague lunch: Huayuan Malatang
description: The three went to Sister Hong's Malatang Shop at Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, and each ordered a steaming bowl of malatang. During the meal, Li Xiang talked about the application of Python in simulation data processing. Ye Mingxuan, drawing on his morning experience modifying the model, mentioned that Python could be used to batch-process engineering drawing annotations. Zhou Tao complained that organizing project data was time-consuming, and Ye Mingxuan said he could further improve the script to add data processing functions.
location: Hongjie Malatang Restaurant, Tiankai Huayuan Science and Technology Park, 290 meters east of the South Gate of Huaxing Nanli, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Read technical books during the lunch break.
description: After returning to the office, he did not go to sleep right away. He opened Chapter 8 of "Core Python Programming," focused on file reading and writing operations, and quickly jotted down a few key functions in his notebook for later discussion. Then he leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for about 15 minutes.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Afternoon routine design tasks and assisting colleagues
description: After the lunch break, handled the lightweight design task for the transmission component housing. Colleague Zhou Tao brought a BOM sheet and asked for help checking the inventory codes for standard parts. Ye Mingxuan checked it against the company's material system, corrected 3 errors for him, and entered the electronic BOM into the shared folder.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Urgent task: material replacement for transmission components.
description: Senior Engineer hurried in with a customer feedback form, asking to change the material of a transmission part from 45# steel to 40Cr. Ye Mingxuan immediately stopped what he was doing, looked up the mechanical performance parameters of 40Cr, modified the model's material properties in SolidWorks, recalculated the static strength under maximum load to confirm the safety factor met the requirement, and notified Zhou Tao to update the relevant BOM. The whole process was completed within 40 minutes.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: End-of-day wrap-up and technical notes.
description: After submitting the revised plan, organized the meeting minutes and revision records for the day, and recorded 'Parameter Comparison of 40Cr and 45# Steel in Transmission Part Applications' as a technical note entry in my personal knowledge base, attaching calculation sketches and client feedback screenshots, then packed up my water bottle and notebook to get off work.
location: Office on the 2nd floor, Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Commute after work and pickup of community group purchase.
description: It was already getting dark when he left work, and the snow had stopped. He drove on the way to Yiyi Community Group-Buying Store in Zhongbei Town, parked at the entrance, scanned the code, and picked up the pre-ordered Aksu apples, Gannan navel oranges, and a box of family-size tissues. After carefully putting the items into the trunk, he continued driving home.
location: Drove from Haitai Development Office Building to Yiyi Community Group Buying Store, Room 104, Building 12, Menghe Garden, Yingyu Road, Xiqing District, Tianjin, then to Huating International Community.

name: Arrived home, tidied up, and conducted a comprehensive family first aid drill.
description: He carried the group-buy items into the house, and his mother took the fruit to wash. Ye Mingxuan changed into a home fleece jacket, went to the garage to quickly check the boxwood lumber and confirm it had no deformation, then returned to the living room to remind his father to start the final drill. The drill simulated a kitchen gas leak that caused his mother to fall and fracture a bone. His father turned off the gas valve, opened the window, and used a triangular bandage to secure his mother's right arm, while Ye Mingxuan recorded the whole process. Afterward, they watched the video together to review. Ye Mingxuan commented that the division of roles was clear and the handoffs were tight, more than a minute faster than last time, but suggested comforting the injured person before immobilizing the fracture.
location: Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin (garage, living room, and kitchen)

name: Family dinner and drill summary
description: Mother prepared stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato and egg soup, and braised beef in soy sauce in advance, and the family had dinner together. Ye Mingxuan led the family in a formal review, recorded the takeaways from the five drills over the two months in the family health diary, and noted, "Basic family first aid capability has been established." Father said that in the future, if something really happens, he won't feel panicked.
location: Restaurant in Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Wood inspection and mortise-and-tenon teaching model design
description: After dinner, after helping his mother clear the table, he went to the garage, turned on the dedicated work light, and checked three boxwood and acrylic rods to confirm they were not damp or cracked. Then he went to the study, opened CAD software, and, based on hand-drawn sketches, designed five detachable teaching models featuring dovetail joints, mitered tenons, sliding dovetails, wedged tenons, and clamp tenons. He created 3D models one by one, annotated dimensions, tolerances, and assembly order, and used Boolean operations to simulate the sliding dovetail connection to ensure no interference. After finishing, he exported the drawings as PDF, printed them, and bound them into a drawing set.
location: Garage and study room, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Prepare equipment for online gathering
description: Stopped design work, put the printed drawings into a folder, took the tablet to the small desk in the bedroom, plugged it in, confirmed the microphone and camera were working, opened the video conferencing software, and set up the meeting room invitation link.
location: Study and bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: The year's last online roommates gathering
description: He entered the video conference room on time and met online with college roommate Liu Yang and classmate Sun Jing. Liu Yang shared lessons from a project delay in Shenzhen's electronics industry; Sun Jing shared insights from leading a team as a project manager; Ye Mingxuan talked about his promotion to senior engineer and independently chairing technical review meetings, and mentioned the mortise-and-tenon model he had just designed. Sun Jing suggested an in-person reunion in Tianjin or Beijing during next May Day holiday. Liu Yang agreed, and Ye Mingxuan smiled and promised to try to have the physical teaching model ready by then.
location: Bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Neck and shoulder stretches and bedtime washing up.
description: After the gathering, my shoulders felt a bit stiff, so I did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relax the muscles. Then I went to the bathroom and washed my face with alternating cold and hot water to fully unwind.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Bedtime journal and professional reading
description: Took out the diary and used a fountain pen to record today's key points: completed the senior engineer's ad hoc task, wrapped up the family first-aid drill, finished the first drafts of CAD drawings for five mortise-and-tenon models, and confirmed at the online gathering that a possible offline meetup could happen next May Day. After writing, he felt fulfilled and calm. Then he read the "Mortise and Tenon Joints" section in the "Mechanical Design Manual," focusing on the mechanical calculation models of traditional mortise-and-tenon joints, to build theoretical preparation for later practical processing. After reading, he turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: By the desk and on the bed in the bedroom, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast.
description: After getting up, Ye Mingxuan quickly washed up and changed into business casual clothes: a dark blue wool suit jacket, a light gray shirt, and black trousers. He put his laptop, interview folder, and spare pen into his commuter bag, and carried an epinephrine pen and throat lozenges with him. Then he had a low-oil, low-salt breakfast with his parents, including millet porridge, boiled eggs, whole wheat steamed buns, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. During the meal, he mentioned today's annual performance review, showing expectation and confidence. His father briefly responded, "Just know what you're doing," and his mother told him not to be nervous and to speak well.
location: Home, Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.

name: Listened to a PMP podcast while commuting by car

On the way, he connected his phone via Bluetooth and played a PMP exam prep podcast, focusing on the chapters about developing the project charter and identifying stakeholders. At the same time, he browsed the Yiyi Community Group Buying WeChat group and saw the Christmas fruit gift box list, so he decided to pick up the items on the way during the afternoon commute.
location: Tianjin Xiqing District, self-driving route: from Huating International Community, Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, to Haitai Development Office Building, No. 6 Haitai Development Sixth Road

He also wrote keywords such as 'independently chaired,' 'cross-department collaboration,' and 'resource planning' on sticky notes. Then he checked his work emails, handled two routine supplier emails, replied to Zhou Tao's question about the BOM verification process, and browsed the OA announcements to confirm that the Q1 action plan submission deadline was next Monday.

At 10 o'clock, Senior Engineer Gao Zhiyuan arrived on time and affirmed Ye Mingxuan's work throughout the year item by item, especially praising his ability to independently chair the external review meetings and his collaborative spirit in proactively assisting colleagues, giving an A-grade evaluation. Ye Mingxuan then formally proposed his 2026 career goals: take the PMP exam in the first half of the year and lead the automation project in the second half. Senior Engineer Gao expressed full support, promised to give preference in project allocation and resources, and suggested first auditing two internal project management training sessions.

He saved it in a dedicated folder. Next, he handled the remaining work emails and sent a message to Zhou Tao sharing that he had earned an A-level evaluation, and they agreed to celebrate over coffee in the afternoon.

name: After-work commute
description: He left work on time and drove home along the familiar route. It was already dark and the streetlights were on. He mentally sorted through the evening task list: checking materials, filing, publishing the blog post, putting postcards into albums, data analysis, and so on. Everything was proceeding in an orderly manner.
location: In Xiqing District, Tianjin, from Haitai Development Office Building on Haitai Fazhan 6th Road to Huating International Community on Zhongbei Avenue

name: After arriving home, inspect materials and archive reports.
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, Ye Mingxuan first went to the study to check the supply bag for tomorrow’s lantern festival event, going through each item—connectors, wooden sticks, colored paper, and so on—to confirm everything was complete, and placed the canvas bag by the door. Then he took out the family emergency archive box from the bookshelf, consolidated the previously scattered first-aid drill records into an annual summary report, printed and filed it, and updated the first-aid procedure reminder card on the refrigerator.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Dinner and rest
description: During dinner, his mother prepared home-style dishes, and the family of three ate and chatted. Father talked about what he saw and heard while playing chess in the park that afternoon, and mother asked whether help was needed for tomorrow's lantern festival event. After dinner, Ye Mingxuan helped clear the table, then rested briefly on the living room sofa to recharge for the evening's core tasks.
location: Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Write and publish the annual blog post.
description: Ye Mingxuan sat down at his desk on time and, based on the mental draft he had formed that afternoon, began writing his annual essay “2025, I Bought Regrets and I Bought Growth.” He reviewed the pressure and joy of buying a house at the beginning of the year, the worry caused by his father's rising blood pressure, the recognition of being promoted to senior engineer, the excitement of the lathe arriving, and the shift in mindset from attending the improvisational theater workshop. At the end of the article, he wrote: “This small lathe is not just equipment; it represents my leap from the ‘handcraft era’ to the ‘precision manufacturing era.’ Next year, see you at Qinghai Lake, to chase that free wind.” After writing, he proofread it twice before clicking publish, and forwarded the blog link to WeChat Moments with the caption “2025, thank you for all the experiences.”
location: Study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Inserting the postcard and the self-driving ceremony
description: After publishing the blog post, Ye Mingxuan took out the hand-drawn Qinghai road trip postcard sent by Li Na from the document folder and looked again at the encouraging words on the back under the light. Then he opened his self-driving trip preparation notebook, carefully placed the postcard on the first page of the "Qinghai Road Trip" chapter, and wrote "December 31, 2026, anchor" beside it as motivation for the future road trip.
location: Study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Completed analysis of December training data.
description: Ye Mingxuan opened the trend chart he had compiled on the computer in the afternoon, compared the November and December training data, and found that his bench press weight had increased slightly and his body fat percentage remained stable in a healthy range. Based on this, he projected the body fat control target before the Spring Festival and marked 'Schedule body composition test with Coach Wang' on his phone calendar.
location: Study, Huating International Community, No. 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin

name: Watched the New Year's Eve gala with parents and counted down to midnight.
description: Ye Mingxuan left his study and went to the living room to watch the New Year's Eve gala with his parents. His mother laughed uproariously at the comedy sketches, and his father was full of praise for the opera performances. Ye Mingxuan used his phone to reply to friends' likes and comments on his annual blog post. Near midnight, his father raised a thermos cup and gave a toast to the family, while his mother teased him about getting married. When the countdown reached zero, sporadic fireworks could be heard outside the window, cheers continued on TV, and the new home completed its first full cycle of four seasons.
location: Living room, Huating International Community, 128 Zhongbei Avenue, Zhongbei Town, Xiqing District, Tianjin.
